Under the supervision of the Nurse Manager, the night shift Unit Supervisor at the Orange County Correctional Facility is responsible for the day-to-day operations of a designated nursing unit which includes ensuring quality patient care is being provided in accordance with established nursing practices and procedures. May serve as the Nurse Manager in her/his absence.

Job Description

General Functions:
Under the supervision of the Nurse Manager, this position is responsible for the day-to-day operations of a designated nursing unit which includes ensuring quality patient care is being provided in accordance with established nursing practices and procedures. May serve as the Nurse Manager in her/his absence.
Representative Duties/Assignments:


  • Directs and oversees the activities of LPNs, RNs, MAs, Lab Technicians and other assigned staff. Duties include but are not limited to:




    • a. Instructing, educating and reviewing the work of others.

    b. Maintaining standards of the division.

    c. Directing personnel to include work assignments, counseling and corrective discipline.

    d. Preparing work schedules.

    e. Acting on inmate and employee problems.

    f. Submitting employee payroll documents on time.

    g. Assists staff with the completion of med passes, physical assessments, and sick calls.




  • Maintain employee records, which would include accurate attendance records, documented poor work habits and corrective discipline issues, and efficiency reports.


  • Holds monthly staff meetings and makes daily rounds of assigned areas.


  • Assist physicians, nurses and other staff in the provision of care.


  • Performs other related duties as assigned.



Minimum Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in Nursing, medicine and/or any related allied health profession and four years as a registered nurse with at least two of those years in a supervisory capacity. Directly related experience may be substituted for the education requirement on a year for year basis.


Must possess a current Florida license as a registered nurse.
BCLS certification.
Must be able to work shifts, including nights and weekends.

Preferences:
Experience in correctional healthcare.

Proficient in IV therapy and phlebotomy.

Application Deadline

Open Date: 11/02/2026
Close Date: 11/30/2026

This posting is subject to close without prior notice.

Salary Information

Pay Grade: 021 - From $40.39 to $52.50
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt

Placement based on Education and Experience

Benefits

  • 10 paid holidays and up to 2 floating holidays annually.
  • 18 days paid time off per year.
  • Longevity bonus based on years of service.
  • 6 days of paid TERM (sick) time annually.
  • Low-cost medical, dental, vision, additional life insurance.
  • Free basic life, long term disability, and employee assistance for all the family members effective on day one.
  • Participation in the Florida Retirement System.
  • Employee assistance program includes multiple free one on one sessions with licensed counselors and online tools for legal advice, financial planning, personal life balance, etc.
  • Free access to Wellworks gyms and Orange County Recreation Centers.
  • Free onsite wellness coaching, including dietician and nurse.
  • Tuition reimbursement program.
  • Earn service time to forgive student loans.

Disclaimer: Benefits may vary for employees under collective bargaining agreements.

For more information on Benefits visit - https://www.ocfl.net/EmploymentVolunteerism/EmployeeBenefits.aspx

Veterans Preference

If you are claiming Veterans' Preference, you are responsible for providing the required eligibility documentation by the closing date of the posting. Please scan and upload a copy of your cover letter and supporting documents, to Orange County Human Resources Division via the secure Box.com folder.

Your cover letter should include the Job ID number you are applying for, the title of the position, your full name and the last 4 digits of your social security number. *If you are a current employee returning from active military service, you may be eligible for promotion preference if the active military service qualifies for Veterans' Preference. Please note that Veterans' Preference applies only to a Veterans' first promotion after reinstatement or reemployment, without exception.

Educational Requirements

If your education was obtained in the United States, the County recognizes degrees or diplomas which are accredited by an agency recognized by the United States Department of Education (USDE) or the Council for Higher Education Accreditation (CHEA). If you have obtained education from a country other than the United States, your degree or diploma must be evaluated to determine the United States equivalency by a member of the National Association of Credential Evaluation Service (NACES) or the Association of International Credentials Evaluations (AICE) at your expense.

Address

This position is located at the Orange County Correctional facility located in Orlando, Florida

Notes

Selected candidates will be required to provide employment references and will be required to complete fingerprints, a pre-employment drug, physical and background check.

Business & Municipal Banking Sales Manager

Reports to: Branch Administration Officer

FLSA Status: Exempt | Supervisory Role: Yes

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. If you are ready to lead impactful banking solutions, drive client success, and excel in a collaborative environment, we invite you to become a pivotal part of our innovative banking family. Your expertise will help shape the future of treasury and municipal banking services—apply today to make a meaningful difference.

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. As a valued team member, you will be eligible for a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, a health savings account with an annual employer contribution, a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous employer match, paid time off plus 11 paid federal holidays, training and professional development programs, tuition reimbursement, reduced fees and rates on certain loan products, and much more!

About the Treasury Services & Municipal Banking Manager Role

Are you a dynamic banking professional with a passion for innovative treasury and municipal banking solutions? Join us as the Treasury Services & Municipal Banking Manager, where you'll spearhead the development, implementation, and ongoing management of vital financial services that empower our business clients and municipal partners. This role offers an exceptional opportunity to lead strategic initiatives, foster client relationships, and drive departmental excellence within a forward-thinking financial institution.

As a key architect of our treasury and municipal banking services, you will champion the sales, onboarding, and continuous support of deposit accounts, cash management products, and municipal banking solutions. Your leadership will ensure seamless client experiences, operational efficiency, and compliance with regulatory standards—setting the stage for mutual growth and success.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Leadership & Brand Promotion: Cultivate and elevate the bank's treasury services identity, advocating for innovative solutions, and fostering a culture of ownership and accountability to enhance customer satisfaction and departmental performance.
  • Client Onboarding & Relationship Management: Open, maintain, and grow treasury management accounts for diverse business clients, ensuring tailored services meet their evolving needs.
  • Operational Excellence: Execute and oversee operational duties related to cash management products, ensuring accuracy, efficiency, and adherence to best practices.
  • Primary Client Liaison: Serve as the main point of contact for deposit-related inquiries, providing expert guidance and timely resolution for commercial clients utilizing treasury management services.
  • Systems & Regulatory Oversight: Manage communication and coordination of system upgrades, enhancements, and changes; develop and refine procedures to ensure regulatory compliance and operational integrity.

This job description is not exhaustive; duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet tight deadlines.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and collaboratively.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, especially Excel and Word.
  • Fluent in English; bilingual a plus
  • Access to reliable transportation

Preferred

  • Minimum of 2 years' experience in Commercial Banking or Cash Management services/support, with comprehensive knowledge of deposit products.
  • At least 2 years' experience in Municipal Banking and Public Deposits services/support.
  • Master's degree in Business or a related discipline.

Schedule

Full-time position. Monday – Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM (evenings/weekends as needed)

Physical Demands:

Primarily sedentary; includes use of standard office equipment.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, or protected veteran status. JOB SUMMARY:

As Learning Experience Designer within the Leadership Capability & Learning COE, you are the teams primary design expert responsible for translating strategic capability priorities into high-quality, engaging, and effective development experiences (e-learning, instructor-led training, etc.). You create solutions that are modern, immersive, and genuinely impactful. Where others see a slide deck, you see an opportunity for a simulation. Where others see a workshop, you see a multi-modal experience that extends into the flow of work. Where others see a leadership program, you see a design challenge.

You work in close partnership with the Sr. Manager, Leadership Capability, who sets the strategic design direction diagnosing capability gaps and defining what behavior change needs to happen. Your role is to bring that direction to life with craft, creativity, a deep understanding of how adults learn, and a strong point of view on the tools, technologies, and emerging practices that can make learning more effective. You operate with significant creative autonomy within that partnership, bringing your own ideas, pushing the boundaries of what development experiences can be, and continuously raising the bar for what great looks like.

Beyond individual experiences, you are also the visual and design standard-bearer for the COE. You own how this function presents itself to leaders, the business, and the broader organization. That means owning the COE's visual design standards and templates so that every deliverable that comes out of this function looks and feels like it belongs to the same world.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design & Build Immersive Learning Experiences
    • Design and build simulations, scenario-based experiences, experiential labs, and immersive learning environments that put leaders in realistic situations and require them to make real decisions.
    • Develop engaging, high-quality e-learning and digital learning assets that extend development into the flow of work, not just for formal learning moments but for the spaces in between.
    • Translate the defined capability priorities and design direction into concrete learning experiences, bringing creative solutions to the build.
    • Prototype rapidly, pilot with real learners, gather feedback, and iterate, always optimizing for behavior change over production polish.
    • Build a reusable library of design assets, templates, and components that accelerate future work and ensure design consistency across the COE's portfolio.
  • Set & Own Visual Design Standards
    • Establish and maintain visual design standards for the Leadership Capability & Learning COE defining the look, feel, and quality bar for all deliverables including program materials, participant guides, presentations, and digital assets.
    • Build a template library that is practical, flexible, and easy for others to use so that design standards get maintained even when you are not the one producing the output.
    • Bring visual storytelling expertise to the design of leadership experiences, ensuring that the narrative arc of every program, module, and asset is as intentional as its instructional design.
    • Translate complex leadership concepts, capability frameworks, and development models into visuals that are immediately legible to a theme park operations leader as much as to an HR professional.
    • Elevate the quality of how the COE communicates its strategy, impact, and value through decks, one-pagers, infographics, and other visual communication formats.
  • Own Learning Technology & Innovation
    • Own all internal instructional design and learning production tools selecting, managing, and maintaining proficiency in the technologies that power the COE's design work.
    • Actively monitor and experiment with emerging learning technologies including AI-powered development tools, immersive and simulation platforms, adaptive learning technologies, and other innovations reshaping how people develop.
    • Bring a point of view on what the COE should be doing differently based on what you are seeing in the field not just executing on existing ideas but challenging the standard.
    • Partner with Learning Operations on any technology decisions that intersect with leader-facing platforms, ensuring alignment on sustainability, budget, and operational support. Integrate AI meaningfully into design and delivery not as a gimmick but as a genuine capability enabler that makes development more personalized, more scalable, and more effective.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Instructional Design, Learning Technology, experience design, or a related field or equivalent demonstrated experience with a portfolio that proves it.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years of experience designing and building learning or development experiences end to end.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in e-learning authoring tools such as Articulate Storyline, Articulate Rise, Adobe Captivate, or equivalent.
  • Strong visual design and visual communication skills with a portfolio that demonstrates high-quality, polished work across multiple formats and modalities. Portfolio submission is required with application.
  • Working knowledge of adult learning theory and learning science, with the ability to articulate why design choices work and how they connect to how adults actually learn.
  • Experience designing beyond the classroom (simulations, scenario-based learning, experiential modules, or immersive digital learning assets).
  • Proficiency in PowerPoint or equivalent presentation design at a genuinely high visual standard.
  • Preferred:
    • Experience with AI-powered learning tools, immersive learning platforms, or adaptive learning technologies.
    • Experience establishing or contributing to visual design standards, template systems, or brand guidelines for a team or function.
    • Background in experience design, interaction design, or UX even if not in an L&D context.
    • Experience working in a COE, consulting environment, or complex matrixed organization where strategic direction was often ambiguous and design solutions had to be built without a complete brief.
    • Experience in a fast-moving, operationally complex industry hospitality, entertainment, retail, or similar environments where practicality and speed matter as much as craft quality.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for preventative and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of animation, special effects, and ride/show control and electrical systems. Install, maintain, test, troubleshoot and repair industrial electrical equipment.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs preventative and predictive maintenance as prescribed by OEM and UO Engineering specifications. This includes changing time-limited parts, calibrating equipment per OEM specifications and cleaning, lubricating, and maintaining equipment. Installs, services, and repairs electrical wiring, fixtures and other electrical components.
  • Completes inspections and creates necessary work orders for discrepancies found. Performs electrical tests and inspections including measuring continuity, current, voltage and resistance of electrical and electronic systems. Follows correct chain of command to notify appropriate management when necessary.
  • Performs repairs to equipment due to safety, reliability, or show quality issues found during PMs, inspections or downtimes to improve ride reliability and show quality. Ensures that electrical systems are properly grounded and maintained in accordance with OEM and Engineering specifications. Responds to and assists in recovery and repair of attractions and show effects as needed.
  • Troubleshoots down to failed component using multiple forms of test equipment, schematics, prints and other resources. Troubleshoots systems to root cause. Troubleshoot, maintain, repair, test and install electrical motors, generators, hydraulic, pneumatic and electrical control systems.
  • Performs modifications of electrical systems per UO Engineering or OEM specifications and direction.
  • Enters follow-up work orders for all discrepancies found. Documents all findings and work performed throughout the process of troubleshooting and performing repairs. Reports labor in Maximo for all work performed.
  • Completes PQS qualification of assigned venues. Trains new technicians to do venue-specific PM work orders, recovery procedures and processes.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

SCOPE:

Responsible for inspection, troubleshooting and repair of animation, special effects and ride and show control systems resort wide.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree or GED is Required
  • Technical school is Preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3-5 Years: Experience in troubleshooting and repair of complex electro-mechanical systems, as well as hydraulic and mechanical systems either in the theme park industry or other industrial industries
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

Valid Florida Drivers License - required to operate company vehicles

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Special requirements for certain specific venues may require the operation of controlled decent devices down severely angled lifts - Training is required and will be provided prior to performing the inspections.
  • Special requirements for certain specific venues may require the operation of high reaches greater than 85ft - Training is required and will be provided prior to performing the inspections

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Automotive Technician / Mechanic, Construction & Skilled Trades
Job.JobDescription:
New Pay Rates Starting at $30.00/hr

Industrial Electrical/Electronics Technician (Ride & Robotics):

Seeking qualified technicians who are responsible for preventative and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting and repair of animation, special effects, and ride/show control and electrical systems. Install, maintain, test, troubleshoot and repair industrial electrical equipment.

Essential Duties Include:

  • Performs daily, weekly, monthly, semi-annual and annual inspections and preventative maintenance on Ride and Show control systems. Inspections include testing, verification and/or calibration of applicable control systems.
  • Identifies system deficiencies and recommending immediate and long-term corrective action to decrease maintenance costs and decrease down times of ride vehicles. This involves researching defective mechanically-controlled items/parts, instructional information to complete the repair process when needed, referring to technical manuals, technical library, and the CMMS system while utilizing a systematic approach.
  • Reads and interprets electrical and mechanical schematics, blueprints and technical documentation.
  • Maintains PLC controllers and/or variable speed motors.
  • Troubleshoots Electrical Control Systems and understands sensor technology. Possessing the knowledge of testing equipment and having the ability to operate digital/analog circuitry, volt/amp meter, and chart recorder up to 480v.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned

Ride Mechanic:

Seeking qualified technicians who are responsible for preventative and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of animation, special effects, and ride/show mechanical systems.

Essential Duties Include:

  • Maintains, both preventive and corrective, Ride and Show mechanical systems.
  • Participates in the testing, verification and/or calibration of applicable mechanical systems.
  • Responds to down times and both show element quality repair and ride recovery related issues.
  • Performs assembly and disassembly for annual inspections and verifying quality control/NDT requirements have been met.
  • Logs completion of inspections, corrective action and/or repairs made and listing applicable parts used.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
    Performs other duties as assigned

EXPERIENCE:

Experience in a commercial/construction/industrial setting is required

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

Valid Florida Drivers License

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Positions in Ride & Show require:

  • Ability to stand for long periods of time
  • Ability to lift and or move between 20 and 50 pounds
  • Working outdoors in all weather conditions

Contributes to routine, capital, and expense budgeting and sets direction and priorities of all maintenance functions for the area of responsibility. Manages and leads technical staff to include continuous improvement, personal development, and administration in area of responsibility.   • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Technical school is preferred
  • Associates degree (AA) in General Education or Technology is preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years in technical and trade experience are required
  • 1+ year of supervisory experience is required
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Manages all maintenance activities for rides, shows, and guest interactive areas for specific area
  • Manages routine, expense and capital budgets for specific area
  • Supervises all hourly personnel in specific area
  • Complete PQS for primary venues of responsibility within 6 months
  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws

Job.JobTitle: Technical Delivery Senior Consultant, Qualtrics (CX / XM)
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work You'll Do

As a Delivery Senior Consultant, Customer Experience on the Customer Strategy & Design team, you will be responsible for:

  • Translating customer experience program objectives into Qualtrics Experience Management (XM) solution designs that define survey architecture, data models, workflows, and integration requirements.
  • Configuring and optimizing Qualtrics surveys, embedded data, dashboards, automations, and logic for enterprise feedback programs.
  • Building secure integrations between Qualtrics and customer relationship management, human resources information systems, and data warehouse platforms using application programming interfaces, web services, or single sign-on.
  • Deploying unmodified Qualtrics-provided Website/App Insights code in approved global headers or footers; avoiding multiple concurrent snippets; and testing data flow, intercepts, reporting, and workflow performance before production releases.
  • Analyzing customer feedback data, building role-based dashboards, and training stakeholders on reporting and workflow use to support experience management adoption.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Customer Strategy & Design team discovers, designs, and prototypes customer growth strategies and innovation portfolios.

This opportunity sits within our Center talent model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the center model provides high-quality services to our clients. Center professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree preferably in computer science, information systems, data analytics, software engineering, or business analytics.
  • 2+ years of experience configuring Qualtrics Experience Management (XM) Platform surveys, workflows, embedded data, dashboards, and reporting.
  • 2+ years of experience designing integrations between cloud platforms and customer relationship management (CRM), human resources information systems (HRIS), or data warehouse platforms using application programming interfaces (APIs), web services, or single sign-on (SSO).
  • 2+ years of experience analyzing customer feedback data and creating dashboard-based reporting.
  • 2+ years of experience using JavaScript or Python to create survey logic, automate platform workflows, or deploy website feedback code.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance

Preferred:

  • Qualtrics certification.
  • 1+ years of experience advising clients on best-practices of configuration for data collection.
  • 1+ years of experience delivering platform demos and technical walkthroughs to business stakeholders, translating data-driven findings into clear action.
  • 1+ years of experience integrating Qualtrics with Salesforce, SAP, or Slack.
  • 1+ years of experience supporting federal, state, or local government agencies or public higher education institutions.
  • 1+ years of experience configuring solutions in environments subject to Federal Risk and Authorization Management Program (FedRAMP) requirements.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $110,700 to $218,300.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Deloitte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruiting process, please direct your inquiries to the Global Call Center (GCC) at USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com.

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

Benefits

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas, and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. Learn more.

Professional development

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there's always room to learn. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.

JOB SUMMARY:

Provides complex planning and scheduling support to executive management in lead capacity of planning/scheduling responsibilities at the Portfolio, PMO, or land level development project assignments. Supports the project team with planning and schedule development on large multi-disciplined program(s)/project(s) throughout the entire project life cycle spectrum from concept development through turnkey completions, consistent with project needs and appropriate policies and procedures. Scope of planning and scheduling responsibilities include development/establishment of program/project schedules, show/ride concept development, show, ride, facility, area development designs, building construction, show/ride production, installation, and commissioning stages.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Prepares program project life cycle and project master schedules and statuses the project schedules utilizing Primavera software. Develops comprehensive plans and schedules from multiple discipline drawings and specifications. Prepares project plans and works with scoping/strategy documents to develop integrated project master schedules. Prepares schedule contract milestones for bid packages.
  • Provides project team with Schedule guidance during all phases of the project. Coordinates with estimating/finance teams to develop appropriate level of detail scope definition and durations for schedule activities to support project monitoring and project controls reporting needs. Coordinates with contractors, vendors, and responsible project team members to develop and integrate activity durations and logic sequences required to perform project work. Integrates project schedule input from all internal and external project organizations.
  • Leads planning and coordination meetings as required to support planning and monitoring functions. Collects/reports progress, evaluates progress variances, develops work-around plans, and coordinates resolution of variances. Conducts resource loading/resource analysis and develops and statuses earned value tracking tools and progress curves as required. Produces reports as required to support project team needs and executive management reporting. Frequently communicates, reports, and interacts with project and core team members including vendors and outside consultants on complex topics.
  • Implements highly effective project control tools and reports and provides insightful analysis that contributes to schedule certainty.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS: 

  • Proven prior project controls leadership, supervisory experience preferred
  • Solid working knowledge of theme parks, show/ride product lines and design and construction.
  • 8+ years of primavera scheduling experience required
  • Possess strong understanding of design and construction progress measurement.
  • Working knowledge of architectural/engineering and show and ride design and production.
  • Must be a well-organized self-starter with strong communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Solid understanding of practical project controls applications and earned value measurement.
  • Ability to supervise staff, consultants, and suppliers including setting goals, prioritization of tasks, coordinating work, and managing time.
  • Strong meeting leadership, facilitation, and alignment skills
  • Strong communication, collaboration, technical writing, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to successfully influence and lead a team.
  • Ability to appropriate delegate and coach/mentor talent.
  • Ability to successfully negotiate schedule changes with vendors and contractors.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills
  • Thorough knowledge of planning techniques

EDUCATION:

Bachelors degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or an applicable field required. Advanced degrees preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

9+ years engineering/construction planning and scheduling experience required. 8+ years theme park planning/coordination experience preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Director of Audience Science is a key leader within UDX Commercial Advanced Data Analytics, responsible for Audience Science across UDX destinations. The role leads a multidisciplinary team that develops audience strategies, segmentation, predictive models, experimentation, journey measurement, and decision-support capabilities.

The Director partners with Marketing, Digital, Product, Operations, Technology, Finance, and destination teams to translate guest and commercial data into measurable improvements in marketing performance, guest experience, and revenue. The role sets the team roadmap, develops talent, guides data and platform priorities, and ensures analytics capabilities are scalable, actionable, and embedded in business decisions.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Team Leadership and Operating Model
    • Set the team strategy, roadmap, priorities, and operating model in alignment with UDX commercial objectives.
    • Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary analytics team while building succession and critical capabilities.
    • Manage the portfolio of recurring delivery, strategic initiatives, and emerging business needs.
    • Establish consistent standards for analytical quality, stakeholder engagement, and delivery.
    • Partner with senior leaders to prioritize investments in data, technology, and talent.
  • Audience Science and Personalization
    • Lead segmentation, predictive modeling, experimentation, audience strategy, and personalization across marketing and digital channels.
    • Guide the development and adoption of scalable customer and audience data, identity, activation, decisioning, and measurement capabilities.
  • Guest and Journey Analytics
    • Own journey analytics priorities and standards across UDX destinations.
    • Lead analyses that identify guest behavior, needs, friction, and opportunities across the end-to-end journey.
    • Integrate audience, behavioral, transactional, operational, and experience data to produce actionable insights.
    • Partner with Marketing, Digital, Product, Operations, and destination teams to translate findings into prioritized and testable improvements.
    • Establish impact tracking that connects journey improvements to guest, commercial, and operational outcomes.
  • Commercial Strategy and Measurement
    • Translate analytics into commercial decisions, measurable financial outcomes, and prioritized actions across UDX destinations.
    • Establish measurement frameworks and controlled testing that quantify marketing, guest, and commercial impact.
    • Provide executives and channel leaders with clear recommendations that improve performance and support a guest-centric approach.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Demonstrated leadership of advanced analytics or data science teams, including talent development and operating-model design.
  • Expertise in segmentation, predictive modeling, experimentation, causal measurement, personalization, and journey analytics.
  • Experience developing audience and guest analytics strategies across marketing, digital, and destination touchpoints.
  • Ability to translate complex analyses into measurable guest, commercial, and operational outcomes.
  • Experience with customer and audience data platforms, identity and activation platforms, cloud data and analytics environments, visualization, experimentation, measurement, and decisioning technologies.
  • Experience partnering with Marketing, Digital, Product, Operations, Technology, Finance, and other cross-functional teams.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and communicate complex findings through concise recommendations.
  • Strong program and product management skills with the ability to manage competing priorities.
  • Strong guest and stakeholder focus with the ability to build effective working relationships.
  • Intellectual curiosity and a commitment to continuous learning.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in data science, statistics, economics, computer science, marketing analytics, business, or a related quantitative field required; equivalent relevant experience may be considered.
  • Masters or Ph.D. in a quantitative field preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 10+ years of experience in advanced analytics, data science, marketing analytics, commercial analytics, or a related field, including experience with guest or customer data, measurement, and experimentation.
  • 5+ years of experience leading analytics or data science teams and developing technical talent.
  • Demonstrated record of building scalable analytics capabilities and translating insights into measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience partnering with senior leaders and cross-functional teams to deliver enterprise initiatives; experience applying AI and intelligent automation to analytics workflows is preferred.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Branch Manager

Reports to: Regional Vice President

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt | Supervisory Role: Yes

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, make a positive impact in our community, and be rewarded for your success.

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. As a valued team member, you will be eligible for a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, a health savings account with an annual employer contribution, a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous employer match, paid time off plus 11 paid federal holidays, training and professional development programs, tuition reimbursement, reduced fees and rates on certain loan products, and much more!

About the Branch Manager Role

We're looking for a dynamic and results-driven Branch Manager to lead the daily operations of a full-service branch. In this role, you'll oversee all aspects of branch performance—from sales and customer service to lending, operations, and security. You'll inspire and coach your team, foster strong customer relationships, and drive growth through new business development, referrals, and client retention.

The ideal candidate thrives in a leadership role, has a passion for delivering exceptional service, and can balance operational efficiency with strategic business growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage all branch operations, ensuring exceptional customer service and operational excellence.
  • Develop new deposit, loan, and business opportunities while achieving branch sales and retention goals.
  • Build and promote the branch's identity, fostering a sales-driven and customer-focused culture.
  • Supervise, coach, and evaluate team members including Assistant Branch Managers, Head Teller, and Tellers.
  • Conduct staff training, regular team meetings, and performance reviews.
  • Effectively execute the selling of new products, services, promotions, and incentive programs to drive growth.
  • Originate residential, home equity, and installment loans.
  • Ensure compliance with all bank policies, procedures, and security protocols.
  • Handle complex customer requests and resolve escalated issues in person or by phone.
  • Approve significant transactions such as large check cashing, bank checks, and general ledger tickets.
  • Maintain branch appearance and uphold operational performance standards.
  • Report regularly to senior management on branch performance, opportunities, and challenges.

This job description is not exhaustive; duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Supervisory experience.
  • Strong customer service and cash-handling experience.
  • Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills in person, by phone, and via email.
  • Fluent in English; bilingual a plus
  • Access to reliable transportation
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
  • Willingness to participate in ongoing training and development.
  • Ability to lift 10–20 lbs., stand for extended periods.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Previous banking or financial services experience.

Schedule

Full-time position with hours aligned to branch operations:

  • Mon–Wed: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM
  • Thu–Fri: 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM
  • Sat: 8:30 AM – 12:00 PM (rotating schedule)
  • Sun: Closed

Employees may need to remain 15–30 minutes after closing. Occasional travel for training, meetings, or branch support.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, marital status, genetic information, disability, or protected veteran status. Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Developer, DDM Development & Campaign Automation is a senior technical contributor responsible for delivering personalized, omnichannel customer communications at scale through Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) and Salesforce Marketing Cloud. This role focuses on building, testing, and deploying email, push, SMS, and related messaging channels, while driving technical excellence, scalable personalization, and operational efficiency across high-volume, business-critical campaigns.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Adobe Journey Optimizer Platform & Channel Execution
    • Implement email, push, SMS, and emerging messaging channels within AJO.
    • Apply best practices for responsive templates, accessibility, localization, and deliverability.
    • Serve as a senior technical resource for complex journeys and advanced personalization use cases.
    • Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to rendering, data dependencies, and channel behavior.
    • Follow established QA, testing, and release management processes.
    • Ensure compliance with CAN-SPAM, TCPA, GDPR, and internal data governance standards.
    • Maintain documentation, templates, and implementation standards.
    • Identify opportunities to improve efficiency through automation and process optimization.
  • Personalization & Dynamic Content Development
    • Build and execute scalable personalization using dynamic content, decisioning logic, and real-time attributes.
    • Translate segmentation and data requirements into reusable and efficient solutions.
    • Develop modular components and templates to support consistent execution across campaigns.
    • Partner with data and analytics teams to ensure personalization is accurate and measurable.
  • Campaign Development & Deployment
    • Build, QA, and deploy campaigns across email, push, and SMS channels.
    • Ensure all deliverables meet quality, performance, and compliance standards.
    • Support high-volume lifecycle and triggered communications with accuracy and timeliness.
    • Participate in release processes and validate readiness for production deployment.
  • Agile Delivery & Cross-Functional Collaboration
    • Contribute technical input during intake, backlog grooming, and sprint planning.
    • Collaborate with Product, Marketing, Creative, QA, Data Engineering, and Analytics teams.
    • Align development work with sprint priorities and enterprise change management processes.
    • Support continuous improvement through retrospectives and knowledge sharing.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Strong expertise in customer journey orchestration, event-driven messaging, and channel execution across email, SMS, and push.
  • Adobe Marketing Platform Knowledge: Working knowledge of Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO), Adobe Campaign Orchestration (ACO), Federated Audience Composition (FAC), and Adobe Experience Platform (AEP)
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Knowledge: Working knowledge of Content Builder, Automations and Journeys
  • Working knowledge of APIs, data flows, identity resolution, and integration patterns.
  • Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and dynamic content.
  • Ability to translate data and segmentation requirements into scalable implementations.
  • Strong understanding of QA processes, deliverability, and campaign performance considerations.
  • Analytical problem-solving skills with the ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
  • Effective collaboration skills in cross-functional, agile environments.
  • Customer-focused mindset with attention to accuracy, timing, and experience quality.
  • Adobe Journey Optimizer certification preffered.
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Marketing Technology, Digital Marketing, Business, or a related field required (or equivalent practical experience).

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of experience in marketing technology, digital messaging, or campaign development.
  • Adobe Journey Optimizer, Adobe Campaign Orchestration, Federated Audience Composition, Adobe Experience Platform (preferred)
  • Salesforce Marketing Cloud Content Builder, Automations and Journeys (preferred)
  • Proven experience building and executing personalized messaging at scale.
  • Experience working in Agile / Scrum environments.
  • Strong hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, and dynamic content.
  • Experience operating in large, matrixed organizations.
  • Familiarity with enterprise customer data models and CDP platforms.
  • Experience supporting high-volume lifecycle or triggered communications.
  • ; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Annual salary: $49,700/yr

POSITION OBJECTIVE: To provide support to Information & Eligibility and Data Services by being the primary point of contact for customer service, client benefits and data related issues. This is a high visibility position which will have communications internally and externally to resolve problems. It is anticipated that all issues brought to the attention of this position require an immediate response to the originator within specified timeframes.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

  • Primary point of contact for department mail received from the Agency for Health Care Administration or other providers related to client insurance or eligibility.
  • Primary point of contact for Express Enrollment, the completion of Medicaid plan enrollment activities and tracking.
  • Primary customer service point of contact for benefit and data support issues including but not limited to Social Security card applications, Youth Credit Checks, Medicaid/PCP/HMO Issues.
  • Research and resolve data services and client benefit questions and inquires being the go between for internal departments and external customers as appropriate.
  • Track and maintain Department of Juvenile Justice involvement for youth in care.
  • Complete immediate responses to inquiries acknowledging we have their inquiry and that we intend to have a solution within 24 hours.
  • Maintain frequent communication with internal staff regarding changes to case data and eligibility including but not limited to IES, Records Room, Adoption, GAP, Youth Services and Operations staff.
  • Accurately enters required program information adhering to strict deadlines
  • Obtains and maintains appropriate eligibility documentation
  • Completes applications for Medicaid and Federal/State Funds
  • Maintains open communication with Protective Investigators and Case Managers responsible for supervising cases of children in care, obtaining information on income, household composition and family resources in order to determine eligibility
  • Queries systems to access specific information for distributing weekly/monthly reports to case management and senior management staff
  • Participates and documents CTS staffing's.
  • Utilize established checklists, forms and task tracking tools identified in the Information & Eligibility Handbook to report work status and maintain required documentation.
  • Distribute and review reports and complete routine data validation activities.
  • Escalate high profile requests and issues.
  • Identify trends within department and present solutions.
  • Assist in training Information & Eligibility Specialists on new policies and procedure.

Overview

At Orange County Government, we are proud to serve the public with integrity, honesty, fairness, and professionalism. Job Description

General Functions:
This position assists with directing and overseeing the functions and duties of a shift responsible for tasks associated with the intake, confinement, and release of the inmate population based on area of assignment. Areas of assignment may include Inmate Records Management, Pretrial Services, and the Judicial Processing Team.

Work is performed, with limited supervision, under the direction of the Corrections Shift Supervisor.

Representative Duties /Assignments

Coordinate shift operations as needed

Ensures the timely and accurate completion and processing of documents.

Directs and oversees duties performed by staff. Delegates work assignments and ensures tasks are completed.

Reviews and approves releases and conducts quality assurance reviews to ensure accuracy.

Assists personnel with interpretation of court orders regarding sentencing, bonds, releases and other instructions from the court.

Prepares various reports to include memos to the Judges.

Completes and submits payroll information for processing as directed.

Serves as a point of contact with the Courts, judges bondsmen, attorneys, and outside agencies.

Assists with the review and development of policies and procedures and trains staff.

Interviews inmates and conducts research to validate information.

Processes inmate identification information via the Automated Fingerprint Identification System.

Acts as a liaison with the Florida Department of Law Enforcement to resolve identification issues.

Assists internal and external entities to resolve issues and ensure accurate processing of inmates.

Conducts shift briefings and completes daily shift reports.

Conducts counseling sessions with staff.

Assists as directed with annual performance evaluations.

Assist the Shift Supervisor as directed

Performs other related duties as required.

Bachelors degree from an accredited institution and two (2) years of experience in criminal justice, public administration, social services, or a closely related field. Professional work experience in criminal justice, public administration, social services, or a closely related field may be substituted for up to two years of the required education on a year for year basis.

Must obtain and maintain FCIC/NCIC certification within three months of employment.

Must possess or be able to obtain and maintain Florida Notary Public Certification within three months of promotion or hire.

in Lieu of the degree requirements, additional relevant experience may be substituted on a year for year basis.

Preferences

Bachelors degree from an accredited institution in Criminal Justice, Public Administration, Social Services, or a closely related field.

Previous work experience in a Correctional Facility

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for directing and managing all aspects of the development of all of the Facility Construction for major land, attraction or hotel development (the Project), including all planning, budgeting, scheduling, estimating, design, construction, fabrication, delivery, and commissioning required to open the Project within the assigned budget, quality, schedule, creative and guest experience targets.

Organize and establish effective Project management; coordinate and manage design decisions and construction document production; avoid contract claims and disputes; minimize change orders during construction phases; effectively manage changes in the Project; eliminate interface disruptions between project participants; maintain, and where possible improve the Project schedule and budget; insure quality design and construction work; emphasize hands-on management of field operations; establish and maintain a competent and experienced staff;  implement efficient and timely document control.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Construction/Fabrication/Implementation - Responsible for the qualification, procurement, selection, contracting and performance of all Contractors, Vendors, Manufacturers, Fabricators, etc. required to complete the facility development of the Project. Ensure that all project procedures are being followed as it relates to Correspondence, RFIs, Directives, Shop Drawings, Submittals, Meeting Minutes, Punch Lists, Deficiency Lists, Notices, Pay Applications, etc. necessary to successfully implement the new theme park facilities.
  • Budget/Scheduling - Responsible for maintaining the overall project budget and schedule within the targeted objectives set forth during project approval.
  • Creative/Architectural Development - Responsible for the coordination and implementation of the creative/architectural content done by the Creative team or outside consultants. Responsible for the final delivery of the creative/architectural vision that meets the initial objectives set forth during the concept development.
  • Design Management - Responsible for the qualification, procurement, selection, contracting and performance of any and all Architectural, Engineering and Technical Designers hired to complete the facility design phase of the Project. Responsible for the successful completion of the design that meets the creative/architectural intent within the budget and schedule established for the project.
  • Personnel Management - Responsible for the hiring and selection of the necessary project team required to implement the project. Responsible for the performance of each of the project team individuals as it relates to the successful opening of new attractions. Responsible for the development and growth of project team.
  • Project Reporting - Responsible for the management, tracking and reporting of all the necessary project components inclusive of budget, schedule and progress of the project to upper management. Responsible to maintain accurate documentation necessary to insure a successful project completion within the targeted budget and schedule.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

  • License(s) in Architecture or Engineering preferred.

  • Directly supervises members of the facility project team.  Size of the facility project team varies from team to team. The project team will consist of Architects, Engineers, Project Managers, Schedulers, Estimators, Technical personnel ranging from 10 35 people in addition to the management of outside Architects, Construction Management, Scheduling, Estimating, Technical, Import and Procurement consultants. Team will consist of high level/experienced employees who are typically degreed/licensed professionals in the engineering, architecture or construction management fields. Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.

  • Preferred qualifications include:

    • ON-THE-JOB TRAINING: Minimum of 6 months to learn internal process and procedures and an additional 6 months to develop necessary familiarity with available resources in the industry to properly accomplish successful project completion.

    • LANGUAGE SKILLS: Ability to read, analyze, and interpret common scientific and technical journals, financial reports, and legal documents. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information to top management, public groups, and/or boards of directors

    • MATHEMATICAL SKILLS: Ability to apply concepts of basic algebra and geometry.

    • REASONING ABILITY: Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.

    • RELATIONSHIPS OUTSIDE WORK UNIT: Influences decisions of major nature. High degree of tact & diplomacy to obtain favorable decisions or maintain good will.

    • OTHER SKILLS AND ABILITIES: Knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Project, and Prolog.

SCOPE: 

Non-routine; general policies applied to frequently changing situations. Complex; established procedures not available. Major decision-making.

EDUCATION:  

Bachelors degree is required in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or a related field. Masters degree in is preferred in Engineering, Architecture, Business Administration, or a related field.

EXPERIENCE: 

15-20 Years of experience in the development and management of major projects with hospitality/entertainment/theme park experience; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Digital Marketing Specialist, Marketing / Communications / PR
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Analyst, Paid Media Experimentation is responsible for the end-to-end design, execution, measurement, and reporting of paid media experiments across Universal Destinations & Experiences, supporting UOR, USH, and new ventures. The role combines deep paid media platform expertise with experimentation, audience strategy, advanced analytics, and financial measurement capabilities to identify and size opportunities, design and execute technically sound experiments, evaluate incremental business impact, and translate results into actionable media and investment decisions. The Senior Analyst serves as a subject matter expert on paid media experimentation, with a strong understanding of how platform algorithms, campaign structures, targeting and segmentation, bidding strategies, attribution methodologies, and measurement limitations affect test design and results. This role partners across Paid Media, Strategy, Analytics, agencies, platforms, and cross-functional teams to prioritize the testing backlog, activate high-impact tests, and scale learnings across destinations and channels.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Measurement, Analytics & Business Impact

  • Own measurement and reporting for paid media experiments, evaluating performance against the approved hypothesis, KPIs, success criteria, and business objectives.
  • Analyze test/control performance across spend, revenue, ROAS, CVR, CTR, CPC, CPM, AOV, conversions, EViV/CpEViV, and other relevant metrics to determine incremental impact, statistical significance, efficiency, and key performance drivers.
  • Use Meta, Google, Looker dashboards, and enterprise data and reporting sources to monitor performance, validate results, investigate anomalies, and develop executive-ready test readouts.
  • Understand and account for differences between platform-reported results and enterprise measurement methodologies, including attribution windows, optimization behavior, audience delivery, and platform-specific reporting nuances.
  • Quantify realized financial impact by applying observed performance lift to addressable audiences and media investment and calculating revenue, EBITDA, savings, and other business outcomes to inform scaling decisions.
  • Develop and maintain standardized impact-sizing methodologies and tools that translate test results into defensible at-scale financial opportunities for business and Finance review.
  • Analyze results across audiences, segments, placements, creative, platforms, destinations, and markets to identify performance drivers and determine where learnings can be scaled or require additional testing.
  • Translate complex results into clear recommendations for campaign optimization, audience strategy, creative strategy, media investment, scaling, or future experimentation.

Paid Media Test Execution & Platform Expertise

  • Own the end-to-end execution of paid media experiments from approved hypothesis through launch, live monitoring, completion, and documentation.
  • Maintain advanced working knowledge of Meta, Google Ads/SA360, paid search, paid social, display/programmatic, CTV/OLV, and other applicable media platforms, including campaign structures, experimentation capabilities, audience tools, bidding and optimization algorithms, attribution settings, and reporting limitations.
  • Translate approved test designs into detailed execution briefs defining audiences, creative, campaign configuration, measurement requirements, dependencies, responsibilities, and timelines.
  • Build or coordinate test audiences and segmentation, including first-party, modeled, affinity, intent, retargeting, prospecting, geographic, and platform audiences; validate suppression, overlap, test/control allocation, and scalability.
  • Coordinate execution across internal teams, agency partners, media platforms, Creative, Legal, Analytics, and other required stakeholders.
  • Perform comprehensive pre-launch QA of campaign setup, audiences, creative, tracking, traffic allocation, test/control structures, and measurement requirements.
  • Monitor live experiments and proactively identify delivery issues, audience contamination, tracking concerns, platform changes, or other factors that could compromise test validity; recommend corrective action or retesting when appropriate.

Paid Media Experimentation Strategy, Sizing & Prioritization

  • Partner with Paid Media, Strategy, Analytics, agency, and business stakeholders to identify optimization opportunities and translate them into clear, testable hypotheses and experimentation plans.
  • Design paid media experiments using appropriate A/B, holdout, campaign-split, geo-split, or other test/control methodologies, defining audience and segmentation strategies, test cells, KPIs, sample and duration requirements, measurement approach, and success criteria based on the capabilities and limitations of each platform.
  • Quantify the potential financial impact of proposed paid media experiments by determining addressable audiences and media investment and estimating revenue, EBITDA, savings, or other business impact to support data-driven backlog prioritization.
  • Assess opportunities based on expected business impact, learning value, audience size, feasibility, scalability, and strategic importance.
  • Identify dependencies, risks, technical requirements, audience overlap, and potential measurement limitations during backlog grooming and prior to test activation.

Global Experimentation Governance & Partnership

  • Serve as the paid media experimentation subject matter expert within the broader Optimization program and partner with Strategy and Measurement leads throughout backlog grooming, sprint planning, execution, and results sharing.
  • Support experimentation across UOR, USH, USJ, and new ventures, adapting test designs and measurement approaches to differences in markets, audiences, media strategies, platforms, business objectives, and data availability.
  • Establish and maintain consistent paid media experimentation processes, documentation, measurement standards, reporting practices, and best practices.
  • Maintain accurate test documentation and results within program systems and learning repositories to enable transparency, historical analysis, and reuse of learnings.
  • Share outcomes and learnings across destinations and media teams to increase the value of experimentation and prevent duplicative testing.
  • Stay current on evolving paid media platform capabilities, privacy requirements, audience technologies, measurement solutions, and experimentation methodologies.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Deep knowledge of paid digital media and hands-on expertise with Meta and Google advertising platforms, including campaign activation, targeting, optimization, experimentation, and measurement.
  • Strong understanding of audience strategy and segmentation, including first-party, modeled, affinity, intent, retargeting, prospecting, geographic, and platform audiences; audience sizing and overlap; suppression strategies; and the implications of audience construction on test validity and media performance.
  • Strong knowledge of experimentation methodology, including hypothesis development, A/B testing, holdouts, campaign and geo splits, test/control design, incrementality, statistical significance, success criteria, and experimental validity.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently design, execute, monitor, analyze, and communicate paid media experiments across multiple channels and platforms.
  • Strong analytical and reporting capabilities with experience using Looker dashboards and other analytics/reporting tools to analyze media and business performance.
  • Ability to translate test performance into financial impact, including revenue, EBITDA, savings, and addressable opportunity, and use expected value to inform prioritization and scaling decisions.
  • Deep understanding of how platform algorithms, bidding strategies, campaign structures, attribution methodologies, audience selection, optimization objectives, and automated platform changes can influence experimental outcomes.
  • Ability to reconcile and appropriately interpret differences between platform-reported metrics and enterprise/business measurement.
  • Strong QA and attention to detail when validating audiences, campaign configurations, creative, tracking, traffic allocation, and experimental setup.
  • Ability to translate complex technical and analytical concepts into clear recommendations for business and executive stakeholders.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills with demonstrated ability to work across Media, Strategy, Analytics, Creative, Legal, agencies, media platforms, and technical teams.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent experiments across platforms, destinations, and stakeholders in a deadline-oriented environment.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, Business, Communications, or a related field required;
  • or equivalent combination of education and experience.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of experience in paid media, media analytics, experimentation, digital marketing analytics, or a related discipline.
  • Hands-on experience with Meta and Google advertising platforms and demonstrated understanding of campaign setup, audience targeting and segmentation, optimization, measurement, and reporting required.
  • Experience designing, executing, and measuring controlled paid media experiments strongly preferred.
  • Experience translating media performance into financial/business impact and working with Looker or comparable business intelligence tools preferred.
  • Experience supporting multiple brands, markets, destinations, or business units and working with agency partners preferred.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.
