POSITION OBJECTIVE: The Diversion Specialist will be responsible for managing a caseload of families served via Family Support Services (FSS) cases. Services to be provided In Home to children and families who are safe but could benefit from services provided via providers in their communities to inhibit them from moving further into the system of care. Diversion Specialist are to oversee the delivery and care coordination of services, make referrals, provide community linkages This position will conduct child safety assessments, complete family assessments and 30- day home visits minimally (or more frequent visits as identified as needed depending on the dynamic of the family) for families served in Orange County. The Diversion Specialist will coordinate and facilitate Family Team Conferences in a flexible, responsive, culturally competent service delivery system. This position will provide family stabilization support to children and families and coordinate with all members of the Family Team including caregivers, providers, DCF and informal and natural supports.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

· Provide specialized assistance to Child Welfare teams and the children and families in care.

· Coordinate planning strategies and maintain positive relationships with agencies and community members as applicable.

· Conduct home visits.

· Assist in the assessment of client's behaviors and emotional needs to determine the best possible community services to be implemented with/ for youth/ family.

· Act as a liaison with DCF/case management and the community

· Conduct home visits at a minimum every 30 days or weekly visits as needed or identified, depending on the family's need and dynamic that is presented at the Diversion staffing.

· Attending staffing's (lockout staffing's, MDT, LRT other community meetings as needed or identified).

· Maintain positive relationships with other agencies and community members as applicable.

· Complete any necessary file documentation and process data through FSFN and other required data systems.

· Prepare documentation to identify prevention efforts.

· Attends and participates in monthly diversion meetings.

· Coordinates and attend Diversion MDT staffing.

· Diverts families from the dependency system.

· Act as a support for the CPI regarding providing/ offering a service that will keep children in their homes/ communities safely and not have to enter out of home care or foster care, as well as service delivery with providers and community resources.

· Maintains monthly diversion logs and diversion tracking mechanisms for diversion/prevention purposes.

· Enters information into FSFN and ensures family support pages are created and maintained regarding reason for diversion/prevention involvement and funding etc. Ensure that family support pages are closed in a timely manner as well.

· Staff cases for diversion/prevention involvement and or to implement a safety service as needed.

· Expected to be a part of the CPI initial consultations and 2nd tier staffing's. Also available to be included in impromptu staffing regarding present and impending danger plans. Be a critical part in the decision of what services are available and can be implemented to ensure a child/ children is able to be kept in their home safely.

· Attach themselves to a CPI case that has been identified as needing prevention services and assist CPI with gathering information from parents/ other providers that the family may have been involved with or is currently with to move case forward and keeping the children safe without “ongoing” case management.

· Act as the conduit between providers and families. They are the linkage of services and ensure that contact between the provider and family has occurred and they are engaged. Also obtain all monthly documentation from providers and scan into the FSFN file cabinet and or update notes in FSFN timely and continuously.

· Ensure that parents sign the FSS Acknowledgement forms upon initial contact.

· Completes funding authorization form/ Diversion Supervisor signs the funding authorization and Diversion Manager approves and signs off for final approval.

· Screens all referrals to community providers and programs in the community.

· Maintain and complete ongoing Diversion tracking logs (weekly and as needed)

· Participates in the agency strategic plan & quality improvement processes.

· Ability to safely & successfully perform essential job functions consistent with the ADA, FMLA, & other federal, state, & local standards, including meeting qualitative & quantitative productivity standards.

· Ability to maintain reasonably regular, punctual attendance consistent with ADA, FMLA & other federal, state, & local standards

· Ability to comply with all personnel policies & procedures

We understand the importance that every provider, parent and employee plays in the success of our mission to protect and inspire every child, every day. An essential function of all employees is to provide excellent customer service by being professional and respectful in all interactions each and every day. It is also expected that all employees are timely and responsive in their communication with others.

NON-ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:

· Duties in other counties as assigned.

This list of functions is not intended to be exhaustive. The agency reserves the right to revise this job description as needed to comply with actual job requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS:

REQUIRED:

  • Bachelor's degree in social work or related area of study

o Related degrees include: human services, criminology, juvenile justice, psychology, sociology, counseling, special education, education, human development, child development, family development, marriage and family therapy, and nursing

  • 2 years' experience in child welfare services.
  • State of Florida Child Welfare Certification (CWCM)

PREFERRED:

  • Master's Degree from an accredited college or university.

SKILLS:

REQUIRED:

· Must be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

Position Summary: The Licensing Specialist serves as the primary point of contact for prospective foster parents and is responsible for the timely and thorough completion of foster home studies in accordance with Florida Administrative Code. This role evaluates applications and provides recommendations for the approval or denial of licenses. The specialist also assesses incident reports and licensing concerns related to potential foster homes, offering recommendations for appropriate resolution. Under the guidance of the Licensing Supervisor, the Licensing Specialist is responsible for collecting, organizing, monitoring, and distributing documentation to ensure licensing standards are met. This position supports the successful progression through the various levels of initial or re-licensure for foster care applicants, ensuring compliance with all regulatory requirements.

Technical/Functional Expectations

1. Complete Licensing Home Studies-Essential Function: The position completes initial and/or re-licensure home studies inclusive of the assessment and evaluation of all household members and babysitters, to include background screening and abuse report history.

2. Background Checks – Essential Function: Review and evaluate criminal history reports, fingerprint results, child abuse and neglect registry checks, sex offender registry searches, and other required clearances. Ensures continuous compliance with Title IV-E requirements by monitoring and tracking background check renewals, preventing lapses in required screenings and clearances for foster parents and household members.

3. Home Visits to Family Foster Homes-Essential Function: This position will provide regular and ongoing home visits to family foster homes throughout the licensure process.

4. Conduct Ongoing Assessments-Essential Function: This position will conduct ongoing assessments to determine capacity as indicated based on family skills, training, household composition, physical space and other determining factors.

5. Liaison between Foster Parents and Case Managers – Essential Function: This position will serve as a Liaison between foster parents and case managers ensuring open communication and timely resolution of any identified concerns when applicable.

6. Foster Care Referrals-Essential Function: This position will comply with Administrative Code requirements for any foster care referral on a licensed foster home. The licensing specialist will make recommendations for resolution of

all incident reports, foster care referrals and licensing concerns related to existing foster homes. This includes any joint visits for DCF institutional reports on assigned foster homes.

7. Confidentiality – Essential Function: Maintain strict confidentiality and security of sensitive personal information in compliance with applicable privacy laws and regulations.

8. Licensing Packets – Essential Function: Ensure licensing packets for caregivers meet code requirements, licensing expiration and DCF submission requirements.

9. Foster Care Regulations – Essential Function: Stay current on changes to foster care licensing regulations, background screening requirements, and agency procedures.

10. Knowledge of Microsoft Office Applications – Essential Function: Utilize Microsoft Office applications and agency databases to manage workflow, analyze information, and produce reports.

11. Attention to Detail and Judgement – Essential Function: Demonstrate strong attention to detail, critical thinking, and sound judgment when reviewing eligibility-related information. Effectively prioritize workload and manage multiple cases while meeting established deadlines.

12. On Call Rotation – Essential Function: Participate in first tier on call rotation.

13. Other duties as required: Job performance requires fulfilling other incidental or related duties as assigned, assisting, and training others, and performing duties of higher rated positions from time to time for developmental purposes.

Behavioral Competencies:

1. Attention to Detail: Able to be thorough and complete when working with assembling, processing, or providing detailed information; track details when under pressure.

2. Customer Service: Able to anticipate and respond to customer's needs, concerns, or questions to meet or exceed their expectations; help evaluate needs and options; show care and concern to demonstrate customer importance and value.

3. Integrity: Able to demonstrate consistency of words and actions; protect confidential information; do what is right even when no one is watching; demonstrate sound business ethics; consistently comply with organizational values.

4. Verbal Communication: Able to clearly express ideas, information, or concerns; presents verbal information in a straightforward manner; ask questions to open channels of communication; listen to understand perspective of others.

5. Self-Control: Able to maintain a composed problem-solving approach when faced with unrealistic expectations, pressing time demands, frustration, or interpersonal conflict.

6. Trust and Respect: Able to demonstrate respect and treat others in an honest and straightforward manner; follows through on commitments.

7. Sensitivity: Work effectively with and show sensitivity to cultural differences and various socio-economic backgrounds of others.

Business Experience:

1. Valid Driver License - Essential: This is required to travel throughout the County and other locations for client and other meetings.

2. Effective verbal and written communication skills: This is required to develop effective and collaborative communications with children and families, the community and service providers.

3. Advanced computer and data entry skills: This is required to maintain spreadsheets and data in Level 1 licensing.

4. Collaboration, negotiation, and problem-solving skills: This skill and experience is required to ensure successful integration into our system of care.

Educational and Experience Requirements:

An associate degree from an accredited college or 60+ college credits from an accredited college AND two years of full-time social work or human services experience or two years of professional work experience. OR a high school diploma or GED equivalent (official transcripts required) AND four or more years of full-time social work or human services experience.

JOB TITLE: Director, Total Quality

JOB OVERVIEW:

Provide strategic direction and leadership for the execution of Darden's restaurant food safety, supplier food safety, product compliance, regulatory affairs, and food safety risk management programs. Lead the execution of Darden's restaurant and supplier food safety strategy through a team of Total Quality Managers, strengthening enterprise risk management, operational performance, and brand protection. Ensure effective policies, preventive controls, governance processes, and performance measures are implemented across the supply chain and restaurant companies to protect guests, team members, and brands. Serve as a trusted technical and business advisor to leadership by identifying emerging food safety, regulatory, supplier, and reputational risks and recommending practical mitigation strategies. Lead a team of Total Quality Managers responsible for executing restaurant and supplier food safety programs.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

Organizational Leadership

-Lead, coach, and develop Total Quality Managers, establishing clear priorities, performance expectations, and accountability.

-Build organizational capability and a strong succession pipeline through meaningful development plans, cross-functional experiences, coaching, and progressive leadership opportunities.

-Promote a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, sound judgment, proactive risk management, and constructive challenge.

Supplier and Product Safety

-Provide strategic oversight for supplier approval, qualification, auditing, monitoring, and compliance programs.

-Establish risk-based expectations for food safety, quality, allergens, traceability, regulatory compliance, and corrective action.

-Partner with Supply Chain and Culinary to incorporate food safety and quality requirements into sourcing, product development, specifications, and supplier agreements.

-Monitor supplier and product performance, identify emerging risks, and ensure timely escalation and corrective action.

-Ensure standard operating procedures are maintained, communicated, and consistently followed across all assigned programs.

Enterprise Leadership and Risk Management

-Partner with the Vice President of Total Quality to develop enterprise food safety strategy and lead its execution across restaurant and supplier programs.

-Translate enterprise strategy into objectives, performance measures, governance processes, and continuous improvement priorities that drive accountability and sustainable results.

-Advise leadership on emerging risks, regulatory developments, industry trends, and opportunities to strengthen food safety performance.

-Lead cross-functional initiatives that protect guests, support business continuity, and safeguard Darden's brands and reputation.

-Allocate resources and prioritize work based on enterprise risk, business needs, and restaurant company priorities.

Restaurant Food Safety

-Provide strategic oversight for restaurant food safety, sanitation, and audit programs, ensuring consistent execution and effective governance.

-Use audits, health department inspections, suspected foodborne illness, claims, and operational data to identify trends, systemic risks, and improvement opportunities.

-Ensure standard operating procedures are maintained, communicated, and consistently followed across all assigned programs.

-Partner with Operations leaders to develop practical, sustainable solutions that improve execution and reduce risk.

Regulatory and Crisis Management

-Maintain effective relationships with regulatory agencies, public health authorities, and industry organizations.

-Support cross-functional responses to food safety events, product recalls, regulatory actions, restaurant closures, and suspected foodborne illness incidents.

-Provide strategic oversight for recall, traceability, incident response, and crisis management programs.

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS:

-Minimum of five years of relevant experience in food safety, quality assurance, public health, restaurant operations, food manufacturing, or supplier compliance, with demonstrated leadership experience and the ability to lead complex cross-functional programs.

REQUIRED EDUCATION:

-Bachelor's Degree in Food Science, Public Health, Environmental Health, Microbiology, or a related discipline. An advanced degree is preferred.

OTHER KEY QUALIFICATIONS:

-Exceptional analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills, with the ability to assess risk and convert insights into action.

-Strong written and verbal communication, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to influence at all levels of the organization.

-Demonstrated innovation, adaptability, organization, attention to detail, and effective time and priority management.

-Strong interpersonal and listening skills, with the ability to understand diverse perspectives while maintaining standards and sound judgment.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

-Advanced knowledge of restaurant and supplier food safety, FDA and USDA requirements, HACCP, preventive controls, allergens, traceability, recalls, and crisis management.

-Registered Sanitarian (RS) or Registered Environmental Health Specialist (REHS) designation.

Branch Manager
Reports to: Regional Vice President
FLSA Status: Non-Exempt | Supervisory Role: Yes

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, make a positive impact in our community, and be rewarded for your success.

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. As a valued team member, you will be eligible for a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, a health savings account with an annual employer contribution, a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous employer match, paid time off plus 11 paid federal holidays, training and professional development programs, tuition reimbursement, reduced fees and rates on certain loan products, and much more!

About the Branch Manager Role

We're looking for a dynamic and results-driven Branch Manager to lead the daily operations of a full-service branch. In this role, you'll oversee all aspects of branch performance—from sales and customer service to lending, operations, and security. You'll inspire and coach your team, foster strong customer relationships, and drive growth through new business development, referrals, and client retention.

The ideal candidate thrives in a leadership role, has a passion for delivering exceptional service, and can balance operational efficiency with strategic business growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage all branch operations, ensuring exceptional customer service and operational excellence.
  • Develop new deposit, loan, and business opportunities while achieving branch sales and retention goals.
  • Build and promote the branch's identity, fostering a sales-driven and customer-focused culture.
  • Supervise, coach, and evaluate team members including Assistant Branch Managers, Head Teller, and Tellers.
  • Conduct staff training, regular team meetings, and performance reviews.
  • Effectively execute the selling of new products, services, promotions, and incentive programs to drive growth.
  • Originate residential, home equity, and installment loans.
  • Ensure compliance with all bank policies, procedures, and security protocols.
  • Handle complex customer requests and resolve escalated issues in person or by phone.
  • Approve significant transactions such as large check cashing, bank checks, and general ledger tickets.
  • Maintain branch appearance and uphold operational performance standards.
  • Report regularly to senior management on branch performance, opportunities, and challenges.

This job description is not exhaustive; duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Supervisory experience.
  • Strong customer service and cash-handling experience.
  • Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills in person, by phone, and via email.
  • Fluent in English; bilingual a plus
  • Access to reliable transportation
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
  • Willingness to participate in ongoing training and development.
  • Ability to lift 10–20 lbs., stand for extended periods.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Previous banking or financial services experience.

Schedule

Full-time position with hours aligned to branch operations:

  • Mon–Wed: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM
  • Thu–Fri: 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM
  • Sat: 8:30 AM – 12:00 PM (rotating schedule)
  • Sun: Closed

Employees may need to remain 15–30 minutes after closing. Occasional travel for training, meetings, or branch support.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Manager, Global UXUI Experience Design - Hotels (2 year project hire)
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Sr. Manager, UXUI role will be a core member of the Global UXUI Experience Design team at Universal Parks and Resorts and lead brand solutions centered on UXUI and system design from inception to execution, framing product needs from a holistic and global perspective.

This candidate will work with a cross functional team focused on identifying opportunities to enhance customer engagement by executing an elegant and seamless experience as well as maintain high quality experience design frameworks for our products (websites, apps, interactive touch screens) to ensure we present a coherent brand image.

This person is a key member in creating opportunities for audience engagement, revenue growth through design executions, measuring demand and loyalty marketing across the customer buying process.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead the holistic view of the products design across integration (customer and technical) points to provide a superior, seamless experience from daily improvements to longer-term strategies.
  • Lead brand solutions centered on UXUI and system design from inception to execution, framing product needs from a holistic and global perspective.
  • Communicate with business and design leaders and act as point of contact for specific commerce related design initiatives.
  • Synthesize product design and consumer trends, propose hypothesis, test via A/B testing tools, document and recommend clear, specific solutions to meet consumer needs.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Demonstrated success creating end-to-end digital product designs in the consumer technology sector.
  • Should have exceptional brand, visual, and interaction design skills and a depth of experience working across the user-centered design process: from conducting and leveraging research (quantitative and qualitative) to prototyping and implementation to testing and evaluation.
  • Strong UI design background and foundational skills: Typography, layout, composition, color theory, iconography, UXUI, motion/interaction design and branding.
  • Experience creating and documenting UI toolkits, style guides, and front-end frameworks for design and development teams.
  • Experience leading cross-functional reward, loyalty, and customer community projects intended to drive engagement and business value.
  • Requires strong domain knowledge in marketing, loyalty, rewards, messaging, and engagement.
  • Experience in building cross-channel experiences in growth marketing.
  • Experience utilizing user-centric design methodology: Gathering/shaping requirements, defining user stories, storyboarding features and iterating based on user feedback/testing.
  • Knowledge of current challenges in the marketing environment such as attribution of marketing touch points, understanding customer lifetime value, and the use of data science led personalization.
  • A desire to tackle and solve problems, from big picture strategy to granular details.
  • Independent, self-motivated, thoughtful, strategic and a clear communicator.
  • Passionately advocate for the user.
  • Experience leading projects with cross functional teams.
  • Comfortable with agile transformation.
  • Some experience in workshop and training facilitation preferred.
  • A positive attitude, open mind, and desire to collaborate and learn.
  • Highly proficient in Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, InVision, and Abstract.

SCOPE:

  • The Sr. Manager, UXUI role will be a core member of the Global UXUI Experience Design team at Universal Parks and Resorts. We are responsible for Global UXUI; design concept, development and delivery of digital product across web, app and other digital applications for all Universal vacation destinations worldwide.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree is required; Bachelors degree or higher is required Graphic Design, Human Centered Interaction and/or Interaction Design

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum of 5-7 years of relevant experience in ecommerce sites, rewards/engagement and loyalty programs working with data-driven product development teams.
  • Must present a portfolio of work that illustrates strong UXUI, visual design and interaction design excellence, brand creation; or equivalent combination of education and experience.


Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Manager, IT Enterprise Data & BI
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Manager, Enterprise Data & BI will provide vision and leadership for the design, engineering, operations, and maintenance for a comprehensive strategy and roadmap for enterprise data supporting Universal Destination & Experiences (UDX) globally. This role will be leading enterprise data projects, working closely and aligning with partner teams, including Digital & Technology, NBCUniversal Operations & Technology, and business stakeholders globally to ensure all enterprise data requirements are understood and supported effectively and efficiently. Promotes collaboration by partnering with other leaders within and across division to share strategies and best practices to promote collaboration and improve efficiency.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Provide leadership responsibilities for a team of salaried technical individual contributors and contractors. Responsible for the planning, development, implementation, support, maintenance and enhancements of data management systems.
  • Work closely with Data Architects, Data Engineers, and Data Testers to ensure data solutions are aligned with business objectives
  • Coordinates with the business users during project implementations and continue to serve as a point of contact for future data questions and issues
  • Facilitates and leads meetings with end users at all levels (VP, Director, Managers, and Subject Matter Experts). Keeps management and business stakeholders informed of critical issues, project status, changes, etc.
  • Define and establish and evolve best practices in data engineering, data analytics, and support
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

Bachelors degree in data science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or related field.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 9+ years prior leadership experience managing teams of 4 or more resources
  • Deep Experience working with data structures, modeling, and cloud platforms (AWS, Azure).
  • Deep Experience with data profiling, mapping, cleansing, and quality assurance.
  • Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI) and data cataloging tools (e.g. Collibra)
  • Experience with one or more databases such as Teradata, SQL Server, Oracle etc.
  • Experience with one or more ETL/Data Quality tools such as IBMs Data Stage/Quality Stage, Informatica Power Center etc.
  • Experience with one or more reporting/ad-hoc analysis tools such as MicroStrategy, Cognos, Business Objects, Tableau etc.
  • Experience with one or more data modeling tools such as Erwin, Embarcadaro etc.
  • Broad experience with data requirements, data modeling concepts, data integration, master data management, metadata management, enterprise data warehousing (EDW) and business intelligence/analytics, tools, protocols and practices.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce high quality documentation and presentations.
  • Strong knowledge of systems development and project management methodologies/processes.
  • Able to understand and interpret logical and physical data models.
  • Familiarity with customer identification and address standardization processes and tools such as Unica etc. a plus.
  • Familiarity with one or more statistical modeling tools by SPSS or SAS etc.
  • Familiarity with Big Data concepts, tools, utilities, protocols, and practices
  • Familiarity with Cloud Computing architectures, protocols, and practices
  • Demonstrated ability of strong customer relationship skills.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for providing day-to-day Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) support to construction and capital project teams through implementation of the UO Contractor Safety Program, EHS standards, and associated processes. Serves as a technical resource to Project Teams, contractors, vendors, and internal stakeholders throughout project development, design, construction, and closeout phases. Supports contractor prequalification, construction safety oversight, design review, inspections, incident response, risk assessments, and regulatory compliance activities. Collaborates with EHS peer teams and Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to identify hazards, evaluate risks, implement controls, and support safe project execution while fostering a positive safety culture and alignment with organizational objectives.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Pre-Construction Phase:

  • Review concept packages and support development of construction documents with Project Teams and Facility Management.
  • Coordinate and support the EHS contractor prequalification process and evaluate contractor performance against established EHS protocols.
  • Participate in pre-construction meetings and communicate UO EHS Contractor Safety expectations to contractors and Project Teams.
  • Conduct contractor safety orientations in alignment with established programs. Evaluate EHS logistics with general contractors, vendors, and Project Teams regarding site access, insurance, contractor safety requirements, and project-specific EHS expectations.

Design Phase:

  • Support Project Managers and Facility Management in reviewing design phase submittals impacting EHS programs and operational safety.
  • Review project design documents for corporate standards and regulatory compliance. Coordinate input from EHS subject matter experts and communicate recommendations to project stakeholders.
  • Evaluate existing facility conditions and operational impacts to identify potential EHS concerns requiring consideration during design.
  • Participate in design review and progress meetings to support safe and compliant project outcomes.

Demolition/Construction Phase:

  • Support implementation of the UO EHS Contractor Safety Program through active participation in project meetings, field observations, audits, and site inspections.
  • Monitor contractor conformance with regulatory requirements, corporate standards, and project-specific EHS requirements.
  • Document inspections, observations, corrective actions, and compliance activities in designated systems. Collaborate with contractors, vendors, Project Teams, and EHS business lines to facilitate communication regarding project schedules, change management activities, high-risk work, and construction safety requirements. Develop and track punch list items related to EHS compliance concerns.
  • Assist with incident investigations, concern reports, corrective actions, and emergent EHS issues.
  • Provide proactive technical guidance and support to Project Teams and contractors throughout project execution. Stop working immediately when imminent hazards are identified.

Project Closeout Phase:

  • Support completion of EHS punch lists and facility closeout activities. Participate in project post-mortem reviews and lessons learned discussions.
  • Assist in preparing documentation required for EHS project sign-off and turnover activities.
  • Verify completion of corrective actions and project EHS requirements prior to project closure.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Job requires active coordination with multiple departments/clients across property.Work is complex with both known and changing contexts and within broad but established standards.
  • Liaise with other EHS functional area experts related to environment, industrial hygiene, construction, fire, standards and assurance, training and safety operations
  • Experience conducting inspections, audits, plan reviews, incident investigations, contractor oversight, and risk assessments.
  • Experience supporting implementation of contractor safety programs and construction-related EHS standards.
  • Direct oversight of EHS management system elements, corrective action programs, performance measurement, compliance verification, and cross-functional coordination.
  • Experience interacting with contractors, project managers, Facility Management, and operational stakeholders.
  • Must be an initiative-taker with basic working knowledge of applicable health and safety regulations, possess basic business acumen and effective communication skills, ability to identify, analyze, and appropriately communicate and act on information in a range of workplace conditions and unpredictable situations.
  • Ability to influence and work on a team by applying communication, collaboration, engagement and listening skills to promote and support change.
  • Possess and utilize mentoring skills to develop capability of management team members related to EHS matters.
  • Basic ability to develop plans, identify trends, and create short term strategies to mitigate risk.
  • Strong computer skills, ability to prepare and deliver presentations, ability to work varied hours and days with most of the time being in the field.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Safety, Occupational Health, Environmental Science, Construction Management, Engineering, Industrial Hygiene, Public Health, or a related discipline preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years of EHS experience supporting construction, capital projects, contractor management, or related operational environments.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Position Summary

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team works to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work you'll do

As a Delivery Consultant, Data Engineering and Conversion Solutions on the AI & Data team, you will be responsible for…

  • Design enterprise cloud data architectures that support transformation initiatives using modern cloud architecture principles.
  • Develop data pipelines, data models, and advanced analytics products using Databricks and/or Snowflake.
  • Apply DevOps practices and data and statistical programming tools to build, deploy, and improve cloud-based data solutions.
  • Conduct business-process assessments and prepare strategic deliverables, including strategic plans and visioning-session materials.
  • Facilitate client sessions and collaborate with executive-level stakeholders to translate business needs into technical delivery priorities.
  • Support State and Local Government client relationships and high-priority business-development activities.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. Requisition code: 372194

Job ID372194

Position Summary

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to help build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These insights are powered by engineering for business advantage, helping transform mission-critical operations.

As a Delivery Manager at Deloitte Consulting, you will oversee the technical delivery of an enterprise Azure managed services engagement for a US financial services client, lead cross-functional and global teams and mentor junior members. You will own the day-to-day service relationship, drive SLA and compliance performance, and support estimation, planning and change orders to ensure successful outcomes.

Work you'll do

We are looking for a Delivery Manager to own the delivery of a three-year Azure managed services engagement. You will be the accountable point of contact for the client, leading the teams that Migrate, transition, operate and secure a mix of Azure workloads, including compute and operating systems, containers, serverless services, backup and disaster recovery, patching, vulnerability and security monitoring, and cost optimization

As a Delivery Manager, you will be the onshore Service Delivery Manager for a multi-year Azure managed services contract covering a mix of IaaS (several hundred virtual machines across production, non-production and disaster recovery) and PaaS/serverless services. You will lead Level 2 and Level 3 operations teams across onshore and offshore Delivery centres, run service governance with the client, and ensure the Migrate, Transition and Operate phases are delivered against contractual SLAs, security standards and cost commitments.

Service Delivery & Contract Governance

  • Own end-to-end delivery across Plan & Define, Transition, and Operate (including the 90-day stabilization period), and maintain the Service Delivery Plan (SDP) as a living document.
  • Deliver against contractual SLAs — incident response/resolution, VM availability, and DR RTO/RPO — reporting monthly and running governance forums (service reviews, optimization reviews, steering committee).
  • Control scope and commercials: flag out-of-scope requests, raise change orders, and act as the escalation point for Priority 1 incidents.

Azure IaaS & PaaS Operations Oversight

  • Oversee Level 2/3 support for Azure IaaS (VMs, networking, storage, firewalls/WAF, load balancing) and PaaS/serverless services, including the shared-responsibility boundary with Microsoft.
  • Ensure golden, CIS-hardened images and IaC templates are maintained and used for all deployments, and oversee CI/CD, key/secrets management, and tagging standards.
  • Coordinate with Microsoft support and the client on CSP-side incidents and platform maintenance.

Incident, Problem & Change Management

  • Run ITIL-aligned incident, problem, and change management through ServiceNow — including the bidirectional eBonding integration — ensuring SLA-compliant prioritization (P1–P4) and root cause analysis for every P1.
  • Govern change requests (standard/normal/emergency) including CAB approvals, and maintain clear hand-offs across client Level 0/1, Deloitte Level 2/3, and third parties.

Security, Compliance & Risk

  • Ensure operational security controls are effective — IAM (SSO/MFA/PAM), credential rotation, and annual access reviews.
  • Oversee vulnerability management (daily scanning, risk prioritization, monthly reporting), SIEM/log monitoring, and security incident response.
  • Oversee cloud security posture management and compliance against NIST/CIS/CSA baselines, and support client audits and control requests.

Backup, Disaster Recovery & Patching

  • Oversee backup/restore policies across block, object, file, and PaaS data; plan and oversee the annual DR fail-over/fail-back test, reporting measured RPO/RTO.
  • Oversee the monthly OS patching cycle and CSP platform maintenance, communicating schedule and impacting the client.

Transition, Automation & Observability

  • Lead transition into managed services — design workshops, solution documentation, tool deployment, and knowledge transfer to steady-state operations.
  • Ensure monitoring/alerting/log management are configured to agreed thresholds, drive automation and continuous improvement (tracking MTTR and incident volume), and maintain client-facing reporting.

FinOps & Financial Management

  • Define budget thresholds and track alerts; oversee the quarterly cloud optimization analysis and reservation/savings-plan reviews.
  • Own delivery P&L inputs (utilization, productivity, revenue leakage) and partner with account leadership on renewals and extensions.

People & Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and coach technical leads and engineers across onshore and offshore Global Cloud Operations centers, including 24x7 on-call coverage for Priority 1 incidents.
  • Manage capacity planning, staffing, and on-call models, and support career development, certification paths, and promotion readiness.

The Team:

At Hybrid Cloud Infrastructure, we deliver solutions spanning Hybrid Cloud, Advanced Connectivity, AI Data Centers, High-Performance Computing and AI Infrastructure to help clients achieve their desired outcomes. Our offerings include engineered transformation services for hybrid cloud infrastructure and platforms, prioritizing resiliency, optimization, and extensive automation. We integrate advanced connectivity with AI infrastructure and enterprise networks to boost operational efficiency and enable real-time data processing. Additionally, we provide comprehensive management of all facets of operations for hybrid cloud infrastructure and field operations.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years in IT infrastructure services delivery, including 5+ years delivering Azure solutions.
  • 3+ years as a delivery manager, service delivery manager or technical lead on an SLA-driven managed services engagement.
  • Strong working knowledge of Azure IaaS: Windows and Linux VMs, VMSS, virtual networks, NSGs, Azure Firewall/WAF, load balancers, managed disks and storage, Entra ID and Key Vault.
  • Working knowledge of Azure PaaS and serverless services (such as App Service, Functions and managed databases), including how operational responsibilities differ from IaaS.
  • Understanding of backup and disaster recovery on Azure (Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery), RPO/RTO objectives and DR testing.
  • Strong command of ITIL and ServiceNow, including incident, problem and change management, SLA reporting and ticketing integrations.
  • Understanding of cloud security operations: vulnerability management, SIEM, endpoint protection, security posture management, IAM/PAM/MFA, and CIS and NIST controls.
  • Working knowledge of Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD (Terraform or Bicep; Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions) and Windows/Linux patch management.
  • Familiarity with monitoring and log management tools (such as Azure Monitor, Log Analytics or Datadog).
  • Experience with cloud cost management, including budget alerts, optimization reviews and reservations.
  • Commercial acumen across SOWs, SLAs, change orders and delivery financials.
  • Strong stakeholder and executive communication skills, including client governance and escalation handling.
  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • Ability to travel 25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred

  • Exposure to container platforms and Kubernetes operations (such as AKS).
  • Cloud certifications (Azure preferred) and ITIL 4 certification are an advantage.
  • Experience in banking or financial services is an advantage.

Operating in a fast‑paced environment, the role requires flexibility, strong prioritization, and the ability to adapt quickly as demands change. -Coordinate with internal departments, including Tax, Purchasing, Restaurant Supply, and Accounting.

-Perform special projects and administrative tasks as assigned.

-Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Outlook, Excel, Word); minimum typing speed of 50 wpm.

-Knowledge of retainage laws and lien waiver processing.

-Comfort working with numbers, budgets, and financial documentation.

Job.JobTitle: Delivery Consultant, Oracle HCM Cloud Functional Core HR
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Human Capital team helps organizations create value through people performance. We work with clients to reimagine work, the workforce, and the workplace across the enterprise and to transform their HR functions with AI and emerging technology. With the rapid pace of change in today's world, you will help clients answer questions like: How do I access, develop, and motivate my workforce? What should my AI strategy be for the HR function? Do I have the right organization and culture to enable performance? Join our team to make work better for humans and humans better at work.

Work You'll Do

As a Delivery Consultant on the team, you will support Oracle Cloud HCM Core HR implementation and delivery activities by:

  • Supporting requirements-gathering and design workshops by documenting business needs and assisting with translating them into Oracle Cloud HCM Core HR configuration requirements
  • Assisting with configuration activities for Oracle Cloud HCM modules, including Employee Self-Service (ESS), Manager Self-Service (MSS), personnel action request (PAR) processing, position management, learning administration, time entry and approvals, absence plans, and related HR processes
  • Preparing and maintaining functional deliverables, including configuration workbooks, fit/gap documentation, security artifacts, integration touchpoints, process flows, and testing assets
  • Supporting fit-to-standard workshops by documenting process flows, business requirements, and design decisions for worker records, job and position management, assignments, person data, and HR transactions
  • Supporting data conversion and cutover activities, including worker and organizational-data mapping and validation, document checklists, and parallel-run activities
  • Collaborating with integration, payroll, reporting, and talent-management workstreams; supporting Oracle Transactional Business Intelligence (OTBI) and BI Publisher reporting activities; and maintaining action items and stakeholder communications
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our HR Strategy & Technology offering develops leading global HR strategies and implements HR technologies that drive transformation, maximize the workforce experience, and sustain HR effectiveness and value while navigating a world of disruption.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to serve businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte Center Model has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the center model provides high-quality services to our clients. Center professionals work out of one of our specific Deloitte locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 1+ years Oracle Cloud HCM experience with configuration and support of Core HR module
  • 2+ years of experience supporting Oracle HCM implementations
  • Ability to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance for this role
  • Bachelor's Degree
  • Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Actively Oracle Cloud Implementation Professional certified
  • Experience with supporting or leading small functional teams in a hybrid delivery model
  • Experience with government/public sector projects

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $71,300 to $118,900.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

JOB SUMMARY:

Serves as a neutral party to investigate and facilitate the resolution of concerns of Team Members and managers within Universal Destinations and Experiences (UDX) involving allegations of unfair treatment, discrimination, harassment, and retaliation. Operates in a manner to preserve the confidentiality of those seeking services. Acts as a liaison to NBCUniversal Legal regarding such investigations. Evaluates trends and assists with work environment assessments. Provides recommendations for the resolution of investigations. 

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for conducting, coordinating, and handling internal investigations of highly sensitive and/or complex employment-related complaints (i.e., allegations of harassment, discrimination, retaliation, management, work environment, reasonable accommodation, etc.) to ensure issues are resolved in a fair and consistent manner.
  • Reviews cases in the case management system for consistency and calibration purposes. Analyzes case data regularly to build metrics and provide trends to HR Business Partners and Operations.
  • Regularly partners with Legal, HR Business Partners, and NBCU Fair Employment Practices on a variety of sensitive matters.
  • Works with individuals and groups to assess work environments in order to continue the culture of direct relationships with Team Members. Recommends options to Operations and HR Business Partners to help resolve conflicts, problematic issues, or concerns, and to bring systemic concerns to the attention of the organization and HR Business Partners for resolution.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Human Resources Management, Labor Relations, or Business Administration is required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of progressive Employee Relations experience, including significant experience conducting investigations required; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Experience with labor unions preferred.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

This role works independently with limited direction and must be comfortable in making independent fact-based recommendations. Will partner extensively across HR, Legal, and the business. In addition:

  • Exceptional written and oral communication skills
  • Strong analytic and organizational skills
  • Collaborative, team-oriented approach
  • Ability to identify, prioritize, and resolve issues quickly and effectively
  • Experience conducting investigations in a corporate environment and ability to conduct investigations with empathy, tact, and discretion
  • Ability to interface and communicate effectively with all levels of Team Members and managers
  • Strong conflict resolution skills
  • Excellent leadership, problem solving, project management, and presentation skills
  • Ability to manage risk while ensuring optimal outcomes are achieved

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Description

Launch Your Auto Claims Career with a Fortune 100 Company!

No Claims Experience Needed, Paid Training & Licensing Included!

Location: Orlando, FL
Applicants must live within 50 miles of the office.

  • Minimum 2 in-office days per month
  • Additional in-person training during the first 6 months
  • Start Date: January 11, 2027

Career Opportunity:

Do you thrive in a high-volume, fast-paced environment? Do you enjoy the challenge of a role where no two days are alike? We are looking for positive, high-energy, passionate customer service professionals. Qualities like these cannot be taught, but they can be sharpened, strengthened and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as an Auto Claims Representative.

As a licensed claims adjuster, you will be fulfilling the promise we made to our customers when they purchased their policy by working with those who have been in an auto accident and need our help. Company Overview:
PRP Wine International has been sharing fine wines exclusively to our clients through educational and fun wine tastings held in their homes and offices since 1972 in the USA. PRP's approach to wine enjoyment at home is based on “enjoyment without risk". Whether a client wants to enjoy trying one of our premium wines from regions like Napa Valley, Barolo and Bordeaux or a fine wine from dozens of other countries and regions around the world, they know exactly what they pay for without playing the famous game of “wine roulette." PRP is dedicated to providing the best wines at competitive prices while ensuring our customers are always happy with their selections. We are so customer centric that we even guarantee the enjoyment of our wines once our clients pour them in their home upon delivery. If a client is ever not happy with a selection they made PRP will honor their request to make them whole again with another selection.
The way we introduce our wines to our clients is through wine tastings in private and intimate environments where the wines being poured and the information shared is based 100% on the needs of the particular group or individual wine drinkers.
We also provide our clients many opportunities to come and taste over 100 new wines each year during events like Boat Cruises, Food and Wine Tastings, Warehouse Sales, Hotel Wine Tastings, Exhibitions and other unique educational events.
PRP has more than 100,000 customers in the USA using this unique service and enjoying the benefits of “try before you buy". The one-on-one conversation also gives customers the opportunity of discovering and appreciating the wide range of wines, grape varieties, wine growing regions, estates and vintages. And so, the wine lover becomes a connoisseur and the wine tasting an experience. The increasingly confusing and extensive variety of national and international wines coming to the market have caused growing uncertainty in the customer and this is where our service, personified by the wine consultant, comes in.
PRP Wine International is a market innovator of wine gifts for business through personalized labels and etched wine accessories. We are also involved in sharing our concept through Charity Fund Raisers and Networking events giving back to the communities that support us around the country.
Visit our Website for additional company information at www.prpwine.com
PRP Wine International is currently hiring for Part-Time wine consultant roles in our organization. This opportunity will allow for your development in sales and the wine world. There are additional opportunities to join the company Full-Time as your time with the organization moves forward and we both feel it is ideal for your personal and professional path.

How do you know if this is the right opportunity for you?

  • Do you want to work for a well-established, growing and national organization?
  • Would you like to represent high quality, unique products to stand behind and sell with 100% confidence?
  • Fun and exciting career
  • Do you excel working in a performance-driven environment where you can exceed sales goals and be rewarded for delivering results?
  • Are you seeking a career-oriented culture where nearly 100% of sales management opportunities are filled internally?
  • Do you like flexibility and self-accountability?
  • Do you want to work within a recession proof industry?
  • Do you want professional sales training and ongoing support to ensure your success?

What you need to do to succeed

  • A positive attitude and willingness to put in the effort
  • Self-Starter
  • Organized
  • Coachable
  • Enjoy meeting and interacting with your clients
  • Comfortable calling existing and prospective clients to set wine tastings
  • Ability to build long-term relationships through personal interaction

Compensation

  • Uncapped commission
  • Lead Generating opportunities furnished
  • Car allowance
  • Bonuses
  • Contests and trips
  • Employee Discount on wine purchases

Job Requirements

  • Must be over the age of 21.
  • Must have a reliable vehicle that you are willing to travel to appointments in.
  • Must be willing to enjoy selling and learning about wine!
  • Must be able to work evenings & weekends.
  • Must be willing to work in a commission driven sales job.

At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thinking meets disciplined investing as we challenge the status quo and help clients achieve what matters most.

Schwab Wealth Advisory is a fee‑based, non‑discretionary investment advisory solution built on trust, personalized service, and a fiduciary commitment to our clients. As a Sr. Manager, Wealth Advisor, you'll manage ongoing client relationships, deliver holistic financial planning, and provide tailored investment guidance aligned to Schwab's approach to investing. You'll collaborate closely with an experienced advisory team to support clients through complex financial decisions while helping them stay focused on long‑term goals.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a relationship‑driven environment, communicates with clarity and empathy, and takes ownership of client outcomes. Your work directly supports client confidence, long‑term retention, and advisory excellence.

What you have


Required Qualifications

  • Financial Planning: Proven ability to develop and communicate holistic financial plans for high-complexity scenarios (e.g., concentrated positions, tax-aware strategies, multi-goal planning), synthesizing inputs into recommendations that align portfolios to client objectives, risk profile, and long-term outcomes.
  • Coachability: Demonstrates a senior learning mindset by seeking input from peers and leaders, integrating feedback into measurable behavior changes, and sharing best practices—coaching others informally to raise advisory quality and client experience.
  • Self-Awareness: Exercises sound judgment and risk awareness—recognizing when situations exceed scope or require additional expertise, surfacing concerns early, and escalating with clear context and options to protect the client experience and meet fiduciary and regulatory expectations.

Additional Requirements

  • CFP® designation or CFA® designation
  • Bachelor's degree
  • Active FINRA Series 7 license
    • May be obtained with a 120-day condition of employment
  • Active FINRA Series 66 license (or equivalent)
    • May be obtained within the first 120 days

In addition to the salary range, this role is also eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.


What's in it for you

At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

  • 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
  • Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
  • Paid parental leave and family building benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

Company Overview:

PRP Wine International has been sharing fine wines exclusively to our clients through educational and fun wine tastings held in their homes and offices since 1972 in the USA. PRP's approach to wine enjoyment at home is based on “enjoyment without risk". Whether a client wants to enjoy trying one of our premium wines from regions like Napa Valley, Barolo and Bordeaux or a fine wine from dozens of other countries and regions around the world, they know exactly what they pay for without playing the famous game of “wine roulette." PRP is dedicated to providing the best wines at competitive prices while ensuring our customers are always happy with their selections. We are so customer centric that we even guarantee the enjoyment of our wines once our clients pour them in their home upon delivery. If a client is ever not happy with a selection they made PRP will honor their request to make them whole again with another selection.

The way we introduce our wines to our clients is through wine tastings in private and intimate environments where the wines being poured and the information shared is based 100% on the needs of the particular group or individual wine drinkers.

We also provide our clients many opportunities to come and taste over 100 new wines each year during events like Boat Cruises, Food and Wine Tastings, Warehouse Sales, Hotel Wine Tastings, Exhibitions and other unique educational events.

PRP has more than 100,000 customers in the USA using this unique service and enjoying the benefits of “try before you buy". The one-on-one conversation also gives customers the opportunity of discovering and appreciating the wide range of wines, grape varieties, wine growing regions, estates and vintages. And so, the wine lover becomes a connoisseur and the wine tasting an experience. The increasingly confusing and extensive variety of national and international wines coming to the market have caused growing uncertainty in the customer and this is where our service, personified by the wine consultant, comes in.
PRP Wine International is a market innovator of wine gifts for business through personalized labels and etched wine accessories. We are also involved in sharing our concept through Charity Fund Raisers and Networking events giving back to the communities that support us around the country.

Visit our Website for additional company information at www.prpwine.com

There are additional opportunities to join the company Full-Time as your time with the organization moves forward and we both feel it is ideal for your personal and professional path.

Job.JobDescription:
Only Oracle brings together the data, infrastructure, applications, and expertise to power everything from industry innovations to life-saving care. And with AI embedded across our products and services, we help customers turn that promise into a better future for all. Discover your potential at a company leading the way in AI and cloud solutions that impact billions of lives.

True innovation starts when everyone is empowered to contribute. That's why we're committed to growing a workforce that promotes opportunities for all with competitive benefits that support our people with flexible medical, life insurance, and retirement options. We also encourage employees to give back to their communities through our volunteer programs.

We're committed to including people with disabilities at all stages of the employment process. If you require accessibility assistance or accommodation for a disability at any point, let us know by emailing accommodation-request_mb@oracle.com or by calling 1-888-404-2494 in the United States.

Oracle is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans' status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Oracle will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

Disclaimer:

Certain U.S. based or U.S. customer or client-facing roles may be required to comply with applicable requirements, such as immunization/occupational health mandates, and/or drug testing requirements.

Range and benefit information provided in this posting are specific to the stated locations only

US: Hiring Range in USD from $20.58 to $40.24 per hour; from: $42,800 to $83,700 per annum. May be eligible for equity.


Oracle maintains broad salary ranges for its roles in order to account for variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions and locations, as well as reflect Oracle's differing products, industries and lines of business.
Candidates are typically placed into the range based on the preceding factors as well as internal peer equity.

Oracle US offers a comprehensive benefits package which includes the following:
1. Medical, dental, and vision insurance, including expert medical opinion
2. Short term disability and long term disability
3. Life insurance and AD&D
4. Supplemental life insurance (Employee/Spouse/Child)
5. Health care and dependent care Flexible Spending Accounts
6. Pre-tax commuter and parking benefits
7. 401(k) Savings and Investment Plan with company match
8. Paid time off: Flexible Vacation is provided to all eligible employees assigned to a salaried (non-overtime eligible) position. Accrued Vacation is provided to all other employees eligible for vacation benefits. For employees working at least 35 hours per week, the vacation accrual rate is 13 days annually for the first three years of employment and 18 days annually for subsequent years of employment. Vacation accrual is prorated for employees working between 20 and 34 hours per week. Employees working fewer than 20 hours per week are not eligible for vacation.
9. 11 paid holidays
10. Paid sick leave: 72 hours of paid sick leave upon date of hire. Refreshes each calendar year. Unused balance will carry over each year up to a maximum cap of 112 hours.
11. Paid parental leave
12. Adoption assistance
13. Employee Stock Purchase Plan
14. Financial planning and group legal
15. Voluntary benefits including auto, homeowner and pet insurance

The role will generally accept applications for at least three calendar days from the posting date or as long as the job remains posted.
