JOB SUMMARY:

Manages Controls engineering efforts associated with safety compliance, improved ride reliability and enhanced show quality for all of the high technology ride and show attractions at Universal Orlando Resort. The manager will also assist the Vice President in maintaining cost controls within Engineerings assigned budget. Work with the attractions to identify, define, and prioritize capital issues to realize optimum cost-of-ownership of Universal Orlandos assets in Rides and Shows.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage and lead the Controls Engineering Department. Support the overall goals and priorities of the department to achieve the highest standards of safety and reliability. Inspire customer service attitude and instill a tradition of continuous process improvement throughout the team. Emphasize reduced cost-of-ownership of the Rides and Attractions through superior engineering and cost savings through improvements in preventative maintenance effectiveness and cost avoidance through proactive measures to reduce equipment failures and collateral damage.
  • Ensure that Controls reengineering tasks for the Rides and Attractions are performed to the highest standards of safety, reliability and quality. Ensure compliance with al applicable codes, regulations and standards including: AISC, ASME, ASTM, ANSI, AWS, JIC, NEC and OSHA among others. Ensure that downtime efforts are kept to a minimum through appropriate partnership with tech services, focusing on preventive maintenance.
  • Serve as Safety Control System expert to maintain configuration management of hardware and software documentation in accordance with Engineering guidelines for proper archiving and security. Prepare Ride control system documentation as required including ensuring all configurations files are in Asset Centre, etc. Prepare comprehensive Engineering reports showing technical analysis, design solutions and learned best practices. Conduct technical reliability evaluations of Engineering design concepts and design constructs. Develop risk analysis studies of new designs to improve ride reliability and maintainability.
  • Manage staff, including selection, hiring, induction, training, performance appraisal and IDP to ensure overall increase in knowledge, experience, responsibility and individual accountabilities Lead, motivate and inspire the Engineering Team by providing design reviews, staff meetings, stimulating culture and challenging environment that recognizes achievement, promotes effective communications and develops individuals to achieve their maximum level of performance and ensure a best in class Engineering Department. Manage Rockwell Assurance partners, and Obsolescence initiatives.
  • Coordinate and facilitate inter and intra-department partners and external resources including: Attraction maintenance group(s), Document Control, Environmental Health and Safety, Facilities, Finance, Human Resources, Landscape and Water Quality, Operations, Outside Vendors, Quality Assurance, Security, and Sustaining Engineering. Maintain, and encourage within subordinates, close and friendly working relationships; model by example.
  • Manage spending within assigned budget guidelines and minimize overtime worked. Assist in identifying and developing detailed budget plans for tasks and projects that reduce cost of ownership of the attractions.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors Degree from a four-year college or university in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology or related fields is required
  • Masters Degree from an accredited college or university in Electrical Engineering, Electrical Engineering Technology or related fields is preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 10+ Years: Experience in an Engineering environment focuses primarily on control and automation systems, preferably in a theme park environment; interacting with other Engineering and Maintenance Department disciplines
  • Experience with:
    • Allen-Bradley PLC based control systems
    • AC and DC motors and motor control systems
    • Motion control systems
    • Show and animation control systems
  • Proficiency with personal computers using Win95, word processing and spreadsheets
  • Proficiency with complex diagnostic test equipment, proficiency in control systems drawings and technical documents.
  • Cognizance in ASTM regulations applying to theme parks, and the NEC are also required.
  • 8+ years project management functions especially in the area of technical compliance, scheduling and budgeting; performing technical support functions in regards to control systems, motor and motion control systems

AND

  • 10+ years demonstrated experience in electrical engineering, control system design and installation utilizing PLCs, ladder logic, variable frequency drives and servo control systems, process and/or machine safety, field experience with Theme Park technical environment and process control fault analysis/isolation experience required
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • PLC controls programming, maintenance, and troubleshooting; required
  • AC/DC Drives (motor controls) Configuration, maintenance, and troubleshooting; required
  • Cisco networking and wireless network certifications; preferred

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Strong analytical skills to perform engineering calculations for design, analysis, test and implementation of electrical and control systems.
  • High Level of knowledge and experience in the design of safety critical systems, ISO 13849-1, ISO 13849-2, ISO12100 standards, IEC60204-1, IEC62061, PL safety levels, and UL 508A, NEC, ASTM, ASTM F24 Standards and UOs Safety Standards.
  • A strong background in servo controls as applied for hydraulic, pneumatic, and electromotive motion control systems is required.
  • High Level of knowledge of Allen Bradley PLC Systems, "C", Visual Basic, and other software platforms. Experience utilizing PLC-5, SLC-500, ControlLogix, CompactLogix, PanelBuilder 1400E, PanelBuilder32, RSView 32, RSLinx, RSLogix (5 thru 5000), RSNetworx, Allen-Bradley PLC, and AC/DC motor control systems.
  • Ability to perform engineering calculations commensurate with Baccalaureate training in electrical, electronic and software engineering.
  • Experience with generation of control system specifications, acceptance test procedures, technical compliance, system risk assessments and failure analysis.
  • Proven application experience utilizing the following products and networks. Anitech, Gilderfluke show system controllers, 1305, 1336, 750 series AB variable frequency drives, Data Highway Plus, Remote I/O, ControlNet, DeviceNet, Ethernet, DMX and SMPTE.

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber practice helps organizations address complex cybersecurity challenges across identity, access, and cloud transformation. As part of this team, you will help clients strengthen the security, resilience, and performance of their Microsoft identity environments, including Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID. This role offers the opportunity to lead large-scale identity initiatives, deliver practical risk-based solutions, and support clients as they modernize critical infrastructure.

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/01/2027.

Work you'll do

As an Engineering Manager II on the Deloitte Cyber team, you will be responsible for:

  • Assessing Microsoft Entra ID and Active Directory environments and developing recommendations to improve security, configuration, and operational health
  • Leading the architecture, design, and implementation of Active Directory and Microsoft Entra ID deployments, migrations, upgrades, and consolidation efforts
  • Supporting identity modernization activities, including single sign-on, multifactor authentication, conditional access, identity provider migrations, and application integrations
  • Performing health checks, security assessments, recovery planning, and remediation activities across Active Directory services, domain environments, and supporting infrastructure
  • Delivering client-facing identity engagements across assessment, design, implementation, and post-implementation phases, while contributing technical insight to Deloitte eminence efforts

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Cyber helps organizations build trust in their digital environments by strengthening security across users, systems, and data. Within this space, our identity capabilities support clients in securing access, modernizing platforms, and reducing risk across enterprise environments. The team works with organizations to improve confidence in how access is managed and how critical information is protected.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, or Information Technology
  • 6+ years of experience in technical consulting, solution architecture, or client delivery involving Microsoft identity and access management solutions
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Entra ID, including conditional access, single sign-on, multifactor authentication, Privileged Identity Management, and application integrations
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience with Active Directory, including Active Directory Federation Services, group policy, domain cleanup, domain and forest recovery, trusts, and federation
  • 5+ years of experience with identity protocols, including WS-Federation, Security Assertion Markup Language, OpenID Connect, and OAuth
  • Ability to travel 25-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience leading enterprise Active Directory or Microsoft Entra ID migration, upgrade, or consolidation programs
  • Experience implementing security solutions for Microsoft identity platforms, including Microsoft Defender for Identity
  • Experience supporting mergers, acquisitions, or divestitures involving Active Directory domains and forests
  • Experience with Microsoft Entra B2B, Microsoft Entra B2C, or identity provider migration activities
  • Experience producing technical assessments, remediation plans, or compliance reporting for identity platforms
  • One or more certifications such as Microsoft SC-300, Certified Cloud Security Professional, Certificate of Cloud Security Knowledge, Certified Information Systems Security Professional, Cisco Certified Network Professional, Cisco Certified Network Associate, Microsoft Certified Solutions Expert, or Microsoft Certified Solutions Associate

Preferred

  • Experience working on state government technology modernization or large-scale system implementation initiatives
  • Experience documenting current-state and future-state business processes, use cases, business rules, operational procedures, and process improvement recommendations

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Recruiting for this role ends on 4/01/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Engineering Manager II on the Deloitte Cyber team, you will be responsible for:

  • Leading Active Directory and identity infrastructure engagements across assessment, design, migration, implementation, stabilization, and post-implementation phases.
  • Performing and overseeing Active Directory assessments covering domain and forest architecture, domain controllers, Sites and Services, Domain Name System (DNS), Dynamic Host Configuration Protocol (DHCP), replication, trusts, Group Policy, privileged groups, service accounts, authentication protocols, and administrative processes.
  • Designing and implementing Active Directory security and hardening improvements, including administrative tiering, role-based access controls, service account management, Group Policy controls, and identity threat detection and recovery capabilities.
  • Architecting and supporting enterprise Active Directory environments, including hybrid identity integrations with Microsoft Entra ID, federation, synchronization services, and application dependencies.
  • Leading or supporting domain and forest migrations, separations, and consolidations, including discovery, dependency analysis, cutover planning, validation, rollback, and post-migration stabilization.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Cyber's Digital Trust & Privacy practice helps organizations build and sustain confidence in their digital products, platforms, services, data practices, and customer experiences. Our work brings together digital trust, online protection, privacy, AI governance, identity, data protection, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance capabilities.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, another technical field.
  • 6+ years of experience in technical consulting, enterprise infrastructure, identity security, or Active Directory engineering.
  • 6+ years of hands-on experience designing, securing, assessing, migrating, or operating Microsoft Active Directory environments.
  • Experience with enterprise Active Directory services, including domain and forest architecture, domain controllers and replication, DNS, DHCP, Sites and Services, Group Policy, trusts, service accounts, Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), and domain or forest recovery.
  • Experience leading or supporting Active Directory domain or forest migrations, separations, or consolidations.
  • Experience with migration tooling such as Quest On Demand Migration (ODM) or Semperis migration capabilities.
  • Experience with identity threat detection, identity resilience, cyber recovery, or recovery validation tooling such as Semperis, Rubrik, or Microsoft Defender for Identity.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree in Cybersecurity, Information Technology, Engineering, or another technical field.
  • Experience with Active Directory security assessments, attack-path analysis, domain hardening, and privileged access management.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Work You'll Do

As a Delivery Senior Consultant, Specialized Finance Solutions on the Specialized Finance Solutions team, you will be responsible for:

  • Support U.S. Department of the Interior (DOI) accounting operations involving property, plant, and equipment (PP&E) and leases.
  • Support accounts payable, accounts receivable, reimbursable agreements, and Intragovernmental Payment and Collection (IPAC) transactions.
  • Prepare and support the review of monthly financial reporting deliverables.
  • Lead assigned accounting tasks, track deliverables, and communicate progress and issues to client and engagement team stakeholders.
  • Maintain accounting documentation and data needed to support timely monthly reporting.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Controllership and Treasury Transformation offering modernizes the finance function to support the evolving business objectives of the organization. We work with the CFO, CAO, controller, and treasurer to develop an efficient, high quality, data-driven, tech-enabled controllership and treasury function that empowers our clients to drive more value to their business partners and to their investors.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain the required Public Trust clearance for this role
  • 2+ years of experience supporting accounting operations involving one or more of the following: property, plant, and equipment; leases; accounts payable; accounts receivable; reimbursable agreements; or intergovernmental transactions.
  • 2+ years of experience preparing monthly financial reports.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg) or Geo-Hub locations (Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, and Philadelphia)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance
Preferred:
    • Experience working in SAP (Systems, Applications, and Products in Data Processing).

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Deloitte Accounting & Reporting Technology team works closely with purpose-built automation technologies in the market to help our clients improve accounting processes, build / configure accounting automation solutions, and develop governance/controls around these tools. We help organizations effectively navigate business risks and opportunities—from strategic and financial risks to operational and regulatory risks—to gain competitive advantage. We apply our experience in ongoing business operations and corporate lifecycle events to help clients become stronger and more resilient. Our market-leading teams help clients embrace complexity to accelerate performance, disrupt through innovation, and lead in their industries.

Recruiting for this role ends on 10/23/2026.

Work you'll do

As an Accounting & Reporting Technology Manager, you will:

  • Lead the coordination and execution of Accounting & Reporting Technology strategic initiatives
  • Lead client pursuits and engagement delivery relating to Accounting & Reporting Technology
  • Lead market research activities to ensure awareness and understanding of key Accounting & Reporting technology related industry trends and opportunities

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte Accounting & Reporting Technology team helps our clients transform business issues into opportunities for growth and long-term competitive advantage. Our Workiva professionals make extensive use of data, statistical and quantitative analysis, rules-based methods, and accounting technology to bring insights to client issues in all industries.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in one of the following majors with relevant business, technology, data and/or analytical focused coursework: Business: Accounting, Economics, Finance, Business Analytics; Technology: Management Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science; Math/Engineering: Computer Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Industrial Engineering
  • 5+ years of related work experience
  • Workiva certification in at least one of the core modules (SEC Reporting, Annual & Interim Reporting, Controls/Audit Management, etc.)
  • 2+ years of experience developing system requirements, designing and prototyping, testing, training, defining support procedures and implementing with specific focus on Workiva Wdesk and Wdata
  • Experience in managing and supervising teams in executing all phases of the technology life cycle, based on proven project management and testing methodologies
  • Prior experience working with and managing data sets as well as integrations between systems
  • You should reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required.
  • You should expect to periodically co-locate with team members or other colleagues in a Deloitte office, and/or virtually, based on specific team and business expectations.
  • Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the type of work you perform and the clients served.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred

  • Master's degree in related area
  • Workiva certification in all of the core modules (SEC Reporting, Annual & Interim Reporting, Controls/Audit Management, XBRL, etc.)
  • Experience with packaged technologies like Workiva
  • Experience integrating Workiva with other accounting automation tools including Blackline
  • Project experience in areas such as process mapping, root cause/ gap analysis/ best fit, requirements gathering/ definition development

Position Summary

The Team

ConvergeCONSUMER™ is a product-driven business that combines differentiated consumer insights with robust prediction and optimization capabilities to help consumer-focused businesses improve decision-making and deliver personalized experiences to drive growth, consumer loyalty, and profitability. We operate with the speed and agility of a startup within the world's largest professional services firm.

We drive value for our clients by optimizing decisions and actions at a level of granularity only made possible with today's data and technology. ConvergeCONSUMER's suite of solutions helps consumer-facing businesses prosper in a world being re-shaped by convergence, where the lines between industries, competitors and collaborators, consumers and suppliers, and even human and artificial intelligence have blurred.

Position Summary

Are you a skilled Forward Deployed Engineer who thrives working directly in the field with wholesale distributors, translating complex operational data into clear, actionable recommendations? Are you looking for an opportunity to help bring ConvergeCONSUMER's capabilities to life inside real distributor environments — from the warehouse floor to the executive dashboard? If the answer to these questions is yes, we would like to talk with you.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/29/2026.

Work you'll do

As an FDE for the WD Edge team, you will:

  • Contribute to the delivery of client engagements that drive measurable business impact through the adoption of ConvergeCONSUMER products among wholesale distribution clients
  • Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market teams to translate distributor needs into actionable solution requirements and deliverables
  • Conduct data and market analyses to uncover insights that inform product positioning, client recommendations, and business decisions
  • Develop client-ready materials, presentations, and proof-of-value demonstrations that clearly communicate solution benefits and results
  • Translate analytical findings and technical outputs into concise, business-relevant insights for client and internal audiences
  • Support engagement planning and execution directly within distributor environments, ensuring alignment between client objectives, solution design, and expected outcomes
  • Gather and synthesize client feedback from the field to identify opportunities for product improvement and expanded solution adoption
  • Assist in the development of go-to-market collateral, sales enablement tools, and internal documentation
  • Collaborate across teams to share learnings, support delivery excellence, and contribute to a culture of continuous improvement
  • Manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced, dynamic environment while maintaining high standards of quality and attention to detail

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Strong analytical mindset, able to interpret data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear, business-oriented narratives that support client decision-making
  • Comfortable partnering across cross-functional teams — product, engineering, and business stakeholders — to shape and deliver client-facing solutions
  • Excellent written and verbal communicator, skilled at developing client-ready presentations and solution documentation
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, able to manage multiple workstreams in fast-paced, ambiguous environments
  • Curious and adaptable, connecting technical capabilities to client needs to drive adoption of innovative solutions
  • Comfortable working directly within distributor and field environments, not just from behind a desk

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Analytics, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • 5+ years of experience in analytics, product implementation, solution delivery, or consulting within technology-enabled or data-driven organizations
  • Experience supporting client engagements or product delivery within wholesale distribution, retail, or related supply chain-driven industries
  • Ability to travel 0-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Prior experience working with AI/ML, data science, or decision intelligence platforms
  • Hands-on familiarity with one or more of the following domains: demand forecasting, inventory optimization, pricing, or supplier management

As a Senior Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE) on ConvergeCONSUMER, you'll operate at the intersection of sales and delivery — building trust with senior client stakeholders, leading hands-on implementation teams, and feeding what you learn in the field back into our product roadmap.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/29/2026.

Work you'll do

As the Senior Product Forward Deployed Engineer (pFDE), you will:

  • Own end-to-end delivery of ConvergeCONSUMER product implementations for enterprise clients, from kickoff through go-live
  • Lead discovery and scoping conversations with client stakeholders to define engagement scope, timeline, and success criteria
  • Lead small delivery teams — a mix of engineers and consultants — through the full lifecycle of a client implementation
  • Serve as the primary client-facing point of contact during delivery, managing scope, timeline, and risk, and escalating issues before they threaten outcomes
  • Partner with sales and account teams to identify opportunities to expand existing engagements or open new ones
  • Present product capabilities and live demos to VP- and C-suite client stakeholders
  • Translate client feedback and product gaps into structured input for product management teams, distinguishing one-off delivery needs from core product enhancements
  • Develop reusable delivery playbooks, demo assets, and implementation patterns that accelerate future engagements
  • Coach and unblock junior FDEs and consultants on the team, sharing delivery and client-management best practices

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Comfortable operating autonomously across both sales-support and hands-on delivery work without close oversight
  • Strong executive presence, with the ability to build credibility quickly with senior client stakeholders
  • Natural people leader, comfortable guiding and unblocking a small team under deadline pressure
  • Skilled at translating between technical delivery realities and business or product priorities
  • Proactive communicator who surfaces risk and feedback early rather than waiting to be asked
  • Resourceful and outcomes-oriented, comfortable navigating ambiguous or evolving client environments
  • Genuine curiosity about the consumer industry and how our products create value for clients

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 8+ years of experience in client-facing technology consulting, professional services, or product delivery roles
  • Demonstrated experience leading small delivery teams and managing client engagements from scoping through go-live
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience delivering technology engagements within the consumer, retail, or transportation/hospitality sectors
  • Experience contributing to business development activities such as client pitches, proposals, or product demonstrations

Job.JobDescription:
Your opportunity

The Schwab Private Wealth Services (SPWS) Client Experience team designs and delivers differentiated experiences for Ultra High Net Worth clients with more than $10 million in assets. The team partners across Investor Services, Advisor Services, Schwab Bank, Operations, Marketing, and Technology to enhance the end-to-end experience for some of Schwab's most affluent clients.

The team's work spans strategy and integration, offer design, product management, and process improvement, providing an opportunity to contribute to high-impact strategic initiatives while gaining exposure to senior leadership.

As a Senior Manager, Ultra HNW on the Client Experience & Strategy team, you will help shape the end-to-end experience for Schwab's most affluent clients. You will translate strategic priorities into actionable roadmaps, solutions, and process improvements while contributing to complex, high-impact initiatives.

This role requires a client-centered, strategic, analytical, and execution-focused mindset, along with the ability to influence stakeholders, solve complex problems, and turn insights into action.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Strategy & Road mapping: Shape the future-state vision and develop actionable near-term strategies and roadmaps.
  • Strategic Initiatives: Lead and support complex, high-impact projects from analysis and planning through execution.
  • Data-Driven Insights: Analyze business and client needs to identify opportunities and develop actionable recommendations.
  • Client Experience: Help define and strengthen the end-to-end experience for the SPWS client segment.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Partner across business, operations, marketing, product, and technology to move strategies into action.
  • Prioritization: Help leaders evaluate opportunities, prioritize investments, and focus resources on the highest-value client experience initiatives.
  • Executive Communication: Translate complex information and stakeholder feedback into clear recommendations, compelling business stories, and executive-level presentations.
  • Relationship Management: Build strong partnerships across the organization to gain alignment and support successful execution.

What You'll Be Good At:

  • Developing a strong understanding of affluent client needs and identifying opportunities to improve products, services, and experiences.
  • Defining business strategies and translating recommendations into practical actions and roadmaps.
  • Solving complex business problems using thoughtful, fact-based analysis.
  • Leading strategic initiatives across client and representative experiences.
  • Synthesizing diverse perspectives and stakeholder feedback into clear recommendations.
  • Communicating effectively and influencing stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
  • Monitoring industry trends, competitive activity, and external developments to understand potential strategic implications.

What you have


Required Qualifications:

  • 7+ years of professional experience, including 4+ years in strategy and/or client experience. Management consulting preferred.
  • Experience leading large, complex initiatives through planning, analysis, stakeholder alignment, and execution
  • Demonstrated analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, including the ability to conduct quantitative analysis, identify broader implications, and translate findings into actionable recommendations
  • Demonstrated ability to develop clear written materials and deliver persuasive presentations to executive audiences
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and make effective decisions in a dynamic, ambiguous environment
  • Bachelors degree

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Master of Business Administration
  • Experience with journey mapping, process mapping, project management, strategic planning, and process improvement
  • Demonstrated client experience skills, with the ability to connect business decisions and actions to client needs and measurable outcomes
  • Ability to build collaborative relationships and align cross-functional stakeholders around shared strategies, priorities, and execution plans
  • Ability to synthesize business-partner feedback, external trends, and competitive developments into clear strategic concepts
  • Strong initiative, adaptability, attention to detail, and results orientation
  • Expert proficiency with Microsoft PowerPoint and Microsoft Excel

In addition to the salary range, this role is eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis without employer sponsorship.


What's in it for you

At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact.

JOB SUMMARY:

  • Field Operations: In field oversight of all field projects. This includes but is not limited too: Point of Origin, City Walk Profile, Panel and adhocs as requested. Supervisors will be expected to spend 35% of their shift in the field observing, coaching, and mentoring team members. All observations, coachings and monitorings will be documented for quality data collection purposes.
  • Project Management: Reconciles weekly payroll and approves team member schedule swaps. Attend daily virtual park operations meetings and sends out daily email updates. Schedules and conducts bi monthly and monthly team meetings. Assists in the creation and maintenance of pre-shift documents, interviewer productivity, and project productivity for all core and adhoc projects. Supervisors assists the team captains with the morning pre-shifts for Point of Origin and other projects as needed.

Is responsible for the growth and development of the team members reporting to them. Conducts required TM 1 on 1 conversations, including 30/60/90s. Address concerns, current performance, and growth opportunities. Work in field with team members to be successful in their current role and prepare for advancement to next level. Participates in department TSAT initiatives routinely.

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Some college or degree preferred. Bachelor of Arts, Hospitality, Marketing, Marketing Research or Anthropology preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years supervisory experience leading teams required.
  • Would prefer supervisory experience in Field Research. Will accept a combination of supervisory experience and education.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws
  • This role requires significant mobility across multiple properties as well as flexibility in hours worked to accommodate research needs.

Position Summary

Work You'll Do

As a Center Delivery Senior Consultant, Software Engineering Solutions on the Engineering as a Service team, you will:


  • Build agents against a layered SDK contract (shared types/tools, composable tools, thin agent shell, FastAPI + React surface)
  • Keep business logic in composable skills rather than shells or routers
  • Integrate LLMs through a multi-provider abstraction (Anthropic/Bedrock/OpenAI/Azure, extending to Vertex/OCI) behind a single sanitization + audit boundary so no raw client data leaves the worker
  • Implement durable service boundaries (async persistence, object-storage artifacts, and a tamper-evident hash-chain audit trail per run)
  • Enforce tenant isolation via Postgres RLS scoped sessions and author Alembic migrations (enum/DDL idempotency, RLS policies)
  • Wire agents into an event-driven orchestrator with human-in-the-loop (HITL) approval gates, exposing progress via async tasks (Celery/Redis) and WebSocket

USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

  • 3-6 years of experience with Docker, SQL, Tailwind CSS 4, React.js

  • Experience with GitHub Copilot
  • Multi-tenant SaaS, audit/compliance (HIPAA/FedRAMP/SOX), and data-domain exposure strongly preferred

Job ID373298

Job.JobTitle: Converge for FSI - RAE Lead Product Forward Deployed Engineer_Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented individual with an innovative mindset to join the Converge for FSI team in our mission to develop differentiated financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This role is focused on the Retirement Agentic Ecosystem (RAE), an AI-enabled platform that connects retirement systems and coordinates workflows across plan onboarding, ongoing operations and participant servicing—helping providers reduce manual work, improve accuracy and deliver more connected experiences. This is a great opportunity to be on the frontlines of Deloitte's innovation & product strategy while staying close to industry/sector priorities.

Position Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled and client-facing Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to sit at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer partnership. In this role, you will embed directly with our most strategic clients — particularly in the financial services sector — to understand their toughest technical challenges and help them design and implement world-class solutions using our platform. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with direct influence on product direction.

You are equally comfortable whiteboarding microservices architecture with a client's principal engineer, running a hands-on technical workshop for a team of developers, and standing up a compelling proof-of-concept in days. You thrive in fast-moving, high-stakes environments and know how to earn the trust of deeply technical stakeholders.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.

Work you'll do

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for strategic client accounts, building deep relationships with architects, engineers, and technical leaders
  • Lead discovery sessions to understand client architectures, pain points, and business objectives
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Collaborate with client architects and internal engineering teams to design scalable, production-ready solutions
  • Provide authoritative guidance on microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and cloud-native deployment patterns
  • Review and advise on client system designs, identifying risks and recommending best practices
  • Rapidly prototype and build POCs that demonstrate platform value in the context of a client's real-world use cases
  • Own and deliver polished, technically rigorous demos tailored to the client's specific technology stack and business domain
  • Maintain a library of reusable demo assets and reference implementations
  • Design and facilitate deep-dive technical workshops, hackathons, and onboarding bootcamps for client engineering teams
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and integration guides
  • Accelerate client time-to-value by enabling their teams to build confidently and independently
  • Act as the voice of the customer — surface product gaps, integration friction, and feature requests to internal product and engineering teams
  • Partner with Sales, Solutions Architecture, and Product to shape the technical go-to-market strategy

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot, including building production-grade microservices
  • Strong understanding of event-driven architecture — Kafka, event sourcing, CQRS, async messaging patterns
  • Hands-on experience with microservices design principles: service decomposition, API design, resiliency patterns, observability
  • Proficiency across multi-cloud environments, with AWS as a primary platform; working knowledge of Azure and GCP
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Exposure to Agentic AI frameworks and tooling — including LangGraph, LangChain, or similar orchestration frameworks
  • Practical understanding of LLM integration patterns, prompt engineering, and AI-powered application design
  • Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client-relevant use cases
  • Exceptional communicator — able to lead technical conversations with senior engineers and C-suite stakeholders alike
  • Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions
  • Self-directed, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously
  • Natural curiosity and a bias for building — you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing or equivalent field. MBA a plus.
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent in client-facing, solutions engineering, or field engineering roles
  • Ability to travel 20-40%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Background in financial services, specifically retirement & wealth, strongly preferred
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices
  • Contributions to open-source projects or public technical content (talks, blogs, repos)
  • Prior experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment
  • Prior experience using AI and LLMs to rapid prototype in a sales, business development or product demonstrations
  • Relevant cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional, etc.)

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.   • Continuous-improvement mindset toward reducing recurring issues over time

  • Hands-on experience with UAT coordination, defect tracking, and escalation management across engineering and delivery teams

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Construction & Skilled Trades, Creative / Design / Architecture
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY

The primary function of the Virtual Design and Construction (VDC) Manager is to lead the integration of VDC technologies to enhance project delivery and collaboration across all stakeholders, ensuring the successful execution of projects through their lifecycle. The VDC Manager, serves as the technical expert for the project team, ensuring that VDC processes are effectively utilized to meet Universal Standards and expectations.  The VDC Manager acts as the liaison between the project team, design, construction, and other stakeholders, ensuring all VDC processes are effectively utilized to meet Universal Standards and expectations, while also ensuring effective coordination, collaboration, and delivery of a high-quality, on-time, and on-budget project.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Project Development: Lead the implementing VDC processes and standards. This includes managing access to the VDC database to ensure that all design and construction activities align with project goals and objectives.
  • Technical Expertise: Serve as the primary point of contact regarding Universal Creatives VDC standards and processes for the project team, ensuring that the project outcomes reflect the vision, goals, and requirements of Universal Creative.
  • Collaboration & Coordination: Partner with architects, engineers, vendors, contractors, and other stakeholders to integrate VDC tools into project workflows, facilitate coordination, and resolve conflicts early in the design and construction phases.
  • Training & Support: Lead training initiatives for project teams and stakeholders on VDC tools and technologies, promoting effective adoption and usage throughout the project.
  • Risk Mitigation and Reporting: Proactively identify and report risks related to design and construction phases, leveraging VDC tools such as clash detection to analyze potential issues and collaborate with project teams to develop and implement mitigation strategies.
  • Quality Control: Ensure that all VDC deliverables, such as models, drawings, and simulations, meet the required standards and are accurate and reliable.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION

  • Supervises an Exempt team.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.
  • Preferred technical skills include:
    • Proficient in the use of Autodesks Revit and Autodesk Navisworks.
    • Solid understanding of Autodesk Construction Cloud as a collaborative tool for project coordination and management

EDUCATION

  • Bachelors degree in architecture, construction management, or any construction-related field required. 
  • Masters degree in architecture or related field is preferred.
  • Registered architect or engineer would be a plus.
  • Certification in VDC (e.g., VDC Professional, BIM Manager Certification), BIM (e.g., Autodesk Certified Professional) or construction management is highly preferred.

EXPERIENCE

  • At least 5 years of experience in Building Information Management (BIM), Virtual Design and Construction (VDC) or related field required. A minimum of 3 years in a BIM/VDC leadership or managerial role.
  • Proven expertise in managing VDC processes, including Building Information Modeling (BIM), 3D modeling, clash detection, across a range of project types (e.g., commercial, theme park, industrial, infrastructure).
  • A minimum of 3 years of experience in themed entertainment or other large-scale, complex projects is required.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobTitle: Director, Journey Automation & Marketing Data Operations
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Director, Journey Automation & Marketing Data Operations leads the strategy, operations, governance, audience development, and journey execution capabilities required to deliver data-driven marketing across Universal Destinations & Experiences (UDX).

This role owns the development of executable audiences and the execution of automated guest journeys, ensuring guest and marketing data can be reliably translated into actionable targeting strategies, personalized experiences, campaigns, and journeys. The Director oversees Marketing Data Operations and Journey Automation, establishing scalable processes, governance, and operational standards across UDX destinations and channels.

Working across Marketing, Commercial Analytics, Digital, Technology, Privacy, and Marketing Operations, this leader will strengthen UDXs ability to use first-party guest data, Analytics-developed insights and models, and measurable learning to advance modern marketing capabilities across platforms including Snowflake, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO).

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Audience Strategy, Targeting & Activation

  • Own the development, creation, validation, and activation of executable marketing audiences across UDX channels and destinations.
  • Lead the operational strategy for audience segmentation, targeting, eligibility, suppression, personalization, and activation across campaigns and automated journeys.
  • Translate Marketing business objectives into scalable audience and targeting strategies, working with Commercial Analytics to incorporate audience insights, segmentation, predictive models, propensity scores, recommendations, and measurement learnings.
  • Clarify and manage the handoff between Analytics-developed strategy, insights, and models and this functions ownership of executable audience development and activation.
  • Establish reusable audience frameworks, naming conventions, validation standards, and operating processes across campaigns and guest journeys.
  • Enable lifecycle, behavioral, trigger-based, and personalized marketing use cases through reliable audience development and activation practices.
  • Partner with Marketing, CRM, Media, Digital Experience, Commercial Analytics, and destination teams to improve audience activation effectiveness.
  • Translate complex technical and data topics into clear business decisions and recommendations.

Guest Data Operations & Governance

  • Own the operating model for guest and marketing data used for audience activation and personalization.
  • Establish standards for data readiness, quality, validation, taxonomy, documentation, and lifecycle management.
  • Ensure guest profiles, attributes, and audiences are reliable and available for marketing use.
  • Establish SLAs, controls, monitoring, and escalation processes for guest data operations.
  • Partner with Data Engineering and Technology on data issues, dependencies, and capability requirements.
  • Empower technical managers and leads to own day-to-day implementation while removing barriers and resolving cross-functional dependencies.

Journey Automation Execution & Marketing Data Enablement

  • Own the execution of automated marketing journeys, including journey configuration, launch readiness, activation, monitoring, and operational optimization in Adobe Journey Optimizer or comparable platforms.
  • Provide business and operational leadership for the data, audience, and journey capabilities that support data-driven marketing activation, including Adobe AEP and AJO.
  • Ensure audiences, attributes, triggers, eligibility rules, analytical segments, propensity scores, recommendations, content dependencies, and data requirements are ready for journey execution.
  • Operationalize Analytics-developed segments, scores, and recommendations with agreed refresh schedules, validation routines, and monitoring standards.
  • Establish repeatable processes from business requirements through data readiness, audience creation, journey configuration, QA, activation, monitoring, and optimization.
  • Support both batch and near-real-time marketing use cases, including triggered, behavioral, lifecycle, and personalized journey execution.
  • Partner closely with campaign automation, creative, production, and destination teams while maintaining accountability for audience development, journey setup, execution readiness, and operational performance.

Operational Excellence, Privacy & Controls

  • Establish the governance and operational discipline required to scale guest data activation, audience development, and journey execution responsibly.
  • Define KPIs and service levels for audience delivery, journey launch readiness, data quality, freshness, activation performance, issue resolution, measurement readiness, and learning adoption.
  • Ensure audience membership, journey exposure, treatment/control assignment, response, and activation performance data are available to Commercial Analytics for measurement and optimization.
  • Partner with Commercial Analytics before launch to implement agreed holdouts, treatment/control logic, tracking requirements, and learning plans for tests, campaigns, and journeys.
  • Drive root-cause analysis and continuous improvement, using test findings and performance insights to improve future audience activation and journey design.
  • Partner with Privacy, Legal, Security, and Data Governance to embed consent, preference, suppression, and responsible data-use requirements into audience development and journey execution processes.
  • Identify opportunities to automate, simplify, and improve manual processes across audience development, QA, journey execution, and performance monitoring.

People Leadership & Strategic Partnership

  • Lead and develop the Journey Automation & Marketing Data Operations teams.
  • Establish clear roles, priorities, career development, and accountability for audience development, journey execution, data operations, and cross-functional delivery.
  • Manage capacity and resources against enterprise demand.
  • Serve as the senior escalation point for guest data, targeting, audience development, audience activation, journey execution, and journey performance issues.
  • Represent the function with senior Marketing, Commercial Analytics, Digital, Data, and Technology leadership.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong understanding of audience development, segmentation, targeting, identity, customer profiles, personalization, journey execution, and marketing activation.
  • Strong working knowledge of first-party data activation and the operational requirements needed to support batch, near-real-time, and triggered marketing use cases.
  • Understanding of modern customer data architectures and the relationship between source data, cloud data platforms, identity, audience creation, and downstream activation.
  • Working knowledge of data privacy, consent, preference management, suppression logic, and responsible use of customer data.
  • Ability to translate business and marketing objectives into clear data, audience, and technical requirements.
  • Strong operational mindset with demonstrated ability to create repeatable processes, standards, controls, and performance measures.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and drive resolution across complex dependencies.
  • Ability to communicate complex data and technology concepts clearly to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
  • Strong executive presence and ability to influence across functions without direct authority.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, balance competing priorities, and operate effectively in a fast-paced enterprise environment.
  • Working knowledge of SQL and data structures is valuable; direct engineering expertise is not required.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner with analytics teams on experimentation, business-impact measurement, and deployment of analytical outputs into marketing platforms.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and relevant professional experience.
  • Advanced degree or relevant industry certifications in marketing technology, data, analytics, or digital transformation are beneficial.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 10+ years of progressive experience in marketing technology, customer data, CRM, audience management, targeting, personalization, digital marketing operations, or related disciplines.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including responsibility for team development, organizational priorities, and cross-functional delivery.
  • Demonstrated experience operationalizing first-party customer or guest data for marketing use cases.
  • Experience owning audience development, segmentation, targeting, customer profile activation, journey orchestration, and journey execution capabilities.
  • Experience working within modern cloud data and marketing technology ecosystems, including Snowflake, Adobe Experience Platform (AEP), and Adobe Journey Optimizer (AJO) or comparable platforms.
  • Experience establishing scalable operating models, data-quality controls, service levels, governance standards, and issue-resolution processes.
  • Experience partnering across Marketing, Data, Technology, Analytics, Privacy, Legal, and other enterprise functions.
  • Experience partnering with Commercial Analytics or comparable analytics teams to translate segmentation, predictive models, propensity scores, recommendations, experimentation plans, and test findings into executable marketing audiences, automated journeys, and measurable activation outcomes.
  • Experience supporting complex, multi-brand, multi-destination, or matrixed organizations is strongly valued.
  • Experience within travel, hospitality, entertainment, retail, or other high-volume consumer environments is beneficial.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Leads and executes the most difficult and unique purchasing projects. This classification reviews a wide range of purchase requisitions including capital and expense items or services; investigates and develops sources of supplies, preparing bid specifications; issues bid requests and reviews quotations. Also requires interpretation of purchasing procedures to departments and vendors, as a specialist in assigned material categories, which require a high degree of technical knowledge based on sourcing category. Works with key stakeholders and legal to optimize best value for Universal Destinations and Experiences. The Sourcing Manager is responsible for the timely placement of purchase orders and delivery of materials to meet customer order requirements and maintain stock inventory levels within approved guidelines. The Sourcing Manager sources, evaluates, and purchases services, supplies, and equipment based on price, service, quality, and warranty. The Sourcing Manager is responsible for collaborating with business partners (internal and external) to assist with writing specifications and developing appropriate timelines to ensure the supply of material and services is taken into consideration to maximize our guest experience. The Sourcing Manager prepares bid forms, handles the RFX process, analyzes bid results, and makes recommendations and awards contracts. The Sourcing Manager authorizes and processes purchase orders in accordance with Universal Orlandos policies and procedures while taking into account total cost of ownership (TCO) for UDX. Potential to lead or supervise Sourcing Specialists, Associate Sourcing Specialists, and support staff in the future.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Researches possible sources/suppliers for requested items, provides alternatives or substitutions when applicable, and assists internal requesters with select requirements. Gathers/reviews requests in various formats including technical drawings or schematics. Investigates potential bidding initiatives to address hard dollar and process savings. Establishes blanket purchase agreements with vendors setting dollar limitations and time of contract limitations.
  • Facilitates the competitive bid process for all requisitions in accordance with company policies. Organize and participate in job walks, solicits price bids and proposals from qualified suppliers, conducts evaluation of all bids, and recommend suppliers for award, negotiate final prices, establish contracts, place orders, and arrange deliveries according to prescribed deadlines and timetables in conjunction with company savings goals. Works with team members from corporate offices to optimize deal terms across the enterprise.
  • Interviews sales representatives and researches companies to develop new sources of supplies to update records and files, and to secure favorable terms for UDX Orlando. Compiles metrics & KPIs for related areas.
  • Partners with the Cost Control group to ensure budget compliance and to identify cost saving opportunities as they relate to a procurement perspective.
  • Leads efforts related to key company initiatives
  • Resolve issues of prices on purchase orders that differ from prices confirmed by suppliers.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Mathematical Skills: Ability to add, subtract, multiply, and divide in all units of measure, using whole numbers, common fractions, and decimals. Have the ability to perform these operations using units of American money, weight measurement, volume and distance. Ability to apply concepts such as fractions, percentages, ratios, and proportions to practical situations. Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as
  • Reasoning Ability: Must have the ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instructions in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Communication Skills: Ability to read, interpret and analyze general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Have the ability to write; reports, business correspondence and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information in various settings; one-on-one, small groups; customers, clients, and other employees of the organization.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree is required.
  • Masters degree is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years in Sourcing and Procurement of specialized/technical commodities, engineered systems and professional services. Skills in supervising or leading the work activities of others may be required.
  • Construction experience highly desirable.
  • MS Excel: Advanced level of analytical capabilities. Ability to gather, interpret data from multiple sources and identify economic trends.
  • MS Powerpoint: Ability to translate information from analysis and convey information effectively in PowerPoint
  • Experience with computerized purchasing system required. The position requires a vast knowledge of suppliers and manufacturers, or equivalent combination of education and experience. Theme Park or entertainment related company experience a plus. Strong communication and negotiation skills, good math and analytical skills as well as the ability to work in a high pressure, fast paced environment.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Organize and establish effective Project management, develop scope of work per project, initiate and manage the Request for Bids (RFP) process, develop the budget and schedule for the Project, and coordinate and manage engineering design and specification decisions and production documentation in accordance with UDX Performance Specifications. Develop and route contracts for approvals, avoid claims and disputes and minimize during phases of the Project. Effectively manage changes and eliminate disruptions between all Project participants. Manage the Project schedule and budget, ensure quality design and production work while properly managing the construction work in the field, prepare and report status of projects, to include daily onsite visits on assigned projects. Emphasize hands on management of field operations, maintain operational use of completed facilities during construction and installation, implement efficient and timely document control.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Preparation of construction documents. These documents include but are not limited to: Construction Drawings; Construction Specifications; Scopes of Work; and General Conditions. Oversee and coordinate creative and technical design development process. Ensure that Technical Services Goals and technical approach to the project match with the budget and schedule.
  • Completes bidding & awarding the construction documents. This includes but is not limited to: development of a bidders list, a project schedule, and the preparation of a Request for Bid (RFP). The RFP includes instructions for the bid, bid response forms, Construction Agreement, Scope of Work, Construction Drawings, Wage and Equipment Rate Schedules, Schedule of Unit Pricing, Payment and Performance Bonds, General Requirements, Environmental Health and Safety requirements, Specifications, the Request for Information (RFI) process for questions and answers.
  • Perform oversight of the vendor contracts. This includes but is not limited to evaluation of technical performance and adherence to the contract requirements, which includes all aspects of the project. It also includes management of the submittal, request for information, modification documents, the directive process, and the change order process.
  • Monitors change or delays to construction schedule. This includes but not limited to evaluation of the contractors schedule performance and schedule coordination with other groups and departments. Weekly look ahead and updates are reviewed, and recovery plans are developed if schedule variances evolve.
  • Preparation of initial and additional capital funding requests including developing the project justification and a project budget.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

Bachelors degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Business Administration, or a related field, is required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years progressive experience working in a design/engineering firm dealing both with theme park design and construction management
  • Experience dealing with large scale construction projects along or with experience in working various positions with a general contractor dealing with estimating, budgeting, bidding, field experience dealing with all aspects of projects required
  • Or equivalent combinations of education and experience

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Surety Underwriter - Small to Mid Commercial
Job.JobDescription:
Description

Liberty Mutual Surety is currently recruiting for a Senior Surety Underwriter to join ourSmall to Mid Commercial Surety team in Florida.

As a Senior Surety Underwriter you will develop and underwrite profitable surety business, and service independent agents, brokers,and Small to Mid Commercial accounts within an assigned territory. Using your excellent relationship skills, you will build and maintain positive partnerships our agents, brokers, and accounts as a trusted advisor and underwriting resource for our producers and customers. You will also use yourbusiness and financial acumen to perform primary credit underwriting and financial/risk analysis, provide recommendations, and make decisions on new and existing accounts. This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced andself-motivated surety professional looking to grow their career with a top surety company that focuses on its employees and customers first.


Liberty Mutual Surety, a business unit of Liberty Mutual Insurance, is the worlds largest globally Surety, including in the United States. Conducting business worldwide through fronting relationships and Liberty-owned subsidiaries, we provide bonds in over 60 countries for construction firms, manufacturers and suppliers, and commercial enterprises on an account and transactional basis. We are committed to building mutually profitable relationships by providing smart business solutions, ease of doing business, and consistent, responsive service. Liberty Mutual Surety is dedicated to the communities we serve and highly values a diverse workforce in more than 18 countries.

Responsibilities:

  • Underwrite and negotiate accounts to maximize profitability whilst minimizing risk, which may include the most complex accounts based on level of role. Makes thorough evaluations and assessments of a customers financial, technical, organizational, and management capacities, including experience, desired objectives as well as a subjective judgment of character.
  • Manage the profitability and retention of an assigned book of business while continue to develop the portfolio through strong relationships and active engagement with new and existing agents and brokers. May assist in developing the marketing plan.
  • Performs analytical evaluations of financial statements on both a static and trend basis. Determines the present and historical financial position of accounts and monitors financial position of risk through analysis of quarterly statements and work in progress data as appropriate.

Your opportunity


We believe that, when done right, investing liberates people to create their own destiny. We are driven by our purpose to champion every client's goals with passion and integrity.
