Charles Schwab Bank (CSB) has proven successful in serving the lending needs of Schwab's core Retail consumer clients which is an important business line that we will continue to grow. We now have a unique opportunity to expand our lending capabilities by targeting Schwab's high net worth (HNW) clients and registered investment advisory (RIA) firms. To seize this growth opportunity, we will build a separate, parallel lending business model leveraging Charles Schwab Premier Bank (CSPB). HNW clients and RIA firms have complex credit profiles and higher service level expectations requiring a different approach with specialized expertise to serve their needs.

Our Opportunity:

The Senior Banking team is seeking a high potential candidate to partner with Schwab Wealth Advisory partners and their end clients by providing Banking and Credit solutions. Bank lending products include residential mortgages, home equity lines of credit, and securities-based lending. Schwab Bank also offers trust services and deposit products including checking and savings accounts. The Senior Banker will be responsible for serving Schwab Wealth Advisory clients and will work closely with partners across the Bank including the Bank Sales Team, Bank Credit Team, Bank Operations, Trust and Deposit service teams to develop solutions and recommendations meeting the unique needs of Schwab Wealth Advisory clients. This role encompasses internal marketing such as meetings with various Schwab Partners and client meetings as may be requested. The Senior Banker will also coordinate with Schwab Wealth Advisory clients' accountants, attorneys or other professionals as needed. Additionally, the Senior Banker acts as the primary contact for assisting loan inquiries, loans in process and problem resolution that may need to be completed for both origination and servicing requests.

What you'll do:

  • Advise Schwab Wealth Advisory clients on appropriate Bank lending, deposit and trust solutions including products, pricing and recommended deal structures. Gather information from clients using internal and external resources for the completion of the application process.
  • Partner with Schwab teammates in assigned geographies to discuss Schwab Wealth Advisory client base and identify lending, deposit and trust opportunities and recommend opportunity action plans.
  • Establish a reputation of execution and excellence. Gain confidence of Schwab Partners to fully develop lending, deposit and trust opportunities with their SchwabWealth Advisory clients.
  • Develop and present creative and intelligent lending, deposit and trust solutions; consult partners, such as credit specialists, as needed.
  • Take ownership of banking client experience from initial contact to loan funding or account establishment, working closely with partners and third-party providers to ensure a smooth process for Schwab Wealth Advisoryclients.
  • Work with and communicate effectively with Schwab partners.
  • Responsible for the early identification of complex transaction structures, such as: entity, trust, guarantor, co-op, unique property requirements, condensed timeframes, properties under construction, and need for multiple co-borrowers.
  • Maintain full awareness of status for all SchwabWealth Advisory banking applications in pipeline and function as primary Schwab Bank liaison for all parties involved in bank account opening process, including service, credit, risk and third-party vendors.
  • Address all issues surfaced during loan process and assist with underwriting requests

What you have


Required Qualifications:

  • Minimum of 5 years of successful lending consultation and business development experience in Financial Services or working closely with HNW/UHNW clients.
  • Expert knowledge of credit products including residential mortgage products, home equity lines of credit, and securities-based loans. Familiarity with bank deposit and cash management products and brokerage margin product as well as business banking requirements and structures.
  • Proven ability to analyze cash flow and balance sheet of HNW/UHNW retail brokerage clients and develop client's personal financial statement. General understanding of estate planning techniques, entity structuring, and tax strategies.
  • Strong skills in diplomacy, discretion, and professionalism; ability to efficiently, tactfully & professionally screen, manage and/or decline transactions while maintaining partner and HNW/UHNW client relationships.
  • Possess excellent oral and written communication skills. Exceptional presentation skills.
  • Strong relationship building capabilities with Schwab teammates, HNW/UHNW clients, and matrix partners (e.g., service, credit, risk and third-party vendors).
  • Strong collaboration skills in a team-oriented environment.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to multi-task and work efficiently, independently and with teams, to meet tight deadlines with minimal supervision.
  • Strong command of mortgage underwriting guidelines. (Completion of formal credit training strongly preferred)
  • Series 7 and 63/65 or 66 licenses required.
  • NMLS license required (To be obtained within 90 days of employment)

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Undergraduate or advanced degree preferred.
  • Banking background with experience working with HNW/UHNW brokerage clients strongly preferred.
  • NMLS license required (To be obtained within 90 days of employment)

As an AI Integration Architect, you'll help shape how emerging artificial intelligence capabilities securely connect across Schwab's enterprise technology ecosystem. Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate Manager - GCP Cloud DevOps Engineer
Job.CustomJobTypeName: Software Developer / Engineer, IT / Technology, Cloud Engineer
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte is seeking a Lead Managed Services Engineer II to design, automate, and operate enterprise-scale cloud capabilities that support clients' critical cyber assets. In this role, you will apply Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Terraform, infrastructure as code, and DevOps practices to build secure, scalable, and reliable solutions. You will collaborate with Cyber Operate, data engineering, and artificial intelligence and machine learning (AI/ML) teams to support evolving client needs, operational excellence, and secure cloud delivery.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

  • Design, build, and maintain Terraform modules and infrastructure-as-code workflows across development, test, staging, and production environments.
  • Provision and operate Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services, including Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Firestore, Identity and Access Management (IAM), Secret Manager, Google Cloud Load Balancing, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), virtual private clouds (VPCs), subnets, firewall rules, private connectivity, Domain Name System (DNS), and Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) certificates.
  • Develop continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines, infrastructure versioning, automated code-review processes, governance controls, and deployment strategies for infrastructure and applications.
  • Implement monitoring, alerting, logging, observability, high availability, and disaster recovery practices; investigate production incidents and document root-cause findings.
  • Create operational runbooks, architecture documentation, and support procedures for managed cloud environments.
  • Partner with data engineering and AI/ML teams to support infrastructure for data platforms and AI workloads, including Vertex AI Agent Engine, Vertex AI Search, and Model Armor.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients' critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required 6+ years of experience in:

  • Experience with Terraform module development and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure provisioning across development, test, staging, and production environments.
  • Experience configuring Cloud Run, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Firestore, Secret Manager, Google Cloud Load Balancing, Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), Identity and Access Management (IAM), virtual private clouds (VPCs), subnets, firewall rules, private connectivity, Domain Name System (DNS), and Secure Sockets Layer (SSL) certificates.
  • Experience developing continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines with Cloud Build or GitHub Actions for infrastructure and application deployments, including version control, code review, and deployment processes.
  • Experience using Cloud Monitoring for monitoring, alerting, logging, and observability; production incident investigation; operational runbook development; and architecture documentation.
  • Experience building application programming interfaces (APIs) or data connectors using Python, Cloud Functions, or Cloud Run; and supporting data platforms using BigQuery, Dataflow, Pub/Sub, Cloud Storage, or Cloud Composer.
  • Experience supporting infrastructure for Vertex AI Agent Engine, Vertex AI Search, or Model Armor.
  • Experience configuring IAM policies, service accounts, and security controls for cloud infrastructure.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 day/week times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Master's degree
  • Google Cloud Professional Cloud DevOps Engineer certification
  • HashiCorp Certified: Terraform Associate certification
  • Experience supporting identity lifecycle management, security operations, threat intelligence, or application security.

Job.JobTitle: Healthcare IT Infrastructure & Clinical Applications Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Healthcare IT Infrastructure & Clinical Applications Consultant, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as an Analyst without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long-term, onsite and/or remote client service delivery.


Work you'll do

As a Healthcare IT Infrastructure & Clinical Applications Consultant you'll support client teams in implementing, upgrading, and supporting enterprise business and clinical applications. You'll deliver assigned project activities, coordinate with client, vendor, onshore, and offshore teams, and help resolve issues through deployment and ongoing support.

Responsibilities

  • Support application implementation, upgrades, and production support.
  • Coordinate day-to-day activities with client, delivery, offshore, and vendor teams; track actions and handoffs.
  • Assist with application configuration, integrations, testing, defect triage, release coordination, and deployment readiness.
  • Investigate issues, coordinate resolution, and support transition to steady-state operations.
  • Maintain project plans, status updates, technical documentation, and operational-readiness materials.
  • Raise risks, dependencies, and issues promptly; communicate progress clearly to stakeholders.
  • Support healthcare infrastructure and data exchange activities involving Windows Server, networking, HL7 v2.x, Epic Bridges, interface engines, REST/SOAP APIs, or FHIR.
  • Follow applicable security, privacy, and compliance practices when handling healthcare information
A successful candidate would possess these skills:
* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Our Industry Solutions offering provides verticalized solutions that transform how clients sell products, deliver services, generate growth, and execute mission-critical operations. We deliver integrated business expertise with scalable, repeatable technology solutions specifically engineered for each sector.

Qualifications

Required:
  • 3+ years of relevant experience in healthcare IT, enterprise applications, infrastructure, systems integration, or technology implementation.
  • Experience supporting application implementation, upgrades, or production support.
  • Familiarity with configuration, integrations, testing, defect management, or release coordination.
  • Working knowledge of Windows Server and networking fundamentals, such as TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls, or load balancing.
  • Experience with healthcare integration technologies such as HL7 v2.x, interface engines, or Epic Bridges.
  • Familiarity with security concepts such as encryption, identity, TLS/PKI, or HIPAA.
  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, business, healthcare, or a related field; or equivalent experience
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience coordinating work across client, vendor, onshore, and offshore teams.
  • Familiarity with REST/SOAP APIs, FHIR, DICOM, Azure or AWS, VMware, Hyper-V, Citrix VDI, ServiceNow, or monitoring tools.
  • Python or PowerShell scripting experience; familiarity with Git or CI/CD.
  • Exposure to clinical applications such as Mindray Patient Monitors, Telcor CPN, GE Centricity Perinatal, GE MUSE, Lumedx, West-Com, Philips Xper, BD Pyxis, Merge Cardio/Hemo, Dragon Medical One, GE ViewPoint, MagView, Natus XLTek/NeuroWorks, EndoManager, TrackCore, Varian Aria, RightFax, OnBase, iMedConsent, GE Advantx, or 3M 360 Encompass.

Certifications

Relevant certifications in Azure or Windows Server administration, networking, cybersecurity, or HL7/FHIR are preferred but not required. Equivalent hands-on experience may be considered.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate Manager - IAM PBAC Architect/Engineer
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte's Cyber Operate offering helps organizations operate and evolve critical cyber capabilities, including identity and access management. As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II, you will lead the design, implementation, and evolution of policy-based access control (PBAC) and broader identity and access management (IAM) solutions for large, highly regulated client environments. You will combine hands-on engineering with technical leadership to strengthen security, support regulatory compliance, and help clients manage access at scale.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for…

  • Lead the design, implementation, and ongoing enhancement of PBAC and IAM solutions for complex, regulated client environments.
  • Translate business and security requirements into IAM architectures, controls, implementation plans, and technology roadmaps.
  • Build and maintain automated provisioning, de-provisioning, and access-control workflows.
  • Assess IAM controls and vulnerabilities, troubleshoot access issues, and lead root-cause remediation that minimizes business disruption.
  • Lead technical workstreams, maintain IAM documentation, deliver enablement on IAM policies and procedures, and mentor team members.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients' critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in “Computer Science” or Information Systems.
  • 6+ years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), including Policy-Based Access Control (PBAC), identity governance, automated provisioning and de-provisioning, enterprise access management, and IAM security audits.
  • Experience building IAM automation using Python or PowerShell and working with Active Directory or Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP), Okta or Azure Active Directory, and Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML), Open Authorization (OAuth), or OpenID Connect.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Master's degree.
  • Current Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Information Security Manager (CISM), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), or a vendor-specific identity and access management or cloud security certification.
  • Experience supporting financial services organizations, including banking, insurance, or capital markets environments.
  • Experience supporting security operations, threat intelligence, application security, or continuous compliance services.
  • Experience with PlainID or Axiomatics.
  • Experience leading IAM technical workstreams, technology roadmaps, or process-improvement initiatives.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Operate Manager - Identity Security Architect & Product Engineering
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Join Deloitte as a Lead Managed Services Engineer II and help design, engineer, and deploy identity security capabilities across enterprise environments. You will advance attack path analysis, identity threat protection, authentication modernization, policy-based access control (PBAC), and identity-driven attack containment. Working across cybersecurity, infrastructure, engineering, architecture, product, and vendor teams, you will deliver scalable solutions using Sgnl.ai, PlainID, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and CrowdStrike Identity Protection. This role combines identity and access management (IAM) architecture, Zero Trust, and product engineering to help clients reduce risk, strengthen resilience, and improve access experiences. This role may require work outside standard business hours based on business needs.

Work you'll do

As a Lead Managed Services Engineer II on the Cyber Operate team, you will be responsible for:

  • Define identity security roadmaps and architecture standards aligned with Zero Trust for authentication, authorization, access governance, and workforce, privileged, and machine identities.
  • Partner with product vendors and internal teams to translate business requirements into identity and access management solutions across enterprise applications and infrastructure.
  • Lead product engineering and deployment for Sgnl.ai, PlainID, CrowdStrike Identity Protection, Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), and authentication and authorization platforms.
  • Expand attack path analysis, identity threat detection, risk scoring, and identity-driven attack containment to address identity-based attack vectors, privilege escalation paths, lateral movement, and access risks.
  • Advance authentication services, including authenticator capabilities and access-experience improvements, alongside adaptive access, PBAC, identity-aware authorization, and risk-based access decisions using identity intelligence and continuous verification.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Operate offering Operates clients' critical cyber assets as a fully managed service or working in partnership with clients. Provides talent, leading technologies, and processes to operate client cyber capabilities, including the identity lifecycle, security operations, threat intelligence, application security business transformation, and continuous compliance.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 6+ years of Experience designing identity and access management (IAM) architecture for workforce, privileged, and machine identities, including Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD), single sign-on (SSO), multifactor authentication (MFA), identity governance, privileged access management (PAM), federation, and authentication protocols.
  • Experience engineering, integrating, and operationalizing Sgnl.ai, PlainID, CrowdStrike Identity Protection, and Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD) across enterprise applications and infrastructure.
  • Experience applying Zero Trust Architecture, identity threat detection and response (ITDR), attack path analysis, authorization frameworks, PBAC, and risk-based authentication; integrating platforms using application programming interfaces (APIs), identity protocols, automation, and cloud-native architectures.
  • You must reside within a commutable distance of your assigned office with the ability to commute daily, if required, without the need for overnight accommodations.
  • You can expect to co-locate on average 1 times a week with variations based on types of work/projects and client locations.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • 10+ years of experience in cybersecurity, IAM, identity architecture, or security engineering.
  • Experience leading identity transformation programs for organizations subject to regulatory requirements.
  • Experience applying National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST) and Zero Trust frameworks.
  • One or more of the following certifications: Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP), Azure Security Engineer, or customer identity and access management (CIAM) or identity and access management (IAM) certification.
  • Master's degree.

Job ID373339

Job.JobTitle: Converge Signals, FSI - Engineering Lead_Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.

Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented Data Scientist to join the Converge for FSI team and help build differentiated, data-driven financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This is a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced analytics and financial services industry expertise, developing the models and insights that power Signals for FSI and future products in the Converge for FSI portfolio.

Position Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled and client-facing Engineering Lead to sit at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer partnership, supporting the Signals for FSI product. Signals is a proprietary set of data assets coupled with AI, data science, and statistical models that help our clients drive business growth and power decisions in a dynamic and changing market. You'll own the architecture decisions that turn this from a collection of prototypes into a real platform: a shared data pipeline and warehouse that any app in the suite can draw from, a common geospatial/demographic data layer that scales nationally. In this role, you will partner with our product & data science team to integrate new data sources and harden prototypes into applications based on client feedback. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with direct influence on product direction. You will be part of the General Manager's leadership team, responsible for proactively bringing ideas that push the business forward, weighing in on key decisions, and helping junior resources across the team overcome hurdles. This is a build-it-for-real role for someone who's done this exact transition before — not scaling one app, but building the reusable foundation that lets a whole suite of client-facing products scale together.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026.

Work you'll do

As the Engineering Lead, you will work at the intersection of data science, engineering, and financial services domain expertise to build and refine the data platforms, models, and analytics that power Signals for FSI:

  • Rapidly prototype and build POCs using financial services datasets and data models that demonstrate value in the context of a client's real-world use cases
  • Lead teams of onshore and offshore data engineers and application engineers to harden prototypes into production grade applications that satisfy the highly secure and regulated environments of financial services.
  • Collaborate with internal Product & Data fabric teams to integrate new data sources and design and build scalable, production-ready data pipelines and applications.
  • Partner with the Product team and client architects to translate financial services use cases into requirements, features, and application specifications.
  • Recognize and promote opportunities for reuse when designing prototypes and applications.
  • Evaluate data, model and application performance against business and regulatory considerations relevant to financial services and iterate based on findings.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, business-relevant insights for Product, Sales, and client-facing teams to shape the technical go-to-market strategy.
  • Maintain a library of reusable demo assets, hardened applications, and reference implementations.
  • Stay current on emerging AI/ML techniques and financial services data trends, and evaluate their application to the Signals for FSI roadmap.
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and integration guides.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Experience in building data and insights products and pipelines that power insights and signals for business users to drive growth decisions.
  • Demonstrated ability to take a working prototype and re-architect it for production scale, cost, and reliability — not just incremental feature work
  • Exceptional written & verbal communicator — able to lead technical conversations with senior engineers and C-suite stakeholders alike; able to translate infrastructure tradeoffs for non-technical stakeholders
  • Proven experience designing and scaling geospatial/location-based data systems (spatial indexing, PostGIS, H3, or equivalent) — ability to replace client-side point-in-radius rendering with server-side spatial queries at scale
  • Strong background in ETL/data pipeline engineering — designing scheduled ingestion from third-party data vendors into a warehouse or lake (BigQuery, Snowflake, or equivalent)
  • Experience with Python/FastAPI (or comparable) backend development and React/TypeScript frontend development, sufficient to review and refactor both sides of a full-stack codebase
  • Hands-on experience with data security and PII handling — masking, access controls, and retention policy for datasets containing personal identifiers
  • Experience standing up CI/CD pipelines and container/Helm-based deployment from scratch
  • Familiarity with authentication/authorization platforms (OAuth2, enterprise SSO/gateway integration) and migrating services onto a shared platform auth layer
  • Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry, with curiosity about how data translates into real client outcomes.
  • Exposure to Agentic AI frameworks, harnesses, and tooling — including LangGraph, LangChain, or similar orchestration frameworks
  • Practical understanding of LLM integration patterns, prompt engineering, and AI-powered application design
  • Strong analytical rigor paired with sound judgment about when a model is ready to ship versus needing further refinement.
  • Comfortable moving between hands-on technical work and clear communication with product, engineering, and business stakeholders.
  • Self-directed and organized, with the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams at once.
  • Collaborative mindset and a willingness to partner closely with engineering and product teams to bring models into production.
  • Comfortable working through ambiguous, messy problems that require creativity and persistence.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including 3+ years in a technical lead or architecture role
  • Ability to travel 10-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree (Master's) in Engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience working with financial services data (e.g., banking, capital markets, or insurance) or delivering analytics solutions to financial services clients.
  • Experience with cloud-based data and analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) in a financial services or other highly regulated industry context.
  • Familiarity with risk, fraud, credit, or customer analytics use cases within banking, capital markets, or insurance.
  • Experience with feature stores or ML feature engineering pipelines, particularly for on-demand/real-time scoring rather than static precomputed datasets
  • Background in financial services or another regulated industry, with working knowledge of data vendor licensing/compliance constraints (e.g., credit bureau or B2B data providers)
  • Experience with LLM/agent infrastructure (LangChain, LLM gateways) including cost monitoring and latency observability
  • Familiarity with FDIC, Census, or similar public geospatial/demographic datasets

Job.JobTitle: Converge Signals, FSI - Data Scientist_Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.

Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented Data Scientist to join the Converge for FSI team and help build differentiated, data-driven financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This is a great opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced analytics and financial services industry expertise, developing the models and insights that power Signals for FSI and future products in the Converge for FSI portfolio.

Position Summary

Financial services data holds enormous, often-underused potential — and turning it into decisions the business can act on takes both rigorous technical craft and real industry fluency. As a Data Scientist on the Signals for FSI team, you'll build the analytical engine behind one of Converge for FSI's flagship products, working hands-on with real financial services data to develop models clients can trust. You'll do it on a team that pairs start-up speed with the scale and credibility of Deloitte, giving you room to experiment while your work reaches some of the most influential institutions in financial services.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026.

Work you'll do

As the Data Scientist, you will work at the intersection of data science, product, and financial services domain expertise to build and refine the models and analytics that power Signals for FSI:

  • Develop, test, and refine statistical and machine learning models using financial services datasets (e.g., consumers, businesses, transactions, accounts, risk, or market data) to power Signals for FSI.
  • Partner with the Product team to translate financial services use cases into data requirements, features, data signals, and model specifications.
  • Conduct exploratory data analysis and validate data quality across structured and semi-structured financial services data sources.
  • Evaluate model performance against business and regulatory considerations relevant to financial services and iterate based on findings.
  • Translate analytical findings into clear, business-relevant insights for Product, Sales, and client-facing teams.
  • Stay current on emerging Statistical, AI/ML techniques and financial services data trends, and evaluate their application to the Signals for FSI roadmap.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Genuine interest in and working knowledge of the financial services industry, with curiosity about how data translates into real client outcomes – early use cases are retail banking, investment and wealth management and insurance, but will expand over time.
  • Strong analytical rigor paired with sound judgment about when a signal or model is ready to ship versus needing further refinement.
  • Comfortable moving between hands-on technical work and clear communication with product, engineering, and business stakeholders.
  • Self-directed and organized, with the ability to manage multiple analytical workstreams at once.
  • Collaborative mindset and a willingness to partner closely with engineering and product teams to bring models into production.
  • Comfortable working through ambiguous, messy problems that require creativity and persistence.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 4+ years of experience in applied data science, machine learning, or statistical modeling, including hands-on model development and validation – proficient at using Python, SQL and other data transformation and analytical tools
  • Ability to travel 10-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Advanced degree (Master's) in Computer Science, Statistics, Data Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • 2+ years of experience working with financial services data (e.g., banking, capital markets, investment management, or insurance) or delivering analytics solutions to financial services clients.
  • 2+ years of working with customer data to build audiences and segments for sales and marketing use cases.
  • Experience with cloud-based data and analytics platforms (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure) in a financial services or other highly regulated industry context.
  • Experience with MCP servers and use of AI to analyze large data sets.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Attractions & Ride Operations, Hospitality / Tourism / Events, Construction Superintendent
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Project Superintendent is responsible for the daily management of the overall project site including all coordination activates between the various Contractors, Sub-Contractors, Architects and Engineers and their Sub-Consultants, Show / Ride Vendors and the various Park Operating Departments (Operations, Security, Food, Merchandise, etc.). This includes pre-planning and execution to ensure the Contractor is providing adequate resources to the tasks to meet Cost, Safety, Quality, and Schedule. Responsible for ensuring that the work being installed by the Contractors is per the drawings and specifications, using sound construction practices and good quality workmanship. This includes but is not limited to ensuring the latest drawings, specifications and Universals environmental, occupational health and safety procedures are being followed and that the facilities being built are dimensionally accurate. Demand quality from all contractors, subcontractors and vendors while meeting cost and schedule requirements.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Responsible for the overall smooth operation of the job site including cleanliness, order, coordination, efficiency and productivity.
  • Continually find solutions to conflicts in structural / architectural / mechanical / electrical drawings and specifications by conferring with the Consultants. Coordinate these solutions with the various sub-trades. Identify contract document conflicts and recommend solutions to the Project Engineer and Project Manager.
  • Enforce quality control and monitor the contractor and subcontractors schedules. Ensure construction work complies with all engineering standards, codes, specifications and design documents.
  • Coordinate inspections with consultants and authorities as required.
  • Schedule coordinate and lead job site safety meetings.
  • Maintain record documents daily, weekly, and monthly reports; of contractors, consultants, and owner actives, including significant project events and milestones.
  • Provide information and interpretation of plans, detail sheets and specifications for contractors and subcontractors.
  • Report accurate quantities of on-site labor by trade; accurately monitor material to ensure quantities that the contractor has on site is sufficient to complete the Project in the field. Check layout work competently, accurately and efficiently.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Associate degree (AA) in Construction, Engineering, or Architecture
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years experience as a project superintendent (preferably in theme parks) required
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Maintain the original aesthetics and function of the animated figures, props, and sets within the Rides and Shows. The responsibilities will include cleaning, repairing, installing, and finishing/painting skins, shells, costumes, props, and set pieces as well as access into these assets for Ride and Show Mechanics. Knowledge of all techniques, materials, and tools involved in silicone skin repair, fiberglass repair and finishing, scenic painting, faux finishing, airbrushing, automotive painting, carpentry, sculpting, mold making, casting, fabrication, sewing, costuming, patterning, wig care, mechanical work, and problem solving will be utilized.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain, troubleshoot, and install flexible and non-flexible skins, coverings (including costumes, wigs, fur, and feathers), and support structures for animated figures. This includes planning/preparing for work, cleaning, repairing, painting of silicone and fiberglass skins and shells, cleaning of work area, and documenting work. Mends or replaces costumes and other figure coverings. Painting processes to include properly assessing, mixing, and applying airbrush and/or faux paint techniques, automotive paint applications, as well as wet/dry brush and sponge painting
  • Maintain sets within Rides and Shows to include planning/preparing for work, cleaning, sculpting, construction, painting, cleaning of work area, and documenting work. Maintenance of show sets to include mending or replacing backdrops, curtains, scrims, and other set related soft materials. Painting techniques to include brushing, rolling, blending, spraying, and faux finishing techniques of show sets.
  • Maintain, fabricate, and install show props to include planning/preparing for work, cleaning, molding, casting, construction, finishing/painting, cleaning of work area, and documenting work.
  • Assist Ride and Show Maintenance with access into figures, props, and sets for their inspections and repairs to include mechanical disassembly and assembly of parts related to animated figures.
  • Maintain, fabricate, and install/embed fasteners and attachments for animated figures, sets, and props. This can include buckles, straps, zippers, snaps, stand-offs, tabs, and various inserts.
  • Inspect figures, sets, props, shop facilities, equipment, and tools for any wear/damage and document findings. Assist in show quality walk-throughs, assessing animated figures, show sets and props for necessary repairs and improvements.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree or GED is required
  • Associates degree is preferred - Visual Arts, Scenery Production, Technical Theater, Costuming or equivalent
  • Bachelors degree is preferred - Visual Arts, Scenery Production, Technical Theater, Costuming or equivalent

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years set/prop fabrication and maintenance with the finishing aspect of animated figures is required
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

Valid Florida Drivers License/ required to operate company vehicles

May 17, 2027 - July 30, 2027

Were you born to close deals? Do you love networking and connecting with people? Do you possess an unwavering drive to succeed?


If you checked any or all of these boxes, its time to put your people skills to work at Comparion Insurance Agency, a Liberty Mutual company as a Sales intern.

Details

This internship is more than just about learning the ropes. The Sales Internship at Comparion Insurance Agency involves immersing yourself in a fast-paced and supportive environment where youre encouraged to sharpen your selling skills.


As a Sales Intern, you will join a network of over 400 Liberty Mutual interns and participate in educational and social programs that contribute to your professional development. We offer a robust intern onboarding program that brings summer interns together to build connections in their first week!


Youll grow sales through cold calling, observe and assist with sales events, develop sourcing strategies, and utilize CRM tools and systems to support marketing campaigns. You may even be asked to implement a social media strategy for sales reps.


Best of all, at the close of the internship, you may have the opportunity to explore a future career in sales at Comparion Insurance Agency.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Digital Product Owner Equity Compensation Platform
Job.JobDescription:
Your opportunity


At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together.

Applicants must currently be authorized to work for any employer in the United States, now and in the future, on a full-time basis without employer sponsorship.

We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate to work on site 4 days per week in one of the specified locations.

Schwab's Workplace Services (WS) supports retirement, stock plan, and designated brokerage services for corporations and their employees. EquiView, Schwab's proprietary stock plan recordkeeping system, serves corporate Stock Plan Services (SPS) clients. As EquiView scales, the WS Digital Product Management team seeks a Senior Digital Product Owner with equity compensation financial reporting experience (ASC 718/IFRS 2) to lead high-impact enhancements for corporate B2B clients, partnering across Product, Technology, Reporting, Risk/Compliance, and Client Services.

You will lead complex, cross-functional initiatives that advance Schwab's enterprise equity compensation platform, emphasizing financial reporting and client outcomes. You will drive major product enhancements, large-scale client initiatives, system and data migrations, and regulatory changes. Operating with high autonomy, you will navigate ambiguity, align stakeholders, and deliver measurable business value.

The ideal candidate combines strategic product leadership, execution excellence, and hands-on equity compensation financial reporting experience (e.g., ASC 718 and IFRS 2), and can translate complex accounting, operational, and client requirements into scalable product capabilities for internal teams and external clients.

You will partner with Product Management, Engineering, Quality Assurance, Reporting, Client Services, Compliance, and other stakeholders to set priorities, manage dependencies and risk, and deliver high-quality solutions that support Schwab's equity compensation business and client objectives.

What you'll do

  • Leadership & Execution – Lead end-to-end delivery for complex, multi-release initiatives across EquiView, including financial reporting enhancements and regulatory- and business-driven updates. Own plans and outcomes: scope, timeline, dependencies, risk, resourcing, and stakeholder alignment. Drive UAT strategy and execution (planning, coordination, communications, and sign-off) and ensure operational readiness for launch.
  • Partner with product owners, analysts, engineers, and stakeholders in an Agile environment to define problems, clarify requirements, and deliver incrementally balancing near-term commitments with longer-term platform strategy.
  • Client & Partner Focus – Partner with business stakeholders to define clear acceptance criteria, refine backlog items, and ensure requirements are testable and executable. Work directly with Engineering and QA to support solution design, clarify functional behavior, and resolve complex platform issues. Collaborate with Reporting, Client Services, Conversion, Product Support, and Operations to support client readiness, training, and post-launch adoption.
  • Strategy – Contribute to the product vision and roadmap for EquiView financial reporting and recordkeeping capabilities by combining market/regulatory awareness with internal stakeholder insights. Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce operational risk, and improve scalability for clients and internal teams.
  • Outcomes – Define success measures (quality, timeliness, adoption, and risk reduction) and drive delivery from discovery through launch. Ensure solutions are well-documented, supportable, and aligned to client needs and Schwab operational controls.

What you have


To ensure that we fulfill our promise of "challenging the status quo," this role has specific qualifications that successful candidates should have.

Required Qualifications:

  • Experience in equity compensation, stock plan administration, and/or equity systems operations.
  • Deep understanding of ASC 718 and/or IFRS 2; familiarity with relevant IRS/SEC requirements (e.g., Section 16) and ESPP concepts.
  • Experience working with equity plan financial reporting platforms.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to troubleshoot complex issues across data, process, and technology
  • High attention to detail with the ability to drive work from concept through implementation and stabilization
  • Demonstrated track record of predictable delivery, proactive risk management, and clear stakeholder communication
  • Ability and desire to work in a collaborative team environment effectively and efficiently.
  • Experience participating in cross functional projects, with an emphasis on systems, technologies, business process redesign and/or impact to field and customer service.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills
  • BA/BS degree or equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Exceptional stock plan and product management skills - ability to synthesize data and stakeholder feedback into insights and actions.
  • 2+ years' experience as a Product Owner or Product Manager (or equivalent experience leading backlog, roadmap delivery, and cross-functional outcomes).
  • Current EquiView financial reporting product experience is highly valued.
  • Agile/Scrum experience.
  • Project Management certification (PMP, Agile, or equivalent).
  • CEP or ECA certification or equivalent experience.

In addition to the salary range, this role is also eligible for bonuses or incentive opportunities.

#workplacejobs


What's in it for you

At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

  • 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
  • Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
  • Paid parental leave and family building benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

Job.JobTitle: Ascend Engineering Foundation (AEF) - Cloud Architect_Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

Ascend Engineering Foundation (AEF) provides a common engineering foundation of reusable assets, common runtime services (CRS), platform capabilities and deployment frameworks that helps teams deliver client solutions consistently and efficiently. Supporting Zora's Product Plus and Ascend's Service+ strategies, AEF brings together cloud infrastructure, integration, AI and agentic capabilities, access controls and AppStore deployment patterns to simplify application modernization and client deployments. AEF's common runtime services provide shared capabilities that applications can reuse, reducing duplication and enabling consistent deployment and operation across supported environments.

Position Summary

As a Cloud Architect, you will build and deploy cloud solutions to support enterprise clients. This requires all dimensions of cloud architecture.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/1/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Cloud Architect, you will architect, build, and operate enterprise cloud environments for our clients — from initial design through migration, onboarding, and day-to-day operations. Key responsibilities include:

Responsibilities

  • Architecting application designs using Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), Amazon Web Services (AWS), or any leading cloud-provider service.
  • Building, migrating, and testing Cloud Service Provider (CSP) environments.
  • Designing data security and end-to-end applications.
  • Leading application migration projects, including optimizing technical reliability and improving application performance.
  • Integrating with on-premises applications, cloud providers, or other platforms.
  • Implementing cost-optimized solutions based on usage, business requirements, and budget.

Onboarding

  • Develop client architecture, assuring it meets availability, disaster recovery (DR), and Well-Architected best practices.
  • Design, implement, and test Disaster Recovery.
  • Identify solution components via Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) review.
  • Lead technical onboarding and integration with the OpenCloud Platform, including the OC Portal.
  • Lead end-to-end implementation of design for new builds.
  • Own technical sign-off and verification of the go/no-go checklist.

Ongoing Operations

  • Lead incident and change request (CR) escalation for timely resolution, ensuring the RCA/problem management process is executed.
  • Lead all root cause analysis (RCA) and problem management efforts.
  • Lead client and project team interaction for technical decisions.
  • Conduct quarterly Well-Architected Reviews (WAR) and update architecture design documents in conjunction with cost optimization.
  • Work directly with Affinity Groups to ensure automation (pipeline) for deployment, release, and operational activities is repeatable and follows best practices.
  • Work with Shared Services team members, identifying repeatable efforts that can be automated.
  • Work with the Service Delivery Manager to implement areas of improvement.
  • Conduct monthly reviews of existing runbooks with the Pod/Architecture Team for alignment of automated processes.
  • Review and own verification of monitoring, performance, and budget alerting to align with SLA requirements as a baseline to support SOWs.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
  • Effective communication skills.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor-level degree in engineering, IT, data communications, telecommunications, computer science, or equivalent professional experience and/or qualifications.
  • 6+ years of relevant consulting, industry, or technology experience.
  • Ability to architect enterprise applications using Azure, GCP, or AWS.
  • Deep knowledge of Kubernetes architecture design and deployment.
  • Cloud networking architecture skills and configuration.
  • Working knowledge of cloud technologies such as computing, storage, network, managed SQL/NoSQL databases/data warehouses, and auto-scaling groups.
  • Understanding of cloud security for identity and access management (IAM) to security groups.
  • Deep knowledge of automation scripts and tools: Terraform, Bash, Ansible, Jenkins, and CloudFormation.
  • Understanding of how to deploy multitier applications across a custom-defined virtual private cloud.
  • Ability to set up multilevel network environments with any of the CSPs.
  • Ability to design scalable, secure, dependable, and efficient technical cloud ecosystems to support enterprise applications.
  • Experience with Application Programming Interface (API) and gateway functions: cloud function and API gateway (or equivalent).
  • Ability to travel X-X%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • AWS certification — Associate or Professional Solutions Architect.
  • Experience with Linux and/or Windows-based OS, including virtual machines: Red Hat, SUSE, or Windows Server.
  • Experience with cloud automation and container tools: Bash scripting and Ansible.
  • Working knowledge of Information Technology Infrastructure Library (ITIL) and/or Agile methodologies.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $134,500 -$265,100.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Deloitte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruiting process, please direct your inquiries to the Global Call Center (GCC) at USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com.

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

Benefits

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas, and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. Learn more.

Professional development

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there's always room to learn. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through mentorship. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.

As used in this posting, "Deloitte" means Deloitte Consulting LLP, a subsidiary of Deloitte LLP. Please see https://www.deloitte.com/us/about for a detailed description of the legal structure of Deloitte LLP and its subsidiaries.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Manager, Project Support - GAP facilitates the strategic global vision for departmental/project processes, compliance, training, and SOP documentation within the GAP division. This position provides integration, analytical, decision and communication support to drive alignment on behalf of the key stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. In addition to leading GAPs strategic processes, the Senior Manager, Project Support - GAP leads stakeholder integration for all levels of Design, Development, and Delivery across all lines of business within Universal Destinations & Experiences (UDX) to deliver key metrics related to documentation for the delivery of capital projects.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensure strategies and implementation plans align with GAPs Charter, Mission, and Vision. Institutes best-practice procedures and documentation. Prepare Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and GOP across all project management processes. Assist the Director in development of the Long-Range Plans (LRP) for GAP by analyzing several data sources including IBE (Rockwell: Install, Base Evaluation), Maximo, Guest Experience & Analytics, GSAT, Quality Control Reports, PMWeb, etc. Manage the integration and data analysis the Venue Sustainability Evaluation (VSE). Partner with stakeholders to fulfill VSE requirements. Facilitate the establishment of venue baselines for Reliability, Operations, and critical component use rates in contribution to VSE activities. Facilitate training of internal/external stakeholders and teams regarding safety, documentation, processes, systems, and project management.
  • Implement audits, and quality control processes to support project management acquiring all documentation and deliverables.
  • Provide support to Finance, Legal and other Project related teams to identify best practices, optimization, and functionality. Identify areas of concern and opportunities for improvement. Facilitate the implementation of new policies, and availability in the interviewing process for staffing.
  • Build and develop process improvement tools to support the GAP organization, utilizing existing resources and identifying new resources for continuous improvement. Develop dashboards, schedules, and reporting platforms.
  • Facilitate comprehensive risk management plan, utilizing scalable planning methods in anticipation for project risks and opportunities.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in applicable technical field required
  • Advanced Degree preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 7+ years experience in direct theme park specific technical/engineering roles required or similar experience in related technical field
  • Or equivalent combination of experience and education

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Branch Manager

Reports to: Regional Vice President

FLSA Status: Non-Exempt | Supervisory Role: Yes

Why Join Us?

At Trustco Bank, we're committed to fostering a supportive and inclusive workplace where our employees can grow their careers. We believe that our people are our greatest asset and consider our employees as family. We value each team member's contribution and offer a supportive, collaborative work environment. In this role, you'll have the opportunity to lead a talented team, make a positive impact in our community, and be rewarded for your success.

We believe that investing in our employees means investing in the future of our company. As a valued team member, you will be eligible for a generous compensation and benefits package that includes: medical, dental and vision insurance, a health savings account with an annual employer contribution, a 401(k)-retirement plan with generous employer match, paid time off plus 11 paid federal holidays, training and professional development programs, tuition reimbursement, reduced fees and rates on certain loan products, and much more!

About the Branch Manager Role

We're looking for a dynamic and results-driven Branch Manager to lead the daily operations of a full-service branch. In this role, you'll oversee all aspects of branch performance—from sales and customer service to lending, operations, and security. You'll inspire and coach your team, foster strong customer relationships, and drive growth through new business development, referrals, and client retention.

The ideal candidate thrives in a leadership role, has a passion for delivering exceptional service, and can balance operational efficiency with strategic business growth.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and manage all branch operations, ensuring exceptional customer service and operational excellence.
  • Develop new deposit, loan, and business opportunities while achieving branch sales and retention goals.
  • Build and promote the branch's identity, fostering a sales-driven and customer-focused culture.
  • Supervise, coach, and evaluate team members including Assistant Branch Managers, Head Teller, and Tellers.
  • Conduct staff training, regular team meetings, and performance reviews.
  • Effectively execute the selling of new products, services, promotions, and incentive programs to drive growth.
  • Originate residential, home equity, and installment loans.
  • Ensure compliance with all bank policies, procedures, and security protocols.
  • Handle complex customer requests and resolve escalated issues in person or by phone.
  • Approve significant transactions such as large check cashing, bank checks, and general ledger tickets.
  • Maintain branch appearance and uphold operational performance standards.
  • Report regularly to senior management on branch performance, opportunities, and challenges.

This job description is not exhaustive; duties and responsibilities may change at any time with or without notice.

Qualifications

Required

  • High school diploma or equivalent.
  • Supervisory experience.
  • Strong customer service and cash-handling experience.
  • Excellent verbal communication and interpersonal skills in person, by phone, and via email.
  • Fluent in English; bilingual a plus
  • Access to reliable transportation
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.
  • Willingness to participate in ongoing training and development.
  • Ability to lift 10–20 lbs., stand for extended periods.

Preferred

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • Previous banking or financial services experience.

Schedule

Full-time position with hours aligned to branch operations:

  • Mon–Wed: 8:30 AM – 5:00 PM
  • Thu–Fri: 8:30 AM – 6:00 PM
  • Sat: 8:30 AM – 12:00 PM (rotating schedule)
  • Sun: Closed

Employees may need to remain 15–30 minutes after closing. Occasional travel for training, meetings, or branch support.

JOB SUMMARY:

Performs basic re-design and development efforts of show and / or ride control and software systems for theme park rides and attractions to provide increased reliability and operational improvements.  May support downtime recovery if necessary. Duties include troubleshooting, fault analysis, redesign assignments, test and start-up integration of Ride and Show systems. All work shall be in conformance with ASTM F24 Committee guidelines and compliant with applicable codes, regulations and standards including: AISC, ASME, ASTM, ANSI, AWS, JIC, NEC, and OSHA, among others..

Tattoos, Branding and Body Ornamentation:

Employees are required to conceal any tattoos that are considered obscene or offensive as determined by Orange County Policy Manual and Operational Regulations Section 406, Dress Code and Appearance. Examples of prohibited tattoos include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Content that depicts nudity or sexual acts.
  • Content that displays obscene, racist, sexist or vulgar words or illustrations.
  • Content that depicts symbols used by militant and/or racist groups.
  • Content that appears to promote, support or identify gangs, gang activity or gang affiliation.
  • Content deemed by management to detract from the professional appearance in uniform.

f. Dental Ornamentation:

2) Employees hired after September 1, 2015, will not use gold, silver, or other caps or veneers for the purpose of dental ornamentation unless deemed medically necessary and prescribed by a licensed dentist. Teeth, whether natural, capped, or veneer, will not be ornamented with designs, jewels or initials.

Regardless of hire date employees will be prohibited from unnatural shaping teeth for non-medical reasons (e.g. fangs) or wearing removable dental ornamentation (e.g. grills).

g. Gauging:

Regardless of hire date, uniformed staff are not permitted to wear any type of gauge while on duty or while performing official Department business. Visible openings, for example the earlobe caused by stretching/wearing a gauge must be completely concealed at all times.

Basic Abilities Test (BAT) Correctional Officer Test Information

BAT is a test required by the Florida Department of Law Enforcement Selected. Applicants will be required to submit proof they have taken and passed the BAT in order to continue in the hiring process. The test is available at local colleges such as Seminole College and Valencia College and is taken at the applicant¿s expense. If you have taken the CJBAT in the past, then it is valid for four (4) years.

All applicants will be required to participate in the Physical Abilities Test (PAT).

The Physical Abilities Test (PAT) consists of a series of physical activities designed to evaluate fitness to perform specific job-related tasks. The battery of job-related field tests is intended to be completed in the fastest possible time and will require effort on the part of the applicant. The test is designed to measure balance, muscular endurance, strength, flexibility, aerobic and anaerobic power and capacity, and fine motor skills.

The minimum PAT fitness standards that candidates are required to successfully perform are:

  • Navigate a 388.66-yard obstacle course, including a 50-foot serpentine run.
  • Negotiate a high step hurdle over obstacles approximately 24 inches tall.
  • Low crawl
  • Climb through a window 40-inches tall.
  • 10-stair ascent and descent
  • 150-pound dummy drag
  • Use a training gun to fire 6 simulated shots with each hand.
  • Manipulate a locking mechanism.

What's in it for you
