Job.JobTitle: Delivery Consultant, AI and Analytics Solutions
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte AI & Engineering team to transform technology platforms, drive innovation, and help make a significant impact on our clients' success. You'll work alongside talented professionals reimagining and reengineering operations and processes that are critical to businesses. Your contributions can help clients improve financial performance, accelerate new digital ventures, and fuel growth through innovation.

Work You'll Do

As a Delivery Consultant, AI and Analytics Solutions on the team, you will:

  • Working across client and delivery teams to design and build model-driven apps using Dataverse, including forms, views, business rules, commands, and dashboards
  • Translating business requirements into data models, solution components, and user experiences aligned to standards and reuse
  • Configuring and extending Dataverse (tables, relationships, column types, validation, calculated/rollup columns) and implementing security (roles, teams, business units, field security)
  • Designing process automation using Power Automate (cloud flows and Desktop), including approvals, integrations, notifications, and exception handling
  • Integrating Power Platform solutions with Microsoft 365, Dynamics 365, Azure services, and external systems via connectors, APIs, and custom integration patterns
  • Establishing and promoting development standards: solution layering, environment strategy, naming conventions, ALM, and deployment pipelines
  • Supporting testing and quality practices: unit/system testing, defect triage, performance tuning, and release readiness
  • Participating in design and code reviews (including Power Fx, JavaScript where applicable, and plugin/workflow approaches), ensuring maintainability and security
  • Partnering with stakeholders to identify modernization opportunities and roadmap enhancements (e.g., legacy app replacement, workflow digitization, case management)
  • Creating and maintaining documentation: solution design, data model, security model, and operational runbooks
  • Contributing to knowledge-sharing—reusable components, patterns, accelerators, and internal community of practice assets

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our AI & Data offering provides a full spectrum of solutions for designing, developing, and operating cutting-edge Data and AI platforms, products, insights, and services. Our offerings help clients innovate, enhance and operate their data, AI, and analytics capabilities, ensuring they can mature and scale effectively.

This opportunity sits within our Deloitte US Delivery Center model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • 4+ years of experience delivering enterprise applications (low-code and/or traditional) with strong business-to-technical translation skills
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience building Power Apps, with 1+ years focused on model-driven apps
  • 3+ years of experience with Microsoft Dataverse data modeling and security design
  • 3+ years of experience with Power Automate (cloud flows), including error handling and integration scenarios
  • 1+ years experience designing solutions to address client requirements, including data, security, and non-functional requirements (performance, auditability, supportability)
  • 1+ years experience working in an Agile delivery environment (backlog, user stories, sprint ceremonies)
  • 1+ years experience understanding of ALM concepts for Power Platform (solutions, managed/unmanaged, environment promotion, deployment practices)
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance

Preferred:

  • Microsoft certifications (e.g., Power Platform App Maker, Power Platform Developer, Power Platform Functional Consultant)
  • Experience with Power Platform extensibility: PCF (PowerApps Component Framework) components, custom connectors, Azure Functions, plugins, or integration middleware
  • Experience with Dynamics 365 implementations (Customer Service, Sales, Field Service, etc.) and common patterns for model-driven apps
  • Familiarity with governance and operating models (CoE setup, environment strategy, DLP (data loss prevention) policies, telemetry/monitoring)
  • Experience with accessibility, UX patterns for model-driven apps, and adoption practices (training, change enablement)
  • Prior Government & Public Services consulting and/or professional services experience
  • Experience with RPA tools like UiPath, Blue Prism or Automation Anywhere.
  • Proven expertise in designing and deploying AI agents using Microsoft Copilot Studio, including conversational flow design, Power Automate integration, and custom connector development

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $71,300 to $118,900.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Position Summary

Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Specialty Transplant Billing Operator, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as an Analyst without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Delivery Talent Model. Project Delivery Model (PDM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long-term, onsite and/or remote client service delivery.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026

Work you'll do

As a Specialty Transplant Billing Operator / Billing and Claims Operator of Transplant Services you will be responsible for the accurate, timely billing, accounts receivable follow-up, and denial resolution of complex transplant accounts for a large health system. This role focuses on hands-on execution of hospital (facility) billing operations.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Prepare, review, and submit hospital (UB-04/837I) claims for transplant and related inpatient and outpatient services, ensuring coding, charges, and payer requirements are met before release.
  • Work assigned A/R inventory through timely follow-up with commercial, Medicare, Medicaid, and managed care payers via portals, phone, and written correspondence.
  • Research, analyze, and resolve denials and underpayments, including medical necessity, authorization, timely filing, and coding-related denials.
  • Prepare and submit appeals with supporting clinical documentation, contract language, and payer policy references; track appeal status through resolution.
  • Validate payer reimbursement against contract terms and flag variances, including transplant case rates, carve-outs, stop-loss, and outlier provisions.
  • Verify that authorizations, referrals, and transplant-specific approvals (evaluation, listing, transplant, and follow-up phases) are on file and linked to the correct accounts.
  • Coordinate with Patient Access, Coding, Health Information Management, Utilization Review, and the transplant clinical team to resolve documentation and account issues.
  • Document all account activity clearly and completely in the billing system to support audit and handoff.
  • Escalate payer trends, systemic denial root causes, and process gaps to leadership with supporting examples.

Transplant Specialty Responsibilities

  • Bill and reconcile organ acquisition costs by transplant program (kidney, liver, heart, lung, pancreas, and others as applicable), including accurate use of organ acquisition cost center revenue codes and charge capture.
  • Maintain organ acquisition cost center billing for Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payers, including recovery of organ procurement organization (OPO) invoices and related acquisition charges.
  • Support Medicare cost report reconciliation by tying organ acquisition billing, usable and non-usable organ counts, and acquisition charges to the general ledger and cost report worksheets.
  • Partner with Reimbursement, Finance, and Decision Support to resolve variances between billed charges, payments received, and cost report data.
  • Manage billing across transplant phases, including pre-transplant evaluation, listing, the transplant admission, and post-transplant follow-up, and apply payer-specific global or case-rate periods correctly.
  • Identify and correct transplant-specific billing errors, including misapplied acquisition charges, duplicate billing of organ costs, and incorrect Medicare and Medicaid pass-through treatment.
  • Apply payer-specific transplant policies, Centers of Excellence requirements, and contract provisions when billing and when disputing payments.
  • Support payer and regulatory audits, cost report settlement activity, and data requests with accurate and timely account documentation.


A successful candidate would possess these skills:
* Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
* Effective written and verbal communication skills
* Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
* Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
* Ability to lead projects or workstreams
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
* Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
* Ability to meet deadlines
* Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

AI & Engineering leverages cutting-edge engineering capabilities to build, deploy, and operate integrated/verticalized sector solutions in software, data, AI, network, and hybrid cloud infrastructure. These solutions are powered by engineering for business advantage, transforming mission-critical operations. We enable clients to stay ahead with the latest advancements by transforming engineering teams and modernizing technology & data platforms. Our delivery models are tailored to meet each client's unique requirements.

Our Industry Solutions offering provides verticalized solutions that transform how clients sell products, deliver services, generate growth, and execute mission-critical operations. We deliver integrated business expertise with scalable, repeatable technology solutions specifically engineered for each sector.

Qualifications

Required:

  • 3+ years of hospital (facility) billing, claims follow-up, or denials management experience in an acute care or health system setting.
  • 1 year of hands-on transplant billing, claims follow-up, or denials experience, including familiarity with transplant-specific payer requirements and global or case-rate billing periods.
  • Working knowledge of UB-04/837I claim requirements, revenue codes, ICD-10-CM/PCS, CPT/HCPCS, and DRG-based and per diem reimbursement methodologies.
  • Working knowledge of Medicare, Medicaid, and commercial payer rules, including timely filing, appeals, and authorization requirements.
  • Proficiency with an enterprise patient accounting system (such as Epic Resolute, Cerner, or Meditech), payer portals, and Microsoft Excel.
  • Bachelor's degree in information technology, business, healthcare, or a related field; or equivalent experience.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience billing organ acquisition costs and supporting Medicare cost report reconciliation (CMS-2552-10, Worksheet D-4 and related schedules).
  • Familiarity with OPO invoicing, organ acquisition cost center structures, and Medicare and Medicaid transplant reimbursement rules.
  • Experience with other complex or high-dollar specialty service lines, such as oncology, cardiology, orthopedics, or neurosciences.
  • Experience with payer contract interpretation and underpayment recovery.

Position Summary: The Out of Home Care (OOHC) Supervisor leads, guides, and directs the OOHC Specialists in securing timely and efficient placement of children in licensed out of home care. The OOHC Supervisor directly supervises OOHC Specialists and provides proactive coaching and feedback to ensure professional development and growth of direct reports. This position facilitates daily team hurdles to assess placement needs, assign tasks and disseminates information while ensuring compliance with contractual, regulatory, program, and accrediting body standards. This includes completion of all administrative functions and Binti and FSFN documentation within required time frames. The OOHC Supervisor ensures follow up and outreach for placements to support and maintain positive relationships within the System of Care. This position participates in the 2nd tier On Call Rotation.
Technical/Functional Expectations:

  1. Leadership-Essential Function: Problem solves, engages team, and assists with complex cases, multiple placements, significant behavioral and/or mental health needs, history of placement distribution, sibling groups etc. to ensure staff feel supported and that children are appropriately, safely placed.
  2. Collaboration and Communication- Essential Function: Strong Collaboration and communication with foster parents, group home providers, Case Management staff, Guardian Ad Items, and other stakeholders and provider networks to proactively engage and share information transparently to maintain open communication and support.
  3. Administrative Oversight - Essential Function: Ensure each child has a completed Child Placement Agreement and OOHC staff complete timely documentation in FSFN and Binti on communication, outreach, and all placement efforts.
  4. Placement Tracking-- Essential Function: Ensure data entry is accurate and completed daily in the Placement Log to reflect all current costs of care.
  5. Other duties as required: Job performance requires fulfilling other incidental or related duties as assigned, assisting, and training others, and performing duties of higher rated positions from time to time for developmental purposes.


Behavioral Competencies:

  1. Analytical Problem Resolution: Able to use systematic techniques to define problems, options, and solutions; evaluate alternative solutions; solve technical problems using logic.
  2. Analyzing: Able to break down problems and information to systematically identify the cause of problems or make recommendations; gather information from multiple sources; analyze complex information; organize information for analysis.

Key Responsibilities

  • Independently investigate and resolve complex technical issues involving healthcare interfaces, enterprise applications, databases, and interconnected systems.
  • Analyze end-to-end integration architectures, including message flows, system dependencies, data transformations, and downstream impacts.
  • Troubleshoot HL7 interfaces, message processing failures, connectivity issues, data discrepancies, and integration performance problems.
  • Utilize SQL queries, application logs, monitoring tools, and technical documentation to identify root causes and implement corrective actions.
  • Develop, modify, maintain, and troubleshoot interface-level scripts, message transformations, and processing logic.
  • Review and interpret existing application source code, including C#, C++, and Java, to investigate errors, exceptions, and runtime issues.
  • Diagnose technical issues involving interface engines, databases, Linux/Unix environments, network protocols, and external systems.
  • Perform data integrity analysis across interconnected healthcare applications and identify discrepancies in message processing or system behavior.
  • Investigate message backlogs, processing bottlenecks, performance degradation, and system availability issues.
  • Collaborate with development, infrastructure, deployment, consulting, application support, and external vendor teams to resolve complex integration challenges.
  • Review Interface Control Documents (ICDs), validate interface configurations, and ensure integration behavior aligns with technical specifications.
  • Support production incidents, system implementations, upgrades, change management activities, and go-live events.
  • Evaluate proposed technical changes, assess potential system impacts, and support testing and validation activities.
  • Maintain technical documentation, troubleshooting procedures, and knowledge resources to improve operational efficiency.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members.
  • Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools to enhance troubleshooting, technical research, code analysis, documentation, and operational workflows while maintaining appropriate security and data protection standards.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of experience supporting healthcare interfaces, interoperability solutions, or enterprise healthcare integration environments.
  • Strong understanding of HL7 v2.x messaging, message structures, ACK/NACK processing, and clinical workflows.
  • Proficiency in SQL, including writing and modifying queries, analyzing data, and troubleshooting database-related issues.
  • Experience working with healthcare integration formats such as HL7, ANSI X12, XML, and file-based interfaces.
  • Knowledge of integration protocols and technologies, including TCP/IP, MLLP, SFTP, FTPS, and HTTPS.
  • Hands-on experience with enterprise interface engines, including message routing, transformations, monitoring, configuration, and troubleshooting.
  • Experience developing, modifying, or troubleshooting interface-level scripting and message-processing logic.
  • Ability to read, interpret, and troubleshoot existing C#, C++, or Java source code to investigate application behavior and technical issues.
  • Experience working in Linux/Unix environments, including log analysis, process monitoring, and basic shell scripting.
  • Familiarity with Git-based version control platforms, such as GitHub or GitLab.
  • Experience utilizing technical troubleshooting and operational support tools, such as Splunk and Jira.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise integration architectures, system dependencies, and end-to-end data flows.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently investigate complex technical issues, perform root cause analysis, and develop effective solutions.
  • Experience troubleshooting issues across multiple applications, databases, interface engines, and infrastructure components.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with internal technical teams, external vendors, and customer stakeholders.
  • Experience supporting mission-critical production environments and managing technical incidents through resolution.
  • Ability to independently research unfamiliar technologies, analyze technical documentation, and develop solutions.
  • Familiarity with AI-assisted technical workflows, including prompt engineering, code analysis, and troubleshooting, with the ability to validate AI-generated results.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting Oracle Health/Cerner Millennium applications and integration architecture.
  • Familiarity with OpenEngine, OpenLink, or comparable healthcare integration platforms.
  • Experience developing or troubleshooting Cerner Command Language (CCL) scripts and queries.
  • Understanding of Oracle Health Millennium database structures and relationships.
  • Experience with Rhapsody or other enterprise healthcare interface engines.
  • Previous experience supporting federal healthcare environments, including VA, DoW, or IHS.
  • Experience collaborating with third-party vendors and external interface teams.
  • Experience mentoring junior technical associates and developing technical knowledge resources.
  • Familiarity with federal healthcare security, privacy, and data protection requirements.

Federal Requirements

  • Ability to obtain and maintain required federal suitability or fitness determinations, Public Trust eligibility, security clearances where applicable, and customer-specific access.
  • Ability to comply with applicable federal security, privacy, and data protection requirements.

What Makes You Successful in This Role

Success in this position requires more than expertise in individual healthcare interfaces. You must be able to understand how multiple systems interact, trace complex technical issues across an entire integration environment, and independently determine where problems originate.

We are looking for a resourceful, analytical professional who takes ownership of technical challenges, is comfortable investigating unfamiliar technologies, and can effectively collaborate with engineering and development teams to deliver solutions.

While experience with Oracle Health technologies is valuable, candidates with strong healthcare integration, SQL, scripting, architecture, and complex troubleshooting experience are encouraged to apply.

Job.JobTitle: Co-Teacher Family Center, Leonard & Marjorie Williams Family YMCA
Job.JobDescription:
Make a difference in your life and the lives of youth!

Position Summary

The position is responsible for implementing and supervising all aspects of daily activities for youth and the Co-Teacher is responsible for working to provide a successful program that will foster Children's social, physical, spiritual, and mental growth in a safe and well-organized environment.

Why choose the YMCA?

  • We offer a competitive wage plan that starts at a minimum of $15.50 per hour for Co-teachers
  • The Y is a cause-driven organization that provides a challenging and fun work environment with creative, talented and diverse individuals!

Our Culture

Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. In the Y, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day. We are welcoming: we are open to all. We are a place where you can belong and become. We are genuine: we value you and embrace your individuality. We are hopeful: we believe in you and your potential to become a catalyst in the world. We are nurturing: we support you in your journey to develop your full potential. We are determined: above all else, we are on a relentless quest to make our community stronger beginning with you. We are the Y.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide a safe and healthy environment, both physically and mentally, to ensure the operation of a quality Child Development (Afterschool) program.
  • Assist in the planning and implementing of the daily lesson plans that fit the children's needs and interests.
  • Take responsibility for the safety of the children in the child development environment and the quality of the supplies, equipment and materials in the child development area.
  • Make sure proper procedures are followed for sign-in/out of children on a daily basis.
  • Report all accidents to the Supervisor, and completely fills out proper health log and/or accident/incident form.
  • Assume equal share of the regular housekeeping chores such as cleaning, preparing for daily activities and cleaning up after projects.
  • Report suspicious and inappropriate behaviors and policy violations.
  • Follow mandated child abuse reporting requirements.
  • Adhere to procedures related to managing high-risk activities and supervising consumers.
  • Participate in member retention, special events and fundraising. Complete all paperwork clearly and concisely. Remain up to date on emergency procedures and family center policies.
  • All other duties assigned by management.

Requirements

  • Minimum age 16 years or older.
  • 1 year of childcare experience preferred
  • CPR, First Aid, AED certifications and Child Abuse Prevention training within 30 days of hire date.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, which may include weekends and holidays as needed.
  • Must be willing to work an on-call schedule rotation as required.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.
  • The physical activities of this position include: stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, grasping, feeling, and repetitive motions. May be required to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. in various forms, and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. The employee must be able to perform medium work.
  • May be required to sit, stand, or maintain physical activity for extended periods of time.
  • Must exhibit patience and understanding. Receives and follows detailed instructions.
  • Must be alert at all times, keeping safety in mind.
  • Must possess acceptable hearing and visual capabilities in order to monitor environment and children's well-being. Talking is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels, with or without correction
  • Must be capable of working under pressure in a somewhat disruptive environment.

Disclaimers

  • Must complete a successful employment verification and background screening, which includes a DCF Level 2 Background Check (Additional information on Level 2 Background through Clearinghouse can be found here: https://info.flclearinghouse.com/)
  • All of the above duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. The YMCA promotes an equal employment opportunity work place which includes reasonable accommodation of otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please see your manager should you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.
  • This job description may not be all-inclusive and employees are expected to perform all other duties as assigned and directed by management. Job descriptions and duties may be modified when deemed appropriate by management.

Salary Description

Starting at $15.50

Job.JobTitle: Referee/Official Youth Sports, Osceola County YMCA Family Center

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Referee/Official for Youth Sports will be responsible for the integral part of monitoring sports activity (including but not limited to refereeing for basketball, soccer and/or volleyball games), making sure all rules are followed and the game is played fairly.

Our Culture

Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. In the Y, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day. Job Responsibilities

  • Enforce the rules of the game. Enforce program rules/policies by maintain constant surveillance of program participants
  • Arrive at least 15 minutes prior to your first game scheduled
  • Complete score sheets at score table. Write in final score, circle winning team, initial games officiated
  • Facilitate/lead youth sports pledge before game
  • Ensure games starts on time
  • Take charge. Do not be afraid to blow the whistle
  • Ensure safety of participants/members
  • Actively engage with coaches. Always explain to the coaches how the game will be called. Explain your calls to players and coaches
  • Ensure goal heights are adjusted according to age division and proper size ball is used
  • Assist supervisor with set up/clean up as needed
  • Maintain control of game. Keep composure under pressure. Help keep a positive environment
  • Builds effective, authentic relationships with participants and parents, helping them connect with each other and the YMCA. Models welcoming, connecting, motivating and affirming behaviors.
  • Completes mandatory staff training and participates in required staff meetings.
  • Participates in special events as assigned.
  • Ensures completion of daily equipment checks and completes daily cleaning tasks.
  • Actively promotes all YMCA programs and activities and supports YMCA campaign initiatives.
  • Follows YMCA policies, procedures, and emergency procedures and able to demonstrate them.
  • Report suspicious and inappropriate behaviors and policy violations.
  • Follow mandated child abuse reporting requirements.
  • Adhere to procedures related to managing high-risk activities and supervising consumers.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 16 years of age with appropriate work permits; 18 years of age & high school degree preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and problem solving skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both participants and parents.
  • Knowledge of youth developmental stages, with ability to apply corresponding learning and physical traits to curriculum development and classroom management.
  • Within 60 days of hire, CPR/AED & First Aid certification

Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, which may include weekends and holidays as needed.
  • Must be willing to work an on-call schedule rotation as required.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.
  • The physical activities of this position include: stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, grasping, feeling, and repetitive motions. Talking is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels, with or without correction.
  • The employee must be able to perform medium work: exerting up to 50 to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
  • The employee is required to have close visual acuity, along with the visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned or to make general observations of facilities or structures. The employee is required to have visual acuity to operate motor vehicles.
  • The employee is subject to both environmental conditions: activities occur inside and outside. The employee is subject to extreme heat: temperatures above 100 degrees for periods of more than one hour.
  • May be required to sit or stand for extended periods of time while demonstrating manual dexterity in order to accurately work on the phone, computer keyboard, and other equipment.

Disclaimers

Job.JobTitle: Before/After School Counselor, Discovery Middle (Orange County Middle Schools Program)
Job.JobDescription:
Make a difference in your life and the lives of youth!

Position Summary

This position supports the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living and social responsibility. Provides direct supervision of a group of children in an after school program (grades 6th – 8th). Creates positive, nurturing relationships with children, while building cooperative relationships with parents/caregivers. Promotes and supports the potential of all youth in programs and facilitates peer-to-peer connections as part of the overall after school experience.

Why choose the YMCA?

  • We offer a competitive wage plan!
  • The Y is a cause-driven organization that provides a challenging and fun work environment with creative, talented and diverse individuals!

  • Acquaint children with rules, activities, daily scheduled, and traditions of the program.
  • Take responsibility for the safety/welfare of each child.
  • Remain in the immediate area assisting in supervision during all activities including aquatics.
  • Assist with organizing, and implementing activity plans for special interest activities.
  • Assist with assuring proper sign in/sign out procedures are followed.

  • Establish positive relationship with each child.

  • Follow mandated child abuse reporting requirements.
  • Adhere to procedures related to managing high-risk activities and supervising consumers.
  • Attends required staff meetings and training sessions.
  • Assists in maintaining cleanliness of entire facility and report broken equipment and/or possible safety hazards.

  • Keep accurate attendance and headcount
  • Report all hours worked accurately and in a timely manner to Supervisor.
  • Remain up to date on emergency procedures, as well as Middle Schools Program and County Public specific Schools policies.
  • Direct or assist in the daily maintenance of the school and YMCA facility area, ensuring safety and cleanliness.
  • Promote and represent the mission and core values of the YMCA of Central Florida in the Family Center and its programs.
  • All other duties assigned by Management

Requirements

  • High school graduate or equivalent; one year or more of college a plus.
  • Previous experience working with children preferably in an after school setting or childcare center, preferred.

  • CPR, First Aid, AED certifications and Child Abuse Prevention training within 60 days of hire date.

  • Must be willing to work an on-call schedule rotation as required.

The employee must be able to perform medium work.
  • May be required to sit, stand, or maintain physical activity for extended periods of time.
  • Must exhibit patience and understanding. Receives and follows detailed instructions.
  • Must be alert at all times, keeping safety in mind.
  • Must possess acceptable hearing and visual capabilities in order to monitor environment and children's well-being. Talking is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels, with or without correction
  • Must be capable of working under pressure in a somewhat disruptive environment.

Job.JobTitle: Member Engagement Representative, Lake Nona YMCA Family Center
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Member Engagement Representative is the welcoming face of the YMCA, responsible for safe and consistent access control, high-impact member engagement, and membership growth. This role conducts cause-driven tours, guides prospective members through enrollment, and delivers an exceptional onboarding experience so every new member feels a strong sense of belonging from day one. By proactively connecting members to programs and services aligned to their goals, accurately maintaining records in YMCA systems, and achieving individual and team sales metrics. The Member Engagement Representative helps drive membership acquisitions and first impressions to advance the YMCA's mission and strengthens community impact.

Our Culture

Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. In the Y, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day. We are welcoming: we are open to all. We are a place where you can belong and become. We are genuine: we value you and embrace your individuality. Job Responsibilities

  • Ensure appropriate procedures are followed for all member and guest/visitor access control, requiring all individuals check in appropriately and follow established YMCA policies.

  • Support new members through the onboarding process, ensuring they feel welcomed, informed, and connected to programs that match the member's personalized goals.
  • Partner with membership and program staff to connect members to YMCA offerings, promoting engagement across wellness, aquatics, youth, and community programs.
  • Conduct cause-driven tours that showcase the YMCA's facilities, programs, and community impact, with the goal of driving membership enrollment.
  • Proactively promote membership sales by identifying individual/family needs and clearly communicating the value of YMCA membership.
  • Meet established assigned sales metrics and performance goals related to membership acquisition and retention.
  • Attend all required trainings and stay current with certifications, compliance requirements, and professional development expectations.
  • Escalates unresolved issues to the Member Engagement Coordinator and/or Supervisor.
  • Handle sensitive and protected member information in alignment with YMCA policies and the Employee Handbook.
  • Maintain a professional appearance at all times in accordance with YMCA dress code standards.
  • Represent the YMCA's mission and core values through professional conduct, a positive presence, and consistent delivery of excellent service standards.
  • Report suspicious and inappropriate behaviors and policy violations.
  • Adhere to job specific child abuse risk management responsibilities.
  • Ensure consumers are properly signed in and signed out, ensures only authorized adults are allowed in the facility, etc.

Requirements

  • High School Graduate or equivalent required.
  • Minimum one year of experience in sales, customer service, or relationship management preferred.
  • Proficiency with computer systems and data entry; experience with CRM or membership management software a plus.
  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to inspire confidence and build relationships quickly.
  • Comfortable engaging with individuals, families, and diverse communities in a positive and approachable manner.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Must be willing to work an on-call schedule rotation as required.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.

Talking is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels, with or without correction.
  • Required to sit or stand for extended periods of time while demonstrating manual dexterity in order to accurately work on the phone, computer keyboard, and other equipment.
  • The employee must be able to perform light work: exerting up to 20 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 10 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects.
  • The employee is required to have close visual acuity, along with the visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned, preparing and analyzing data and figures, transcribing, viewing a computer screen, extensive reading, or to make general observations of facilities or structures.

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

This position supports the work of the Y, a leading nonprofit committed to strengthening community through youth development, healthy living and social responsibility. Interacts with new and existing members to help them in achieving their health and well-being goals. Creates a welcoming environment for all members of all backgrounds and abilities. This position is responsible for providing high quality personal exercise training, excellent customer service, and product knowledge to members in a safe and clean environment.

Our Culture

  • Coach and motivate members in support of their desired behavior change.
  • Regularly checks on members' progress and answers questions from members to support them in achieving their goals related to healthy living.
  • Maintains working knowledge of fitness/health living trends to provide effective information and support to members.
  • Builds effective, authentic relationships with members; helps members connect with each other and the YMCA.
  • Engaging with members to upsell all programs including Personal Training, Group Exercise, Youth Sports, Aquatics & Youth Development programs.
  • Utilizes tools, technology and information for the purpose of increasing member knowledge of healthy living programs provided through the YMCA (handouts, schedules, etc.).

  • Adhere to job specific child abuse risk management responsibilities.

  • Respond promptly and appropriately to emergency situations or when rescue or first aid is necessary
  • Enforce all safety rules fairly, consistently with tact and respect.
  • Maintain Personal Training or specialize certifications (per Association requirements) certifications
  • All other duties as assigned by management

Requirements

  • Must be at least 18 years of age
  • High School graduate or equivalent preferred
  • CPR, First Aid, AED Certification preferred prior to hire. Must obtain within 60 days of hire
  • Previous experience with diverse populations preferred

Must be current and in good standing.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Must be willing to work an on-call schedule rotation as required.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.
  • May be required to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. in various forms, and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. The employee must be able to perform medium work.
  • May be required to sit or stand for extended periods of time while demonstrating manual dexterity in order to accurately work on the phone, computer keyboard, and other equipment
  • Must be alert at all times, keeping safety in mind. Must possess acceptable hearing and visual capabilities in order to monitor environment and members' well-being.
  • Must possess auditory, verbal and visual capabilities in order to adequately communicate via phone and in person. Talking is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels, with or without correction
  • Must be capable of working under pressure in a somewhat disruptive environment.
  • May be required to sit, stand, or maintain physical activity for extended periods of time including continuous physical endurance for thirty to sixty minutes of aerobic activity.

We are determined: above all else, we are on a relentless quest to make our community stronger beginning with you. We are the Y.

Job Responsibilities

  • Communicates program and student information with other school administration, at Coordinator's request.
  • Take responsibility for the leadership and guidance of a group of participants.
  • Acquaint children with rules, activities, daily scheduled, and traditions of the program.
  • Take responsibility for the safety/welfare of each child.
  • Remain in the immediate area assisting in supervision during all activities including aquatics.
  • Assist with organizing, and implementing activity plans for special interest activities.
  • Assist with assuring proper sign in/sign out procedures are followed.
  • Keep accurate attendance and headcount
  • Establish positive relationship with each child.
  • Communicate progress of child to immediate supervisor.
  • Monitor the needs of all children; treats each child with respect, dignity and as an individual.
  • Report any suspicions of child abuse to Supervisor as required by Florida State Law.
  • Follow medication and food allergy policy.
  • Takes responsibility for all equipment and supplies used, helping maintain good working conditions, inventory and cleans-up after all activities.
  • Assists in meeting and maintaining YMCA Before/ After School Best Practices.
  • Report suspicious and inappropriate behaviors and policy violations.
  • Follow mandated child abuse reporting requirements.
  • Adhere to procedures related to managing high-risk activities and supervising consumers.
  • Attends required staff meetings and training sessions.
  • Assists in maintaining cleanliness of entire facility and report broken equipment and/or possible safety hazards.
  • Participate in special events.
  • Keep accurate attendance and headcount
  • Report all hours worked accurately and in a timely manner to Supervisor.
  • Remain up to date on emergency procedures, as well as Middle Schools Program and County Public specific Schools policies.
  • Direct or assist in the daily maintenance of the school and YMCA facility area, ensuring safety and cleanliness.
  • Promote and represent the mission and core values of the YMCA of Central Florida in the Family Center and its programs.
  • All other duties assigned by Management

Requirements

  • High school graduate or equivalent; one year or more of college a plus.
  • Previous experience working with children preferably in an after school setting or childcare center, preferred.
  • At least 18 years of age.
  • CPR, First Aid, AED certifications and Child Abuse Prevention training within 60 days of hire date.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, which may include weekends and holidays as needed.
  • Must be willing to work an on-call schedule rotation as required.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.
  • The physical activities of this position include: stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, grasping, feeling, and repetitive motions. May be required to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. in various forms, and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. The employee must be able to perform medium work.
  • May be required to sit, stand, or maintain physical activity for extended periods of time.
  • Must exhibit patience and understanding. Receives and follows detailed instructions.
  • Must be alert at all times, keeping safety in mind.
  • Must possess acceptable hearing and visual capabilities in order to monitor environment and children's well-being. Talking is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels, with or without correction
  • Must be capable of working under pressure in a somewhat disruptive environment.

Position Summary

The Annual Giving Manager is responsible for leading and executing the YMCA's annual giving campaign and related appeals to support the association's fundraising goals. This role focuses on cultivating a culture of philanthropy, managing donor communications, and building strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders. The Annual Giving Manager serves as the subject matter expert on annual giving strategies and processes, ensuring the YMCA's mission is effectively communicated and supported.

Our Culture

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead the annual giving campaign, including association-wide year-end giving initiatives and special events, to achieve fundraising goals and benchmarks.
  • Develop and execute comprehensive annual fundraising strategies, including digital and direct mail campaigns, audience segmentation, copywriting, vendor management, and performance tracking for reporting and optimization.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for all annual giving initiatives, providing leadership, training, and support to Family Center staff and volunteers.
  • Build and manage a donor communications calendar in collaboration with the Chief Development Officer and Brand and Cause team to support the Annual Giving Campaign across all Family Centers.
  • Maintain association-wide data and tracking systems to ensure adherence to campaign deadlines, reporting requirements, and administrative procedures for all donations.
  • Collaboration and Relationship Building
  • Work collaboratively with YMCA leadership, Family Center leaders, board members, volunteers, and staff to develop annual giving plans, case statements, materials, goals, budgets, timelines, activations, and training programs.
  • Champion efforts to strengthen the Y's philanthropic culture by fostering greater annual giving among staff, board volunteers, members, donors, and the community.
  • Cultivate relationships between the YMCA and key community stakeholders, including public and private corporations, media partners, and other organizations, to enhance the Y's position as an essential community nonprofit.
  • Solicit and secure compelling testimonial stories to highlight the Y's impact and demonstrate the ongoing need for support.
  • Support sponsorship funding efforts as assigned to secure revenue for YMCA programs and special events across the association.
  • Ensure proper stewardship of gifts and adherence to the highest ethical standards, following the Donor Bill of Rights.
  • Track and manage donor data and campaign outcomes to support continuous improvement and compliance with reporting requirements.
  • Report all accidents/incidents to your supervisor and follow the Association's current employee and member injury reporting procedures.
  • All other duties as assigned by management

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in financial development, communications, public relations, nonprofit management, or a related field required.
  • Minimum of 5 years of demonstrated experience successfully raising funds in a nonprofit or community fundraising capacity.
  • Proven success in leading volunteers with fundraising leadership experience preferred.
  • Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to work effectively with diverse internal and external stakeholders.
  • Exceptional verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • High energy and a proven ability to influence decision-makers and build dynamic relationships.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and donor database software, CRM systems, and project management tools.
  • Excellent problem-solving, project management, and decision-making skills.

Talking is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels, with or without correction.

Position Summary

The Custodian will perform routine janitorial work ensuring the facility is clean, sanitary, safe, orderly and attractive for members in accordance with established policies and procedures.

Job Responsibilities

  • Responsible for cleanliness of entire facility including locker rooms and grounds including sweeping, vacuuming, cleaning and/or polishing assigned areas, windows, mirrors, walls, ceilings, hallways; emptying wastebaskets; and other duties as deemed necessary.
  • Responsible for stocking supplies in locker facilities.
  • Laundering of towels.
  • Assist with inventory control of supplies and tools.
  • Assist members with questions. If unable to assist, direct towards membership desk.

  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

  • Friendly, customer service oriented attitude with fellow employees and members.

  • Follow mandated child abuse reporting requirements.
  • Adhere to procedures related to managing high-risk activities and supervising consumers.
  • Follow medication and food allergy policy.
  • Takes responsibility for all equipment and supplies used, helping maintain good working conditions, inventory and cleans-up after all activities.
  • Assists in meeting and maintaining YMCA Before/ After School Best Practices.
  • Reports all accidents to the Supervisor, and properly completes proper health log and/or accident/incident form.
  • Attends required staff meetings and training sessions.
  • Keep accurate attendance and headcount
  • Participate in special events.
  • Report all hours worked accurately and in a timely manner to Supervisor.
  • Remain up to date on emergency procedures, as well as Elementary Schools Program and Orange County Public Schools policies.
  • Direct or assist in the daily maintenance of the school and YMCA facility area, ensuring safety and cleanliness.
  • Promote and represent the mission and core values of the YMCA of Central Florida in the Family Center and its programs.
  • All other duties assigned by management.

Requirements

  • High school graduate or equivalent; one year or more of college a plus.
  • Previous experience working with children preferably in an after school setting or childcare center, preferred.
  • At least 18 years of age.
  • CPR, First Aid, AED certifications and Child Abuse Prevention training within 60 days of hire date.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, which may include weekends and holidays as needed.
  • Must be willing to work an on-call schedule rotation as required.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.
  • The physical activities of this position include: stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, grasping, feeling, and repetitive motions. May be required to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. in various forms, and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. The employee must be able to perform medium work.
  • May be required to sit, stand, or maintain physical activity for extended periods of time.
  • Must exhibit patience and understanding. Receives and follows detailed instructions.
  • Must be alert at all times, keeping safety in mind.
  • Must possess acceptable hearing and visual capabilities in order to monitor environment and children's well-being. Talking is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels, with or without correction
  • Must be capable of working under pressure in a somewhat disruptive environment.

Disclaimers

  • Must complete a successful employment verification and background screening, which includes a DCF Level 2 Background Check (Additional information on Level 2 Background through Clearinghouse can be found here: https://info.flclearinghouse.com/).

The YMCA promotes an equal employment opportunity work place which includes reasonable accommodation of otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please see your manager should you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.
  • This job description may not be all-inclusive and employees are expected to perform all other duties as assigned and directed by management. Job descriptions and duties may be modified when deemed appropriate by management.

Salary Description

Starting at $15.50 an hour

JOB SUMMARY:

Supports management in coordinating the daily operation of assigned venue and maintains venue technical show quality. Assist with the operation and execution of entertainment shows, leads crew, and applies expert level knowledge and understanding of hazards associated with pyrotechnic/fireworks and high-risk special effects equipment or systems. High risk is defined as show elements or practices where life safety is taken into consideration. Communicates with leadership and immediately stops any unsafe activity. Ensures the proper completion and enforcement of all UO, NFPA and Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs) policies, procedures, regulations, and documentation.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Oversees the daily operations of Technical Entertainment systems, including planning, delegation, and coordination of work tasks. Effectively delegates work assignments among qualified crew members, leads crews during work startup and stoppage, and communicates performance expectations. Ensures compliance with safety guidelines, standard operating procedures, and company policies. This includes adhering to guidelines established by the National Fire Protection Association (NFPA), Bureau of Alcohol Tobacco Firearms and Explosives (BATFE), and Authorities Having Jurisdiction (AHJs). Coordinates with other departments, communicates resource needs, and provides two-way communication between technicians, supervisors, and management. Monitors employee productivity, enforces compliance with UO policies, and reports non-compliance issues to appropriate leadership.
  • Maintains and shares job knowledge and assists in developing employees. Communicates performance expectations and provides technical training for best practices/techniques along with feedback to technicians.  Provides technical show notes and lead observations for assigned technicians to venue management to ensure high standards of show quality are maintained. 
  • Complete required documentation to maintain accountability of the locations for pyrotechnic/firework devices, keeping incompliance within internal and governmental regulations. Ensures proper completion of all technical documentation, including daily checklists, SOPs, inventory, and other such documentation. Complete required training documentation including assessments and check-off lists.
  • Maintains inventory of tools, equipment, material, and other UO property, ensuring proper care, maintenance, and storage is upheld. Ensures a safe working environment and assists with regular inspections. Notify Management of any material needs or safety concerns.
  • Partners with the responsible maintenance team to troubleshoot issues and escalate to management as appropriate. Ensures all daily, weekly, and monthly maintenance checks are completed.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION: 

  • Technical school, Associates degree (AA) or Bachelors degree is preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

  • 3+ years of experience providing work direction, leading knowledgeable individuals and promoting team dynamics.
  • 5+ years of experience using advanced control systems and handling pyrotechnic elements; or equivalent combination of education and experience. 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Accountable to strictly adhere to all policies and procedures, as defined by the Entertainment Department, governing the safe operation of all technical equipment.
  • Proven ability to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.
  • Emergency repairs, parts assembly, and networking preferred.
  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
  • Ability to deal with problems involving a few concrete variables in standardized situations.
  • Ability to make decisions under stress.
  • Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to write detailed information such as daily FYI, observations, and assessments.
  • Ability to effectively present information in one-on-one and small group situations to customers, clients, and other employees of the organization.
  • Basic computer skills with basic experience in Microsoft Office Suite
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Analyst, Application Support (HTML & SQL Experience Preferred)
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Application Support Analyst is responsible for ensuring the reliability, performance, security, and continuous improvement of business-critical applications. This role serves as a senior technical resource and escalation point, providing guidance and support to Application Support Analysts while independently leading the investigation and resolution of complex or high-impact application issues. The Sr. Analyst coordinates with business stakeholders, engineering, vendors, and other technical teams to resolve issues, minimize business disruption, and maintain application stability.

The role monitors application health, identifies recurring issues and systemic risks, and drives root-cause analysis and long-term solutions to improve application reliability and operational efficiency. The Sr Analyst also supports application changes, enhancements, upgrades, and deployments; develops and maintains application workflows, databases, and supporting web-based solutions; oversees access and security controls; and helps establish consistent support processes, documentation, and best practices. Through strong technical expertise, sound judgment, mentorship, and cross-functional collaboration, the Sr. Application Support Analyst ensures applications effectively support business operations and deliver a reliable end-user experience.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Independently lead investigation and resolution of complex, high-impact, or recurring application incidents, such as application errors, outages, and performance issues.
  • Serve as an advanced escalation point for issues that cannot be resolved through established support procedures or by Application Support Analysts.
  • Own complex incidents through resolution, coordinating with engineering, vendors, and application owners while maintaining accountability for issue progress, business impact, and resolution.
  • Perform immediate fixes or workarounds to restore service.
  • Manage user access, roles, and permissions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to evaluate business processes, identify system gaps, and translate requirements into prioritized enhancement or improvement recommendations.
  • Lead communication for high-impact incidents, providing clear updates on business impact, technical status, risks, mitigation actions, and expected resolution. Establish and promote application support standards, operational best practices, and consistent support procedures across the team.
  • Coordinate stakeholder communications during major incidents and ensure timely, accurate updates through restoration and post-incident follow-up.
  • Create, modify, and support SQL databases, queries, tables, and related data structures used by supported applications.
  • Develop and maintain HTML-based application pages, interfaces, or supporting web content as required.
  • Design, configure, test, and maintain application workflows and workflow automations to support business processes.
  • Monitor application health, uptime, and performance dashboards.
  • Perform routine checks to ensure integrations and services are functioning.
  • Develop, review, and approve support documentation, troubleshooting standards, escalation procedures, and operational runbooks.
  • Establish knowledge-management standards and ensure recurring issues are converted into reusable support guidance, known-error records, or standardized resolution procedures.
  • Document system configurations and troubleshooting steps.
  • Ensure processes are standardized and repeatable.
  • Perform application configuration changes, workflow updates, and other technical enhancements within supported platforms.
  • Support small enhancement requests or business rule updates.
  • Coordinate with admins or developers for larger changes.
  • Conduct deeper investigations into recurring or critical issues.
  • Document root causes and long-term fixes.
  • Identify trends in incidents to prevent future problems.
  • Collaborate with engineering to implement permanent solutions.
  • Lead or facilitate post-incident reviews for significant incidents and track corrective actions through completion.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to lead technical discussions and communicate complex incidents, risks, root causes, and remediation plans to technical and non-technical stakeholders, including leadership.
  • Exercises independent judgment in ambiguous or high-impact situations; assesses business impact, technical risk, and urgency to determine appropriate response and escalation strategies. Effective conflict resolution and technical problem-solving skills
  • Advanced technical knowledge related to:
    • Infrastructure & network design, support, and troubleshooting
    • Windows and Linux systems administration
    • Asset management tools (such as ServiceNow, Snipe-IT, and Lansweeper)
    • Remote administration tools (such as Bomgar and Intune)
    • Task/project management and report tools (such as PowerBI and Click-Up)
    • Automation tools and platforms (such as scripts and Power Automate)
    • SQL database creation, modification, querying, troubleshooting, and ongoing support
    • HTML programming and maintenance of web-based application content or interfaces
    • Workflow design, configuration, automation, and troubleshooting within enterprise applications
  • Experience with technical audits and compliance frameworks for policies and standards (especially cyber and privacy)
  • Experience with development and maintenance of technical documentation
  • Experience supporting large corporate enterprise systems, integrations, databases and workflows, including the design and modification of business process workflows.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret data, identify trends, and support insights generation.
  • Support evaluation, testing, and implementation of application enhancements and process improvements.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in MIS, Business or IT is required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3+ years of experience in application support, IT support, or a related technical role; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Advanced experience troubleshooting software applications, system integrations, or enterprise platforms.
  • Familiarity with ticketing systems (such as ServiceNow, Jira, or similar).
  • Experience working with logs, error analysis, and basic debugging techniques.
  • Exposure to incident management and root cause analysis processes.
  • Experience with HTML programming and workflow development within enterprise applications of business systems.
  • Experience with PMWeb programming and administration, including workflow development, SQL, HTML and application configuration, preferred.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.
