Job.JobTitle: Sr Project Manager, Operations & Tech Consulting Support
Job.JobDescription:
Your opportunity


At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us challenge the status quo and transform the finance industry together.

We believe that, when done right, investing liberates people to create their own destiny. We are driven by our purpose to champion every client's goals with passion and integrity. We respect and appreciate the diversity of our employees, our clients, and the communities we serve. We challenge conventions strategically to create value for our clients, our firm, and the world. We live and bring to life the concept of ‘own your tomorrow' every day. We champion our employees' strengths, guide their development, and invest in their long-term success. We hire optimistic, results-oriented, curious, innovative, and adaptable people with the desire to help our clients and one another succeed.

Schwab Advisor Services (AS), a division of Charles Schwab & Co., Inc. is the leading provider of custody, trading, technology, and practice management to registered investment advisors (RIAs). It provides access to sophisticated wealth-management services that help advisors attract and retain affluent clients, as well as profitably grow, compete, and succeed in their business efforts. Schwab Advisor Services serves over 16,000 independent advisory firms who custody approximately $5 trillion of assets with Schwab. RIAs choose independence because they are determined to take charge of their future. They want the freedom to serve their clients without compromise and to control their destiny as business owners. And like them, Schwab believes in doing the right thing for investors – it's a basic shared value.

The AS Business Consulting & Education (BCE) team creates and delivers industry-leading consulting, benchmarking, thought leadership, and education programs that help advisors achieve their goals and gain competitive advantage. Its extensive offerings include the RIA Benchmarking Study and immersive programs and content spanning business management, technology, operations, cybersecurity, AI, leadership, and more. BCE's impact is driven by its ability to create relevant, scalable programs that transform practice management insights into highly actionable strategies, further empowering advisors to grow, compete, and succeed. These programs are delivered by a nationwide team of experienced consultants who work closely with advisors to understand the firm's challenges and areas of opportunity and then map a path forward.

As a key contributor to the Schwab Advisor Services BCE organization, the Senior Project Manager, Operations and Technology Consulting Support will partner closely with our Technology, Operations, Cyber and AI Consultants to support the delivery of immersive Digital Modernization Consulting Engagements to our largest and most complex RIA clients. The role will provide hands-on project management and in-depth data analysis, synthesis, and visualization support from pre-engagement through implementation, helping clients reduce rework and operational friction and strengthening how we work together to serve clients. Key focus areas include client onboarding, money movement, account maintenance, API integrations, and more. The Senior Manager will work across a wide range of internal Schwab teams and RIA clients to organize, track, and advance critical workstreams and initiatives through implementation, helping ensure strong outcomes.

This role will also help lead the creation, enhancements, and ongoing management of program content and resources, including scalable tools, guides, worksheets, exercises, and other consulting assets that support both immersive client engagements and broader application of the program.

BCE team members thrive on building connections, engaging with advisors, and delivering innovative solutions within a collaborative setting. They are driven by curiosity, a love of learning, and a desire to use their strengths to achieve significant outcomes. The ideal candidate demonstrates adaptability within a dynamic, iterative workplace, values constructive feedback exchange, maintains a positive approach to professional collaboration, skillfully listens to and supports advisors' needs, and can collaborate with and influence across multiple levels.

We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site 4 days a week in the specified location(s).

Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full time basis without employer sponsorship.

What you have


Required qualifications:

  • Exceptional project management and organizational skills, with strong attention to detail and the ability to independently lead multiple projects and workstreams
  • Excellent knowledge of RIA operations, service, and technology with a preference for experience working with very large and complex RIA firms.
  • Data analysis, synthesis, and visualization skills, with the ability to translate complex and varied inputs, including detailed operational data, client and executive insights, and other sources, into compelling stories, presentations, and other material.
  • Well-developed business presence and consultative skills with the ability to listen, assess issues, analyze options, solve problems, influence outcomes, and develop win/win solutions.
  • Demonstrated experience and skill in content creation, writing, communication, and facilitation
  • Proven problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand dependencies, anticipate downstream implications, and navigate ambiguity and obstacles.
  • Strong interpersonal and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to build relationships, earn trust, and effectively partner with internal and external stakeholders.
  • A client-centric “can if” mindset, bias for action, and demonstrated ability to achieve meaningful results in a fast-paced, iterative, and matrixed environment.
  • Experience or exposure across client service, operations, and technology within RIA firms, broker-dealers, and/or related financial services businesses.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Planner, ideally complemented by broader experience using project management platforms such as Smartsheet, Asana, or Jira to apply disciplined project management practices across workstreams, timelines, dependencies, and implementation.
  • 8+ years of project management experience and 8+ years of experience within the financial services industry.
  • Bachelor's degree required
  • PMP, PMI-ACP, Lean, and/or Six Sigma experience or certifications are a plus

Preferred qualifications:

  • In-depth knowledge of Schwab's digital solutions, operations and processes
  • Experience with practice management program content development and management
  • MBA preferred, but not required

In addition to the salary range, this role is also eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.


What's in it for you

At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

  • 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
  • Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
  • Paid parental leave and family building benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

Job.JobTitle: Director, Blockchain Platform Architect – Technology Incubation – R&D
Job.JobDescription:
Your opportunity


At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together.

We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

The Schwab Technology Services (STS) Research & Development team explores emerging technologies and turns them into practical capabilities that create measurable value across Schwab. We operate at the intersection of innovation and execution—rapidly testing ideas, partnering across the enterprise, and scaling what works.

The Blockchain Platform Architect will define and guide the architecture for enterprise-grade blockchain and digital asset platforms within the Technology Incubation organization. Reporting to the Director of Technology, this role will translate emerging blockchain opportunities into secure, scalable, and operationally resilient platform designs that can move from experimentation to enterprise adoption.

This architect will partner closely with engineering, cloud, security, enterprise architecture, risk, legal, compliance, product, and business stakeholders to design platforms that balance innovation speed with Schwab's standards for security, resiliency, governance, and client trust.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Own the target-state architecture and technical roadmap for blockchain and digital asset platform capabilities, including platform components, service boundaries, integration patterns, APIs, data models, and operational controls.
  • Design secure, scalable, fault-tolerant distributed systems that support experimentation, pilot delivery, and production use.
  • Evaluate blockchain protocols, node infrastructure, custody patterns, smart contract frameworks, interoperability models, and blockchain data access strategies.
  • Partner with engineering teams to guide implementation, review designs, resolve complex technical tradeoffs, and establish reusable platform patterns.
  • Collaborate with security, risk, legal, compliance, and enterprise architecture teams to ensure platform designs meet enterprise controls, regulatory expectations, defense-in-depth principles, and operational resilience requirements.
  • Define architecture documentation, reference models, decision records, design standards, and graduation criteria needed to move capabilities from prototype to sustainable ownership.
  • Serve as a technical advisor to the Director of Technology and executive stakeholders by translating blockchain architecture choices into business value, risk implications, investment needs, and adoption paths.

Success Measures:

  • Blockchain platform initiatives have clear architecture direction, reusable patterns, documented tradeoffs, and measurable progress toward incubation milestones.
  • Security, risk, compliance, and operational readiness requirements are built into the platform design early rather than added late in the delivery lifecycle.
  • Engineering teams can move faster through common platform standards, reference architectures, reusable services, and clear decision records.
  • The Director of Technology and executive stakeholders have clear visibility into platform maturity, technical risks, dependencies, and decisions required for enterprise adoption.

What you have


Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, or a related technical field (advanced degree a plus).
  • 10+ years of experience in software engineering including delivering platforms, or complex technology initiatives.
  • Strong technical foundation in modern architectures, cloud-native development, and engineering best practices; ability to guide technical decisions without needing to be the primary implementer.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence across organizational boundaries and collaborate effectively with Product, Risk, Legal/Compliance, Security, and business stakeholders.
  • Excellent communication skills—able to align leaders, and convey technical tradeoffs clearly.
  • Deep experience designing and operating enterprise platforms, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, APIs, event-driven patterns, observability, resiliency, and DevSecOps practices.
  • Strong understanding of blockchain fundamentals, distributed ledger technologies, consensus mechanisms, cryptography, smart contracts, tokenization concepts, node operations, custody models, and digital asset transaction flows.
  • Experience applying security and control patterns such as authentication, authorization, encryption, key management, secrets management, secure coding, vulnerability management, monitoring, and incident response readiness.
  • Ability to work across ambiguous, emerging technology spaces while producing practical architecture artifacts, decision frameworks, and implementation guidance.
  • Clear communication skills with the ability to influence engineers, architects, product partners, risk stakeholders, and senior leaders.

In addition to the salary range, this role is also eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.


What's in it for you

At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

  • 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
  • Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
  • Paid parental leave and family building benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Line Cook / Prep Cook, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
POSITION SUMMARY

The Renaissance Orlando at SeaWorld is now partnering with the Rouxbe Cooking School to offer culinary associates engaging online training opportunities to help grow their careers. Through Rouxbe's self-paced online platform and culinary training curriculum, Marriott associates with all levels of culinary experience will have access to hundreds of well-designed and visually appealing lessons they can immediately apply to their jobs.

Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality and presentation standards, and food prep checklists. Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food before use. Safely and appropriately use baking and measuring tools/equipment/appliances to prepare baked foods. Follow and ensure compliance with food safety handling policies and procedures, including personal hygiene procedures. Check and ensure correct temperatures of kitchen appliances and food, and report issues to management. Wash and disinfect kitchen area; set-up and break-down work station; and follow and ensure compliance with sanitation and cleaning procedures. Monitor the quality of food prepared and portions served throughout shift.

Follow all company policies and procedures, including safety and security; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others and support team to reach common goals. Comply with quality expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: Less than 1-year related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

POSITION SUMMARY

Complete closing duties, including storing all reusable goods, breaking down goods, cleaning all equipment and areas, returning equipment to proper locations, locking refrigerators, restocking items, turning off lights, locking doors, and completing daily cleaning checklist. Set up, stock, and maintain work areas. Inspect the cleanliness and presentation of all china, glass, and silver prior to use. Maintain cleanliness of work areas throughout the day, practicing clean-as-you-go procedures.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; and complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional, maintain confidentiality of proprietary information, and protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards. Speak with others using clear and professional language, and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others, support team to reach common goals, and listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Read and visually verify information in a variety of formats (e.g., small print). Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance. Grasp, turn, and manipulate objects of varying size and weight, requiring fine motor skills and hand-eye coordination. JOB SUMMARY

Serves as the property Manager on Duty and oversees all property operations, ensuring that the highest levels of hospitality and service are provided. Represents property management in resolving any guest related situation. Manages the flow of questions and directs guests within the lobby. Serves as Guest Relations Manager and handles the tracking of service issues.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Leading Guest Services Teams

• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

• Encourages and builds mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

• Serves as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.

• Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.

• Celebrates successes and publicly recognizes the contributions of team members.

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.

Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals

• Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.

• Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.

• Maintains a strong working relationship with all departments to support property operations and goals and to expedite the resolution of any problems that may arise through the general operation of the property.

• Intervenes in any guest/employee situation as needed to insure the integrity of the property is maintained, guest satisfaction is achieved, and employee well being is preserved.

• Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.

• Comprehends budgets, operating statements and payroll progress reports as needed to assist in the financial management areas of department.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

• Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.

• Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.

• Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.

• Serves as a leader in displaying outstanding hospitality skills.

• Sets a positive example for guest relations.

• Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

• Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.

• Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.

• Strives to improve service performance.

• Provides immediate assistance to guests as requested.

• Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.

• Participates in the development and implementation of corrective action plans to improve guest satisfaction.

Implementing Projects and Policies

• Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.

• Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPS) and support the Peer Review Process.

• Manages payroll administration.

Conducting Human Resource Activities

• Identifies the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.

• Provides guidance and direction to subordinates, including setting performance standards and monitoring performance.

• Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.

• Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.

• Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door” policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.

• Supervises on-going training initiatives and conducts training when appropriate.

• Participates in the employee performance appraisal process, providing feedback as needed.

Additional Responsibilities

• Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

• Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

• Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.

• Maintains high visibility in public areas during peak times.

• Understands and can implement all emergency plans including accident, death, elevator, thefts, vicious crimes, bombs, fire, etc.

• Performs Front Desk duties in high demand times.

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Strategy & Transactions team helps guide clients through their most critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team delivers integrated, end-to-end support and advisory services covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, government operations modernization, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, mergers and acquisitions (M&A), and sustainability. Work alongside clients every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and provide practical solutions at every stage of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.

Work you'll do

As a Rural Health Delivery Manager on the Operations Transformation team, you will support Rural Health Transformation engagements, oversee work quality and support consistent delivery across projects. This role acts as the central point of coordination between engagement leadership and delivery resources, managing planning, resourcing, and risk across multiple concurrent workstreams. Role responsibilities include:

•Oversee work quality and consistency across deliverables

•Develop and manage resource allocation plans, balancing capacity against workstream demands

•Identify, track, and manage risks, issues, and stakeholders across the delivery portfolio, escalating as needed

•Establish and maintain delivery standards, templates, and quality review processes

•Monitor team capacity and support staffing and onboarding planning as engagement needs evolve

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Operations Transformation offering provides NextGen core operational solutions and operating models, business-led technology support, and process optimization services, maximizing value to our government clients' missions.

The Deloitte US Delivery Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the delivery center model provides high-quality services to our clients. USDC professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree required
  • 5+ years of experience in delivery management, project management, or a related operations role, ideally within a shared services or delivery center environment
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
      • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg) or Geo-Hub locations (Atlanta, Charlotte, Dallas, Houston, and Philadelphia)
      • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
      • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
      • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance
  • Healthcare or public sector consulting delivery experience
  • Demonstrated experience with multi-workstream planning and coordinating resources across concurrent workstreams
  • 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be able to obtain a clearance
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • PMP certification or equivalent project management credential
  • Experience managing delivery centers supporting Medicaid, rural health, or state government engagements
  • Familiarity with quality assurance frameworks for analytical or reporting deliverables

Position Summary


Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

• Drive strategic direction of initial workshops Phase 0 planning workshops & subsequent Phase 1 requirements gathering / implementation planning workshops, working directly with your team to collate appropriate materials and agenda

• Lead end-to-end delivery of multi-workstream SIR programs, including scoping, schedule, budget, risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, and quality management

• Stand up delivery governance and operating rhythms; drive backlog, sprint, and release planning across SIR, Major Security Incident Management, Data Loss Prevention, Threat Intelligence Security Center (TISC), and related SecOps workstreams in partnership with architects and product owners

• Leverage a team of Business Process Consultant, Solution Architects, and Technical Consultants to effectively synthesize requirements, drive epic and user story creation and begin execution of development work

• Act a liaison for both the project team and the project teams, facilitating touchpoints where needed to generate design decisions, remove blockers, and maintaining velocity of execution

• Manage stakeholder engagement and executive communications with CISOs and SOC and incident response leaders; facilitate decisions, change control, and status reporting with clear KPIs, value realization, and adoption metrics

• Guide executive and program stakeholders through the transition from current-state processes and tools to ServiceNow-aligned architecture, including migration approach, out-of-the-box versus customization decisions, sequencing, and change impact, in partnership with architects

• Lead executive stakeholder engagement with CISOs and SOC/IR leaders, guiding the transition to ServiceNow-aligned architecture and reporting on KPIs, value realization, and adoption.

• Engage directly with both internal and client facing PMO teams, clearly delineating responsibilities, aligning status reporting cadence and messaging of Risk, Actions, Issues and Dependencies to wider stakeholders

• Lead implementation planning, including cutover from legacy case management or SOAR tools, training direction and User Acceptance Testing preparation

• Orchestrate cross-functional teams and vendors across onshore and offshore models both internally and externally; align resources and mitigate delivery risks, blockers, and interdependencies

• Lead, staff, and develop Consultants and Senior Consultants; set the quality bar and coach for growth

• Oversee pre-sales through delivery handoff, including scoping, estimates, staffing plans, delivery approach, and transition-to-operations readiness

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

• Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team

• Effective written and verbal communication skills

• Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

• Ability to build and sustain professional relationships

• Ability to lead projects or workstreams

• Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment

• Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor

• Ability to meet deadlines

• Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Strategy & Transformation offering develops and transforms cyber programs in line with our client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. We support capabilities across a broad suite of ServiceNow products across SecOps, Integrated Risk Management, and IT Asset Management. We are a growing team and are looking for our next generation of leaders to steer the direction of practice.

Qualifications

Required

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, Information Technology, or Business Administration

• ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)

• 6+ years managing or acting as a business process consultant on ServiceNow programs or projects in a client-facing consulting or professional services role

• 6+ years leading or acting as a business process consultant in a multi-workstream ServiceNow deliveries using Agile or hybrid methodologies, including backlog, sprint, and release management

• 4+ years managing program financials, executive reporting, stakeholder management, and change control

• 3+ years managing distributed delivery teams, including onshore and offshore resources, vendors, and client personnel

• Experience guiding client leadership through migration from legacy tools and processes to ServiceNow-aligned architecture and best practices

• 2+ full lifecycle ServiceNow SIR implementations delivered from initiation through go-live and transition to operations

• Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

• Limited immigration sponsorship may be available

Preferred

• 3+ years delivering ServiceNow Security Incident Response programs

• ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist – Security Incident Response (CIS-SIR)

• ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)

• ServiceNow Certified Technical Architect (CTA) or Certified Master Architect (CMA)

• Experience leading a SOC platform consolidation or SOAR migration

• Understanding of high usage SIEM / SOAR tools, as well as market trends

• Experience with Threat Intelligence Security Center (TISC)

• Experience applying NIST 800-61, NIST CSF, ISO 27001, or MITRE ATT&CK in operating model or platform design

• Experience delivering Now Assist for Security Operations, AI Specialists, or Performance Analytics

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Security, Engineering, or Information Technology

Job ID371143

Job.JobTitle: Converge for Life Sciences - Customer Success, Deal Desk, & Pricing and Packaging Lead, Sr. Consultant – Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future.

This role is aligned to the Converge for Life Sciences portfolio, Deloitte's AI-enabled platform portfolio for the modern life sciences enterprise. Converge by Deloitte combines proprietary data assets, advanced analytics, and AI-driven decision intelligence to help pharmaceutical, biotech, and medical product organizations accelerate the pace of discovery, development, and commercialization, while improving compliance and operational visibility across the enterprise.

Rather than being aligned to a single product, this role sits within the Converge for Life Sciences commercial operations function and supports deal structuring, contracting, and client success activities across the portfolio's full suite of software and AI-enabled offerings.

Position Summary

As the Senior Consultant for Customer Success, Deal Desk, and Pricing and Packaging, you will serve as the commercial engine behind the Converge for Life Sciences go-to-market motion. You will own the full lifecycle of software license transactions, including all software license order renewals, partner with commercial strategy to design creative and innovative pricing and packaging models for software, technology, and IP offerings, and help ensure clients realize ongoing value from the platforms they adopt. Working across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Risk, and Sales leadership, you will bring commercial structure and discipline to a growing, multi-product portfolio.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/01/2026.

Work you'll do

Deal Desk, Contracting & License Renewals:

  • Own end-to-end management of all software license order renewals, ensuring accurate, on-time execution and continuity of client subscriptions across the portfolio.
  • Lead the full commercial contracting lifecycle: drafting offering summaries, securing internal approvals, engaging clients, drafting license agreements, routing risk and legal reviews, and executing signed agreements.
  • Build and maintain the commercial artifact(s) of record used to track deal status, payment milestones, and renewal timing across a staggered, multi-client portfolio.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for ad hoc contracting questions, coordinating with Legal/Risk on approvals so deals move cleanly from shaping through execution.

Pricing & Packaging Strategy:

  • Support the design of creative, innovative commercial models for new and existing software, technology, and IP offerings, including tiering structures, usage- and overage-based mechanics, margin targets, and contract exit terms.
  • Partner with Product Management to establish a consistent point in the product development lifecycle at which pricing and packaging work begins, so commercial readiness keeps pace with new product launches.
  • Build repeatable pricing frameworks and playbooks that scale as the software and AI-enabled product portfolio grows.
  • Evaluate and recommend licensing structures (e.g., subscription, consumption-based, transitional/migration licensing) that balance client adoption with long-term revenue durability.

Cross-Functional Commercial Alignment:

  • Act as the connective tissue across Finance, Legal/Risk, Product, and Leadership on commercial and contractual matters, ensuring the right stakeholders are engaged at the right time.
  • Partner with Finance on forecasting and cost modeling tied to commercial offerings, and support Legal/Risk in an advisory capacity on structural deal questions.
  • Identify and help resolve cross-functional commercial issues that don't have a natural owner, bringing structure and follow-through to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations.

Customer Success & Adoption:

  • Partner with Account, Product, and Practice teams to support client adoption, stakeholder engagement, and client-facing messaging once a product is live, without duplicating relationship-management work already owned by those teams.
  • Coordinate cross-functional resources, including practice expertise, product teams, and leadership, to resolve client-facing adoption issues and maintain a consistent client experience post-sale.
  • Monitor client health signals tied to commercial terms, such as renewal risk or usage against contracted tiers, and proactively flag concerns to the broader account team.

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

Cross-Functional Leadership & Collaboration:

  • Comfortable operating as both a leader and a connector across Sales, Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal/Risk, and Account teams.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with the ability to manage a staggered portfolio of concurrent deals, renewals, and client engagements at different stages simultaneously.
  • Clear, confident communicator, able to bring structure to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations without a predefined playbook.
  • Self-directed ownership mindset; comfortable being accountable for outcomes that span multiple functions with no single predefined owner.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience defined as an additional 4+ years of relevant work experience in lieu of a degree.
  • 4–6 years of combined experience in deal desk, commercial contracting, pricing and packaging, sales operations, or customer success roles, ideally within a SaaS or enterprise software environment.
  • Demonstrated experience owning end-to-end commercial contract lifecycles, including drafting, approvals, execution, and renewal tracking.
  • Experience designing or supporting pricing and packaging models for software, technology, or IP-based offerings (e.g., tiered, usage-based, or subscription licensing structures).
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with experience using commercial or contract-tracking tools to manage a portfolio of active deals.
  • Demonstrated ability to work cross-functionally across Finance, Legal, Product, and Sales/Account teams to move commercial work forward.
  • Ability to travel 20-25%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience in life sciences technology environments (e.g., CRM, field engagement, patient services, R&D, supply chain, manufacturing, or market access).
  • Familiarity with software licensing and contracting norms in a SaaS or enterprise technology business, including subscription, consumption-based, and transitional licensing models.
  • Experience supporting or partnering with customer success functions on client adoption and stakeholder engagement for newly launched products.
  • Comfort engaging with Legal/Risk teams in an advisory capacity on structural deal questions (e.g., demo licensing, exit/refund terms).
  • Proficiency in commercial or product management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence, Salesforce, Aha!).

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 - $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Front Desk Agent / Concierge, Hospitality / Tourism / Events
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY

Assists the Front Office Manager in administering front office functions and supervising staff on a daily basis. Front office areas include Bell/Door Staff, Switchboard and Guest Services/Front Desk. Position directs and works with managers and employees to carry out procedures ensuring an efficient check in and check out process. Ensures guest and employee satisfaction and maximizes the financial performance of the department.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; no work experience required.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Maintaining Guest Services and Front Desk Goals

• Manages day-to-day operations, ensuring the quality, standards and meeting the expectations of the customers on a daily basis.

• Develops specific goals and plans to prioritize, organize, and accomplish your work.

• Handles complaints, settling disputes, and resolving grievances and conflicts, or otherwise negotiating with others.

• Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.

• Ensures that regular on-going communication is happening with employees to create awareness of business objectives and communicate expectations, recognizes performance, and produces desired results.

• Understands the impact of department's operations on the overall property financial goals and objectives and manages to achieve or exceed goals.

Supporting Management of Front Desk Team

• Utilizes interpersonal and communication skills to lead, influence, and encourage others; advocates sound financial/business decision making; demonstrates honesty/integrity; leads by example.

• Encourages and building mutual trust, respect, and cooperation among team members.

• Serving as a role model to demonstrate appropriate behaviors.

• Supervises and manages employees. Manages all day-to-day operations. Understands employee positions well enough to perform duties in employees' absence.

• Establishes and maintains open, collaborative relationships with employees and ensures employees do the same within the team.

• Supervises all areas of the Front Office in the absence of the Front Office or Assistant Front Office Manager.

Ensuring Exceptional Customer Service

• Provides services that are above and beyond for customer satisfaction and retention.

• Improves service by communicating and assisting individuals to understand guest needs, providing guidance, feedback, and individual coaching when needed.

• Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

• Sets a positive example for guest relations.

• Empowers employees to provide excellent customer service.

• Observes service behaviors of employees and provides feedback to individuals.

• Interacts with customers to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.

• Ensures employees understand customer service expectations and parameters.

• Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

• Emphasizes guest satisfaction during all departmental meetings and focuses on continuous improvement.

Managing Projects and Policies

• Implements the customer recognition/service program, communicating and ensuring the process.

• Trains staff and monitors adherence to all credit policies and procedures to reduce bad debts and rebates.

• Supervises same day selling procedures to maximize room revenue and control property occupancy.

• Supervises daily Front Desk shift operations and ensures compliance with all policies, standards and procedures.

• Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and support the Peer Review Process.

Supporting Human Resource Activities

• Supports the developmental needs of others and coaching, mentoring, or otherwise helping others to improve their knowledge or skills.

• Solicits employee feedback, utilizes an “open door” policy and reviews employee satisfaction results to identify and address employee problems or concerns.

• Brings issues concerning employee satisfaction to the attention of the department manager and Human Resources.

• Assists as needed in the interviewing and hiring of employee team members with the appropriate skills.

• Supports a departmental orientation program for employees to receive the appropriate new hire training to successfully perform their job.

• Participates in employee progressive discipline procedures.

Additional Responsibilities

• Provides information to supervisors, co-workers, and subordinates by telephone, in written form, e-mail, or in person.

• Analyzes information and evaluating results to choose the best solution and solve problems.

• Informs and/or updates the executives, the peers and the subordinates on relevant information in a timely manner.

• Performs all duties at the Front Desk as necessary.

• Runs Front Desk shifts whenever necessary.

• Participates in departmental meetings and continually communicates a clear and consistent message regarding the Front Desk goals to produce desired results.

The Renaissance Orlando at SeaWorld is now partnering with the Rouxbe Cooking School to offer culinary associates engaging online training opportunities to help grow their careers. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality and presentation standards, and food prep checklists. Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food before use. Check and ensure correct temperatures of kitchen appliances and food, and report issues to management. Wash and disinfect kitchen area; set-up and break-down work station; and follow and ensure compliance with sanitation and cleaning procedures. Monitor the quality of food prepared and portions served throughout shift.

Follow all company policies and procedures, including safety and security; report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language and answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others and support team to reach common goals. Comply with quality expectations and standards. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Move over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces. Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: Less than 1-year related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

Job.JobTitle: Technology & Data Integration, Strategy, Growth, and Transformation Consultant
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart-of-the-business solutions.

Work You'll Do

As a Project Delivery Consultant, Strategy, Growth and Transformation on the Supply Chain & Network Operations team on the project, you will:

  • Design, build, and maintain automated workflows in Microsoft SharePoint and Microsoft Power Automate to support supply chain risk assessment intake, routing, notifications, and approval processes
  • Support the modernization of legacy analytical tools by maintaining and enhancing Microsoft Access (MS Access)-based databases, processes, and reporting workflows
  • Develop and sustain Microsoft Power BI dashboards that provide users and program stakeholders with exposure, contract, and operational analytics
  • Integrate, import, and validate data from multiple sources, including procurement, commercial, government, and intelligence-related data sets, into centralized repositories and reporting solutions
  • Support the use of human-reviewed Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) tools to accelerate data ingestion, draft risk assessment outputs, and identify data anomalies

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Supply Chain & Network Operations offering advises, implements, and operates transformational solutions that bring world class supply network capabilities.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in supply chain, logistics, information systems, business, data analytics, engineering, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience developing and maintaining Microsoft Access (MS Access) databases, queries, forms, or reports
  • 3+ years of experience building automated workflows using Microsoft Power Automate and Microsoft SharePoint
  • 3+years of experience developing dashboards and reporting solutions in Microsoft Power BI
  • 3+ years of experience integrating, importing, or validating data from procurement, contract, logistics, or operational data sources, including Federal Procurement Data System (FPDS) or USAspending.gov
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • 3+ years of experience supporting supply chain risk management, logistics operations, or defense supply chain analytics
  • 2+ years of experience using Generative Artificial Intelligence (GenAI) tools in human-in-the-loop workflows
  • 3+ years of experience automating risk assessment outputs using structured data
  • 2+ years of experience supporting federal, defense, or government clients
  • 3+ years of experience working with cloud-based workflow modernization or enterprise data integration initiatives

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. Job.JobTitle: Security Specialist, Risk and Compliance Services
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Deloitte is seeking an experienced Specialist, Risk and Compliance Services to administer the daily operations of the National Industrial Security Program (NISP) and implement procedures and controls to safeguard classified as well as special program information, as required. Be a part of a diverse team of security professionals in performing standard and specialized/multidisciplinary security duties supporting NISP-related classified, Controlled Unclassified Information/agency sensitive (CUI-Public Trust) contracts for a subset of Deloitte Government and Public Services (GPS) accounts.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/07/26.


Work You'll do:

  • Initiate, prepare, and submit required contractor personnel security applications for access to Public Trust, client sensitive data to include SF86, SF85P, SF85, Visit Authorization Letters (VAL) and other agency required paperwork
  • Manage and conduct NISP operations that includes both "access elsewhere" and “possessing facility” operational environments for Department of Defense and other government agencies
  • Ensure compliance with DOD/Federal/Intelligence Community regulations that govern the critical security disciplines of both NISP/NISPOM and SCI classified contract-related security operations
  • Analyze complex problems, develops, and articulates focused solutions, and takes independent action in an often-ambiguous work environment
  • Develop security procedures consistent with Deloitte policies, the National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM), including Intelligence Community Directive (ICD) 704 and ICD 705
  • Review, coordinate, publish (and amend, as needed) security program governance documentation (e.g.: policies, procedures, and Standard Practice Procedures (SPP) manuals)
  • Provide advisory and consultation to Federal leadership, senior management, project managers, and engagement team members
  • Conduct regular interactions (in-person meetings, briefings, phone calls, status emails) with Deloitte client account teams, government clients, and other Enterprise Service teams to understand their needs and requirements, develop efficient security support processes, report/provide relevant security-related information, engage clients as appropriate, and develop sound working relationships
  • Report all security violations and compromises/potential compromises of classified information to the Corporate Facility Security Officer
  • Conduct security-related liaison activities with external (client) customers/Government security officials, internal (Deloitte) Federal leadership, and Enterprise Solutions (Federal Contracts, Recruiting and Talent, as necessary)
  • Review personnel security clearance request packages for accuracy and completeness.
  • Coordinate security support for compartmented or special access programs, as required
  • Manage the Self-Assessment program between DCSA Security Reviews to monitor the overall security status of classified contracts/operations and provide recommendations for corrective actions, to include establishing continuous evaluation criteria
  • Perform other related duties as required, necessary or directed to assure a comprehensive and viable security program within the guidelines of the NISPOM
  • Assist with ad hoc proposal security volume reviews
  • Ensure both internal and external security information systems (e.g.: SharePoint, internal security databases, etc.) are updated with current data related to account
  • Escalate issues and concerns to appropriate managers and senior leadership
  • Collaborate across all GPS Security teams to ensure best practices are being consistently employed and information is adequately shared as appropriate

Required Qualifications:

  • Active Top Secret clearance. Be able to obtain/maintain Top Secret/SCI clearance, as required
  • Experience working in a team environment that is rapid-response, customer-focused, and results-driven
  • Experience of people management supporting large, diverse, complex security organizations
  • Strong understanding of the security clearance process and ability to resolve personnel clearance problems effectively
  • Knowledge and experience of utilizing the Defense Information System for Security (DISS) database, National Industrial Security System (NISS) and ACCS
  • Experience in the Industrial Security field to include personnel security, operations security, insider threat management, FOCI mitigations, and incident management
  • Experience establishing facility clearances and getting classified areas certified by DCSA.
  • Familiarity with the drafting, coordinating and processing of prime/sub DD254s
  • Competence in delivery of business presentations, public speaking and training experience, and effective written communications skills to support interaction with all levels of personnel (employees and leadership)
  • Proficiency in the use of M.S. Office products, SharePoint, Personnel Security Management databases
  • Ability to travel up to 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's (BS/BA) Degree or Advanced Degree with Security Specialization
  • FSO Program Management for Possessing Facilities Certification

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. Job ID369934

POSITION SUMMARY

Our jobs aren't just about putting food on the table that our guests will enjoy until they ask for their bill. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique – with food and drinks on the side. Our Guest Service Experts take the initiative and deliver a wide range of services to make sure that guests enjoy their meal. Whether setting tables, communicating with the kitchen, interacting and serving guests, or cleaning work areas and supplies, the Guest Service Expert makes transactions feel like part of the experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – creating a safe workplace, following company policies and procedures, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Service Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time; moving over sloping, uneven, or slippery surfaces), managing the menu (read and visually verify information), and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance and 50 pounds with assistance; reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Service Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: Less than 1 year related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

Position Summary

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions to help our clients navigate the ever-changing threat landscape. Through powerful solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we enable our clients to operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage to secure success.

The Lead Product Engineer is the senior technical owner for one of Deloitte's product lines as a hands-on lead spanning across spacecraft hardware, embedded software, AI/ML, ground systems, and cyber operations. This role holds final technical authority over what ships and release readiness, while defining and evolving the system architecture, including how the Deloitte product integrates into new spacecraft buses and mission profiles, so it remains scalable, coherent, and strategically aligned across a growing set of host platforms and customer programs.

Recruiting for this role will end on November 30, 2026.

Work You'll Do

As a Lead Product Engineer on the Enterprise Security team, you will be responsible for…

  • Serving as the senior technical owner for a Deloitte product line across spacecraft hardware, embedded software, AI/ML, ground systems, and cyber operations.
  • Defining and evolving system architecture, integration patterns, and technical standards to support deployment across new spacecraft buses, mission profiles, and host platforms
  • Making release readiness decisions and owning final technical authority over product quality, system integrity, and what is approved for shipment
  • Leading technical tradeoff decisions for adaptation to unfamiliar bus architectures, interfaces, and orbital environments while maintaining schedule, performance, and mission outcomes.
  • Partnering with product, engineering, manufacturers, bus partners, and government and commercial customers to drive technical vision, delivery, and interoperability of Deloitte's products.
  • Lead integration engineering for each new host platform: define interface control documents (ICDs), adapt Silent Shield to mission-specific bus protocols (e.g., CAN, MIL-STD-1553, SpaceWire) and message structures, and manage the non-recurring engineering required to onboard a new bus, satellite manufacturer, or mission profile.
  • Lead multidisciplinary delivery across cyber, software, hardware, AI, and systems: unblock teams, ensure implementation consistency across bus types and mission profiles, and bridge research to production.
  • Translate compliance frameworks (NIST, CNSSP-12, ATO, STIGs as applicable) into executable delivery controls and compliance-ready designs, consistent across Deloitte-owned and customer-owned deployments.
  • Own system-level test strategy and execution, including FlatSat and hardware-in-the-loop (HWIL) integration testing, security validation, mission-readiness, and operational acceptance across host platforms; own system failures and root-cause resolution.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective technical written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Strong leadership skillset.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Strong technical acumen
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong grasp of security architecture.
  • Ability to lead and influence without direct authority.
  • Ability to meet deadlines

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Enterprise Security offering embeds security in all aspects of digital transformation by securing a client's technical backbone while enabling secure digital transformation. Includes security architecture, secure development and deployment, end-to-end cyber cloud capabilities, application security, and security for emerging technologies and connected products.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • Active TS/SCI or SCI eligibility is required.
  • 8+ years of experience in product engineering, systems engineering, software engineering, or embedded systems engineering.
  • 8+ years of experience working in the space industry with a strong understanding of systems architecture.
  • 5+ years of experience with spacecraft systems, embedded software, cyber operations, ground systems, or artificial intelligence/machine learning-enabled products.
  • Proven leadership capabilities delivering complex, multidisciplinary cyber and/or space systems through production and operations.
  • Deep experience designing secure architecture across cloud, on-premises, hybrid, and space/embedded constraints, with strong systems-thinking and integration background (interfaces, bus protocols, constraints, failure modes).
  • Demonstrated experience integrating a payload, subsystem, or capability across multiple satellite bus architectures or host platforms, including interface definition (ICDs), non-recurring engineering, and acceptance testing with external manufacturers or bus partners.
  • Experience defining system architecture and technical requirements for integrated hardware and software products.
  • Experience supporting technical integration with external partners, manufacturers, or customers
  • Experience operating under compliance constraints (NIST, ATO, STIGs, as applicable) and translating them into executable delivery controls and compliance-ready designs.
  • Expertise in Cyber Governance and Policies and Product Management.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Master's degree or PHD in engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, or a related technical field.
  • Cyber technical skillset.
  • Experience with satellite mission operations, telemetry/tracking/command (TT&C), or aerospace delivery environments.
  • Background in embedded systems integration across multiple bus protocols (CAN bus, MIL-STD-1553, SpaceWire, real-time protocols).
  • Experience working with satellite manufacturers or bus partners on payload integration, radiation qualification, or SWaP-constrained design.
  • Familiarity with AI/ML model deployment pipelines in constrained environments (e.g., ONNX).
  • Background in SPARTA (Space Attack Research and Tactic Analysis) threat frameworks.
  • Working fluency across the platform tech stack, enough to guide design decisions in each domain: embedded/space (C, POSIX, CAN bus, real-time OS); AI/ML (Python, ONNX, PyTorch, Isolation Forest, autoencoders); ground segment (Docker, Grafana, MQTT, Node.js); CI/CD and DevOps (GitHub Actions, automated security scanning, containerized deployments, Prometheus, Fluent Bit).

The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $151,500 to $252,200.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.
