Job.JobTitle: Wellness Instructor/Personal Trainer, Roper YMCA Family Center
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

This position will cultivate member relationships by providing a high-level customer service experience, and improve member retention. This individual will engage members by interacting with them on the wellness floor, supporting the general membership, and completing a schedule for cleaning equipment each shift.

Our Culture

Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. In the Y, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day. We are welcoming: we are open to all. We are a place where you can belong and become. We are genuine: we value you and embrace your individuality. We are hopeful: we believe in you and your potential to become a catalyst in the world. We are nurturing: we support you in your journey to develop your full potential. We are determined: above all else, we are on a relentless quest to make our community stronger beginning with you. We are the Y.

Job Responsibilities

  • Assists members and customers on the wellness floor and the Family Center courteously.

  • Participates in member retention, special events and fundraising
  • Engaging with members to upsell all programs including Personal Training, Group Exercise, Youth Sports, Aquatics & Youth Development programs.
  • Stays current with industry trends and wellness and fitness techniques
  • Report all accidents/incidents to your supervisor and follow the Association's current employee and member injury reporting procedures.
  • Respond promptly and appropriately to emergency situations or when rescue or first aid is necessary
  • Enforce all safety rules fairly, consistently with tact and respect.
  • Report suspicious and inappropriate behaviors and policy violations.
  • Adhere to job specific child abuse risk management responsibilities.
  • Ensure unused rooms and closets remain locked; routinely monitor high-risk locations (locker-rooms and bathrooms), etc.

Requirements

  • CPR, First Aid, AED Certification preferred prior to hire. Must obtain within 60 days of hire
  • Desire and ability to work with people of all ages, improving the health and fitness at all levels

Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, which may include weekends and holidays as needed.
  • Must be willing to work an on-call schedule rotation as required.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.
  • May be required to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. in various forms, and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. The employee must be able to perform medium work.
  • May be required to sit or stand for extended periods of time while demonstrating manual dexterity in order to accurately work on the phone, computer keyboard, and other equipment
  • Must be alert at all times, keeping safety in mind. Must possess acceptable hearing and visual capabilities in order to monitor environment and members' well-being.
  • Must possess auditory, verbal and visual capabilities in order to adequately communicate via phone and in person. Talking is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels, with or without correction
  • Must be capable of working under pressure in a somewhat disruptive environment.
  • May be required to sit, stand, or maintain physical activity for extended periods of time including continuous physical endurance for thirty to sixty minutes of aerobic activity.

Disclaimers

  • Must complete successful background screening, which includes criminal and employment verification.

Please see your manager should you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.

Job.JobTitle: Project Engineer (Show Engineering) - 2 Year Project Role
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Support the development of project scopes, schedules, and budgets while managing multiple vendors and providing technical leadership. Establish effective project management practices, guide design decisions, and ensure timely delivery of project milestones. Collaborate with the Manager, Project Engineering to manage changes and resolve challenges among stakeholders, while also participating in verification and validation testing. Provide technical solutions across diverse UDX venues and advise stakeholders on best practices and compliance with UDX standards and specifications.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • The Project Engineer leads the full lifecycle of venue systemsincluding design, production, fabrication, installation, focus, programming, commissioning, and turnoverwhile providing technical leadership and mentorship to the project team. They oversee scopes, schedules, and budgets, foster collaboration across departments, and work closely with the Manager, Project Engineering to develop documentation and schedules for both Capital and Expense Programs. Responsibilities also include supporting contractual documentation such as Scopes of Work (SOW), RFIs, RFPs, and specifications, and delivering clear, concise updates and presentations to senior leadership and stakeholders at all levels. This role requires strong communication skills, adherence to GAP policies and procedures, and support for system training and documentation improvements across platforms like SharePoint, MAXIMO, and PMWeb.
  • Oversees contractors mock-up, prototype, and acceptance testing efforts to ensure final installed systems meet scope of work and contract specifications. Review all improvements to insure they follow all applicable codes, regulations and standards including ISO, IEC, AISC, ASME, ASTM, ANSI, AWS, NEC, OSHA, NFPA, F24 and IEEE standards.
  • Support Subject Matter Experts in multiple disciplines for mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, pneumatic or control systems. Support the development and review FMEAs and Safety Risk Assessments for new and existing Venues and Scope of Work for contracts and projects.
  • Review designs and documentation from vendors/contractors ensuring compliance with contractual requirements and specifications.
  • Develop and conduct Acceptance Test Procedures for Venues.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in applicable technical field required
  • Advanced degree is preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of experience in direct theme park specific technical/engineering roles required or similar experience in related technical field
  • Significant vendor management experience
  • 3+ years of projects experience within the entertainment/theme park industry required
  • Experience in Theme park development, construction, show and ride systems design or fabrication is preferred
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Manager, Communications is a strategic leader responsible for developing and executing communications strategies that align with business priorities and advance understanding of the companys ambition and growth strategy. This role is key to shaping the perception of the company as an Employer of Choice, developing and writing key internal communications and content, including executive communications, while also aggregating UDX content from various Destinations, Divisions, Business Segments and Global Functions, ensuring brand, voice, and IP standards are represented accurately.

Partnering closely with the Senior Director, the Senior Manager will develop high-impact enterprise-wide communications plans and content that have clearly stated objectives and outcomes; craft narratives and key messages; support executive-level communications including town hall presentations, talking points and scripts, videos and organizational updates; create editorial calendars spanning internal communications channels and forums.

The Senior Manager supervises and coaches a small team, emphasizing development, accountability and high performance. This highly visible role requires strong relationship-building skills, sound judgment and the ability to influence others through a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Communication Planning
    • Develop and implement communication objectives and plans, inclusive of strategies and tactics, that support enterprise priorities and initiatives, ensuring alignment with UDX focus areas and messaging.
    • Partner with senior leadership and key stakeholders to craft clear, engaging and effective communication content and messaging that resonates with various employee audiences.
    • Continuously measure and assess the impact of communication initiatives, using insights to refine strategies and improve effectiveness.
    • Identify opportunities and benchmark best practices to expand the reach and resonance of communication channels.
  • Editorial Content Strategy and Channel Oversight
    • Oversees and manages the production of enterprise-wide publications (digital or print), email, digital, video, social and web platform/Intranet and print content. Reviews and edits content, ensuring messaging is clear, balanced, engaging, consistent and effective. Provides timely and constructive feedback to content producers. Manages outside vendors, as appropriate and ensures delivery of aligned scopes of work.
    • Partners with other business groups to ensure Team Member focused content aligns and supports overall plans and strategy. Ensures brand, voice, and IP standards are represented accurately.
    • Drive implementation and alignment of enterprise editorial content strategy and own internal-facing editorial content calendar to deliver consistent, high-quality messaging across internal channels, that also enhances and amplifies enterprise-wide content.
    • Have proven experience supporting senior level executives at internal events, including preparing messaging, briefing books, related content.
  • Culture Building, Storytelling and Engagement and Events
    • Identify, source and create compelling content that tells the companys story, showcases key initiatives and amplifies employee voices.
    • Engage with employees at all levels to uncover impactful narratives that enhance internal brand awareness and foster a sense of community.
    • Work closely with other Communications teams, Talent & Culture, executive leadership, and other departments to ensure a cohesive and compelling internal storytelling approach.
    • Generates editorial programming that tells our powerful Team Member stories to inspire our internal audience and build affinity with our external audience.
    • Support the planning and execution of internal events, town halls and leadership roadshows to enhance employee engagement and alignment.
    • Collaborate with senior leaders to ensure their messages are delivered effectively, using the right channels and formats to reach employees.
    • Manage logistics, content development and post-event engagement strategies to maximize impact.
  • Client Partnerships and Team Leadership
    • Fosters effective relationships with our key client groups and divisional partners. Leads cross-functional task forces, as identified, that serve to collectively elevate company communication initiatives. Identifies opportunities for enhanced collaboration with divisional partners.
    • Provides leadership, support, coaching and development of direct reports and functional subject matter experts ensuring that they have the development and skills necessary to provide a consistent delivery of performance.
  • Measurement & Analysis
    • Establish KPIs for associated efforts and monitor communications effectiveness to constantly improve impact.
    • Evaluates and monitors data (email, social media, web platforms; survey results, etc.) and develops action plans to address the analysis. Identify opportunities to increase the capture of metrics to further enhance the analysis of the impact of our messaging.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Proven ability to use research and insights to plan, develop, execute and evaluate communications plans in support of company initiatives. Works collaboratively across functions, divisions and locations.
  • Experience with high impact communications, both internal and externally focused, that have generated measurable results. Must have entrepreneurial spirit and execute within a corporate environment.
  • Demonstrate a proven ability to engage senior leaders and deliver measurable results through strong team engagement, development and retention.
  • Competence in dealing with sensitive or controversial matters on a frequent and recurring basis and ability to effectively apply issues and crisis management skills to mitigate risk and organizational impact.
  • Ability to be nimble and adapt, demonstrating effectiveness at handling multiple concurrent, often conflicting priorities.
  • Proven aptitude for quick creative thinking with acute attention to detail within demanding deadlines.
  • Ability to produce content aligned to storytelling strategies and effectively measure its performance.
  • Effectively sell-in programs and ideas to internal and external stakeholders.
  • Experience developing and publishing content on internal and external communication platforms including employee newsletter, intranets, LinkedIn, Instagram and Medium.
  • Must be comfortable with Adobe Creative Suite tools and have some working knowledge of HTML and web design.
  • Knowledge of external communications is a plus, with an ability to work collaboratively across North America and global communication groups.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism or a related field is required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 7+ years experience working in Communications is required, including 3+ years of supervisory experience.
  • 1+ year of experience at Universal Destinations & Experiences preferred
  •  Public Relations, or Advertising experience preferred.
  • Knowledge of media, working with journalists and social media a plus.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Project Manager has overall responsibility for the successful planning and execution of projects for IT and/or Cyber Security. The Project Manager will work closely with the operations, solutions delivery, infrastructure, innovation, governance and security teams, business partners, and vendors to define, develop, and execute deployment of their assigned projects. The Project Manager ensures that the deployment of projects to the production environment follows the project life cycle methodology and successfully meets the business goals.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Works closely with all Technology teams, business partners, and Vendors to plan, organize, secure, and manage resources for assigned project efforts following software development lifecycle and project implementation policies and procedures as applicable. Independently research, analyze, identify, and document the tasks to achieve the project goals. Coordinate, facilitate, and lead project team meetings to accomplish project deliverables.
  • Responsible for the management of the project including; work statements, work breakdown structures, developing and tracking budget and schedule, tracking individual project tasks, providing risk analysis, tracking and resolving issues and action items, requirements gathering, quality assurance, providing various project management visibility and control measures and reports as needed and communicating to project team and stakeholders.
  • Work closely with our business partners to understand their business and system problems and opportunities in the context of the requirements. Support requirement discussions, requirement reviews, design reviews, testing and remaining project activities to ensure required resources participate and deliverables meet project scope and schedule.
  • Communicate Program Information, status, and key health metrics to stakeholders. Facilitate inter-team communication and resolution of Program-level dependencies, including weekly status meeting and monthly executive steering committee meetings.
  • Trace the requirements through life cycle of the project to ensure that the scope is managed and that the original requirements are delivered.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Solid practical experience dealing with project management, particularly dealing with proposed efforts and leading them through a defined process of prioritization and demand management.
  • Ability to work progressively with a wide range of individual levels, sponsors, stakeholders and resources to align activities and initiatives.
  • Demonstrated cross-functional expertise in diverse fields such as IT including Cyber Security, marketing, strategy, finance, operations, etc. and with skills as far ranging as business case development, ROI analysis, cost estimating, and what-if analyses.
  • Demonstrated experiencing in presenting persuasive recommendations to leadership as well as key external stakeholders, including ability to communicate complex ideas and recommendations to leadership that highlights a clear decision framework based on analysis and experience.
  • Cross-Team/Cross Department Project Leadership experience.
  • Strong Organizing & Inter-Personal Skills.
  • Technology experience/background a plus.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree is preferred in MIS, Technology or Business.
  • Other: Knowledge of project management concepts and processes, requirements gathering, or business analysis preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years equivalent work experience
  • Experience preferred in project management, business analysis
  • Requires the use of sound business judgment in coordinating the requirements of the user group(s) for a project
  • Conflict resolution and problem-solving techniques required
  • Good in presentation, facilitation, communication, and negotiation required; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • Project Management Certification is preferred.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Works with internal business clients and external vendors.
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret business periodicals, professional journals, technical manuals and procedures, or governmental regulations.
  • Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals.
  • Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.
  • Ability to interpret a variety of instructions furnished in written, oral, diagram, or schedule form.
  • Ability to compute rate, ratio, and percent and to draw graphs, and interpret spreadsheets.
  • Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions.
  • Work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Ability to build and lead a team in completing a project.
  • Some travel possible to support Parks Technology division and client locations.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for performing the skilled, discipline specific tasks required to ensure the smooth operation of Universal Orlando Facilities as it pertains to all industrial, commercial and non-commercial plumbing equipment, utilities and infrastructure.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain, service and repair all UO plumbing systems, including, but not limited to: water closets; urinals; sinks; faucets; drinking fountains; and all associated piping by complying with all NSF, ADA, and State Plumbing codes and regulations. Perform all plumbing utility locates and/or leak detection using the appropriate method.
  • Maintain, service and repair all UO infrastructure, including, but not limited to: sanitary lines; grease lines; oil lines; grease traps; lift stations; and interceptors. Operate large cable commercial sewer machines and high-pressure line jetting equipment.
  • Maintain, service and repair all potable water systems as it pertains to UO Facilities, including, but not limited to: water softeners; water heaters; steam effect boilers; potable backflow preventers; circulating pumps; tempering valves; mixing valves; high pressure fog/mist lines; nozzles and pumps; and all related potable infrastructure.
  • Assist and support Plumbing Tech Is with the service and repair of UO natural gas systems, including, but not limited to: all above ground and below ground pipes; valves; and fittings. Perform all leak and cathodic protection surveys. Locate underground gas piping using line locate equipment as needed and/or mandated by the Public Service Commission. Utilize appropriate leak detection equipment to identify and locate underground gas leaks.
  • Assist and support Plumbing Tech Is with the service and repair of all high-pressure steam boilers and piping. Perform daily water conductivity tests on boiler feed water. Maintain all flame, water, natural gas and pressure controls as well as all other safety devices. Maintain, service and repair all makeup water feed pumps and associated piping. Support annual state inspections on fireside as well as perform wet side boiler inspections.
  • Assist and support Plumbing Tech Is with the service and repair of all water based fire protection systems, including, but not limited to: all fire hydrants; fire sprinkler systems; fire pumps; industrial backflow preventers; and all related fire infrastructure.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

SCOPE:

Maintain, service, troubleshoot, repair and operate all commercial and industrial plumbing systems to ensure the continuous smooth operation of Universal Orlando. Including, but not limited to: potable water, industrial water, natural gas, sanitary, storm, grease, high pressure steam and fire protection systems; compressed air piping; and chilled water piping. Maintain all facility plumbing in accordance to all applicable codes, standards, and UO specifications.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree or GED is required
  • Technical school is preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum 3 years experience in industrial and commercial construction, maintenance facility or a fast paced service company dedicated to plumbing repair is required
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience will be considered

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • A valid Florida Drivers License is required to operate company vehicles
  • A Certification of Training issued by either a State Regulatory Agency or construction trade school is preferred
  • A valid Journeyman Plumbing License is preferred

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job Summary:

The Auditor, Qualitative Research will complete field assignments at various locations where they engage in conversations and observations while posing as authentic guests. The auditor will observe ticket sales, in-park operations, and other experiences as they occur using direct participation and observation to gather information. Auditors are responsible for taking notes during interactions, documenting what they experience and observe, and writing detailed reports that clearly explain what happened so someone who was not there can understand the experience. This role requires strong communication and observation skills, attention to detail, the ability to work independently in the field, and a willingness to receive and apply ongoing coaching and feedback.

Major Responsibilities:

  • Conduct covert visits to assigned locations, posing as customers or potential customers to evaluate knowledge, quality, customer service, cleanliness, and overall experience.
  • Discreetly record shorthand notes and observations of locations and interactions without breaking character and alerting others that you are conducting an auditing report.
  • Provide detailed, in-the-moment written reports on all assigned locations/criteria, including photo and video documentation as assigned. Log and submit mileage expense reports and retain and submit accurate itemized receipts.
  • Conduct fixed counts/observations of guest behaviors, interactions, or other observable phenomenon. Conduct brief, semi-structured interviews to collect data on topics of interest.
  • Attend and participate in mandatory in-person quarterly training and learning workshops.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

High school degree or GED is required.

EXPERIENCE:

1+ Year: clerical, customer service, data entry, computer experience preferred. Mystery Shop experience a plus; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

#LI-DNI

Description

Comparion Insurance Agency is hiring self-motivated, relationship-driven professionals for a rewarding outside sales career. This role offers autonomy and flexibility to build your career, grow your earnings, and make a meaningful impact by helping protect individuals and families with auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and specialty insurance.

Backed by a Fortune 100 company, you'll receive hands-on training, resources, and team support to help you succeed. No prior insurance experience required.

THIS POSITION HAS IN-OFFICE REQUIREMENTS.

This is a full-time, field-based employee position. Applicants must be able to travel within their local community to meet with customers and build relationships. Reliable transportation, such as a valid driver's license or another means of travel, is preferred.

Licensing Requirement:
Candidates are welcome to apply even if you do not currently hold your Property & Casualty and Life insurance licenses; however, you must obtain both licenses before your scheduled start date. Whether you already hold your licenses or obtain them before your start date, youll receive a $1,000 professional start bonus to support your transition into your new role!

What you'll do:

  • Sell auto, home, life, small commercial auto, and related insurance products using a consultative, needs-based approach.
  • Build and maintain a book of business through referrals, networking, and community engagement as part of your outside sales efforts.
  • Identify prospective customers using established lead methodologies and relationship-driven outreach.
  • Accurately document customer interactions and handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
  • Use insurance sales technology, relationship management tools, and multi-carrier platforms to deliver tailored insurance solutions.
  • Participate in training, coaching, and performance incentives to continuously improve sales results.

Essential functions include: meeting with customers in the office and in the community, communicating by phone, email, and in person, traveling locally, and using a computer and sales software.

Qualifications

Day One Skills & Traits:

  • Self-motivated and accountable: you take ownership of your work and results.
  • Reliable and responsive: you follow through and do what you say you'll do.
  • Professional and trustworthy: you handle customer information with care and integrity.
  • Relationship-focused: you enjoy helping others and building long-term trust.
  • Strong communicator: you're comfortable talking with people and explaining options clearly.
  • Comfortable with technology: you can learn and use new software and digital tools with ease.
  • Composed and dependable: you stay organized and professional while managing multiple customer needs.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience in customer-facing roles like retail, hospitality, service, operations, logistics, banking, account management, or sales.
  • Basic understanding of sales conversations, including handling common customer questions or objections.
  • Experience managing multiple accounts, clients, or priorities simultaneously.
  • Exposure to consultative selling, negotiation, or regulated industries.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role is determined by a number of factors including skills, experience, education, certifications and location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market and provides an opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factors set forth in the compensation plan for the role.

In 2022, Comparion Insurance Agency was created to transition former Liberty Mutual exclusive agents to an agency that delivers a unique value proposition to carriers with over 2,000 agents in approximately 180 cities in 44 states. We offer customers 50 insurance companies with product breadth including auto, home, life, pet, renters, umbrella, jewelry and much more. We use our scale to deliver a first-rate customer experience through consultative insurance experts located in their communities.

Our Leadership team has over 200 years of cumulative insurance experience. At Comparion, we have a philosophy of staying close to our customers and agents, so sales leadership is located throughout the country in our larger storefronts. Comparion is owned and backed by Liberty Mutual Group, a Fortune 100 company, founded in 1912

Liberty Mutual is an equal opportunity employer. We will not tolerate discrimination on the basis of race, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, age, disability, veteran's status, pregnancy, genetic information or on any basis prohibited by federal, state or local law.

Fair Chance Notices

  • California
  • Los Angeles Incorporated
  • Los Angeles Unincorporated
  • Philadelphia
  • San Francisco

Position Summary

Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced SAP IS-U Retail Consultant, you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. If so, consider an opportunity with Deloitte under our Project Talent Model. Project Talent Model (PTM) is a talent model that is tailored specifically for long-term, onsite client service delivery.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026

Work you'll do/Responsibilities

As a Consultant at Deloitte, you will work within an engagement team and be responsible for supporting the overall project goals and objectives. In this role, you will interact with stakeholders and cross-functional teams. It is expected that you will be able to perform independent tasks as well as provide technical guidance to team members, as needed.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for Retail Access processes, including supplier-related transactions, enrollment and change activities, market requirements, exception management, and regulatory and operational support.
  • Act as a liaison between the business area and technical support organizations to ensure business needs are properly documented and translated into technical requirements.
  • Advanced knowledge of utility Customer Service operations, SAP utility system processes, query and reporting tools, and data analysis.
  • Support business continuity, governance, risk identification, escalation, operational reporting, and execution of departmental priorities.
  • Provide strategic and in-depth research, analysis, and recommendations related to Customer Service business processes, operational performance, and continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Communicate regularly with Engagement Managers (Directors), project team members, and representatives from various functional and / or technical teams, including escalating any matters that require additional attention and consideration from engagement management.

The Team

Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart-of-the-business solutions.

Enterprise Operations as a Service provides multi-year managed service contracts to support enterprise technology investments and key business processes. We ensure continuous modernization and transformative business changes through five key services: SAP Operations, Oracle Operations, IT Operations, Supply Chain Operations, and Finance Operations. Our mission is to help businesses thrive by maintaining their essential operations and enabling growth.

Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years of SAP IS-U experience
  • Experience in Retail Access processes, including supplier-related transactions, enrollment and change activities, market requirements, exception management, and regulatory and operational support.
  • Experience in utility Customer Service operations, SAP utility system processes, query and reporting tools, and data analysis.
  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred

  • Analytical/ Decision Making Responsibilities
  • Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products
  • Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
  • Excellent Written and Communication Skills
  • Ability to deliver technical demonstrations

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $85,000 to $115,000. 

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Deloitte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruiting process, please direct your inquiries to the Global Call Center (GCC) at USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com.

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas, and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities. Learn more.

Professional development

From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe there's always room to learn. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership opportunities and connect and grow through mentorship. From on-the-job learning experiences to formal development programs, our professionals have a variety of opportunities to continue to grow throughout their career.

As used in this posting, "Deloitte" means Deloitte Consulting LLP, a subsidiary of Deloitte LLP. Please see https://www.deloitte.com/us/about for a detailed description of the legal structure of Deloitte LLP and its subsidiaries.

Qualified applicants with criminal histories, including arrest or conviction records, will be considered for employment in accordance with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, City of Los Angeles's Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act. Job.JobDescription:
POSITION SUMMARY

Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to determine if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

JOB SUMMARY

Functions as the strategic business leader of the property's Rooms Operations. Areas of responsibility include Front Office, Recreation/Health Club and Housekeeping. Position works with direct reports (department heads) to develop and implement departmental strategies and ensures implementation of the brand service strategy and brand initiatives. The position ensures Rooms Operations meet the brand's standards, targets customer needs, ensures associate satisfaction, focuses on growing revenues and maximizes the financial performance of the department. Develops and implements property-wide strategies that deliver products and services to meet or exceed the needs and expectations of the brand's target customer and associates and provides a return on investment to the owner and Marriott International.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 4 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

OR

• 4-year bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Hotel and Restaurant Management, or related major; 2 years experience in the guest services, front desk, housekeeping, sales and marketing, management operations, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Profitability

• Demonstrates and communicates key drivers of guest satisfaction for the brand's target customer.

• Analyzes service issues and identifies trends.

• Makes and executes the necessary decisions to keep property moving forward toward achievement of goals.

• Works with Rooms management team to develop an operational strategy that is aligned with the brand's business strategy and leads its execution.

Managing Revenue Goals

• Monitors Rooms operations sales performance against budget.

• Reviews reports and financial statements to determine Rooms operations performance against budget.

• Coaches and supports operations team to effectively manage occupancy & rate, wages and controllable expenses.

• Reviews the Wage Progress Report and compares budgeted wages to actual wages, coaching direct reports to address problem areas and holding team accountable for results.

Leading Operations and Department Teams

• Champions the brand's service vision for product and service delivery and ensures alignment amongst the Rooms leadership teams.

• Develops systems to enable associates to understand guest satisfaction results.

• Communicates a clear and consistent message regarding departmental goals to produce desired results.

Managing the Guest Experience

• Reviews guest feedback with leadership team and ensures appropriate corrective action is taken.

• Responds to and handles guest problems and complaints.

• Stays visible and interfaces with customers on a regular basis to obtain feedback on quality of product, service levels and overall satisfaction.

• Creates an atmosphere in all Rooms and Food and Beverage areas that meets or exceeds guest expectations.

Managing and Conducting Human Resources Activities

• Facilitates the development of creative solutions to overcome obstacles and ensures implementation to continually improve guest satisfaction results.

• Ensures associates are treated fairly and equitably.

• Ensures that regular, ongoing communication is happening in Rooms (e.g., pre-shift briefings, staff meetings).

• Fosters associate commitment to providing excellent service, participates in daily stand-up meetings and models desired service behaviors in all interactions with guests and associates.

• Incorporates guest satisfaction as a component of staff/operations meetings with an emphasis on generating innovative ways to continually improve results.

• Sets goals and expectations for direct reports using the performance review process and holds staff accountable for successful performance.

• Solicits associate feedback, utilizes an “open door policy” and reviews associate satisfaction results to identify and address associate problems or concerns.

• Ensures property policies are administered fairly and consistently, disciplinary procedures and documentation are completed according to Standard and Local Operating Procedures (SOPs and LSOPs) and supports the Peer Review Process.

• Conducts annual performance appraisal with direct reports according to Standard Operating Procedures.

• Champions change, ensures brand and regional business initiatives are implemented and communicates follow-up actions to team as necessary.

Position Summary

The Team

The Innovation & Delivery Transformation (I&DT) team is building the future of Deloitte's business through new AI-native platforms and products. The team is responsible for identifying, nurturing, scaling, and winning in new markets through new capabilities. Rather than relying on what the firm has historically done, I&DT looks ahead and invests in areas where growth is expected three, five, and ten years into the future. This role sits within Products+ at the portfolio level, supporting the overall Product+ data strategy, usage tracking, and procurement.

Position Summary

Data is the foundation of every AI-native product we build, and Product+ needs someone to shape how we source, govern, and capitalize on it. In this role, you'll define the Product+ data strategy, build the third-party data and technology relationships that bring it to life, and advise leadership on how our data assets can drive new revenue. If you want to sit at the intersection of strategy, partnerships, and monetization, this is a rare chance to do it at portfolio level.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/06/2026.

Work you'll do

In this role, you'll lead the effort to define and execute the data strategy for the Product+ portfolio, working with Product+ leadership and stakeholders across the organization. You'll also manage the third-party data and technology relationships that support it and keep our processes compliant. Key responsibilities include:

  • Drive the process to define, document, and refresh the Product+ data strategy, aligning priorities with Product+ leadership
  • Engage stakeholders across the firm (product, technology, legal, risk, and finance) to gather requirements and build consensus on data needs
  • Identify, evaluate, and onboard third-party data and technology providers that support the data strategy
  • Manage ongoing vendor and partner relationships, including contract renewals, usage, performance, and cost
  • Administer the firm processes required for data and technology acquisition, including procurement, risk, and compliance reviews, and keep documentation audit-ready
  • Track and report data usage and spend across the Product+ portfolio to inform investment decisions
  • Support financial metrics and associated Product+ P&L reporting including commercial performance across pipeline, adoption, margin, and annual growth targets.
  • Serve as a key advisor on data monetization efforts, helping assess opportunities, pricing considerations, and go-to-market approaches
  • Prepare recommendations and updates for Product+ leadership

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to translate ambiguous strategic goals into clear, actionable plans
  • Strong executive communication and the ability to influence without direct authority
  • Comfort navigating complex, cross-functional processes and balancing competing priorities
  • Sound judgment when handling sensitive, contractual, or regulated information
  • Collaborative, relationship-oriented approach with both internal stakeholders and external partners

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 4+ years' experience in data strategy, data product management, vendor/partner management, or technology strategy consulting
  • 2+ years' experience managing third-party data or technology vendor relationships, including contract or renewal management
  • 2+ years' experience working directly with senior stakeholders or leadership teams
  • Experience working within an enterprise procurement, compliance, or risk review process
  • Ability to travel up to [10]%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • 2+ years' experience supporting or advising on data monetization, data licensing, or data product pricing
  • Experience in a professional services, consulting, or enterprise technology environment
  • Experience tracking and reporting on software or data usage and spend (e.g., using Excel, Power BI, or Tableau)
  • Experience working with AI/ML products or data used to power them
  • Advanced degree (MBA, MS) in a related field

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. Position Summary

As a Full Stack Engineer Senior Consultant in Deloitte's Cyber Digital Trust & Privacy practice, you will operate at the intersection of client-facing advisory, product engineering, and hands-on technical delivery. You will help clients address complex challenges across digital trust, online protection, privacy, artificial intelligence governance, and data protection by translating business and regulatory requirements into scalable, production-grade technology solutions.

Full Stack Engineers work directly in client environments to architect, build, integrate, deploy, and improve solutions. Depending on the engagement, you may develop trust and safety capabilities, implement product compliance controls, operationalize privacy-by-design practices, build governance for generative or agentic AI, or deploy data protection and cryptographic solutions. These capabilities support Deloitte's broader Digital Trust & Privacy mission: helping organizations build confidence in their digital products, platforms, services, data practices, and customer interactions.

Deloitte's Cyber Digital Trust & Privacy practice helps organizations build and sustain confidence in their digital products, platforms, services, data practices, and customer experiences. Our work brings together digital trust, online protection, privacy, AI governance, identity, data protection, cybersecurity, and regulatory compliance capabilities. This role is designed for a technically strong consultant who can move from ambiguity to implementation, collaborate with product and engineering teams, and communicate effectively with business, security, privacy, legal, and compliance stakeholders.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant, Strategy, Growth and Transformation on the Digital Trust & Privacy team, you will be responsible for:

  • Translating client business objectives, risk requirements, and policy expectations into technical architecture, product requirements, engineering backlogs, and implementation plans
  • Designing, developing, integrating, deploying, testing, and troubleshooting production-grade solutions in client environments, including artificial intelligence (AI) and generative AI (GenAI)-enabled capabilities where applicable
  • Building application programming interfaces (APIs), automations, workflows, integrations, dashboards, and other technical components that enable scalable digital trust, privacy, and data protection capabilities
  • Embedding governance into software development and deployment workflows through automated checkpoints, controls-as-code, policy enforcement, and continuous monitoring
  • Collaborating with clients and cross-functional stakeholders to prototype solutions, resolve technical issues, and deliver solutions that meet regulatory and program objectives

The Team

The Full Stack Engineer team is a multidisciplinary engineering group that turns these capabilities into practical solutions. We work alongside client product, engineering, security, privacy, data, risk, compliance, and business teams to move from strategy and policy to implementation and measurable outcomes.

Our work may include:

  • Helping digital platforms improve trust and safety and address online harms
  • Enabling product teams to meet privacy and product compliance expectations
  • Building technical governance and guardrails for generative and agentic AI
  • Protecting sensitive data across cloud, collaboration, application, and enterprise environments
  • Implementing data discovery, classification, data loss prevention (DLP), encryption, public key infrastructure (PKI), and related cryptographic capabilities
  • Developing Deloitte products and accelerators that make complex digital trust and privacy capabilities easier to deploy and operate

Qualifications

Candidates will have experience in one or more of the following:

  • Digital trust and online protection.
  • Trust and safety.
  • Security & Privacy.
  • Product compliance.
  • AI governance.
  • Data protection.
  • Cryptography

Required:

3-5+ years of experience translating client requirements into solution architectures and building and deploying production-grade solutions using Python, Java, and/or Node.js; Rest API's; microservices; event-driven architectures; or serverless components.

  • 1+ years of experience delivering solutions on AWS, Azure, or GCP deployed via CI/CD pipelines including containers and version control tools.
  • 6 months+ of experience designing or deploying GenAI and/or LLM solutions in a client or production environment.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or related.
  • Ability to travel 25-50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

Preferred Experience:

  • JavaScript or TypeScript and React or Next.js for application or demo development
  • Developing or deploying technical controls for generative AI, LLM, or agentic AI applications
  • Human oversight controls, tool access controls, prompt-injection mitigations, logging, monitoring, or controls-as-code
  • Kubernetes, GitOps, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, Neo4j, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.
  • Regulated industries such as financial services, healthcare, or public sector environments, including work aligned to Sarbanes-Oxley (SOX), Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS), Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC), Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act (HIPAA), or General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Certifications (preferred)

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
  • Cloud certifications from Azure, AWS, Google Cloud.
  • Identity certifications from Okta, Ping, SailPoint, Saviynt, or CyberArk.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collabaorate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Deloitte's Cyber Engineering is a new team that is spearheading the buildout of Cybersecurity technology that will underpin the next generation of our Cybersecurity services. Join us as we work with technologies shaping the future of Cybersecurity to build future capabilities today.

Position Summary

Join Deloitte's Cyber Engineering team to help build technology that supports the next generation of cybersecurity services. As a Full Stack Engineer, you will design, develop, and enhance applications across frontend and backend environments, working with modern engineering practices and cloud-based technologies. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions that support client and business needs.

Work you'll do

As a Full Stack Engineer on the Cyber Engineering team, you will be responsible for…

  • Building and integrating application programming interfaces, microservices, and cloud-based services to support product functionality
  • Supporting product quality through code reviews, testing, debugging, and continuous integration and continuous deployment practices
  • Contributing to technical analysis, solution design, and delivery activities that support client outcomes and product development

  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams

  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Physics, Statistics, or a similar technical field
  • 2-3+ years experience in the following areas:
    • 2-3+ years of experience in full stack development across frontend and backend technologies, including experience with Angular, React, or Next.js and JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, and CSS3
    • 2-3+ years of experience in backend development using Node.js, Python with Django or Flask, or Java with Spring Boot
    • 2-3+ years of experience building and consuming Representational State Transfer application programming interfaces and working with microservices or serverless architectures in production environments
    • 2-3+ years of experience working with relational databases and at least 1 NoSQL database, and using Git, Azure DevOps or similar tools, Docker, Agile or Scrum methods, automated testing, and continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines

  • Ability to travel 20%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience with object-oriented programming, design patterns, and clean coding practices
  • Experience building secure, reusable, responsive, and maintainable applications
  • Experience with secure development practices, DevOps, DevSecOps, web security, GitOps, or Kubernetes customization
  • Experience with OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Neo4j, Memgraph, Maven, or Gradle
  • Experience with Bootstrap, jQuery, or JavaServer Pages in legacy or mixed-technology environments
  • Cloud certification in Amazon Web Services, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform

Job.JobTitle: Co-Teacher Family Center, Downtown Orlando YMCA Family Center
Job.JobDescription:
Make a difference in your life and the lives of youth!

Position Summary

The position is responsible for implementing and supervising all aspects of daily activities for youth and the Co-Teacher is responsible for working to provide a successful program that will foster Children's social, physical, spiritual, and mental growth in a safe and well-organized environment.

Why choose the YMCA?

  • We offer a competitive wage plan that starts at a minimum of $15.50 per hour for Co-teachers
  • The Y is a cause-driven organization that provides a challenging and fun work environment with creative, talented and diverse individuals!

Our Culture

Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. In the Y, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day. We are welcoming: we are open to all. We are a place where you can belong and become. We are genuine: we value you and embrace your individuality. We are hopeful: we believe in you and your potential to become a catalyst in the world. We are nurturing: we support you in your journey to develop your full potential. We are determined: above all else, we are on a relentless quest to make our community stronger beginning with you. We are the Y.

Job Responsibilities

  • Provide a safe and healthy environment, both physically and mentally, to ensure the operation of a quality Child Development (Afterschool) program.
  • Assist in the planning and implementing of the daily lesson plans that fit the children's needs and interests.
  • Take responsibility for the safety of the children in the child development environment and the quality of the supplies, equipment and materials in the child development area.
  • Make sure proper procedures are followed for sign-in/out of children on a daily basis.
  • Report all accidents to the Supervisor, and completely fills out proper health log and/or accident/incident form.
  • Assume equal share of the regular housekeeping chores such as cleaning, preparing for daily activities and cleaning up after projects.
  • Report suspicious and inappropriate behaviors and policy violations.
  • Follow mandated child abuse reporting requirements.
  • Adhere to procedures related to managing high-risk activities and supervising consumers.
  • Participate in member retention, special events and fundraising. Complete all paperwork clearly and concisely. Remain up to date on emergency procedures and family center policies.
  • All other duties assigned by management.

Requirements

  • Minimum age 16 years or older.
  • 1 year of childcare experience preferred
  • CPR, First Aid, AED certifications and Child Abuse Prevention training within 30 days of hire date.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, which may include weekends and holidays as needed.
  • Must be willing to work an on-call schedule rotation as required.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.
  • The physical activities of this position include: stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, grasping, feeling, and repetitive motions. May be required to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. in various forms, and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or a negligible amount of force constantly to move objects. The employee must be able to perform medium work.
  • May be required to sit, stand, or maintain physical activity for extended periods of time.
  • Must exhibit patience and understanding. Receives and follows detailed instructions.
  • Must be alert at all times, keeping safety in mind.
  • Must possess acceptable hearing and visual capabilities in order to monitor environment and children's well-being. Talking is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels, with or without correction
  • Must be capable of working under pressure in a somewhat disruptive environment.

Disclaimers

  • Must complete a successful employment verification and background screening, which includes a DCF Level 2 Background Check (Additional information on Level 2 Background through Clearinghouse can be found here: https://info.flclearinghouse.com/)
  • All of the above duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. The YMCA promotes an equal employment opportunity work place which includes reasonable accommodation of otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please see your manager should you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.
  • This job description may not be all-inclusive and employees are expected to perform all other duties as assigned and directed by management. Job descriptions and duties may be modified when deemed appropriate by management.

JOB SUMMARY:

Generates project estimates for all projects ranging from new attractions, retail, restaurants, and resort hotels to entirely new theme parks. Completes subsequent estimating activities as projects progress through design and construction, to compare to budget. Manages the estimating process for large scopes of work. Responsible for all components of the project to include Facility, Show, Ride, Soft Costs and other project costs.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Collaborates on project estimates for projects including estimate refinements prepared by the individual project estimators or outside estimating firms. Reviews continually evolving design documents and estimates to ensure the projects are tracking on budget.
  • Assists project team with contractor and vendor change order negotiation.
  • Performs function of lead estimator for large scopes of work, which requires supervision of in-house or contracted estimating resources, as scope of work indicates. 
  • Develops RFP cost breakdowns for Facility, Show and Ride bids. Works with project team to establish bid alternates. Provides post-bid cost analysis and award recommendation.
  • Works with project team to identify project trends/risks and provides estimated values. Leads the management of risk throughout project lifecycles.
  • Works with Finance to establish proper budget breakdown and associated budget codes for management and reporting.
  • Works with project team to establish work package/buyout plan.
  • Prepares budget estimate summaries and presents to Senior Leadership.
  • Participates in Contractor subcontractor buy-out process, providing owner representation/oversight.
  • Researches market conditions for cost trends and local means and methods (both locally and internationally). Develops location cost factors and escalation factors.  Analyzes Universal Creative historical costs and disseminates to appropriate year and location.  Incorporates current and historic costs into a central database. Develops comparisons for various attractions and non-attraction facilities.
  • Creates value engineering (VE) components with the project team to mitigate cost overruns.
  • Identifies, tracks and records key project metrics for input into UC historical database.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

Individual must be capable of presenting cost estimates to upper management positions and third-party clients, including the Executive Project Director, Senior Vice President of Attraction Development, and the President of Universal Creative.

EDUCATION:

Bachelors degree in Construction Management, Engineer in related business fields is required.  Masters degree in Construction Management or Business Administration preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

7+ years on-site construction and estimating experience on retail, food, hotel, theme parks and themed entertainment projects, knowledge of show and ride estimating, and facility impacts required. 10+ years on-site construction and estimating experience for owners and/or contractors for in the Resort/Entertainment field of commercial construction; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Automotive Technician / Mechanic, Construction & Skilled Trades
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for preventative and corrective maintenance, troubleshooting, and repair of animation, special effects, and ride/show mechanical systems.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Performs preventative and predictive maintenance as prescribed by OEM and UO Engineering Specifications. This would include changing time-limited parts, calibrating equipment per OEM specifications, and cleaning, lubricating, and maintaining equipment.
  • Completes inspections and creates necessary work orders for discrepancies found. Follows correct chain of command to notify appropriate management when necessary.
  • Performs repairs to equipment due to safety, reliability, or show quality issues found during PMs, inspections, or downtimes to improve ride reliability and show quality. Responds to and assists in recovery and repair of attractions and show effects as needed.
  • Troubleshoots down to failed component using schematics, leak detection equipment, vibration analysis, and other specialized tools and equipment.
  • Performs modifications per UO Engineering or OEM specifications.
  • Enters follow-up work orders for all discrepancies found. Documents all findings and work performed throughout the process of troubleshooting and performing repairs. Reports labor in Maximo for all work performed.
  • Completes PQS qualification of assigned venues. Trains new technicians to do venue-specific PM work orders, recovery procedures, and processes.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

SCOPE:

Responsible for inspection, troubleshooting and repair of animation, special effects, and ride and show mechanical systems resort wide.

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree or GED is Required
  • Technical school is preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 3-5 Years: Experience in troubleshooting and repair of complex electro-mechanical systems, as well as hydraulic and mechanical systems either in the theme park industry or other industrial industries
  • Or equivalent combination of education and experience

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

Valid Florida Drivers License - required to operate company vehicles

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Special requirements for certain specific venues may require the operation of controlled decent devices down severely angled lifts - Training is required and will be provided prior to performing the inspections
  • Special requirements for certain specific venues may require the operation of high reaches greater than 85ft - Training is required and will be provided prior to performing the inspections

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Manager, Lead Architect (Commerce Experience Preferred)
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Sr. Manager, Lead Architect Commerce is a technology leadership role responsible for providing architectural vision, technical leadership, and team leadership across Universal Destinations & Experiences global commerce platforms and global architecture teams. This individual leads a team of architects responsible for the design, modernization, and governance of solutions supporting digital commerce, payments, ticketing, reservations, loyalty, and related revenue-generating capabilities that enable exceptional guest and team member experiences.

This role is accountable for ensuring solution architectures align with enterprise standards, business objectives, and technology roadmaps while driving scalability, security, resiliency, and operational excellence. The position partners closely with business, product, engineering, operations, and technology leaders to deliver strategic initiatives, guide platform investments, and advance the evolution of Universals commerce ecosystem through modern architecture practices and industry-leading solutions.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Commerce Architecture Strategy - Lead the architecture strategy, roadmap development, and solution design for Universal Destinations & Experiences global commerce platforms. Provide architectural leadership across digital commerce (b2c and b2b). Ensure technology investments align with business objectives, enterprise architecture standards, and long-term platform modernization strategies. Serve as a trusted advisor to business and technology leaders on architecture decisions, technology direction, and emerging industry trends.
  • Architecture Delivery & Governance - Oversee the development and governance of solution architecture deliverables supporting commerce initiatives. Ensure architecture designs are scalable, secure, resilient, and aligned with enterprise standards, design patterns, and technology roadmaps. Provide technical oversight for complex integrations across commerce, finance, guest experience, and operational systems. Establish and maintain architecture metrics, standards, and review processes to drive consistency and quality across solutions.
  • Technical Leadership & Cross-Functional Collaboration - Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Data, Finance, and Operations teams to deliver integrated technology solutions. Facilitate alignment between architecture teams and key stakeholders to ensure solutions support both business and technical objectives. Lead architecture discussions, technology evaluations, and strategic planning efforts across multiple initiatives and value streams. Act as a subject matter expert for commerce and transaction-processing ecosystems.
  • Team Leadership & Talent Development - Lead, mentor, and develop a team of solution and application architects responsible for supporting commerce capabilities. Provide guidance on architecture best practices, decision-making, prioritization, and professional development. Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement while ensuring effective communication across teams. Drive team performance through coaching, succession planning, and measurable delivery outcomes.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Broad technical knowledge with demonstrated success designing and implementing complex enterprise solutions in large-scale organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop and communicate technology strategy and architecture direction.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise architecture, solution architecture, and software delivery methodologies.
  • Ability to influence technical and business stakeholders across multiple organizational levels.
  • Deep understanding of digital commerce, payments, order management, loyalty, ticketing, and reservations platforms.
  • Knowledge of commerce platforms such as SAP Commerce Cloud and related commerce ecosystems required.
  • Strong knowledge of enterprise integration patterns including REST APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging platforms, and distributed systems.
  • Experience designing highly available, scalable, secure, and resilient customer-facing transaction platforms.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-native architectures, SaaS platforms, microservices, and modern application design patterns.
  • Knowledge of relational and NoSQL database technologies and data integration principles.
  • Ability to develop architecture roadmaps, technology standards, and governance processes that align with business objectives.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to assess complex business and technical challenges.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and presentation skills, including the ability to communicate effectively with executive leadership and technical teams.
  • Ability to lead, mentor, and develop architects while fostering a collaborative and high-performing team culture.
  • Ability to build strong relationships and work effectively across Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, Cybersecurity, Finance, Operations, and business organizations.
  • Knowledge of payment processing, PCI compliance, and transaction management concepts preferred.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related technical discipline preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 9+ years of experience in technology delivery, software engineering, solution architecture, or platform architecture roles.
  • 9+ years of experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale commerce, customer experience, or transaction-processing solutions.
  • 5+ years of leadership experience managing architects, engineers, or other technical professionals.
  • Demonstrated experience developing architecture strategies, technology roadmaps, and solution designs for complex, highly integrated enterprise environments.
  • Experience designing and implementing solutions supporting digital commerce, payments, order management, ticketing, reservations, loyalty, customer identity, or related business capabilities.
  • Experience leading architecture efforts across cloud-native, SaaS, and hybrid technology environments.
  • Experience with enterprise integration patterns including APIs, event-driven architectures, messaging platforms, and distributed systems.
  • Experience presenting technical strategies, architecture recommendations, and investment decisions to executive leadership and business stakeholders.
  • Experience establishing architecture governance processes, standards, and best practices across multiple teams and initiatives.
  • Experience supporting large-scale, customer-facing platforms requiring high availability, scalability, security, and operational resilience.
  • Experience with SAP Commerce Cloud, or comparable enterprise commerce platforms required.
  • Experience in hospitality, travel, entertainment, retail, theme park, destination, or other high-volume guest-facing industries preferred.
  • Experience supporting omni-channel commerce ecosystems integrating digital commerce, payments, loyalty, and customer engagement platforms preferred.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.
