JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for developing, establishing, and integrating comprehensive project plans and schedules throughout the projects lifecycle. Responsible for initiating, integrating, monitoring and statusing internal and/or external project schedules into a comprehensive program or integrated project master schedule. This includes providing project controls advisements and progress analysis for senior management decision making as well as tracking current and future resources and production progress based on the Integrated Master Schedule. Scope of planning and scheduling responsibilities include development/establishment of project schedules, show/ride concept development, show, ride, facility, area development designs, building construction, show/ride production, installation, and commissioning stages.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Prepares project life cycle and project master schedules and statuses the project schedules utilizing Primavera software. Develops comprehensive plans and schedules from multiple discipline drawings and specifications. Prepares project plans and works with scoping/strategy documents to develop integrated project master schedules. Prepares schedule contract milestones for bid packages.
  • Provides project team with Schedule guidance during all phases of the project. Coordinates with estimating/finance teams to develop appropriate level of detail scope definition and durations for schedule activities to support project monitoring and project controls reporting needs. Coordinates with contractors, vendors, and responsible project team members to develop and integrate activity durations and logic sequences required to perform project work. Integrates project schedule input from all internal and external project organizations.
  • Leads planning and coordination meetings as required to support planning and monitoring functions. Collects/reports progress, evaluates progress variances, develops work-around plans, and coordinates resolution of variances. Conducts resource loading/resource analysis and develops and statuses earned value tracking tools and progress curves as required. Produces reports as required to support project team and leadership reporting. Frequently communicates, reports, and interacts with project and core team members including vendors and outside consultants on complex topics.
  • Contributes to highly effective project control tools and reports and provides insightful analysis that contributes to schedule certainty.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS: 

  • Proven prior project controls leadership, supervisory experience preferred
  • Solid working knowledge of theme parks, show/ride product lines and design and construction.
  • 5+ years of primavera scheduling experience required
  • Possess strong understanding of design and construction progress measurement.
  • Working knowledge of architectural/engineering and show and ride design and production.
  • Must be a well-organized self-starter with strong communication, and interpersonal skills.
  • Solid understanding of practical project controls applications and earned value measurement.
  • Ability to coordinate staff, consultants, and suppliers including setting goals, prioritization of tasks, coordinating work, and managing time.
  • Solid meeting leadership, facilitation, and alignment skills
  • Solid communication, collaboration, technical writing, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to successfully influence and guide a team.
  • Ability to negotiate schedule changes with vendors and contractors.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills
  • Knowledge of planning techniques

EDUCATION:

Bachelors degree in Engineering, Architecture, Construction Management or an applicable field required. Advanced degrees preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

7+ years engineering/construction planning and scheduling experience required. 5+ years theme park planning/coordination experience preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience. 

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Electrician, Construction & Skilled Trades, Construction Superintendent
Job.JobDescription:
Chinchor Electric, Inc. is family owned and operated and has been in business for 40 years. We are celebrating being one of the Nation's Top Workplaces after receiving the honor of being granted the Orlando Sentinel's Top Workplace award in both 2024 and 2025! We are a Commercial and Industrial Electrical contractor, performing Heavy Industrial Electrical, Highway Lighting, Traffic Signalization projects, and much more. We work with both corporate clients and government entities and maintain yearly contracts with Orange, Seminole, Osceola, and Volusia counties, as well as the Florida Department of Transportation. We are proud to share that we have opened a second location in St. Augustine, Florida to serve Jacksonville and the surrounding areas and are expanding to open a third location in Summerfield to serve Ocala and the surrounding areas. We have opportunities for advancement in both career and education.

Chinchor Electric, Inc. is seeking highly motivated and hardworking experienced Industrial Electrician Foremen. Join our team, apply today!

Educational Opportunities and Benefits:

  • Medical (100% Employer-Paid Plan Options)
  • Dental
  • Vision
  • Life Insurance
  • 401K + Match
  • Christmas Bonus
  • Paid Time Off
  • 20% Night Shift Differential
  • Employee Referral Program
  • Advancement Opportunities
  • Paid apprenticeship and training opportunities through the 4-year Florida Electrical Apprenticeship & Training (FEAT) and Northeast Florida Builders Association (NEFBA) apprenticeship programs.
  • Paid certifications including:
    • CDL-A
    • Crane Certification (rigging, signaling, operating)
    • IMSA
    • Maintenance of Traffic
    • Traffic Signal Technician Levels I, II, and III

Job Type: Full Time, Hourly, Non-Exempt

Pay: $28+ Hourly, Based on Experience

Travel & night work may be required. MUST be able to work out of town and nights, on occasion.

Industrial Electrician Foreman Responsibilities:

  • Oversee the daily operations of crews of electrical apprentices and industrial electricians.
  • Work closely with the project superintendent and project manager to ensure the efficient and successful completion of projects from start to finish.
  • Install, maintain, troubleshoot, and repair electrical systems associated with water and wastewater treatment facilities, including pumps, motors, MCCs, control panels, instrumentation, SCADA systems, underground conduit, and duct bank systems.
  • Install and terminate conduit, wiring, feeders, and electrical equipment for treatment processes, lift stations, and facility infrastructure.
  • Diagnose electrical and control system issues using testing equipment and hand tools to safely restore system operation.
  • Inspect electrical systems and equipment for hazards, defects, and code compliance.
  • Perform testing of electrical systems, controls, instrumentation, and power distribution equipment to ensure safe and reliable operation.
  • Coordinate with supervisors, operators, engineers, and other trades to support plant operations and project activities.
  • Follow all company safety procedures, lockout/tagout requirements, and site-specific safety standards.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Required Skills, Qualifications, and Experience:

  • Minimum of 4 years of supervising experience required.
  • Minimum of 3 years of industrial electrical experience required, with experience in water or wastewater treatment facilities strongly preferred.
  • Working knowledge of electrical systems including motors, pumps, MCCs, VFDs, control panels, instrumentation, and SCADA systems.
  • Experience installing and maintaining conduit systems, underground conduit, duct banks, feeders, and power distribution equipment.
  • Ability to read and interpret blueprints, one-line diagrams, control schematics, and electrical specifications.
  • Proficient in troubleshooting electrical and control systems using standard testing equipment and hand tools.
  • Knowledge of NEC requirements, electrical safety standards, and lockout/tagout procedures.
  • Ability to work safely in active industrial, water treatment, and wastewater treatment environments.
  • Capable of lifting materials, working outdoors in varying weather conditions, climbing ladders, and working in confined spaces when required.
  • Strong communication, teamwork, and problem-solving skills.
  • Valid driver's license and reliable transportation required.
  • Class A CDL *Preferred*.

Physical Demands

Must be able to perform multiple tasks and can handle the physical demands of the job, including but not limited to, digging using a shovel, standing, walking, kneeling, bending, crouching, pulling, pushing, climbing, and lifting at least 50lbs.

Job.JobTitle: Licensed Financial Services Team Lead, Banking Operations
Job.JobDescription:
Your opportunity


At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the finance industry together.

We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location.

Operational Services is responsible for moving assets into, out of, and between Schwab accounts. We play a critical role for the firm in our efforts to deliver service and an elite client experience for both retail investors and independent advisors, while providing a controlled and disciplined environment that allows our employees to feel valued and engaged.

The Banking Operations Hotline Team Lead is responsible for supporting team performance, operational execution, and employee engagement. This role helps ensure specialists have the information, resources, feedback, coaching, and recognition needed to deliver strong business results and an excellent client experience. The ideal candidate enjoys influencing outcomes, coaching peers, building partnerships, and developing leadership capabilities that may support future people leadership opportunities.

What you will do:

In this role, you will serve as a subject matter expert, trusted partner, and informal leader who helps the team achieve operational excellence while delivering an outstanding client experience in a controlled, risk-aware environment.

  • Coach, mentor, and support specialists through guidance, feedback, recognition, and knowledge sharing that reinforces quality, risk awareness, and client-focused behaviors.
  • Serve as a subject matter expert by responding to operational, technical, regulatory, and procedural inquiries, researching complex issues, and recommending effective solutions.
  • Evaluate risk and exercise sound judgment when reviewing client accounts, money movement requests, and escalated client situations to help protect clients and the firm.
  • Communicate complex information clearly and effectively to specialists, clients, and business partners while providing education on products, services, procedures, and best practices.
  • Partner across teams to support business initiatives, process improvements, operational excellence, and delivery of outstanding client experience.
  • Model Schwab's values by fostering teamwork, accountability, inclusion, and continuous improvement.

You demonstrate these behaviors:

  • Initiative: Identifies what needs to be done and takes action without waiting to be asked.
  • Analytical Thinking: Uses a logical, structured approach to evaluate information, solve problems, and make sound recommendations.
  • Fostering Teamwork: Builds strong relationships by sharing information, supporting peers, contributing to team meetings, and offering constructive feedback.
  • Influencing Others: Gains support for ideas, proposals, projects, and solutions through credibility, collaboration, and clear communication.

What you have


To ensure that we have fulfilled our promise of "challenging the status quo," this role has specific qualifications that successful candidates should have.

Required Qualifications

  • Active FINRA Series 7, 63, 9, and 10 licenses required.
  • 3+ years of experience in the brokerage or financial services industry, with an emphasis on customer service, operations, or client support.
  • Bachelor's degree in finance, economics, business administration, or equivalent work experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence, coach, mentor, or support the development of others.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex topics clearly.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Proficiency with Microsoft applications and the ability to navigate multiple internal systems efficiently.
  • Demonstrated leadership capabilities, including serving as a role model, mentoring peers, influencing outcomes, and supporting the development of others.
  • Passion for service excellence, coaching, and fostering a collaborative, team-oriented environment.
  • Strong organizational, prioritization, and follow-through skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-directed learner who adapts quickly to change, builds business knowledge, and embraces continuous improvement.
  • Intermediate to advanced technical proficiency, including the ability to effectively utilize multiple applications, databases, research tools, and communication platforms.
  • Knowledge of regulatory, audit, and compliance requirements applicable to the financial services industry.

In addition to the salary range, this role is also eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.


What's in it for you

At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

  • 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
  • Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
  • Paid parental leave and family building benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

Job.JobTitle: Accounting & Finance Data, Reporting, and Automation Engineer - State, Local, and Higher Education
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Position summary

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Work You'll Do

As a Senior Consultant for General Business Finance Data Analytics & Insights team, you will be responsible for the design, build, and maintain automations that streamline accounting and finance processes for state, local, and higher education clients. You will work closely with client finance teams and our consultants to turn manual, error-prone work into reliable, auditable, and scalable workflows. You will also build the data pipelines, reporting tools, and control checks that help clients close faster, reconcile with confidence, and stay ready for audit.

  • Design and build automations for recurring finance and accounting processes, such as bank reconciliations, accounts payable and receivable matching, journal entry preparation, accrual calculations, and month-end and year-end close checklists.
  • Develop process automation and workflow solutions using tools such as Power Automate, UiPath, or similar platforms, with appropriate exception handling and human review points.
  • Build and maintain data extraction, transformation, and loading (ETL) pipelines that pull data from ERP and other information systems, including Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft, into reporting environments.
  • Write SQL queries and scripts to validate data, identify anomalies, and support general ledger analysis, reconciliations, and chart of accounts clean-up.
  • Design and maintain dashboards and recurring financial reports for controllers, treasurers, budget offices, and boards, including fund-level, grant-level, and capital asset reporting.
  • Build automated control testing and monitoring routines aligned to the COSO framework, producing evidence that supports internal audit, external financial statement audits, state audits, and Single Audits under Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200).
  • Document automations thoroughly, including process maps, logic, data lineage, access controls, and runbooks, so that clients can maintain and audit them independently.
  • Establish version control, testing, and change management practices for automations, and ensure they comply with client IT security and data governance policies.
  • Train client staff on how to operate, monitor, and modify automations, and transition ownership to permanent teams at the end of an engagement.
  • Evaluate client processes to identify automation opportunities, estimate return on investment, and recommend a prioritized roadmap.
  • Support backfill and interim engagements where automations reduce workload for embedded consultants, and ensure those automations are documented for the returning staff member.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

The General Business Finance Data Analytics & Insights team helps finance organizations turn financial and operational data into reliable reporting and actionable insights.

The team combines data engineering, analytics, visualization, and finance process knowledge to support decisions across planning, performance management, and business operations.

Professionals collaborate with stakeholders to improve data quality, reporting efficiency, and access to information.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, information systems, computer science, data analytics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
  • 3+ years of experience in one or more of the following:
    • Building finance or accounting automations using RPA, AI, or other workflow tools;
    • Developing query-based reporting output, data validation, or ETL processes;
    • Scripting in various languages for financial data analysis; or
    • Implementing ERP, reporting, or data integration solutions for finance teams.
  • Working knowledge of accounting fundamentals, including general ledger structures, reconciliations, journal entries, and the chart of accounts. Familiarity with fund accounting and GASB or FASB standards is preferred.
  • Hands-on experience with automation and intelligence platforms or a business intelligence tools (Power BI, Tableau, or similar).
  • Understanding of internal controls, COSO principles, and audit requirements, with the ability to design automations that produce audit-ready evidence.
  • Familiarity with data governance, information security, and access controls in regulated environments.
  • Ability to obtain/maintain and security clearances needed for the client and/or project.
  • Ability to work independently across multiple client environments, manage competing priorities, and travel as needed.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

Preferred:

  • Strong SQL skills, including joins, aggregations, window functions, and query optimization, with experience working against relational databases.
  • Experience with ERP (such as SAP, Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft) or other systems (for example Workiva, Balckline, One Stream, Anaplan, etc), is preferred.
  • Experience supporting federal, state, local government, or higher education clients
  • Experience with data warehousing or lakehouse architecture
  • Experience with Extract, Transform, Load (ETL) orchestration tools
  • Experience working in Agile delivery environments
  • Experience using Git-based version control and continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Accounting Information systems, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, Mathematics, or Statistics
  • Strong documentation skills and the ability to explain technical solutions clearly to non-technical finance stakeholders.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Work you'll do

As part of our Accounting and Finance Technology practice within the Finance Transformation team, you will serve as a finance-process expert who also configures, supports, and analyzes the financial technology platforms state, local, and higher education clients rely on. You will translate accounting and budgeting requirements into system design, lead implementation and optimization workstreams, and help clients get more value from their ERP, financial reporting, budgeting, and related fintech investments. Example responsibilities include:

  • Lead functional workstreams for ERP and financial system implementations, upgrades, and optimizations, including SAP, Workday Financials, Oracle Cloud ERP, PeopleSoft, Banner, Ellucian, and similar platforms used by public and higher education institutions.
  • Gather and document business requirements for general ledger, accounts payable and receivable, procurement, grants and sponsored programs, capital assets, cash and treasury, and budgeting, translating them into system configuration specifications.
  • Configure and test system functionality, including chart of accounts structures (fund, function, object, and program), approval workflows, accounting rules, and security roles that align with segregation-of-duties requirements.

  • Advise on financial reporting solutions, including the design of management, grant, and fund-level reports, and the preparation of Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) and board reporting outputs.
  • Ensure systems support accounting standards and compliance requirements, including GASB and FASB guidance, GASB 87, 96, and 101 considerations, Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200), and state reporting requirements.
  • Analyze financial data from system outputs to validate configurations, identify process gaps, and recommend improvements, using SQL, Excel, or reporting tools as needed.
  • Support system testing, data conversion, cutover planning, and go-live readiness, including user acceptance testing and reconciliation of legacy and new system balances.
  • Design and deliver training and process documentation for client finance and IT staff, and help build internal capability so clients can sustain their systems after go-live.
  • Lead project workstreams and manage deliverables, timelines, and risks, coordinating with client stakeholders, technical teams, and other consultants.

Our Finance Transformation offering focuses on the transformation of corporate functions through the centralization and optimization of how these services are delivered – delivering resilient, agile, and cost-effective outcomes that drive the CFO agenda, including solutions and capabilities to drive ERP enabled transformation through functional design, implementation and governance of process, controls, and policies. Our Controllership and Treasury Transformation offering modernizes the finance function to support the evolving business objectives of the organization. We work with the CFO, CAO, controller, and treasurer to develop an efficient, high quality, data-driven, tech-enabled controllership and treasury function that empowers our clients to drive more value to their business partners and to their investors.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, information systems, or a related field
  • 3+ years of experience in governmental, higher education, or similar finance environments, with hands-on accounting or finance responsibilities such as general ledger, reconciliations, budgeting, grants accounting, or financial reporting.
  • Working knowledge of GASB and FASB standards, fund accounting, and the chart of accounts structures used by public and higher education institutions.
  • Experience leading or contributing to system implementations, upgrades, or process redesign projects, including requirements gathering, testing, and go-live support.
  • Ability to obtain/maintain any security clearance needed for the project and/or client.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Demonstrated experience configuring, supporting, or analyzing at least one major ERP, Experience with ERP (such as SAP, Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft) or other systems (for example Workiva, Balckline, One Stream, Anaplan, etc), is preferred.
  • Experience documenting business requirements, process flows, or test scripts
  • Experience in government or public sector environments
  • Experience with finance transformation, shared services, or global business services initiatives
  • Certified Public Accountant or Certified Management Accountant credential
  • Project Management Professional
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams, manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment, and meet deadlines.

  • Serve as a subject matter expert (SME) for Retail Access processes, including supplier-related transactions, enrollment and change activities, market requirements, exception management, and regulatory and operational support.

The Team

Our Deloitte Enterprise Performance team is at the forefront of enterprise technology, working across finance, supply chain, and IT operations to deliver holistic performance improvement and digital transformation. Join our team of strategic advisers and architects, differentiated by our industry depth to collaborate with leading solution providers and leverage your experience in strategy, process design, technology enablement, and operational services to enable heart-of-the-business solutions.

Enterprise Operations as a Service provides multi-year managed service contracts to support enterprise technology investments and key business processes. We ensure continuous modernization and transformative business changes through five key services: SAP Operations, Oracle Operations, IT Operations, Supply Chain Operations, and Finance Operations. Our mission is to help businesses thrive by maintaining their essential operations and enabling growth.

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of SAP IS-U experience
  • Experience in Retail Access processes, including supplier-related transactions, enrollment and change activities, market requirements, exception management, and regulatory and operational support.

Preferred

Job.JobTitle: Accounting, Finance, and Controls Senior Consultant: State, Local, and Higher Education
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Position summary

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Work you'll do

As part of our Controllership and Treasury Transformation team, you will support state, local, and higher education clients with accounting operations, financial controls, audit readiness, asset accountability, and financial data analysis. Example responsibilities include:

  • Support accounting operations for state agencies, counties, municipalities, and public or private universities, applying Governmental Accounting Standards Board (GASB) standards for public entities and Financial Accounting Standards Board (FASB) standards for private institutions, along with fund accounting principles.
  • Perform general ledger analysis, account reconciliations, journal entry review and preparation, and chart of accounts design or cleanup, including fund, function, and object code structures.
  • Support month-end, quarter-end, and fiscal year-end close activities, including accruals, adjustments, and preparation of supporting schedules.
  • Assist with internal controls design and testing aligned to the COSO framework, and help clients prepare for external financial statement audits, state audits, and Single Audits under Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200) for federal grant funds.
  • Support Annual Comprehensive Financial Report (ACFR) preparation, including schedules, note disclosures, and coordination with auditors.
  • Support capital asset accounting for land, buildings, infrastructure, equipment, and construction in progress, including depreciation, asset tagging and verification, and capitalization thresholds.
  • Support accounting for inventory, operating materials and supplies, and internal-use software, including implementation of GASB 51 for intangible assets and, where applicable, GASB 87 leases and GASB 96 subscription-based IT arrangements.
  • Perform data validation, control testing, and reporting, using SQL and Excel to extract and analyze data from ERP systems such as Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft, Banner, or Ellucian.
  • Support grant and sponsored program accounting, including cost allocation, drawdown reconciliation, and tracking of compliance requirements.
  • Support treasury and cash management activities, including bank reconciliations, investment reporting, and cash flow analysis, as part of the broader transformation scope.
  • Document current-state processes, identify gaps and inefficiencies, and help design and implement improved workflows, policies, and procedures.
  • Deliver knowledge transfer and training to client staff so that process improvements are sustained after the engagement.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Controllership and Treasury Transformation offering modernizes the finance function to support the evolving business objectives of the organization. We work with the CFO, CAO, controller, and treasurer to develop an efficient, high quality, data-driven, tech-enabled controllership and treasury function that empowers our clients to drive more value to their business partners and to their investors.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 3+ years of experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Governmental or higher education accounting (GASB or FASB-based) and fund accounting;
    • General ledger analysis, account reconciliations, journal entries, and chart of accounts design;
    • Internal controls, COSO-based control testing, and audit readiness for financial statement, state, or Single Audits;
    • Capital asset accounting, including land, buildings, infrastructure, equipment, construction in progress, and depreciation;
    • Grant or sponsored program accounting, including cost allocation and compliance under Uniform Guidance (2 CFR 200);
    • Accounting for inventory, operating materials and supplies, internal-use software, leases (GASB 87), or subscription-based IT arrangements (GASB 96);
    • SQL, Excel-based reporting, data validation, or control testing using ERP data; or
    • Treasury, cash management, or bank reconciliation activities.
  • Working knowledge of GASB standards, and familiarity with FASB standards for private universities, is preferred.
  • Ability to obtain/maintain any security clearances needed for the project and/or client.
  • Experience preparing or supporting month-end, year-end, or CAFR close activities.
  • Ability to work across multiple client environments, manage competing priorities, and travel as needed.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • 3+ years of experience supporting government or higher education clients
  • Experience working in a consulting or project-based delivery environment
  • Experience with ERP (such as SAP, Workday, Oracle, PeopleSoft) or other systems (for example Workiva, Blackline, One Stream, Anaplan, etc), is preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes and train client staff.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $95,600 to $188,400.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Job.JobTitle: Sr. Financial Analyst, Operations Analysis - Cheddar's Scratch Kitchen
Job.JobDescription:
JOB OVERVIEW:

The Sr. Financial Analyst, Operations Analysis is responsible for forecasting, analyzing, and financial modeling in support of the brand business objectives. In this role, the analyst is also responsible for developing proactive solutions and communicating potential impact on the overall business. Additionally, the analyst will work closely with Brand Operations and Brand Leadership to ensure business needs are met.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITES:

  • Partner with Operations Leadership, Finance Leadership, and Restaurant Management teams to develop best practices that will deliver restaurant sales and earnings growth in support of brand financial commitments.
  • Provide financial oversight of divisional performance and ensure Business Plan targets are being achieved.
  • Assist Divisional Vice Presidents and Directors in the development, implementation and monitoring of plans that improve restaurant earnings. This includes ensuring that waste management tools (A vs. T and Par/Pull) and labor productivity tools (LMS) are being used to their full potential.
  • Analyze, identify, and communicate emerging trends and their impact, so action is prioritized appropriately.
  • Identify and support restaurants that are not meeting their earnings potential through outlier identification and analysis.
  • Visit restaurants / markets, to gain insight related to specific initiatives that may be in test and/or proactively identifying opportunities and develop plans for improvement of controllable expenses for existing restaurants.
  • Leverage data analysis to determine the financial impact of proposed business initiatives.
  • Prepare and coordinate various weekly, monthly and/or year-end analyses, and financial reports for management review.
  • Provide ad hoc reports, analysis and participate in special projects as needed.

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS:

  • Minimum of 2+ years experience in an analytical role
  • Proven strong financial and analytical skills
  • Proven spreadsheet and data retrieval skills
  • Demonstrates the capability to build financial models and apply forecasting techniques with an emphasis on statistical analysis of economic and financial data
  • Strong project management skills

REQUIRED EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's Degree (Accounting, Finance or related field)

OTHER KEY QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong verbal and written communications skills
  • Proven facilitation skills
  • Proven experience with analyzing, prioritizing, and solving problems effectively
  • Solid teamwork and interpersonal skills
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate and function effectively within a complex corporate environment.
  • Ability to adapt to changing business environments, solve problems and take advantage of improvement opportunities
  • Sound judgment and decision making abilities.
  • Professional curiosity and initiative to identify and present growth opportunities
  • Ability to carry out multiple complex projects with minimal supervision

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPIRENCE:

  • MBA
  • Restaurant Operations Experience a plus

POSITION SUMMARY

Prepare ingredients for cooking, including portioning, chopping, and storing food. Wash and peel fresh fruits and vegetables. Weigh, measure, and mix ingredients. Prepare and cook food according to recipes, quality standards, presentation standards, and food preparation checklist. Prepare cold foods. Operate ovens, stoves, grills, microwaves, and fryers. Test foods to determine if they have been cooked sufficiently. Monitor food quality while preparing food. Set-up and break down work station. Serve food in proper portions onto proper receptacles. Wash and disinfect kitchen area, tables, tools, knives, and equipment. Check and ensure the correctness of the temperature of appliances and food.

Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager; complete safety training and certifications. Ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Speak with others using clear and professional language. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others; support team to reach common goals; listen and respond appropriately to the concerns of other employees. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time or for an entire work shift. Reach overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATION

Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

Related Work Experience: At least 1 year of related work experience.

Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience.

License or Certification: None

POSITION SUMMARY

Our jobs aren't just about giving guests a clean room and a freshly made bed. Instead, we want to build an experience that is memorable and unique. Our Guest Environment Experts are skilled in a wide range of housekeeping functions with responsibility for maintaining the appearance and cleanliness of the whole hotel. They are empowered to move about their space and do what needs to be done. Whether delivering guest requests, stocking carts, cleaning rooms and public spaces, or other similar responsibilities, the Guest Environment Expert makes sure the spaces in the hotel help create a great guest experience.

No matter what position you are in, there are a few things that are critical to success – ensuring a safe work place, following company policies and procedures, maintaining confidentiality, upholding quality standards, and ensuring your uniform, personal appearance, and communications are professional. Guest Environment Experts will be on their feet and moving around (stand, sit, or walk for an extended time) and taking a hands-on approach to work (move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance). Doing all these things well (and other reasonable job duties as requested) is critical for Guest Environment Experts – to get it right for our guests and our business each and every time.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Vice President, Development & Delivery is responsible for delivering projects within one assigned Universal Creative global project portfolio, ensuring alignment with the Companys creative vision and strategic goals to be on time, on budget, and on brand. This position oversees all aspects necessary for the development of attractions, entertainment facilities, hotels, restaurant/retail, themed experiences, and venues; including planning, budgeting, scheduling, estimating, design, construction, fabrication, delivery, and commissioning required to successfully deliver projects. This role involves close collaboration with divisional partners, and cross-divisional and Company key stakeholders; interfaces with Intellectual Property partners; and manages vendor engagements and relationships. The VP, Development & Delivery will also work with the SVP, Development & Delivery to drive innovation in delivery methods.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Oversee project timelines, budgets, and resources to ensure projects are completed on time, within budget, and consistent with the creative, aesthetic, and guest experience intent.
  • Mentor and develop portfolio and project leaders and team members, fostering a culture of innovation, empowerment, authenticity, and collaboration.
  • Develop and implement strategies for the successful execution of projects within assigned portfolio, ensuring alignment with the Companys overall goals and vision.
  • Oversee the management, tracking, and reporting of all necessary project components inclusive of budget and schedule. Ensure the maintenance of accurate documentation necessary for a successful project completion. Transparently report project status and progress to Universal Creative and Universal Destinations & Experiences leadership.
  • Oversee the prequalification, procurement, selection, contracting and performance of all Consultants, Contractors, Vendors, Manufacturers, and Fabricators. Ensure all project procedures are followed as it relates to correspondence, RFIs, directives, shop drawings, submittals, meeting minutes, punch lists, deficiency lists, notices, and pay applications.
  • Manage relationships within Universal Creative, across Universal Destinations & Experiences, and with external partners during design, development, and delivery, ensuring contributions align with project goals and standards.\
  • Identify and mitigate risks associated with projects within the portfolio, ensuring that potential issues are addressed proactively.
  • Ensure compliance with all relevant laws, regulations, contracts, and policies, and uphold the highest standards of quality, safety, and ethics.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic and creative environment
  • Ability to effectively present information to senior executive leadership, public groups, and/or boards of directors
  • Ability to make critical decisions in complex, high-pressure situations to drive project success
  • Ability to read, analyze, and interpret construction drawings/specifications, technical drawings/specifications, financial reports, schedules, and legal documents
  • Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to earn trust and credibility. Proven ability to work effectively with all levels of the organization and with a wide range of stakeholders, both individually and in groups.
  • Knowledge of identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks to ensure project success
  • Passionate and knowledgeable about the themed entertainment industry and committed to delivering exceptional guest experiences
  • Proficiency in project and process management methodologies, software, skills and tools with a demonstrated track record of delivering results. Ability to handle multiple priorities, lead change and drive results.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

  • Global travel required.
  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.

EDUCATION:  

  • Bachelors degree in Architecture, Engineering, or Construction required. Master of Architecture, Engineering, or Construction strongly preferred; or equivalent, related experience. 
  • License in Architecture or Engineering preferred
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) Certification preferred

EXPERIENCE: 

  • 12+ years of experience successfully managing and delivering complex, large-scale, and high-profile projects, preferably in the areas of resort development, attractions, themed experiences, and destinations required. Global experience preferred.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Hospitality / Tourism / Events, Sales / Business Development
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Global Product team is focused on driving product strategies to evolve and enhance the Guest experience across Universal Destinations & Experiences. As a Manager, Digital Product Owner, the primary function of this role will be to manage new capabilities across the entire product lifecycle, from product strategy, planning, definition, delivery, and implementation. The specific focus for this role will be digital product management for the onsite Guest and Team Member experience, Mobile or Web Applications.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Product Definition

  • Partner with the UXUI team to establish experience interactions and designs based on high level feature requirements.
  • Drive detailed product Feature definition, including functional and non-functional requirements.
  • Support product implementation across the domestic sites, capturing site specific functional requirements in partnership with on-site stakeholders.

Product Delivery

  • Facilitate product backlog grooming with the Delivery scrum team.
  • Define and document product user stories to enable technical design, development, and testing.
  • Participate in scrum team Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily-stand ups, and retrospectives.

Product Implementation and Support

  • Perform product validation throughout the development cycle, to ensure alignment with functional requirements.
  • Maintain close partnership with Business Transformation to ensure that product functionality aligns with Operational and Business capabilities.
  • Represent and support the product as the ongoing subject matter expert.
  • Develop an ongoing approach for measuring the success of newly implemented experience enhancements, to enable well-informed future product planning.

Product Planning

  • Establish the product roadmap and coordinate with key partners to manage product delivery and implementation timelines.
  • Partner with other Digital Product Managers to ensure product dependencies and integration points are considered during roadmap and release planning.
  • Establish product backlog priorities for release and sprint planning, considering new capabilities, minor enhancements, and defect fixes.

Product Strategy

  • Proactively evaluate Guest experience strengths and pain points from all perspectives, to identify opportunities for new and/or improved experience delivery capabilities.
  • Develop and frame up product recommendations with associated cost, value and experience analysis, to gain approval and funding for development.
  • Collaborate and liaise with key business partners to establish product goals and objectives.
  • Ensure product alignment with the holistic experience transformation vision.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with an ability to understand broad concepts, identify connection points and gaps, and establish product strategies that align with the broader vision and support Guest and business strategies.
  • Demonstrated analytical and technical skill set, with an ability to synthesize and analyze product-related data across an array of sources (e.g., Marketing, Consumer Insights, Industrial Engineering, etc.), to evaluate product effectiveness.
  • Extremely strong communication and presentation skills, with an ability to influence senior leadership by developing and clearly framing up options, analysis, and recommendations.

The Manager Digital Experience Technology (aka Consumer Marketing / Software Developer / MarTech Engineer / Marketing Technologist / Cloud Engineer) plays a critical leadership role in delivering scalable, secure, and data-driven customer identity and marketing technology solutions. This role combines technical expertise in identity resolution, customer data platforms (CDP), cleanrooms, and Adobe Experience Cloud with strong delivery management capabilities to ensure timely and high-quality solution execution.

The Manager is responsible for leading cross-functional engineering teams to deliver integrations, architectures, and operational solutions that power customer identity, personalization, and multi-channel marketing activations. This position ensures alignment between strategy and execution by partnering with product, business stakeholders, architects, and the project management office, while providing real-time communication and progress updates to leadership.

  • Partner with architects to design scalable solutions leveraging AWS, Snowflake, Adobe Experience Platform, Salesforce Marketing Cloud, and cleanroom technologies
  • Provide hands-on technical guidance where needed, leveraging architecture and engineering background in AWS, Snowflake, identity solutions, and Adobe Experience Cloud
  • Manage engineering teams to ensure high-quality, on-time delivery of integrations, pipelines, identity graph development, and marketing activations
  • Drive operational excellence for identity and MarTech platforms, ensuring uptime, monitoring, incident management, and real-time updates to leadership
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.

  • Demonstrated success leading cross-functional teams in Agile/Scrum environments.
  • Proven track record of delivering large-scale integrations, pipelines, and marketing technology solutions on time and within scope;

JOB SUMMARY:

Provide analytical decisionsupport for Universal Destinations & Experiences leadership, influencing datadriven operational and workforce decisions. This role applies industrial engineering, operations research, and advanced analytics to drive measurable improvements in efficiency, service delivery, and financial performance, while supporting a seamless, highquality guest experience. Leverage quantitative methods in operational planning, capacity and demand analysis, and productivity improvement to design, implement, and sustain scalable decisionsupport solutions in a highvolume, guestfacing environment characterized by demand variability and operational constraints.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, operationalize, and sustain endtoend analytical and decisionsupport solutions using industrial engineering and business analytics principles. Apply structured analytical techniquesincluding probability and statistics, process flow analysis, queuing theory, mathematical optimization, scenario modeling, and prescriptive optimization solversto diagnose problems, evaluate tradeoffs, and recommend actionable solutions. Develop and maintain decisionsupport models for labor planning, workforce utilization, budgeting, scheduling, and hiring strategies, balancing cost efficiency with service levels, guest experience outcomes, and operational realities.
  • Operate with a strong internal consulting mindset by partnering closely with operational leaders to define problems, frame decisions, and drive adoption of datadriven solutions. Continuously elevate analytical solutions by applying advanced analytics techniques, modern programming practices, and modern analytics and productivity tools to improve speed, quality, scalability, and longterm impact.
  • Acquire and prepare data using database querying tools and modern data pipelines. Engineer, standardize, and maintain analysisready datasets by consolidating, cleaning, and translating data from multiple enterprise systems into governed sources of truth. Apply advanced trend analysis and statistical techniquesincluding forecasting, classification, and anomaly detectionto understand performance drivers and validate insights.
  • Identify and implement opportunities to automate and scale analytics by productionizing metrics, models, and decision logic using modern analytics and productivity tools within cloudbased platforms, supporting both realtime and scenariobased decisionmaking across fluctuating demand conditions.
  • Develop clear, compelling business cases and presentations for audiences ranging from frontline operators to senior and executive leadership. Create dashboards and visualizations as part of standardized performance and decisionsupport systems that help stakeholders evaluate scenarios, understand tradeoffs, and act with confidence. Translate complex analytical findings into concise narratives that drive alignment and action.
  • Participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policies, procedures, and training. Perform other duties as assigned.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and programming tools (Python, R), with the ability to independently develop complex queries, analytical workflows, and reusable code.
  • Experience building reusable, production ready analytics and decision support solutions, including standardized metrics, governed datasets, automated analytical workflows, and sustained operating models.
  • Demonstrated experience applying optimization or operations research techniques in resource constrained, variable demand service environments.
  • Experience influencing operational decisions in complex, real time or near real time environments, balancing efficiency, resource constraints, and guest or customer experience outcomes.
  • Experience working with business intelligence and visualization platforms (Power BI, Tableau) and cloud based data platforms (Snowflake, Azure).
  • Experience using modern analytics and productivity tools (e.g., Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT) to improve analytical efficiency, code quality, and documentation.
  • Strong analytical judgment, conceptual thinking, and problem solving abilities, with the ability to translate analysis into actionable recommendations.
  • Excellent interpersonal and consulting skills, including the ability to partner effectively with operations, finance, and technology stakeholders.
  • Experience conducting field studies and operational data collection to inform labor standards, productivity measurement, and capacity analysis.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.
  • Commitment to knowledge sharing, best practices, and continuous improvement of analytical standards within the Business Analytics & Industrial Engineering team.
  • Willingness to support a 24/7/365 operation, including periods of high demand such as weekends and holidays.

EDUCATION:

Required:

  • Bachelors degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Management Science, Decision Science, or a closely related field.

Preferred:

  • Masters degree in Industrial Engineering, Operations Research, Management Science, Decision Science, or a closely related field of study.

EXPERIENCE:

Required:

  • 3+ years of applied industrial engineering and operational analysis, or equivalent experience.

Preferred:

  • 2+ years of experience performing operational analyses for theme parks, resorts, retail/dining/entertainment venues, etc.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Manager, AI/ML Engineering will lead a multidisciplinary team of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, data engineers, and developers to design and deploy enterprise-scale optimization and decision-intelligence solutions that drive measurable business outcomes. This role combines strategic vision with hands-on technical leadership, serving as an enterprise subject matter expert for machine learning, optimization and mathematical programming while guiding teams to deliver production-ready systems that enhance business performance and guest experiences. Key responsibilities include managing a portfolio of applied AI/ML initiatives across personalization, marketing, dynamic pricing, revenue management, workforce planning, digital experiences, and other complex decision domains; translating strategy into execution; embedding responsible AI and decision-system practices; and fostering a culture of innovation. The ideal candidate will be a collaborative leader, committed to developing talent, championing technical rigor, and enabling AI,ML and optimization at scale across the organization.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Strategic Leadership & Enterprise Enablement

  • Provide strategic and technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams of data scientists, AI/ML engineers, data engineers, and developers, setting direction and aligning work to enterprise priorities while promoting collaboration, continuous learning, and high-impact delivery.
  • Establish and communicate a clear enterprise vision, technical roadmap, and operating model for optimization and decision intelligence, balancing immediate business needs with long-term capability development.
  • Direct technical teams by defining objectives, decision rights, technical standards, architectural guardrails, and measurable outcomes.
  • Guide and mentor technical teams through problem formulation, architecture, model design, solution trade-offs, and production readiness in support of machine learning, optimization and mathematical programming.
  • Coordinate initiative sequencing, resource needs, dependencies, and delivery risks across product, engineering, data, and business teams, removing roadblocks and ensuring execution remains aligned with scope, schedule, and business outcomes.

Applied AI/ML & Optimization Development

  • Provide technical direction and oversight for AI/ML and optimization development, architecture, code quality, reusable libraries, reference architectures, and product-lifecycle best practices to ensure scalable, maintainable, secure, and production-ready solutions.
  • Engage with internal and external partners to gather requirements and collaborate with engineers, architects, product leaders, and business stakeholders to design robust solutions across domains.
  • Lead end-to-end problem formulation, model design, algorithm selection, prototyping, benchmarking, and validation across optimization, machine learning, and decision science. Apply advanced analytical and AI/ML techniques to integrate predictive and prescriptive modeling, experimentation, simulation, real-time signals, and business constraints into scalable decision systems that improve business outcomes and adapt over time.
  • Establish delivery and operational governance, remove cross-team roadblocks, and track quality, reliability, adoption, and business-impact KPIs. Define standards for model and solver monitoring, performance degradation and drift detection, incident response, and continuous improvement.

AI/ML Technical Strategy

  • Define and drive the strategy and prioritized portfolio for optimization products and decision systems, balancing near-term business outcomes with long-term platform evolution and determining where capabilities should be built, bought, reused, or standardized across personalization, marketing, dynamic pricing, revenue management, workforce planning, digital experiences, and resource allocation.
  • Evaluate open-source and commercial solvers, frameworks, and platforms across performance, cost, scalability, licensing, and security; direct cross-functional alignment on technology choices, investments, standards, and responsible-AI requirements, and communicate recommendations, trade-offs, and program status to senior leadership.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Hands-on experience designing and developing production decision systems, including data and feature pipelines, APIs and services, cloud platforms such as AWS, GCP, or Azure, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, containerization, observability, model monitoring, drift detection, and retraining or recalibration processes.
  • Deep expertise in statistical inference, supervised and unsupervised learning, regression, classification, clustering and segmentation, time-series forecasting, probabilistic modeling, predictive analytics, and model ensembling.
  • Demonstrated expertise formulating and solving large-scale decision problems using linear, mixed-integer, nonlinear, stochastic, robust, and/or multi-objective optimization; experience with constraint programming, decomposition, simulation, heuristics, and learning-based decision methods.
  • Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL, with experience using optimization modeling frameworks and one or more solver ecosystems such as Gurobi or CPLEX.
  • Experience integrating optimization with machine learning, forecasting, predictive models, personalization and recommendation systems, experimentation, simulation, or adaptive decision methods.
  • Proven ability to establish technical vision, influence and direct multidisciplinary teams without formal authority, drive cross-functional alignment, and resolve complex technical and business decisions.
  • Track record of connecting technical solutions to tangible business value and managing a portfolio of initiatives across multiple business domains.
  • Storyteller comfortable presenting to executives and mentoring both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Hands-on experience applying privacy, security, fairness, explainability, governance, and compliance principles in production AI/ML and optimization systems.
  • Advanced knowledge of product and delivery methodologies, with demonstrated success translating strategy into coordinated execution in fast-paced, ambiguous, and matrixed environments.

EDUCATION:

  • Masters degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science or in a relevant applied quantitative field is required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 9+ years experience in appliedAI, data science or softwareengineering roles;
  • or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Digital and Experience Development team is focused on driving product strategies to evolve and enhance the Guest experience across Universal Parks & Resorts. As a Product Manager, the primary function of this role will be to manage new capabilities across the entire product lifecycle, from product strategy, planning, definition, delivery, and implementation.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Leadership

  • Encourage an innovative culture that fosters "outside the box" thinking
  • Drive the vision of the team in support of business needs
  • Understand and track key trends and innovations, continuously looking for opportunitites to advance the product portfolio
  • Act as product expert both internally and externally, providing learning opportunities to other Team Members and attending external industry events
  • Provide leadership, management, and coaching
  • Establish standards and best practices to maximize team performance and company advancement
  • Develop growth plans and foster individual and professional growth
  • Keep key stakeholders updated on product roadmap developments and advancements
  • Manage issues, risks, and escalations as needed to support the product team
  • Work closely with IT and other internal organizations to ensure alignment
  • Contribute to the success of the larger team by driving joint collaboration, visioning, and planning
  • Provide other Team Members with support in continued growth opportunities through shared product experiences
  • Participate and drive formal mentorship opportunities to help other Team Members improve their product skills

Product Planning

  • Establish the product roadmap and coordinate with key partners to manage product delivery and implementation timelines
  • Partner with other Digital Product Managers to ensure product dependencies and integration points are considered during roadmap and release planning
  • Establish product backlog priorities for release and sprint planning, considering new capabilities, minor enhancements, and defect fixes

Product Strategy

  • Proactively evaluate Guest experience strengths and pain points from all perspectives, to identify opportunities for new and/or improved experience delivery capabilities
  • Develop and frame up product recommendations with associated cost, value and experience analysis, to gain approval and funding for development
  • Collaborate and liaise with key business partners to establish product goals and objectives
  • Ensure product alignment with the holistic experience transformation vision
    Product Definition
  • Partner with the UXUI team to establish experience interactions and designs based on high level feature requirements
  • Drive detailed product Feature definition, including functional and non-functional requirements
  • Support product implementation across the domestic sites, capturing site specific functional requirements in partnership with on-site stakeholders

Product Delivery

  • Facilitate product backlog grooming with the Delivery scrum team
  • Define and document product user stories to enable technical design, development, and testing
  • Participate in scrum team Agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, daily-stand ups, and retrospectives

Product Implementation and Support

  • Perform product validation throughout the development cycle, to ensure alignment with functional requirements.
  • Maintain close partnership with Business Transformation to ensure that product functionality aligns with Operational and Business capabilities.
  • Represent and support the product as the ongoing subject matter expert.
  • Develop an ongoing approach for measuring the success of newly implemented experience enhancements, to enable well-informed future product planning
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Strong critical thinking and problem-solving skills, with an ability to understand broad concepts, identify connection points and gaps, and establish product strategies that align with the broader vision and support Guest and business strategies
  • Demonstrated analytical and technical skill set, with an ability to synthesize and analyze product-related data across an array of sources (e.g. Marketing, Consumer Insights, Industrial Engineering, etc.), to evaluate product effectiveness
  • Extremely strong communication and presentation skills, with an ability to influence senior leadership by developing and clearly framing up options, analysis and recommendations
  • Strong organizational skills with an appropriate balance of attention to detail and agility to deliver in a fast-paced environment
  • Demonstrated ability to lead collaborative, cross-functional project teams with a wide range of stakeholders and key partners
  • Experience supporting an operating environment, with a focus on ensuring that strategies are sound and viable from Business perspective.
  • Demonstrated experience leading a team, encouraging innovation, and creating a shared vision that empowers Team Members.
    Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree (or equivalent experience) required - Business, Technology, Digital Marketing, or Industrial Engineering preferred;
  • Masters degree preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 9+ years in Product Management, Digital Marketing, E-Commerce, Digital Experience Design, Industrial Engineering, Technology, or related fields.
  • People Management
    • Including goal setting, escalation handling, and mentorship
  • Managing the digital experience for a consumer website and/or mobile app
  • Experience with large scale transformation initiatives
  • Demonstrated ability to define and execute strategic initiatives
  • Working in an agile technology delivery program
  • Defining a customer journey and digital product roadmap
  • Product backlog management, including Feature definition, requirements, prioritization and sprint planning
  • Close partnership with a Technology Delivery team
  • Stakeholder engagement and relationship building
  • Executive communication, with the ability to influence decision making
  • Excellent analytical, written and oral communication skills, and be able to explain complex concepts both concisely and simply;
  • or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.
