Position Summary

Are you passionate about technology and interested in joining a community of collaborative colleagues who respectfully and courageously seek to challenge the status quo? If so, read on to learn more about an exciting opportunity with Deloitte Technology US (DT - US). We are curious and life-long learners focused on technology and innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/7/2026.

Work you'll do

We are currently looking to add a self-motivated professional to our passionate, innovative, and results-driven Digital Forensics & Investigations Team. The Team is deeply committed to the protection of the Deloitte brand, our practitioners, and our clients.

  • Day to day: Monitoring, documenting and conducting investigations; Coordinating with OGC, Talent, Confidentiality and Risk Team's stakeholders.
  • Support the Digital Forensic & Investigations Team in high tech investigations in the form of electronic evidence, computer forensic analysis, e-mail analysis, data recovery and network assessments in support of our Legal, Talent, Confidentiality and Insider Threat organizations.
  • Perform computer forensic / investigative services including digital evidence collection, preservation, analysis, data recovery, electronic mail extraction, and database examination
  • Perform technical analyses and interpretations of computer-related evidence such as e-mail and information stored on electronic devices
  • Document and generate examination reports to communicate findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders; and provide actionable recommendations when necessary
  • Contribute to the overall process improvement of investigation policies and processes
  • Collaborate with leadership and stakeholders, including, but not limited to, internal clients such as legal, talent, insider threat, incident response, and cyber security leadership
  • Keep up to date of emerging digital forensic and investigation trends, technologies, and techniques
  • Evaluate, test, recommend, and integrate new Electronic Discovery and/or Computer Forensic tools and technologies
  • Develop unique and creative solutions to problems on the fly to successfully perform mission critical tasks

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Technology US (DT - US) helps power Deloitte's success, which serves many of the world's largest, most respected organizations. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The ~3,000 professionals in DT - US deliver services including:

  • Cyber Security
  • Technology Support
  • Technology & Infrastructure
  • Applications
  • Relationship Management
  • Strategy & Communications
  • Project Management
  • Financials

Cyber Security

Cyber Security vigilantly protects Deloitte and client data. The team leads a strategic cyber risk program that adapts to a rapidly changing threat landscape, changes in business strategies, risks, and vulnerabilities. Using situational awareness, threat intelligence, and building a security culture across the organization, the team helps to protect the Deloitte brand.

Areas of focus include:

  • Risk & Compliance
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Data Protection
  • Cyber Design
  • Incident Response
  • Security Architecture
  • Business Partnership

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science
  • Minimum of 8 years of various technology experience
  • Minimum of 4 years of experience in any combination of roles as a Security Analyst, Incident Responder, Forensic Examiner, and / or Enterprise Mail Administrator
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Skills needed: Hands-on forensic tools analysis experience and understanding of evidence handling protocols; Investigative experience; File system knowledge; Strong technical skills; Strong analytical, fact-finding, and problem-solving skills; PowerShell scripting; Microsoft Purview experience.
  • Verifiable skills performing computer investigations
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, analytical, problem-solving skills, and overall attention to details
  • Understanding of forensic protocols & artifacts, operating systems, and platforms

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $97,600 to $200,600.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.

Our purpose

Deloitte's purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Job.JobTitle: Associate Director Cyber Engineering - Data Protection
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Are you passionate about technology and interested in joining a community of collaborative colleagues who respectfully and courageously seek to challenge the status quo? If so, read on to learn more about an exciting opportunity with Deloitte Technology US (DT - US). We are curious and life-long learners focused on technology and innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/7/2026.

Work you'll do

US Cyber Data Protection team is responsible for securing and protecting confidential data of Deloitte US Member Firm, our Clients and our Employees. Team's core mission is to implement consistent cyber security controls to protect Firm's data and data entrusted to us by our Clients, to build their trust and protect our brand. We are seeking an experienced, strategic Cyber Engineering Associate Director to join the US Cyber Data Protection team in the Deloitte Technology US Organization within Deloitte Services LP.

The US Cyber Engineering Associate Director, Data Protection is a senior leader of the US Cyber Data Protection team and serves as the team's final technical escalation point and strategic owner for a portfolio of large, complex cyber security technology services. The role leads cross-functional initiatives spanning the entire US Member Firm, requiring in-depth technical knowledge, sound judgment and decision-making. The Associate Director is accountable for the delivery, adoption and ongoing support of these services for 181K+ US/USI Member Firm professionals, for shaping the long-term Zero Trust and data protection strategy with Cyber Leaders, and for building and developing a high-performing team.

This role will directly lead nine (9) Deloitte US and USI professionals, provide oversight of the wider US Cyber Data Protection team, and serve as Service Owner for the following US Member Firm Cyber Data Protection services: (1) Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) Proxy (2) Web Application Firewall (WAF) (3) FSI Enhanced Controls Adoption (4) Data Classification & Rights Management (DCRM) (5) Key and Certificate Management. The role will also assist in leading the team's emerging services and new Zero Trust initiatives as the portfolio grows. Role will require demonstrated ability and comfort with executive level reporting, issue escalation, and effectively communicating solutions to Business Leaders, CIO Leadership Team, Confidentiality and Privacy Stakeholders, BISOs, FSI Practice Leaders and PPMDs, and Executives in the Deloitte US Member Firm.

The position reports to US Cyber Engineering Director, Data Protection

As the Associate Director, Cyber Engineering on the US Cyber Data Protection team, you will be responsible for leading in the following areas:

Strategy, Vision and Zero Trust Leadership:

  • Work with Cyber Leaders to establish long-term Cyber Data Protection strategy and Zero Trust vision, cyber strategic plans, and supporting programs, tools and processes.
  • Position US Cyber to align with Technology and Cyber Leadership direction and lead new Zero Trust initiatives and cross-functional programs across the US Member Firm.
  • Own planning, budgeting, prioritization and solution recommendations for the services in scope aligned to Zero Trust Transformation and Data Protection needs.

Service Ownership and Delivery Excellence

  • Serve as Service Owner for ZTNA Proxy, WAF, FSI Enhanced Cyber Controls Adoption, DCRM, Key and Certificate Management; own roadmaps, adoption, service health, risk posture, operational metrics and stakeholder satisfaction for each.
  • Lead migration of internet facing applications to modern cloud-delivered ZTNA platforms while maintaining secure and reliable access.
  • Lead end to end onboarding of Firm's internet facing applications to multiple WAF providers across multi-cloud environments. This includes leading implementation and optimization of WAF policies, performing analysis and tuning of WAF policies to minimize false positives, leading transitioning of WAF policies from Detection mode to Prevention/Block mode through structured analysis, tuning, testing and stakeholder engagement.
  • Lead the team in providing day-to-day technical expertise and support for TLS/SSL Certificate Lifecycle Management, Encryption Key Management, Data Classification and Rights Management, Code Signing and Public Key Infrastructure.
  • Lead deployment and management of cyber security technology projects of Client and Service Auto-Labeling and Certificate Lifecycle Management Automation efforts.
  • Responsible to roll out, enhance and provide on-going support for new/existing Cyber Data Protection & Engineering services.
  • Serve as the Cyber Leader and final escalation point on all technical challenges, issues or escalations for growing number of US Data Protection & Engineering Services.
  • Provide on-going support and continuous improvement for new and existing services by embedding automation, self-service and clear service levels
  • Ensure strong service governance, including runbooks, change and incident discipline, audit readiness and clear handoffs between engineering and operations

Stakeholder Management and Executive Partnership:

  • Build and manage senior stakeholder relationships across Cyber, C&P, Technology Leaders, BISOs, FSS Leaders, Global Leaders and Vendors to ensure delivery of outstanding support for the services under the role's purview.
  • Provide clear executive-level reporting on progress, risks and outcomes to Firm Directors and the CIO Leadership Team and communicate complex technical solutions in business terms.
  • Lead cross-functional cyber initiatives across multiple teams involving 40-50 stakeholders, and spearhead technical efforts with Global Cyber teams and Vendors.

Data Protection and Zero Trust Innovation

  • Advance protection of sensitive data across endpoints, cloud, SaaS, applications, collaboration platforms and email, using classification, rights management, DLP, encryption, certificates and key management as an integrated control set
  • Stay close to service risks, incidents and design decisions through regular deep-dive reviews, and provide architectural guidance on web application security, Zero Trust, data classification, and key and certificate lifecycle management
  • Stay current on emerging threats, encryption technologies and AI-related data risks, and proactively recommend tools, controls and standards that strengthen the Firm's security posture

People Leadership and Talent Development

  • Lead, coach and develop nine direct reports (Managers, Leads, Cyber Engineers and Analysts).
  • Recruit and retain high-performing talent, mentor and coach next-generation leaders, improve staff productivity and oversee their development.
  • Lead US Cyber performance management, succession planning and professional well-being, and foster a culture of inclusion, ownership and continuous learning.

Experience working with majority of the following cyber data protection and application security technologies:

  • Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) Proxy platforms such as Akamai Enterprise Application Access, Palo Alto Secure Agentless Access, or similar
  • Web Application Firewall platforms such as Akamai WAF, Radware WAF, AWS WAF or similar
  • Data Loss Prevention platforms such as Netskope DLP, Broadcom DLP or similar
  • Data Classification, Labeling and Rights Management technologies such as Microsoft Purview
  • Certificate Lifecycle Management platforms such as Venafi, Keyfactor, or similar
  • Public Key Infrastructure platforms such as DigiCert, Sectigo, or similar
  • Encryption Key Management platforms such as CipherTrust, Azure Key Vault, or similar
  • Cloud-native security, certificate and key services in AWS, Azure and GCP
  • Secure network protocols including TLS, SSH, SFTP, 802.1x and IPSEC

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Engineering
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant and combined experience in the IT/Cybersecurity space
  • Minimum 4 years of combined experience as a Technical Lead or a Manager leading large cyber technology initiatives and/or directly managing cyber team members
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Proven ability to lead and develop Cyber Engineers and Cyber Analysts, including recruiting, performance management and succession planning
  • Proven track record leading multiple large, complex, high-visibility cyber security technology initiatives and workstreams
  • Comfort with executive-level reporting, issue escalation, and communicating with CISO, Cyber Leaders, Business Stakeholders, Firm Director and Client-facing PPMDs
  • Experience managing budgets, vendors and strategic technology partnerships
  • Master's degree in a relevant field
  • Professional security certifications such as CISSP, CISM or SANS/GIAC
  • Experience leading Zero Trust strategy, design and adoption across a large enterprise
  • Experience supporting Financial Services Industry
  • Demonstrated experience adopting, operating and supporting enterprise grade Zero Trust (ZTNA) Proxy, Web Application Firewall, DLP/DCRM platforms
  • Experience working across multi-cloud environments and multiple WAF and ZTNA platforms
  • Expertise in PKI architecture, enterprise trust models and certificate lifecycle automation
  • Experience supporting large-scale production environments with responsibility for change implementation, incident response and threat mitigation
  • Experience establishing long-term strategy and vision, and influencing without authority across a matrixed organization
  • Strong mentoring capability for managers, and emerging technical leads
  • Awareness of regulatory, audit and policy requirements (e.g., ISO 27001) impacting data protection
  • Ability to work under pressure, resolve issues/escalations effectively and keep a team motivated under intense workload
  • Ability to write technical reports and communicate technical content to business and executive audiences
  • Experience working in a virtual and globally distributed team

Job.CustomJobTypeName: Cloud Engineer, IT / Technology, Cybersecurity Analyst
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Responsible for ensuring the delivery of the cloud security strategy, and for the architecture and implementation of the cloud cybersecurity systems that carry it out, in partnership with US Infrastructure and US Cybersecurity leadership. Establishes and maintains the capabilities required to secure data and applications operating in dynamic cloud computing environments, provides oversight into and integration of security solutions, and monitors security controls to ensure compliance with firm standards.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/7/2026.

Work you'll do

This role is a key driver in determining the firm's cloud security strategy and roadmap. The Manager sets direction on cloud controls and best practices for the firm's cloud foundations, evaluates new solutions, and develops the supporting elements required to adopt new technologies in a safe and secure manner, including the controls required by data classification and compliance obligations.

That partnership with US Infrastructure extends into design and delivery of cloud security solutions, focused primarily on public cloud environments with some responsibility for on-premises environments. The role also partners with Deloitte Global on cyber strategy, keeping US cloud security direction aligned with global priorities and standards. The Manager supports cross-functional cloud teams in advancing capabilities across cloud security architecture, engineering and operations, contributes to the cloud security program and governance agenda, and helps develop strategic relationships with key alliance partners.

Responsibilities:

Strategy and partnership

  • Act as a key driver in determining the firm's cloud security strategy, technology standards, roadmaps, and practices under the oversight of US Cybersecurity leadership, and contribute to the overall vision and governance of the cloud security program
  • Partner with US Infrastructure to define requirements and deliver cloud security solutions that meet Deloitte policies, primarily across public cloud environments and secondarily on-premises
  • Partner with Deloitte Global on cyber strategy, aligning US cloud security direction with global standards, initiatives, and priorities
  • Help drive strategic relationships with key alliance partners and technology vendors
  • Evaluate new solutions and develop the supporting elements required to incorporate new technologies safely and securely, based on data classification and compliance requirements
  • Monitor cloud security industry trends, developments, and emerging threats
  • Incorporate business drivers, needs and strategies to address future business and technology needs
  • Communicate the implications of architectural decisions, issues and plans to business and IT leadership

Architecture and engineering

  • Work across cloud teams and business units to define security requirements and design cloud platform solutions
  • Architect and design comprehensive solutions that meet business security requirements in support of a given project or capability
  • Lead cloud security architecture on assigned projects using any Cloud Service Provider (CSP)
  • Ensure the secure design and implementation of SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS technologies that support security initiatives
  • Guide the implementation of new cloud infrastructure methodologies, concepts, and changes to security services in line with business requirements and security guidelines
  • Design or evaluate new tools for improving platform availability using automated protection mechanisms
  • Work closely with development teams on Infrastructure as Code, automation, and orchestration
  • Work in Agile methodology and partner with scrum teams on secure application and infrastructure solution architecture, planning user stories for sprints while addressing requirements and orchestrating security impact
  • Enable shift-left security by embedding automated controls, policy-as-code, and security scanning directly into CI/CD pipelines and developer workflows

Controls, operations and governance

  • Manage cloud security processes and supporting tools
  • Validate security controls to ensure adherence with firm security standards
  • Review control designs and validate their implementation to confirm they are effective
  • Collaborate with cloud engineers to address security risks and drive the implementation of controls across the entire cloud platform lifecycle, providing mitigation recommendations
  • Provide operational support and participate in Agile teams focused on business unit success

Leadership and collaboration

  • Oversee the implementation of cloud security capabilities performed by the US Infrastructure team, which does not report into this role, working across multiple technical disciplines, including developers, subject matter experts, database administrators, system administrators, and system architects, to provide technical direction and confirm that delivered solutions conform to the approved architecture, standards, and control requirements
  • Mentor engineers and architects in modern cloud best practices
  • Provide technical guidance and foster a collective understanding of data flows and the security issues encountered in cloud applications and services
  • Develop relationships with product teams by helping them leverage compliance and security to drive value for their products and practices
  • Lead others in the resolution of highly sensitive and confidential issues on behalf of the team
  • Act as a trusted advisor to internal stakeholders and participate in their decision-making process, including presenting alternatives and information
  • Monitor service standards for the internal teams and business units the role supports
  • Exhibit a high level of professional flexibility, volunteering innovation and new ideas

Work Complexity and Independent Judgment:

  • Work is substantially complex and varied, and regularly requires the selection and application of technical and detailed guidelines
  • Independent judgment is required to identify, select and apply the most appropriate methods, as well as to interpret precedent
  • Supervision typically consists of receiving direction on the more complex projects and on new job duties and priorities

Problem Solving and Decision Making:

  • Regularly makes recommendations to management on areas of significance to a channel or function within the firm
  • Frequently expected to recommend new solutions to problems, improve existing methods, procedures and services, and generate new ideas
  • May review decisions made by other individuals on more routine matters

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams

  • Experience with large-scale enterprise cloud projects from ideation through to finished production product
  • Experience as an Enterprise Security Architect and/or Systems Engineer, designing cloud frameworks or implementing cloud security
  • Hands-on experience with Palo Alto Networks Prisma Cloud and/or Cortex
  • Working knowledge of the following capabilities delivered through those platforms: CNAPP – Cloud-Native Application Protection Platform, CSPM – Cloud Security Posture Management, CWPP – Cloud Workload Protection Platform, CIEM – Cloud Infrastructure Entitlement Management, DSPM – Data Security Posture Management, KSPM – Kubernetes Security Posture Management, ASPM – Application Security Posture Management, IaC security scanning and policy-as-code enforcement in CI/CD, WAAS – Web Application and API Security, CDR – Cloud Detection and Response, XDR – Extended Detection and Response (Cortex XDR), SOAR – Security Orchestration, Automation and Response (Cortex XSOAR), XSIAM – Extended Security Intelligence and Automation Management, ASM – Attack Surface Management (Cortex Xpanse)

Job.JobTitle: Client and Business Cyber Services Associate Director - BISO
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Are you passionate about technology and interested in joining a community of collaborative colleagues who respectfully and courageously seek to challenge the status quo? If so, read on to learn more about an exciting opportunity with Deloitte Technology-US (DT-US). We are curious and life-long learners focused on technology and innovation, including how AI is reshaping the way secure software gets built.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/7/2026.

Work you'll do

The Associate Director, Government & Public Services (GPS) Business Information Security Officer (BISO) is a leadership role within the DT-US Cyber Security function, with a matrixed relationship to Cyber Operations, Security Architecture, Cyber Design, and Technology and Business leaders across the US Member Firm. The role is accountable for leading Cloud Security, Application Security, and AI security for GPS, and for ensuring GPS meets current Federal and Department of Defense (DoD) security and compliance requirements.

The US Chief Information Security Officer (CISO) oversees the strategy and governance of information security, risk management, and information security operations for the entire Deloitte US firm, including GPS, an US$8 billion business line serving Federal, Defense, state, and local clients. As a key member of the DT-US Cyber Security leadership team, the Associate Director serves as a trusted advisor to GPS and executive stakeholders, drives secure software and AI practices across the development lifecycle, and works across the organization to protect critical assets.

Responsibilities:

  • Ensure security controls and compliance for cloud and hybrid environments (AWS, Azure, GCP), aligned to FedRAMP (Rev. 5 and FedRAMP 20x), the DoD Cloud Computing Security Requirements Guide (SRG) and its impact levels, and NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5.
  • Work proactively with colleagues across the organization to champion cyber security requirements for cloud, Zero Trust, and vulnerability management.
  • Oversee and operationalize the security objectives of the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SSDLC), aligned to the NIST Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF, SP 800-218) and secure-by-design principles, including software supply chain security (SBOMs, dependency and provenance controls) and support for federal secure software attestation requirements.
  • Integrate AI across every phase of the SSDLC (requirements, design and threat modeling, build, test, release, and operations), governing both AI-assisted development (code assistants and agentic tools) and AI-enabled solutions in line with NIST SP 800-218A, the NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0) and Generative AI Profile, and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications.
  • Establish AI security practices including model and data provenance, prompt injection and adversarial testing (AI red teaming), AI bill of materials, human oversight, and continuous monitoring of AI systems.
  • Drive GPS readiness and evidence for Federal and DoD client requirements, including the Risk Management Framework (NIST SP 800-37 and DoDI 8510.01), NIST SP 800-171, DFARS 252.204-7012, the Cybersecurity Maturity Model Certification (CMMC) program (32 CFR Part 170 and DFARS 252.204-7021), DISA STIG hardening, and CUI protection.
  • Protect critical assets and align and prioritize cyber security investments using a risk-based approach consistent with NIST Cybersecurity Framework (CSF) 2.0.
  • Develop plans to enforce established cyber security standards, minimize vulnerabilities, and strengthen the business information technology posture, including continuous monitoring and remediation.
  • Develop cyber security and AI risk metrics that report exact status, inform leadership, and drive remediation plans.
  • Partner with delivery, legal, procurement, and client teams to manage contractual flow-down and compliance obligations and engage vendors and cloud providers on security and AI readiness.
  • Lead and develop a high-performing team of security professionals while building cloud, application, and AI security competency across the organization through training, reference architectures, and playbooks.

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Technology-US helps power Deloitte's success. Deloitte Technology-US drives Deloitte, which serves many of the world's largest, most respected organizations. DT-US develops and deploys cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The ~3,000 professionals in DT-US deliver services including:

  • Cyber Security
  • Technology Support
  • Technology & Infrastructure
  • Applications
  • Relationship Management
  • Strategy & Communications
  • Project Management
  • Strategic Financial Management

Cyber Security

Cyber Security vigilantly protects Deloitte and client data. The team leads a strategic cyber risk program that adapts to a rapidly changing threat landscape, including AI-enabled threats, and to changes in business strategies, risks, and vulnerabilities. Using situational awareness and threat intelligence, and building a security culture across the organization, with integration into the global cyber security capabilities that help protect the Deloitte brand.

Areas of focus include:

  • Risk & Compliance
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Data Protection
  • Cyber Design
  • Incident Response
  • Security Architecture
  • AI Security & Governance
  • Business Partnership

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Information Technology, Computer Science, or Engineering.
  • Minimum 10 years of experience in cybersecurity and/or risk management, including
  • Minimum 4 years supporting highly regulated environments (e.g., federal, defense, audit and financial services, or critical infrastructure).
  • Demonstrated experience driving security and compliance for cloud, including FedRAMP and DoD Cloud Computing SRG authorizations.
  • Minimum 2 years of people and/or process management experience
  • Must be able to obtain US Government security clearance or public trust determination, as required.
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Demonstrated ability to drive organizational changes in cyber security for the application development lifecycle, including integrating security and AI governance into the SSDLC and DevSecOps pipelines.
  • Working knowledge of secure AI and machine learning practices, including AI-specific threats such as prompt injection, data poisoning, and model supply chain risk.
  • Working knowledge of OWASP, application security, software supply chain security (SBOM, SLSA), and vulnerability remediation processes.
  • Deep knowledge of standards and guidance, including:
  • NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5, SP 800-171, SP 800-37 (RMF), SP 800-218 (SSDF), SP 800-218A, NIST CSF 2.0, and NIST AI RMF 1.0
  • FedRAMP (Rev. 5 and 20x), DoD Cloud Computing SRG, DoDI 8510.01, DISA STIGs, DFARS 252.204-7012, and CMMC
  • ISO/IEC 27001:2022, ISO/IEC 42001, Cloud Security Alliance Cloud Controls Matrix (CCM), and OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications
  • Understanding of and ability to apply trends in global security and risk management, including Zero Trust architecture and the evolving Federal and DoD regulatory landscape.
  • Ability to frame and communicate security and risk-related concepts to technical and nontechnical audiences at various levels, and to influence senior stakeholders in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Industry certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CCSP, CSSLP, CISA, GIAC, or equivalent experience strongly preferred; DoD 8140 qualification a plus.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $130,900 to $268,700.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Position Summary

As a Manager in AI Security Engineering, you will play a critical role in securing the development and deployment of AI/ML and Generative AI solutions. You will operate hands-on across high-visibility initiatives, embedding security, trust, and resilience into AI systems while enabling rapid, responsible innovation.

Recruiting for this role ends on 11/30/2026.

Work you'll do

You will bring strong engineering depth and applied AI knowledge, combined with expertise in cybersecurity principles, to design and deliver secure, scalable solutions. This role requires a collaborative, execution-focused leader who can influence teams, mentor engineers, and ensure AI systems meet enterprise security, risk, and compliance expectations.

Key Responsibilities

Secure, Outcome-Driven Delivery
Design and deliver AI-enabled solutions that are secure by design, balancing business value with risk mitigation. Solve complex problems while ensuring protection of data, models, and systems.

Hands-On AI Security Engineering
Actively contribute to architecture, design, and development of AI/ML and GenAI systems with embedded security controls. Integrate security across the SSDLC, including code reviews, testing, and deployment. In this role you will be responsible for managing AI defensive technologies and the operations of those technologies which will evolve over time.

AI Risk Identification and Mitigation
Identify and address AI-specific vulnerabilities, including prompt injection, data leakage, model manipulation, and misuse. Implement practical safeguards to ensure system integrity and trustworthiness.

Technical Leadership and Advocacy
Serve as a trusted technical voice for secure AI engineering. Ensure solutions are feasible, secure, and aligned with business and customer objectives.

Engineering Excellence with Security Focus
Maintain high standards for code quality, scalability, and security. Contribute to secure coding practices, reusable patterns, and continuous improvement across engineering teams.

Iterative and Responsible Innovation
Support rapid experimentation while applying appropriate security guardrails. Enable teams to innovate safely through controlled, risk-aware development practices.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with product, engineering, cybersecurity, and risk teams to embed AI security into solutions. Balance usability, performance, and security in decision-making.

Standards and Best Practices
Apply and help evolve standards for AI security, including data protection, access control, model validation, and monitoring within DevSecOps and MLOps pipelines.

Communication and Influence
Clearly articulate technical risks, trade-offs, and solutions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Contribute to alignment and informed decision-making.

Impact

This role directly contributes to reducing enterprise risk and strengthening trust in AI systems. Your work will enable secure adoption of AI capabilities while protecting critical assets and maintaining compliance.

The successful candidate would possess these skills

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to mentor and provide clear guidance to others

The team

Deloitte Technology US (DT - US) helps power Deloitte's success, which serves many of the world's largest, most respected organizations. We develop and deploy cutting-edge internal and go-to-market solutions that help Deloitte operate effectively and lead in the market. Our reputation is built on a tradition of delivering with excellence.

The ~3,000 professionals in DT - US deliver services including:

  • Cyber Security
  • Technology Support
  • Technology & Infrastructure
  • Applications
  • Relationship Management
  • Strategy & Communications
  • Project Management
  • Financials

Cyber Security

Cyber Security vigilantly protects Deloitte and client data. The team leads a strategic cyber risk program that adapts to a rapidly changing threat landscape, changes in business strategies, risks, and vulnerabilities. Using situational awareness, threat intelligence, and building a security culture across the organization, the team helps to protect the Deloitte brand.

Areas of focus include:

  • Risk & Compliance
  • Identity & Access Management
  • Data Protection
  • Cyber Design
  • Incident Response
  • Security Architecture
  • Business Partnership

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Business Administration
  • Minimum 6 years of relevant experience in software engineering, cybersecurity, and/or including AI/ML, with hands-on delivery experience
  • Minimum 1 year of people and/or process management experience

Preferred:

  • Strong understanding of AI/GenAI technologies and associated security risks (e.g., prompt injection, data exposure, adversarial threats)
  • Experience building and securing applications using Python, JavaScript, or similar, along with ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow)
  • Familiarity with secure development practices (DevSecOps) and integrating security into CI/CD and MLOps pipelines
  • Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native security principles
  • Knowledge of data protection, identity/access management, and secure architecture patterns
  • Ability to work across teams, mentor engineers, and contribute to a strong engineering culture
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts into business-relevant insights

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Referee/Official for Youth Sports will be responsible for the integral part of monitoring sports activity (including but not limited to refereeing for basketball, soccer and/or volleyball games), making sure all rules are followed and the game is played fairly.

Our Culture

Our mission and core values are brought to life by our culture. In the Y, we strive to live our cause of strengthening communities with purpose and intentionality every day. We are welcoming: we are open to all. We are a place where you can belong and become. We are genuine: we value you and embrace your individuality. We are hopeful: we believe in you and your potential to become a catalyst in the world. We are nurturing: we support you in your journey to develop your full potential. We are determined: above all else, we are on a relentless quest to make our community stronger beginning with you. We are the Y.

Job Responsibilities

  • Enforce the rules of the game. Enforce program rules/policies by maintain constant surveillance of program participants
  • Arrive at least 15 minutes prior to your first game scheduled
  • Complete score sheets at score table. Write in final score, circle winning team, initial games officiated
  • Facilitate/lead youth sports pledge before game
  • Ensure games starts on time
  • Take charge. Do not be afraid to blow the whistle
  • Ensure safety of participants/members
  • Actively engage with coaches. Always explain to the coaches how the game will be called. Explain your calls to players and coaches
  • Ensure goal heights are adjusted according to age division and proper size ball is used
  • Assist supervisor with set up/clean up as needed
  • Maintain control of game. Keep composure under pressure. Help keep a positive environment
  • Builds effective, authentic relationships with participants and parents, helping them connect with each other and the YMCA. Models welcoming, connecting, motivating and affirming behaviors.
  • Completes mandatory staff training and participates in required staff meetings.
  • Participates in special events as assigned.
  • Ensures completion of daily equipment checks and completes daily cleaning tasks.
  • Actively promotes all YMCA programs and activities and supports YMCA campaign initiatives.
  • Follows YMCA policies, procedures, and emergency procedures and able to demonstrate them.
  • Report suspicious and inappropriate behaviors and policy violations.
  • Follow mandated child abuse reporting requirements.
  • Adhere to procedures related to managing high-risk activities and supervising consumers.

Requirements

  • Minimum of 16 years of age with appropriate work permits; 18 years of age & high school degree preferred.
  • Excellent interpersonal, communication, and problem solving skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both participants and parents.
  • Knowledge of youth developmental stages, with ability to apply corresponding learning and physical traits to curriculum development and classroom management.
  • Within 60 days of hire, CPR/AED & First Aid certification

Work Environment & Physical Demands

  • Must be willing to work a flexible schedule, which may include weekends and holidays as needed.
  • Must be willing to work an on-call schedule rotation as required.
  • The noise level in the work environment is usually moderate to loud.
  • The physical activities of this position include: stooping, kneeling, crouching, reaching, standing, walking, pushing, pulling, lifting, grasping, feeling, and repetitive motions. Talking is required for expressing or exchanging ideas by means of the spoken word. Hearing is required to perceive information at normal spoken word levels, with or without correction.
  • The employee must be able to perform medium work: exerting up to 50 to 100 pounds of force occasionally, and/or up to 20 pounds of force frequently, and/or up to 10 pounds of force constantly to move objects.
  • The employee is required to have close visual acuity, along with the visual acuity to determine the accuracy, neatness, and thoroughness of the work assigned or to make general observations of facilities or structures. The employee is required to have visual acuity to operate motor vehicles.
  • The employee is subject to both environmental conditions: activities occur inside and outside. The employee is subject to extreme heat: temperatures above 100 degrees for periods of more than one hour.
  • May be required to sit or stand for extended periods of time while demonstrating manual dexterity in order to accurately work on the phone, computer keyboard, and other equipment.

Disclaimers

  • Must complete a successful employment verification and background screening, which includes a DCF Level 2 Background Check (Additional information on Level 2 Background through Clearinghouse can be found here: https://info.flclearinghouse.com/)
  • All of the above duties and responsibilities are essential job functions subject to reasonable accommodation. The YMCA promotes an equal employment opportunity work place which includes reasonable accommodation of otherwise qualified disabled applicants and employees. Please see your manager should you have any questions about this policy or these job duties.
  • This job description may not be all-inclusive and employees are expected to perform all other duties as assigned and directed by management. Job descriptions and duties may be modified when deemed appropriate by management.

Job.JobTitle: Senior Director, Digital Technical Production & Guest Data Operations
Job.JobDescription:
JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Director, Digital Technical Production & Guest Data Operations is responsible for owning and operating the technical production backbone across Universal Destinations & Experiences owned and operated digital channels, including websites, online stores, mobile apps, email, SMS, chatbot, push/in app messaging, and direct mail. This role also owns Guest Data Operations, ensuring the integrity, governance, and operational readiness of guest data that powers commercial activation and measurement.
As a senior leader within the Commercial Operations & Analytics organization, this role provides critical operational enablement across the commercial and personalization lifecycleconnecting strategy to activation and ensuring scalable, reliable execution across digital platforms and data domains. The role partners closely with portfolio planning, analytics, UX/UI, marketing activation, ecommerce, and technology teams and operates with enterprise-wide scope, decision rights, and accountability.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Digital Technical Production Operations (Owned & Operated Channels)
    • Own end-to-end technical production operations across all owned and operated digital channels, including websites, online stores, mobile apps, email, SMS, chatbot, push/in app messaging, and direct mail.
    • Lead cross-functional production teams responsible for campaign execution, always-on merchandising, content operations, and launch of new capabilities and ventures, including scaling MarTech platforms to achieve personalization and commercial strategies.
    • Establish and maintain production intake models, prioritization mechanisms, workflow standards, and operational SLAs that enable speed, quality, and scale.
    • Ensure consistent execution quality, platform stability, and brand integrity across all digital touchpoints.
    • Oversee production readiness, release coordination, testing support, issue escalation, and operational optimization for owned channels.
    • Continuously evolve technical production models, tooling, and ways of working in partnership with Technology and UX/UI teams.
  • Executive Leadership & Commercial Operating Model Enablement
    • Serve as a senior leader within the Commercial Operations & Analytics organization, accountable for digital production, personalization execution and guest data operations as foundational elements of the commercial operating model.
    • Translate commercial strategy, portfolio priorities, and activation roadmaps into scalable operational execution.
    • Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing leadership team (Directors, Senior Managers), establishing clear accountability, performance expectations, and succession planning.
    • Define and enforce enterprise standards for technical production execution, operational rigor, and guest data stewardship.
    • Partner closely with peer leaders including VP, Portfolio Planning & Transformation; VP, Commercial Data & Analytics; VP, Global UX/UI Design; and Sr. Director, Digital Capabilities & Innovation.
    • Represent production and guest data operations in executive planning, roadmap, and investment discussions.
  • Guest Data Operations & Governance
    • Own Guest Data Operations strategy and execution, ensuring reliable, governed, and activation-ready guest data across the commercial ecosystem.
    • Translate marketing, digital experience, and commerce requirements into operational data needs in partnership with Technology and Data Engineering teams.
    • Establish and enforce data governance standards, including data ownership, access controls, privacy compliance, and stewardship models.
    • Lead data quality management practices, including validation, monitoring, and remediation across guest data pipelines.
    • Maintain a centralized data catalog and metadata framework documenting data definitions, lineage, and usage standards.
    • Serve as the primary guest data and personalization steward responsible for MarTech data platforms and tools administration and operation (e.g. Adobe, Snowflake, SFMC, Unica).
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established company policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Proven executive-level leadership experience within complex, matrixed organizations.
  • Deep expertise in digital technical production across web, mobile, ecommerce, and direct digital channels.
  • Strong command of guest data operations, including governance, stewardship, quality management, and operational enablement.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate within and help shape enterprise commercial operating models.
  • Exceptional cross-functional leadership skills and ability to drive alignment across strategy, activation, design, technology, and data teams.
  • Strong executive communication skills, with experience advising and influencing senior leadership.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree is required.
  • MBA or advanced degree preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience across digital production, technical operations, commercial platforms, and/or guest data operations.
  • Demonstrated success leading large, cross-functional teams and enterprise-scale operational domains.
  • Experience operating at the intersection of marketing, ecommerce, digital experience, and data enablement.
  • Equivalent combination of education and experience may be considered.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Arborist II is responsible for operating bucket trucks and heavy equipment to perform specialized tree maintenance, with an emphasis on palm care and pruning. This role involves executing tree pruning and removals in accordance with established rigging protocols. The Arborist II also evaluates basic tree health, implements corrective actions as needed, and upholds strict safety standards to ensure efficient and effective operations.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Operate all heavy equipment, being adept in the use of a bucket truck and high reach to prune, move, install, and remove trees. Being proficient in the operation and maintenance of all 2-cycle equipment i.e.: Chain saws, power pole saws, and back-pack or handheld blowers. Identify nutritional needs, infestations, and diseases while performing routine work. Sanitize equipment between trees.
  • Climb trees for proper maintenance and removal, within UO climbing and rigging guidelines. Including the ability to perform specific climbing knots i.e.: Bowline hitch, half hitch, double half hitch, and slip knot.
  • Perform rigging of trees for proper pruning and removal by applying current best practices. Provide correct hand signals for heavy equipment operation to ensure safe operation.
  • Complete Maximo Work Orders.
  • Install, maintain, and remove supporting systems including bracing, propping, guying, and cabling on trees and palms.
  • Performs housekeeping tasks as related to vehicles, assigned housekeeping area(s), tools and equipment, tool and equipment storage, lockers, personal tool bag, and safety-related items; Follows established departmental 5S guidelines.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EXPERIENCE & EDUCATION:

This Job Description covers 3 Tiers associated with the Arborist II Job Title, beginning with Tier 1 and ending with Tier 3.

Tier 1

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred
  • CDL-B License or CDL-A License Required

EXPERIENCE:

  • Basic Climbing Experience (6mos)
  • One of the following:
    • 6+ Months Arboriculture Experience
    • 6+ Months performing High End Landscaping (Resort/Theme Park)

Tier 2

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred
  • CDL-B License or CDL-A License Required

EXPERIENCE:

Previous level & tier requirements plus:

  • 1+ Yrs. Climbing
  • One of the following:
    • 2+ Yrs. Arboriculture Experience
    • Horticulture Degree or Horticulture Program Certificate

Tier 3

EDUCATION:

  • High School Diploma or GED preferred
  • CDL-B License or CDL-A License Required

EXPERIENCE:

Previous level & tier requirements plus:

  • 4 Years Arboriculture Experience
  • ISA Certification
  • MOT Card Holder
  • 4 Years Bucket Truck Operation

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

To install, maintain, service, rebuild, troubleshoot, repair, and operate all low, medium, and high voltage industrial, commercial, and non-commercial electrical equipment and utility systems, as it pertains to the continuous smooth operation of Universal Orlando Facilities.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Maintain, install, service and repair all 12470-volt High Voltage transformers, switchgear, Air Switches, Breakers, and equipment.
  • Inspect, troubleshoot and Infrared all 12470-volt / 4160-volt High Voltage Transformers, Air Switches, Breakers, and cable park wide. Maintain, install, service and repair all main switchgear, main breakers, sub panels and branch circuits. Maintain, install, service and repair all park wide life safety electrical systems and equipment including all UPS, generators, transfer switches and egress lighting.
  • Maintain, install, service and repair all 4160-volt CEP electrical equipment, motors, and motor control centers.
  • Assist vendors and contractors on transformer oil analysis, infrared testing of breakers and all switch gear and related equipment. Provide quality inspections of UPS systems, generators, and all emergency back-up equipment when work is provided by vendors and contractors. Keep records of all outages; provide follow-up communications to the Facilities Manager as to reasons determined for failures. Maintain high voltage loop sheets, current phone numbers of all pertinent sources and records of any alterations to the 12470-volt High Voltage loop systems in USF and IOA.
  • Point of contact on high voltage operations site wide. Initiates contact with Utility provider in the event of power failures, street light outages and power quality issues. Communicates all outages through Tech Base, Security, Ride and Show and Technical Service management. Assist AMP, Placemaking, and Creative with electrical projects, provide input on initial electrical plans and perform follow-up inspections of completed work. Provide underground electrical locations for projects as required.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Technical school is preferred
  • Associate degree (AA) is preferred

EXPERIENCE:

  • 6+ years equivalent experience in industrial and commercial construction, maintenance facility or a fast-paced service company dedicated to electrical repair is required
  • 1+ year in theme park industry is preferred

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • A valid Florida Drivers License is required to operate company vehicles
  • Additionally, a Journeyman, Contractor, or Masters licenses with a minimum of 8,000 hours of relevant job experience that is issued by a Municipality, City, County, State, for Electrical is required

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Senior Security Solution Architect is a highly technical role of the UDX Global Architecture organization responsible for improving the security of UDX applications and platforms through secure architecture, software engineering, and emerging security tooling. This role partners with development teams, Architecture, and NBC Cyber to identify vulnerabilities, define remediation, and embed security throughout the software development lifecycle. The Senior Security Solution Architect takes a hands-on approach to security by reviewing architectures and code, validating findings, developing proofs of concept, and helping teams implement secure solutions. The role uses conventional security tools and frontier AI models/tooling to accelerate security analysis and remediation, including issues in existing platforms.

The role translates NBC Cyber requirements and recognized industry standards into practical UDX implementation patterns, reference designs, standards, and methods within Architecture Standards & Methods. This position does not establish NBC or UDX cybersecurity policy but translates NBC Cyber requirements into UDX solutions.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Security Architecture, Analysis & Remediation:

  • Assess existing and proposed solutions, identify and validate security weaknesses, define secure architectural designs, patterns and reference architectures. Provide architecture expertise and guidance to delivery teams through implementation in partnership with NBC Cyber.

Secure SDLC & Development Partnership:

  • Embed security into development practices, code review, testing, and CI/CD. Work directly with development teams on findings, proofs of concept, remediation approaches, and automated controls.

Security Implementation Patterns, Standards & Methods:

  • Translate NBC Cyber requirements and industry standards into UDX implementation patterns, reference designs, standards, and methods. Maintain this guidance within Architecture Standards & Methods. Partner and engage with other architects and domain experts and participate in solution review board meetings.

Emerging Technology & AI-Enabled Security:

  • Use frontier AI models and emerging security tooling to analyze code and architecture, identify vulnerabilities, accelerate remediation, and improve secure engineering practices. Conduct research on emerging technologies in support of system development efforts and recommend technologies that will increase security, cost effectiveness and system flexibility.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required:

  • Strong application security and secure software design expertise.
  • Strong software development background with the ability to read, write, and review code, APIs, and SDKs.
  • Strong experience in architecture practices including UML diagrams, and OpenAPI/AsyncAPI specifications.
  • Strong knowledge of OWASP practices, authentication and authorization, API and microservice security, secrets management, dependency risk, input validation, and cryptography fundamentals.
  • Experience with threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, prioritization, and remediation.
  • Strong understanding of secure SDLC and DevSecOps practices including CI/CD, code review, and automated testing.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security concepts including IAM, networking, containers, serverless, APIs, and infrastructure as code.
  • Ability to translate cybersecurity requirements and industry standards into practical architecture and engineering patterns.
  • Strong architecture documentation skills, including standards, reference patterns, and technical guidance.
  • Practical experience with at least one frontier AI-enabled software development model and tooling
  • Strong analytical, collaboration, and communication skills across development, architecture, security, and leadership teams.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering or similar required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 9+ years of IT experience in software engineering, security, architecture, or large integrated solutions; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Demonstrated experience in solution architecture and application security.
  • Hands-on software development experience with modern application architectures, APIs, and integration patterns.
  • Experience identifying, validating, and remediating software security vulnerabilities.
  • Experience integrating security practices and tooling into the software development lifecycle and CI/CD pipelines.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and cloud-native application security.
  • Experience developing security architecture patterns, implementation standards, or technical guidance.
  • Practical experience applying AI-enabled development or security tooling to software analysis, testing, or remediation.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Solutions Architects role is to design application architecture for specified projects to meet security, performance, reliability, reusability, scalability, and maintainability requirements. Project work includes participating in and designing solution options to existing platforms, systems, applications and microservices. This individual will also be involved design of new systems and platforms. Responsible for leading technical discussions with stakeholders and others to drive decisions and solution design. Coach and guide agile delivery teams through technical solutions and work with product owners and product managers to implement end-to-end solutions. Maintain technical knowledge of UPR systems and act as a subject matter expert. Provide documentation and support to teams involved in the solution.

The Solutions Architect will have to work with cross functional teams that will include Product Owners, Data Architects, Delivery Teams, IT Security, DevOps, Infrastructure Teams and Agile Scrum Masters and others in the organization to succeed. Project work includes web applications, native mobile applications, microservices, DevOps, and platform design. This architect will have the opportunity to work on international enterprise multi park solutions.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Solution Design - Where applicable, architect, design/develop, and oversee implementation of end-to-end integrated solution. Be a subject matter expert for development teams as part of implementation. Document and maintain the organizations existing solutions architecture and technology portfolio; make recommendations for improvements and/or alternatives. Review new and existing solutions design projects and procurement or outsourcing plans for compliance with standards and architectural plans. Interface and coordinate tasks with internal and external technical resources. Collaborate with Project Managers, vendors and IT stakeholders to provision estimates and develop overall implementation plan for installation, customization, and integration efforts. Model business and systems processes based on findings through use case scenarios, sequence diagrams, swaggers, workflow diagrams, and data models.
  • Strategy & Planning - Act as visionary and strategist for their solution domain area. Assist, design and implement long-term strategic goals and short-term tactical plans for managing and maintaining corporate technology and software. Ensure that proposed and existing solution architectures are aligned with Data Architecture and Enterprise Architecture. Provide architectural expertise and direction to other architects, and software delivery teams. Develop, document, and communicate plans for investing in solutions architecture, including analysis of cost reduction opportunities. Conduct research on emerging technologies in support of systems development efforts and recommend technologies that will increase cost effectiveness and systems flexibility. Provide technical assessments for new work efforts. Lead development of formalized solution methodologies. Build and maintain repository for deliverables and methodologies.
  • Technical Collaboration - Confer with delivery teams, product team, or senior management to refine business requirements and collaborate on technical designs and resolve technical issues. Participate and actively engage with other architects and domain experts at the solution review board.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Lead or participate in major end-to-end business process re-engineering or business transformation initiatives.
  • Hands-on experience with business requirements gathering/analysis.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including a thorough understanding of how to interpret customer business needs and translate them into practical applications and operational solutions.
  • Demonstrated ability to produce requirement artifacts: Business Requirements, Functional Specifications, data flow diagrams, UML modeling techniques include sequence, component, deployment and domain models.
  • A background in software development with ability to code at some level and knowledge of APIs and SDKs.
  • A technical architecture background. You understand at a high-level network design, routers, switches, firewalls, BGP, caching, SANs, servers, and operating systems form a part of the solution stack.
  • Extensive experience in developing strategic systems architecture plans.
  • Proven experience in system design and development.
  • Proven experience in system and network design and development.
  • Strong understanding of information processing principles and practices.
  • Solid grounding in core enterprise applications
  • Strong knowledge of software evaluation principles and practices.
  • Proven project planning and management experience.
  • Good knowledge of applicable data privacy practices and laws.
  • Demonstrable experience in solution architecture
  • Demonstrable experience in integration solution design.
  • Aptitude to work as change agent that believes in a continuous improvement approach.
  • Excellence in visual communication using modeling languages such as UML.
  • Comprehensive understanding of software development lifecycle (SDLC), continuous integration, agile software development methodologies, values and procedures.
  • Excellence in architecture documentation skills.
  • Strong experience with reverse proxies, web servers, gateways, service-oriented architectures, web services (REST), microservice patterns, service buses and integration patterns, security practices, database technologies.
  • Proven experience with databases and data storage including NoSQL and SQL databases, along with in memory key value stores.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Systems Engineering or similar essential required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 10+ years of IT experience with large integrated projects;
  • or equivalent combination of education and experience.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Experience leading global enterprise engineering projects or teams is a plus.
  • Familiarity with REST, Node.Js, .NET, NoSQL, SQL, native mobile applications, eventing patterns and microservices.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Provides HR counsel and support to Supervisors/Managers and hourly Team Members, with heavy emphasis on maintaining positive employee relations. Supports the execution of Talent & Culture (T&C) activities related to reporting, communication, analysis, placement, and training for assigned client group(s). Serves as a liaison with other T&C departments including Talent Acquisition, Talent Development, Organizational Development, Payroll, Benefits, Team Member Services, Compensation and Open Door to manage and resolve issues as well as assist with T&C process coordination. Represents self as face of T&C to Team Members in operational areas.

On-Site Opportunity. Experience in a high-volume operational setting in Human Resources highly desired. 

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Consults with managers and supervisors regarding Team Member discipline and performance issues. Investigates workplace situations, including claims of harassment, discrimination, and policy violations. Supports decision making related to terminations and other forms of discipline. Ensures that corrective Team Member coaching and counseling are handled in a fair and consistent manner.
  • Provides support to Team Members by interacting and communicating with guests and Team Members in the parks, visiting break rooms and Lead offices to promote positive relations and seek out potential issues.
  • Supports the process involved in reviewing Performance Reviews, Team Member Counseling, and Performance plans. Ensures that any written communication directed to Team Members is legal, fair, consistent, in line with Universal Orlandos values, and follows the progressive discipline policy. Provides input and drives dialogue regarding Team Member Reasonable Accommodation requests/decisions.
  • Manages & monitors annual HR processes and special project initiatives and follows-up as needed. This includes but is not limited to: Wardrobe Home Care program, Open Door Plus Appeals, attending EIL, Town Hall events, TSAT meetings, HR Roundtable presentations, Peer Review preparation, Position Management reviews, work authorization expiration notifications, No Pay Report follow-up, Average Hours report, job descriptions, , talent review, staffing assistance for job fairs, and XTRAS initiatives.
  • Attends a variety of special project, operational and HR staff meetings.
  • Provides advice and consultation for front-line hourly Team Members regarding benefits, payroll questions, policy interpretations, and EAP issues. Provides direction for internal transfer and career path direction including on-boarding plans, Intern programs, seasonal supervisor offers, and related follow-up paperwork.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Solid organizational skills, ability to handle multiple priorities.
  • Ability to flex & adapt in a fast-paced, constantly changing environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to deliver high quality HR services.
  • Ability to objectively coach Supervisors/Managers and Team Members through difficult and emotional issues.
  • Ability to research and analyze various types of data and information.
  • Independent, self-starter, requiring minimal day-to-day task supervision.
  • Professional, confident demeanor.
  • Base knowledge of company policies & practice.
  • Thorough knowledge of MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint, experience with an HRIS (i.e., SAP) preferred.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Business Management, or related field required.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years Human Resources experience in a large-scale fast paced HR environment preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • Working knowledge of employee relations, staffing and payroll required.


Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.
