Position Summary

Our Deloitte Finance Transformation team practices to help chief financial officers, controllers, and finance teams define and execute their finance and global business services agendas and strategies. You will work with leading-class teams and solutions, helping clients navigate challenging environments, market uncertainty, technology development, and regulatory considerations to unlock value. Your work may span strategy, operations, process design, and technology as we partner with clients to transform finance.

Deloitte is seeking a Data and Technology Specialist, Project to support a client project with data and information technology services. In this role, you will analyze financial services data, support data integration and reporting solutions, and help deliver timely insights for critical client operations. This Project Delivery role is designed for a professional with specialized data analytics skills aligned to a current client need.

Work you'll do

As a Data and Technology Specialist, Project on the Government & Public Services team, you will be responsible for delivering data analytics and technology support.

  • Analyze financial and operational data to identify trends, validate data quality, and support decision-making.
  • Build and maintain extract, transform, and load (ETL) workflows that integrate source-system data into analytics-ready datasets.
  • Develop data visualizations and reporting products that communicate insights to client stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with business and technology teams to document requirements, test solutions, and resolve data issues.

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Business Finance offering enables finance to drive strategic value through transformation and synchronization of planning, costing, budgeting and forecasting across finance and other functions. Using advanced, scalable data and tech platforms, we also generate actionable insights and analytics, streamline decision making and enable data driven profitable growth. Manages risk and opportunities associated with diverse and complex grant programs through end-to-end grants management solutions.

The Project Delivery Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 4+ years of work experience
  • 1+ years of experience in financial services
  • Must be able to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Experience using Databricks
  • Experience using IBM InfoSphere DataStage or IBM InfoSphere QualityStage
  • Experience using Microsoft Power BI
  • Experience using Microsoft Azure SQL Server
  • Experience applying accounting concepts in data analysis
  • Experience performing data analysis, developing data visualizations, and building extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $91,100 to $179,500.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Deloitte is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for people with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in the recruiting process, please direct your inquiries to the Global Call Center (GCC) at USTalentCICInbox@deloitte.com.

Recruiting tips

From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

Benefits

At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. We value our people and offer employees a broad range of benefits. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.

Our people and culture

Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas, and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients' most complex challenges. Job ID374839

Job.JobTitle: Cyber - Senior Consultant, AI Data Security
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

As a Sr Consultant: AI Data Security in Deloitte's Cyber for AI team, you will own technical workstreams that secure how enterprise data is ingested, transformed, retrieved, and used by GenAI, RAG, and other agentic systems. You will combine client advisory with hands-on engineering to translate requirements into architecture, integration, and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations, and help estimate delivery work.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work You'll do

As a Sr Consultant: AI Data Security on the Data team, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead discovery and data-flow analysis for RAG applications, agents, vector stores, enterprise sources, and downstream outputs.
  • Design secure data architectures for ingestion, transformation, embeddings, indexes, retrieval, context assembly, caching, and memory.
  • Lead integrations with classification, catalog, lineage, data loss prevention (DLP), encryption, secrets management, and fine-grained authorization services; engineer entitlement-aware retrieval and metadata-filtering patterns across structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Plan and execute control testing for tenant isolation, access filtering, data leakage, and pipeline reliability; own a data security workstream; manage dependencies and milestones; and provide day-to-day guidance to consultants.
  • Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes, and contribute architecture, effort, and estimation inputs to pursuits.

The Team

Deloitte's Cyber for AI team helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security, and operations. We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data, or infrastructure risk.

Within the team, the Data capability focuses on how enterprise data is discovered, classified, retrieved, transformed, and protected across RAG pipelines, vector stores, model context, and agent memory.

Qualifications

3-5+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience, including hands-on production work in both domains and experience designing, integrating, and securing production generative AI, RAG, or agentic workloads, including model, tool, and enterprise data connections.

Required Experience:

  • Designing and securing RAG or agentic data paths across ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector indexing, retrieval, prompt context, outputs, and memory, and experience with data security patterns in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.
  • Implementing vector, search, and/or data platforms including Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, pgvector, OpenSearch, Elasticsearch, Azure AI Search, Vertex AI Vector Search, Databricks, or Snowflake
  • Data security controls for classification, tagging, lineage, fine-grained access, metadata filtering, encryption, key management, tokenization, redaction, and DLP.
  • Designing, building, and reviewing data pipelines using Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka, Airflow, cloud-native data services, Git, and CI/CD practices.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field.
  • Ability to travel 20% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred Experience:

  • Managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
  • AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices, or AI-specific monitoring.
  • Building reusable technical assets, delivery methods, or automation for client engagements.
  • Machine learning tools and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow.
  • AI data services such as Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, Microsoft Foundry with Azure AI Search, Google Vertex AI RAG Engine, or Databricks AI capabilities.
  • Enterprise data security and governance platforms such as Microsoft Purview, Amazon Macie and Lake Formation, Google Sensitive Data Protection, BigID, Collibra, Immuta, or Privacera.

Certifications (Preferred)

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
  • Certified Data Privacy Solutions Engineer (CDPSE)
  • AWS / Azure / GCP Cloud certifications
  • Databricks and/or Snowflake certification(s)
  • Data Engineering certifications

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.

At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Position assists with menu planning, maintains sanitation standards, assists servers and hosts on the floor during peak meal periods and supervises Restaurants/Bars and Room Service Departments, where applicable. Responsibilities include ensuring guest and employee satisfaction while maintaining the operating budget. Accountable to ensure standards and legal obligations are followed.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 3 years experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.

OR

• 2-year degree from an accredited university in Food Service Management, Hotel and Restaurant Management, Hospitality, Business Administration, or related major; 1 year experience in the food and beverage, culinary, or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Assisting in Management of Restaurant Team

• Handles employee questions and concerns.

• Monitors employees to ensure performance expectations are met.

• Provides feedback to employees based on observation of service behaviors.

• Assists in supervising daily shift operations.

• Supervises restaurant and all related areas in the absence of the Director of Restaurants or Restaurant Manager.

• Participates in department meetings by communicating a clear and consistent message regarding the departmental goals to produce desired results.

Conducting Day-to-Day Restaurant Operations

• Ensures all employees have proper supplies, equipment and uniforms.

• Communicates to Chef and Restaurant Manager any issues regarding food quality and service levels.

• Assists in ensuring compliance with all restaurant policies, standards and procedures.

• Monitors alcohol beverage service in compliance with local laws.

• Assists in achieving or exceeding budgeted goals.

• Performs all duties of restaurant employees and related departments as necessary.

• Opens and closes restaurant shifts.

Providing Exceptional Customer Service

• Interacts with guests to obtain feedback on product quality and service levels.

• Supervises staffing levels to ensure that guest service, operational needs and financial objectives are met.

• Encourages employees to provide excellent customer service within guidelines.

• Handles guest problems and complaints, seeking assistance from supervisor as necessary.

• Strives to improve service performance.

• Sets a positive example for guest relations.

• Assists in the review of comment cards and guest satisfaction results with employees.

• Meets and greets guests.

Assisting in Human Resource Activities

• Supervises on-going training initiatives.

• Uses all available on the job training tools for employees.

• Communicates performance expectations in accordance with job descriptions for each position.

• Coaches and counsels employees regarding performance on an on-going basis.

JOB OVERVIEW:

The Software Quality Assurance Analyst is responsible for validating the quality and production readiness of software solutions by translating business requirements into effective test strategies, executing comprehensive testing, and providing actionable quality insights. This role embraces an AI-first quality engineering mindset, leveraging Generative AI, Testing Agents, and automation technologies to accelerate test design and execution, improve test coverage, streamline defect investigation, and enhance quality insights. The analyst collaborates across Product, Development, Data, and Business teams to ensure requirements are met, risks are identified early, and software releases are delivered with confidence, quality, and efficiency.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

-Review business, functional, and technical requirements to ensure clarity, completeness, and testability.

-Design, author, maintain, and execute test scenarios, test cases, test suites, and related test artifacts within Azure DevOps (ADO), ensuring end-to-end traceability between requirements, tests, defects, and releases.

-Execute functional, integration, system, regression, exploratory, and data validation testing as appropriate.

-Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects in a clear, reproducible manner through resolution.

-Analyze test results and defect trends to identify risks, recurring issues, and opportunities to improve testing processes, automation coverage, and overall quality engineering effectiveness.

-Create, configure, and leverage AI-powered Testing Agents, reusable Skills, and Generative AI tools to support requirements analysis, test design, test data generation, defect investigation, documentation, and quality insights while applying appropriate human oversight and validation.

-Proactively communicate project status, quality risks, dependencies, and issues to stakeholders and leadership.

-Monitor and manage assigned work items, testing activities, and release deliverables to ensure timely execution.

-Produce accurate, actionable, and timely test reports, quality metrics, and release readiness assessments.

-Effectively prioritize and execute work in fast-paced Agile delivery environments with competing priorities.

-Research and evaluate emerging testing technologies, AI capabilities, quality engineering practices, and industry trends to continuously improve testing outcomes.

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS:

-2+ years of experience in development or QA

-Experience with Azure DevOps (ADO) for test case management, defect tracking, execution, and reporting.

-Experience leveraging Generative AI, AI-powered Testing Agents, and reusable Skills, or similar AI-assisted technologies within the software development and testing lifecycle.

-Experienced in functional test design, execution, and analysis.

-Thorough understanding of development and testing life cycles (SDLC/STLC).

-Experience working in an agile environment.

-Experience with browser compatibility testing

REQUIRED EDUCATION:

-Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Management Information Systems, Applied Mathematics

OTHER KEY QUALIFICATIONS:

-Highly motivated self-starter with the ability to work independently.

-Excellent analytical and organizational skills with strict attention to detail.

-Creativity in proactively developing approaches to problems and recommending actions to management, or implementing the recommendations.

-Strong team player, willingness to do whatever it takes to complete assignments on time with quality.

-Excellent communication skills, both written and oral.

-Ability to communicate using both technical and non-technical "layman's" terms to an audience.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

-QAI, ISTQB, CSTP, CSTAS, CTFL or CTAL Certification.

-Knowledge of industry standard test practices and strategies.

-Ability to create and execute SQL queries to support data validation, troubleshooting, and quality analysis.

-Experience with test automation frameworks such as Playwright, Selenium, or equivalent modern automation tools.

-Experience using GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, ChatGPT, or similar AI-assisted development and testing tools.

-Identify repeatable testing activities and convert them into reusable automation assets, AI-assisted workflows, and quality engineering accelerators.

-Experience with Point of Sale (POS) systems.

-Experience with mobile application testing across multiple technologies such as, but not limited to; J2ME, Android, Symbian, .NET Technology.

-Knowledge of restaurant operations a plus.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Senior Consultant: AI Security, Infrastructure
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

As a AI Infrastructure Senior Consultant in our Cyber for AI team, you will lead technical workstreams that secure how artificial intelligence (AI) agents, workloads, and users authenticate, receive permissions, and access enterprise tools and data.

You will combine client advisory and hands-on engineering to translate requirements into architecture, integration, and production controls. You will guide junior practitioners, lead demonstrations, and help estimate delivery work.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As an AI Infrastructure Senior Consultant on the Infrastructure team, you will be responsible for:

  • Owning an infrastructure workstream, managing dependencies and milestones, providing day-to-day guidance to consultants, and contributing technical demonstrations, prototypes, architecture, effort, and estimation inputs to pursuits.
  • Leading discovery and architecture analysis for managed AI services, self-hosted model stacks, cloud foundations, networks, and operational tooling.
  • Designing and deploying secure AI landing zones and model-serving environments across AWS, Azure, Google Cloud, or Kubernetes-based platforms.
  • Leading implementation of network isolation, private access, egress controls, cluster security, secrets management, artifact controls, infrastructure as code (IaC), and policy enforcement.
  • Engineering and reviewing Kubernetes and model-serving patterns for tenant isolation, GPU workloads, autoscaling, resilience, and controlled enterprise integration.
  • Planning and executing platform security, resilience, and operational testing.
  • Diagnosing complex failures and driving issues through resolution.

The Team

Deloitte's Cyber for AI team helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data, or infrastructure risk. Infrastructure capability in our team focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation, and observability.

Qualifications

3-5+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience, including hands-on production work in both domains and experience designing, integrating, and securing production generative AI, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or agentic workloads, including model, tool, and enterprise data connections.

Required:

  • Hands-on experience designing and securing cloud, network, Kubernetes, container, and model-serving platforms in AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud, including secure AI landing zones.
  • Experience implementing network segmentation, private connectivity, egress controls, Domain Name System (DNS), Transport Layer Security (TLS), firewalls, gateways, service meshes, and enterprise integration patterns.
  • Experience implementing or reviewing infrastructure automation, Kubernetes configurations, deployment pipelines, and operational diagnostics using Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Azure Bicep.
  • Experience in CI/CD pipelines, policy-as-code, Kubernetes role-based access control (RBAC), network policies, admission controls, and secrets management.
  • Programming capabilities with Python, Go, Bash, PowerShell, HashiCorp Configuration Language (HCL) and/or YAML and Git.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field.
  • Ability to travel 20% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Experience in consulting, client delivery, or customer-facing engineering, including developing reusable technical assets, guiding junior engineers, or contributing to engineering standards.
  • Experience across both managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
  • Experience with AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices, or AI-specific monitoring.
  • Experience using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow for machine learning development, deployment, or monitoring.
  • Experience with AI platforms and model-serving technologies such as Amazon Bedrock/Bedrock AgentCore, SageMaker AI, Microsoft Foundry, Azure Machine Learning, Google Vertex AI, vLLM, KServe, NVIDIA Triton, NVIDIA Inference Microservices (NIM), or Ray Serve.
  • Experience securing GPU infrastructure, model and container registries, software supply chains, signed artifacts, service meshes, or multi-tenant inference environments.

Certifications (preferred)

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
  • Certified Kubernetes Administrator (CKA) and/or Security Specialist (CKS)
  • AWS / Azure / GCP Cloud certifications
  • Certified Terraform Associate / Infrastructure Engineer Professional

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400 to $207,800. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled.

At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case.

You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.

Position Summary

As a Cyber for AI Infrastructure Sr. Manager on Deloitte's Cyber for AI team, you will help clients address cloud and infrastructure security challenges across managed and self-hosted artificial intelligence (AI) platforms. Work you'll do

  • Leading multi-workstream infrastructure programs from current-state assessment and target architecture through implementation and operational adoption.
  • Defining scalable control patterns for network isolation, Kubernetes, model serving, graphics processing unit (GPU) environments, infrastructure as code, policy enforcement, software supply chain, and observability.

  • Overseeing client relationships, engagement quality, delivery risk, and customer satisfaction while building practice capability through offerings, alliances, reusable accelerators, technical guidance, and development of future leaders.

The team

Deloitte's Cyber for AI team helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems from design through production. The team brings together AI engineering and cyber skills across identity, data, infrastructure, application security, and operations.

We work with clients to make security controls part of the platform and delivery lifecycle so teams can move from experiments to production without creating unmanaged access, data, or infrastructure risk.

Within the team, the Infrastructure capability focuses on secure AI landing zones, cloud and network architecture, container and model-serving platforms, policy automation, and observability.

Qualifications

8+ years of combined cybersecurity and AI engineering experience including hands-on production work in both domains and experience shaping and delivering production generative AI or agentic programs, including managed or self-hosted architectures and enterprise control integration.

Required Experience:

  • Designing and securing AI landing zones and infrastructure across AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud including cloud and network architecture, Kubernetes, container, GPU, and model-serving platforms.
  • Security infrastructure including private connectivity, segmentation, egress control, service-to-service security, tenant isolation, secrets management, encryption, resilience, and observability.
  • Implementing Infrastructure as Code (IaC), CI/CD, and policy-as-code using Terraform, CloudFormation, Bicep, Open Policy Agent, Gatekeeper, Kyverno, or comparable tools.
  • Reviewing architecture, automation, platform configuration, and critical prototypes.
  • Guiding teams through infrastructure decisions.
  • Leading consulting client engagements, technical pursuits, executive relationships, delivery quality, and account growth.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field.
  • Ability to travel 25% to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.

  • Building offerings, reusable technical assets, alliance relationships, or market-facing points of view.
  • Machine learning tools and frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow.

  • Securing GPU infrastructure, model and container registries, software supply chains, signed artifacts, service meshes, or multi-tenant inference environments.

Job.JobTitle: Cyber Senior Consultant: AI Security, Identity
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

As a Sr. Consultant: AI Security, Identity in our Cyber for AI team, you will lead technical workstreams for secure artificial intelligence (AI) agents and workloads including how users authenticate, receive permissions, and access enterprise tools and data. You will combine client advisory and hands-on engineering to design architectures, integrations, and production controls; guide junior practitioners; lead demonstrations; and support delivery estimates.

Recruiting for this role ends on 05/31/2027.

The team

Deloitte's Cyber for AI team helps organizations secure generative AI and agentic systems by embedding security controls in platforms and delivery lifecycles. The Identity capability focuses on how agents, workloads, and people are identified, authenticated, authorized, and governed across enterprise and cloud environments while managing access, data, and infrastructure risk.

Work you'll do

As a Sr. Consultant: AI Security, Identity on the Identity team, you will be responsible for:

  • Lead discovery sessions to map user-to-agent-to-tool access paths, privilege boundaries, and identity lifecycle requirements.
  • Design identity architectures and integrations for AI agents and workloads, including federation, credentialless access, delegated authorization, policy enforcement, and connections across cloud and enterprise platforms.
  • Engineer and review token exchange, on-behalf-of access, consent, session controls, and just-in-time privilege patterns; test production controls and resolve authentication and authorization issues.
  • Own identity workstreams, manage dependencies and delivery milestones, and guide consultants.
  • Lead technical demonstrations and prototypes and contribute architecture, effort, and estimation inputs to pursuits.

Qualifications

3-5+ years of cybersecurity experience, including 1+ year of artificial intelligence (AI) security engineering experience.

Required:

  • Production work designing, integrating, and securing generative AI, RAG, or agentic workloads with model, tool, and enterprise data connections.
  • Designing and implementing identity controls for service accounts & principals, managed identities, workload federation, secrets, and short-lived credentials for one or more public cloud platforms.
  • Implementing OAuth 2.0 or 2.1, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, JWT, token exchange, PKI, mTLS, including delegated and on-behalf-of access patterns.
  • Implementation experience with identity, identity governance, privileged access, cloud IAM, and secrets-management platforms. (i.e. MS Entra, AWS IAM / STS, Google Cloud IAM, Okta, Ping, SailPoint, Saviynt, CyberArk, and/or HashiCorp Vault.
  • Building or reviewing identity integrations or automation using Python, TypeScript, Java, and/or Go with APIs, JSON or YAML along with Git, and CI/CD practices.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity or a related field; alternatively, equivalent demonstrated experience.
  • Ability to travel 20–50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • Previous consulting, client delivery, or customer-facing engineering experience, including developing reusable technical assets, guiding junior engineers, or contributing to engineering standards.
  • Experience across managed AI services and self-hosted or open-weight AI platforms.
  • Experience with AI threat modeling, red teaming, security evaluations, secure AI development practices, or AI-specific monitoring.
  • Experience with machine learning tools / frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or MLflow.
  • Experience with agent-focused identity capabilities, including Microsoft Entra Agent ID or Model Context Protocol (MCP) authorization, or with policy engines, identity graphs, or authorization platforms such as Open Policy Agent (OPA), Cedar, OpenFGA, or Neo4j.

Certifications (preferred)

  • Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP)
  • Certified Cloud Security Professional (CCSP)
  • Cloud certifications from Azure, AWS, Google Cloud.
  • Identity certifications from Okta, Ping, SailPoint, Saviynt, or CyberArk.

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

Respond and attend to guest repair requests. Communicate with guests/customers to resolve maintenance issues. Follow all company and safety and security policies and procedures; report any maintenance problems, safety hazards, accidents, or injuries; complete safety training and certifications; and properly store flammable materials. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards, anticipate and address guests' service needs, assist individuals with disabilities, and thank guests with genuine appreciation. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 50 pounds without assistance and heavier lifting or movement tasks with assistance. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

License or Certification: Driver's License

Job.JobTitle: Insurance Product Forward Deployed Engineer – Products & Platforms
Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

The Team

Are you looking for a unique opportunity with both start-up spirit AND enterprise strength? Deloitte's Converge for FSI business offers both! We are looking for a talented individual with an innovative mindset to join the Converge for FSI team in our mission to develop differentiated financial services products that achieve product-market fit. This role is focused on ClaimBeacon, Deloitte's AI-powered claims solution. ClaimBeacon is a managed, agentic AI platform integrated with Guidewire that helps insurance carriers modernize the claims experience for both customers and Claims Adjusters. This is a great opportunity to be on the frontlines of Deloitte's innovation and product strategy while staying close to industry/sector priorities.

Position Summary

We are looking for a highly skilled and client-facing Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) to sit at the intersection of engineering excellence and customer partnership. In this role, you will embed directly with our most strategic clients — particularly in the financial services sector — to understand their toughest technical challenges and help them design and implement world-class solutions using our platform. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role with direct influence on product direction.

You are equally comfortable whiteboarding microservices architecture with a client's principal engineer, running a hands-on technical workshop for a team of developers, and standing up a compelling proof-of-concept in days. You thrive in fast-moving, high-stakes environments and know how to earn the trust of deeply technical stakeholders.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/3/2026. (if posted in Colorado)

Work you'll do

  • Serve as a technical point of contact for strategic client accounts, building deep relationships with architects, engineers, and technical leaders
  • Lead discovery sessions to understand client architectures, pain points, and business objectives
  • Translate complex technical concepts into clear, compelling narratives for both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Collaborate with client architects and internal engineering teams to design scalable, production-ready solutions
  • Provide authoritative guidance on microservices architecture, event-driven systems, and cloud-native deployment patterns
  • Review and advise on client system designs, identifying risks and recommending best practices
  • Rapidly prototype and build POCs that demonstrate platform value in the context of a client's real-world use cases
  • Own and deliver polished, technically rigorous demos tailored to the client's specific technology stack and business domain
  • Maintain a library of reusable demo assets and reference implementations
  • Design and facilitate deep-dive technical workshops, hackathons, and onboarding bootcamps for client engineering teams
  • Produce high-quality technical documentation, runbooks, and integration guides
  • Accelerate client time-to-value by enabling their teams to build confidently and independently
  • Act as the voice of the customer — surface product gaps, integration friction, and feature requests to internal product and engineering teams
  • Partner with Sales, Solutions Architecture, and Product to shape the technical go-to-market strategy

The successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Deep expertise in Java and Spring Boot, including building production-grade microservices
  • Strong understanding of event-driven architecture — Kafka, event sourcing, CQRS, async messaging patterns
  • Hands-on experience with microservices design principles: service decomposition, API design, resiliency patterns, observability
  • Proficiency across multi-cloud environments, with AWS as a primary platform; working knowledge of Azure and GCP
  • Familiarity with containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Exposure to Agentic AI frameworks and tooling — including LangGraph, LangChain, or similar orchestration frameworks
  • Practical understanding of LLM integration patterns, prompt engineering, and AI-powered application design
  • Interest in staying current with the rapidly evolving AI/ML landscape and translating it into client-relevant use cases
  • Exceptional communicator — able to lead technical conversations with senior engineers and C-suite stakeholders alike
  • Strong facilitation skills for running workshops, design reviews, and working sessions
  • Self-directed, highly organized, and comfortable managing multiple client engagements simultaneously
  • Natural curiosity and a bias for building — you'd rather spin up a demo than write a slide about one

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing or equivalent field. MBA a plus.
  • 5+ years of software engineering experience, with significant time spent in client-facing, solutions engineering, or field engineering roles
  • Ability to travel 20-30%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.

Preferred:

  • Background in insurance strongly preferred, particularly with claims or policy administration systems
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevSecOps practices
  • Contributions to open-source projects or public technical content (talks, blogs, repos)
  • Prior experience in a startup or high-growth SaaS environment
  • Relevant cloud certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, GCP Professional, etc.)

A reasonable estimate of the current range is $105,400-207,800.

Your opportunity


At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us challenge the status quo and transform the finance industry together. We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and fully intend for the selected candidate for this role to work on site in the specified location(s).

The Network Services organization enables reliable, scalable technology capabilities that support critical business operations and client experiences. As a Network Engineering Manager and people leader, you will develop a high-performing engineering team and establish the operating discipline needed to deliver strategic and operational priorities with greater clarity, consistency, and predictability.

You will align the team's book of work to business needs, guide prioritization across competing initiatives, and create clear standards, documentation, metrics, and reporting that improve decision-making and executive visibility. You will simplify workflows, strengthen service-level performance, manage strategic vendor relationships, and use quantitative and qualitative insights to reduce delivery friction and improve outcomes. Through close partnership with engineering and Network Services leaders, you will shape capacity plans, service strategy, and evolving capabilities while coaching team members, clarifying ownership, and adapting delivery plans as business needs change.

What you have


Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
  • 3+ years of experience in product ownership, technology delivery, or related work, including leading teams and coordinating delivery across multiple stakeholders
  • People leadership experience that includes coaching, performance management, and team development
  • Experience partnering with engineering organizations to define, implement, and manage applications or tools throughout the product lifecycle
  • Demonstrated ability to organize complex work, establish priorities, resolve delivery challenges, and align teams around shared outcomes
  • Advanced proficiency with Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Strong executive communication, customer focus, time management, and problem-solving capabilities
  • Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience developing operational metrics, service-level reporting, standard operating procedures, or delivery playbooks
  • Experience managing strategic technology vendors or external service partners
  • Familiarity with Information Technology Infrastructure Library practices
  • Experience using project management tools to manage backlogs, capacity, dependencies, and delivery commitments
  • Demonstrated ability to use qualitative and quantitative insights to improve workflows, service performance, and delivery predictability

In addition to the salary range, this role is eligible for bonus or incentive opportunities.


What's in it for you

At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

  • 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
  • Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
  • Paid parental leave and family building benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

Position Summary

Are you an experienced, passionate pioneer in technology who wants to work in a collaborative environment? As an experienced Oracle HCM Cloud Payroll Consultant you will have the ability to share new ideas and collaborate on projects as a consultant without the extensive demands of travel. The Project Talent Model is designed for professionals with specialized skills that align to a current client need. Team members focus on delivering services to clients, without additional expectations related to business development or promotion. Their employment is tied to their role on a project, and they are eligible for a benefits package that is competitive for project delivery-focused professionals.

Work you'll do/Responsibilities

As a Consultant at Deloitte, you will work within an engagement team and be responsible for supporting the overall project goals and objectives. In this role, you will interact with stakeholders and cross-functional teams. It is expected that you will be able to perform independent tasks as well as provide technical guidance to team members, as needed.

  • Oracle Payroll Functional day to day Incident/ Request/enhancements for US and Mexico Payroll.

The Team

Our Human Capital practice is at the forefront of transforming the nature of work. As converging forces reshape industries, our team uniquely addresses the complexities of work, workforce, and workplace dynamics. We leverage sector-specific insights and cross-domain perspectives to help organizations tackle their most challenging workforce issues and align talent strategies with their strategic visions. Our practice is renowned for making work better for humans and humans better at work. Be part of this exciting era of change and join us on this transformative journey.

Our Insights, Innovation & Operate Offering is designed to enhance key aspects of our clients' businesses by leveraging cutting-edge technology, data, and a blend of deep technical and human expertise. We innovate and deliver creative, industry-specific solutions that streamline operations and accelerate speed-to-value.

 Qualifications

Required

  • 3+ years' Oracle Cloud Payroll experience
  • Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Computer Engineering, or related IT discipline; or equivalent experience
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available
  • Ability to travel 10%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred

  • Analytical/ Decision Making Responsibilities
  • Analytical ability to manage multiple projects and prioritize tasks into manageable work products
  • Can operate independently or with minimum supervision
  • Excellent Written and Communication Skills
  • Ability to deliver technical demonstrations

Your opportunity


DAFgiving360 is an independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to increasing charitable giving in the United States. Since 1999, donors have recommended over $55 billion in grants to more than 300,000 charities. Through donor-advised funds and philanthropic tools, DAFgiving360 helps individuals and families integrate charitable planning into their financial lives and make a meaningful difference.

DAFgiving360 has entered into a services agreement with Charles Schwab & Co., Inc. for administrative and other services, including human resources. This position will be an employee of Charles Schwab & Co., Inc. and subject to its policies and procedures, while reporting to and remaining accountable to DAFgiving360 for day-to-day activities.

Role Overview

The Senior Manager of Marketing is a senior-level individual contributor on DAFgiving360's Insights and Education, Public Relations, and Brand Expression team. The role owns strategy and execution for insights-driven and educational content supporting the strategic themes “Grow our clients” and “Invest in our offer.” The work is aligned with organizational OKRs focused on increasing brand awareness, new high-net-worth accounts, and contributing accounts.

What You'll Do

  • Identify advanced charitable planning and giving topic gaps based on the personas and journeys of experienced, high-net-worth, and ultra-high-net-worth donors and their advisors.
  • Develop insights and education content strategies that define the business need and OKRs addressed, content formats, activation channels, search and answer engine optimization, promotion channels, KPIs, and project timing.
  • Use modern formats and activation channels to deliver educational content.
  • Serve as the marketing subject-matter expert and project lead for assigned work.
  • Collaborate across Marketing and with DAFgiving360 and Schwab SMEs to support content effectiveness and project success.
  • Partner with the Offer and Client Experience team to apply research that sharpens content for target audiences.
  • Monitor and report on content performance and recommend opportunities for optimization.

Why You're Set Up for Success

This role brings together marketing strategy, content development, financial services or charitable-sector knowledge, and cross-functional leadership in a highly visible individual-contributor position. You will be positioned to succeed if you enjoy translating complex topics into compelling educational content for sophisticated audiences and leading high-impact work through expertise and influence.

  • Think strategically while maintaining ownership of execution.
  • Understand the needs of HNW and UHNW donors and their advisors.
  • Translate advanced charitable-planning concepts into engaging, accessible content.
  • Lead multiple initiatives, partners, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Connect content strategy to organizational OKRs and business outcomes.
  • Use data and performance insights to continually optimize content.

What you have


The Expertise You Bring

  • BA or BS degree in philanthropy, marketing, communications, journalism, English, economics, finance, or a related discipline, or equivalent work experience.
  • 7+ years of professional experience.
  • Experience working with a charitable organization or financial services provider.
  • Experience developing integrated, multi-channel content marketing campaigns.
  • Demonstrated experience creating compelling content across multiple formats.
  • Experience leading multiple complex projects and collaborating with multiple stakeholders.
  • Ability to connect content and marketing strategies to broader business goals.
  • Experience measuring content performance and using results to recommend improvements.
  • Experience partnering with subject-matter experts and cross-functional teams.

Experience involving wealth management, charitable giving, donor-advised funds, HNW/UHNW audiences, financial advisors, or advanced financial and charitable planning would provide particularly relevant context for the work.

The Skills You Bring

  • Strategic thinking: Connect business objectives to actionable content strategies.
  • Content strategy and storytelling: Transform sophisticated topics into compelling educational content.
  • Integrated marketing: Activate content across multiple formats, channels, and stages of the audience journey.
  • Audience orientation: Develop content around personas, client journeys, and the needs of HNW/UHNW donors and advisors.
  • Digital optimization: Apply search optimization and emerging answer-engine optimization approaches.
  • Project leadership: Lead concurrent projects with different partners, timelines, and scopes.
  • Collaboration and influence: Partner effectively with marketing teams, business leaders, SMEs, research partners, and client-experience teams.
  • Measurement and optimization: Monitor KPIs and translate performance data into actionable recommendations.
  • Attention to detail: Maintain strong quality standards throughout content development and production.
  • PowerPoint: Communicate strategies, recommendations, and results effectively through presentations.

Schwab Training and Development

As a Charles Schwab employee supporting DAFgiving360, this role provides an opportunity to continue building expertise across marketing, financial services, charitable giving, client experience, and sophisticated donor audiences. The experience can strengthen capabilities in strategic marketing, content strategy, financial-services marketing, philanthropic education, cross-functional leadership, and executive-level influence.


What's in it for you

At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

  • 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
  • Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
  • Paid parental leave and family building benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

Position Summary

ServiceNow Senior Consultant

Our Deloitte Cyber team understands the unique challenges and opportunities businesses face in cybersecurity. Join our team to deliver powerful solutions that help clients navigate an evolving threat landscape. Through solutions and managed services that simplify complexity, we help clients operate with resilience, grow with confidence, and proactively manage cyber, risk, and technology programs.

Recruiting for this role ends on 5/31/2027.

Work you'll do

As a Senior Consultant - ServiceNow on the Cyber Strategy & Transformation team, you will be responsible for...

  • Leading requirements workshops and stakeholder interviews to capture, validate, and document business requirements, user stories, and current-state and future-state process flows
  • Analyzing processes, controls, and tools to identify opportunities for ServiceNow configuration and automation across IT Operations Management, IT Asset Management, Integrated Risk Management, Security Operations, Third-Party Risk Management, and ServiceNow AI Control Tower use cases
  • Supporting functional design and configuration of ServiceNow solutions, including forms, workflows, notifications, service level agreements, dashboards, reports, roles, and access controls
  • Documenting data models, taxonomies, workflows, controls, and reporting requirements for cyber, risk, and artificial intelligence governance use cases
  • Producing project artifacts, including requirements documentation, functional designs, test scenarios, training materials, release notes, and deployment support materials
  • Collaborating with client stakeholders, functional teams, and technical teams to support demonstrations, user acceptance testing, defect triage, training, cutover activities, and solution adoption

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The team

Our Cyber Strategy & Transformation offering develops and transforms cyber programs in line with a client's strategic objectives, regulatory requirements, and risk appetite. It keeps the enterprise a step ahead of the evolving threat landscape and gives stakeholders confidence in the organization's cyber posture. Includes design of the cyber organization, governance, and risk assessments.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Cyber Security, Engineering, Information Technology, Finance, Business or related area
  • 4+ years of experience supporting ServiceNow implementation projects in a client-facing consulting role
  • 4+ years of experience gathering business requirements, facilitating workshops, documenting process flows or user stories, and producing functional documentation
  • 4+ years of experience designing, configuring, or implementing ServiceNow solutions in one or more of the following modules: IT Operations Management, IT Asset Management, Integrated Risk Management, Security Operations, or Third-Party Risk Management
  • 4+ years of experience configuring ServiceNow forms, workflows, notifications, service level agreements, reports, dashboards, roles, or access controls
  • Ability to travel 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve.
  • Limited immigration sponsorship may be available.

Preferred:

  • ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA)
  • ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD)
  • ArchX (Architecture Excellence)
  • One or more ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) certifications, including CIS-Risk and Compliance (CIS-RC), CIS-Security Incident Response (CIS-SIR), CIS-Vulnerability Response (CIS-VR), CIS-Third-Party Risk Management (CIS-TPRM), CIS-Hardware Asset Management (CIS-HAM), CIS-Software Asset Management (CIS-SAM), CIS-Service Mapping (CIS-SM), CIS-Discovery (CIS-DISCO), CIS-Event Management (CIS-EM), CIS-Data Foundations (CIS-DF), or CIS-Strategic Portfolio Management (CIS-SPM)
  • Experience supporting implementation and configuration of ServiceNow AI Control Tower capabilities, including AI inventory management, intake and approval workflows, lifecycle oversight, issue management, dashboards, and reporting
  • Experience supporting identity governance for human and non-human actors using Veza, or cyber asset discovery and configuration management database (CMDB) integration using Armis

JOB SUMMARY:

The Manager, Global UXUI Experience Design, Research & Accessibility role is a core member of the Global Experience Design Group at UDX, working closely with a cross functional team to craft usability studies, analyze results, and derive insights and recommendations to inform development of new experiences that unlock the potential of Universal Parks products and platforms for our guests. Leads and supports the development of usability testing and accessibility strategies and activities focused on driving business results and validating useful, usable, accessible, and delightful interactions across our global digital product experiences

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

USABILITY TESTING & ACCESSIBILITY ANALYSES

  • Conduct usability testing to test hypotheses of iterative design work that will transform and enhance the Universal Parks user experience as well as to identify design problems, uncover opportunities for improvement and learn about the target users behavior and preferences.
  • Collect and analyze KPIs to make informed data-driven recommendations for UX/UI improvements. Use findings as a positive focal point for collaboration and product design evolution.
  • Write detailed study plans including goals, hypothesis, metrics, and study approach.
  • Apply the best methods to answer UX research questions.
  • Be accountable for ensuring quality of usability tests.
  • Consolidate test findings into a compelling insightful story to share with stakeholders.
  • Have a passion for refining design solutions based on evidence, UX research methodology and results, and accessibility principles, collaborating directly with consumer insights, analytics and research teams as well as product and technology teams.
  • This is a hands-on role, and the candidate will be expected to execute work and will be responsible for planning and conducting usability and accessibility tests, reviews, analysis, and documentation as part of the role.

LEADERSHIP AND COLLABORATION

  • Define and conduct qualitative research, including usability studies, interviews, and more to provide insights on requirements definition, content strategy, wireframes, visual and interaction design in partnership with the Global UXUI Experience Design Team, Product and Technology teams.
  • Be a vocal Champion and encourage team members to deliver accessible and innovative design solutions that improve engagement, conversion and build fan loyalty across our digital platforms.
  • Ensure consistent, cross-functional communication across marketing and experience teams to include IT, Business Operations, Marketing, Creative, Revenue Operations and Finance relative to key business decisions and customer engagement.
  • Achieve operational excellence and superior guest experience advancements by building and sustaining a high-performing UXUI product design team to achieve and exceed goals and objectives.
  • Coach team members in user research methodology and accessibility principlesparticularly those less-experienced in research disciplines.

CUSTOMER EXPERIENCE

  • Develop and conduct usability testing strategies and activities that support the UPR Global Experience Design vision and strategies across the consumer journey with a focus on identifying customer challenges to help improve the user experience.
  • Partner on development of end-to-end experiences and enhancements across all customer touch points and channels in partnership with a cross functional team.
  • Conduct usability tests and heuristic reviews, competitive research, and assess end-to-end business processes and practices to identify and implement enhancements that improve customer satisfaction in effort to deepen loyalty and trust with our guests.
  • Share insights and recommend solutions for key business decisions with and through the organization to enable alignment and collaboration as new products or enhancements roll out.
  • Ensure that the designed practices, annual product and consumer targets, and key performance indicators (KPIs) are met based on the experiences delivered. In addition, be responsible for profit and loss as well as operational profitability of the product as influenced by the consumers reception and experience.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree is required.
  • Undergraduate degree in User Experience, Experience Design, Human Factors, Psychology, UX Research, Human Centered Interaction and/or Interaction Design is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of experience with demonstrated leadership in user research and usability testing for digital experiences. IA, UX, or CD in a progressive technology enablement, innovation, or marketing organization
  • 2+ years experience as a Senior UX Researcher or Senior Designer developing digital interactive products or experiences.
  • Accessibility certification and experience preferred
  • Experience with immersive technologies, ecommerce sites in the travel and hospitality sector, rewards/engagement and loyalty programs are a plus.
  • Must present a portfolio of work that includes usability research case studies and demonstrate strong UX and interaction design excellence;
  • or equivalent combination of education and experience.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Experience in project team leadership and large-scale program planning and implementation as well as willing to be hands on when needed
  • Demonstrated success creating end-to-end digital product designs in the consumer technology sector
  • Proven experience working with product teams and UXUI designers in conducting user research (e.g., usability testing, heuristic analyses, competitive benchmarking, contextual interviews) on digital platforms
  • Proven track record in building highly effective interpersonal business relationships, working in a consultative capacity, and presenting to stakeholders of all levels in a highly matrixed organization.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to articulate and visualize both qualitative and qualitative results
  • Demonstrable experience in a wide range of qualitative and quantitative methodologies, including heuristics, remote usability testing, contextual interviews, surveys, rapid iterative testing, ethnography, and other techniques
  • The ability to write detailed test plans and summarize data sets
  • Knowledge of reviewing and applying accessibility best practices to solutions.
  • Passionate advocate for the user who enjoys conducting usability testing, and champions accessibility principles.
  • Experience with agile methodology.
  • Understanding of key metrics for digital interactive products including, but not limited to monthly active users (MAU), daily active users (DAU), average revenue per paying user (ARPPU), average revenue per install (ARPI), conversion rates and how these metrics can and will impact the product strategy.
  • Ability to project manage and work effectively under deadlines and in complex business environments through collaboration and utilizing supporting and partner teams. A positive attitude, open mind, and desire to collaborate and learn.
  • Highly proficient in usability testing platforms such as UserZoom or UserTesting.com
  • Experience with Adobe Creative Suite, Sketch, InVision and Abstract.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

As a member of the Universal Creative senior leadership team, the Senior Vice President, Global Project Hub is responsible for establishing the enterprise governance framework, project controls, standards, and operational processes that enable successful project execution across all Universal Creative portfolios.

The Senior Vice President provides strategic leadership for the Global Project Hub, leading a multidisciplinary team of subject matter experts responsible for enterprise estimating, planning and scheduling, project controls, financial governance, logistics, reporting, and delivery methodologies. The role establishes enterprise standards, provides executive advisory support, and drives consistency, accountability, and operational excellence across the global project portfolio.

Serving as the enterprise authority on project governance, this position partners with portfolio leadership to provide strategic oversight, financial insight, risk management, and best practices that improve project performance while ensuring projects remain aligned with Universal Creative's business objectives.

The Senior Vice President also serves as the primary business liaison to executive leadership across Universal Creative portfolios, supporting long-range portfolio planning, strategic communications, organizational alignment, capital planning, and budget development while cultivating executive relationships with internal stakeholders and joint venture partners to ensure successful delivery of enterprise objectives.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Global Project Hub Leadership
    • Provide strategic vision and leadership for the Global Project Hub, aligning enterprise project support functions with Universal Creative business objectives.
    • Lead multidisciplinary teams of subject matter experts responsible for estimating, planning and scheduling, project controls, logistics, architectural and engineering support, reporting, and enterprise project methodologies.
    • Establish enterprise standards that enable consistent execution, operational excellence, and scalable support across all global portfolios.
    • Develop organizational capabilities and leadership talent that strengthen enterprise project delivery and continuous improvement.
    • Serve as the primary business liaison with executive leadership across Universal Creative portfolios, ensuring strategic priorities remain aligned with enterprise objectives.
  • Enterprise Governance & Project Controls
    • Establish and govern enterprise-wide project management standards, methodologies, stage gates, approval processes, and project controls across all Universal Creative portfolios.
    • Develop and maintain standardized approaches for scheduling, estimating, forecasting, reporting, change management, cost controls, and risk management.
    • Drive consistency in project delivery methodologies while continuously improving governance frameworks, operational processes, and performance metrics.
    • Lead enterprise adoption of emerging technologies, digital tools, and industry best practices that enhance project execution and organizational effectiveness.
    • Establish governance frameworks and enterprise standards for the engagement, performance, and oversight of consultants, contractors, manufacturers, fabricators, vendors, and strategic partners, ensuring consistent expectations, accountability, quality, and delivery excellence across all portfolios.
    • Develop enterprise processes supporting procurement governance, correspondence, RFIs, directives, submittals, meeting documentation, project controls, and change management that enable predictable project execution across the organization.
  • Financial & Business Governance
    • Establish enterprise financial governance standards supporting capital project planning, estimating, forecasting, and budget development.
    • Provide executive oversight and strategic guidance regarding project financial health, cost trends, contingency utilization, forecasting accuracy, and budget realism.
    • Partner with Finance and portfolio leadership to improve capital planning, financial transparency, and executive decision-making.
    • Evaluate enterprise financial performance metrics and recommend improvements that optimize investment decisions and project outcomes.
    • Support development and communication of long-range planning strategies across Universal Creative portfolios while aligning financial priorities with enterprise objectives.
  • Executive Advisory & Portfolio Support
    • Serve as the executive advisor to portfolio leadership, providing strategic guidance regarding project controls, schedule recovery, estimating accuracy, financial performance, governance, enterprise risk, and organizational effectiveness.
    • Partner with executive leadership to identify organizational risks, remove barriers, and implement enterprise solutions that improve project delivery across all portfolios.
    • Build and maintain strategic relationships across Universal Creative, Universal Destinations & Experiences, portfolio leadership, and external partners to ensure cross-functional alignment and successful execution of enterprise initiatives.
    • Provide executive oversight for enterprise procurement strategies, vendor performance, sourcing approaches, and strategic partnerships that improve quality, consistency, and long-term organizational value.
    • Cultivate executive relationships with joint venture partners and external stakeholders to support collaboration, portfolio integration, and successful execution of strategic initiatives.
  • Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement
    • Champion a culture of operational excellence through continuous improvement, enterprise performance measurement, benchmarking, and process optimization.
    • Develop and monitor enterprise KPIs that measure organizational effectiveness and project performance.
    • Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve organizational efficiency, and strengthen executive decision-making across the Global Project Hub.
    • Lead organizational transformation initiatives that improve enterprise capability, governance maturity, and operational excellence.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UDX policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

Global travel required.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and creative environment.
  • Ability to lead organizational transformation, enterprise governance, and strategic change across a global organization.
  • Ability to effectively present complex business, operational, financial, and strategic information to executive leadership, boards, and key stakeholders.
  • Strong executive decision-making, strategic thinking, and problem-solving skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop enterprise governance frameworks, project controls, financial governance, and organizational standards.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and executive relationship-building skills.
  • Comprehensive understanding of project delivery methodologies, capital planning, estimating, scheduling, forecasting, financial analysis, organizational performance, and enterprise risk management.
  • Ability to build executive partnerships across internal organizations, external partners, consultants, vendors, and joint venture stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in project management methodologies, enterprise systems, and executive reporting tools.
  • Passion for the themed entertainment industry and commitment to delivering exceptional guest experiences.
  • Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Engineering, Construction, Finance or related discipline required.
  • Master's degree preferred.
  • Professional Architecture or Engineering license preferred.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification preferred.

EXPERIENCE: 

15+ years of progressive executive leadership experience in project governance, project controls, capital project management, portfolio management, or large-scale development organizations, including responsibility for enterprise scheduling, estimating, financial oversight, governance frameworks, organizational leadership, strategic planning, and operational excellence. Global leadership experience strongly preferred.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.
