JOB SUMMARY:

Responsibilities will encompass a wide range of tasks including downtime recovery, troubleshooting, fault analysis, redesign projects, obsolete part migration, and the integration of control and mechanical hardware ensuring the seamless operation of Ride & Show systems across all attractions.  On-call 24/7, carrying the Engineering Duty Phone on a rotational basis, and serving as the primary liaison for the Engineering department, addressing issues across disciplines to support Ride & Show and Operations. All work will adhere strictly to ASTM F24 Committee guidelines and comply with relevant codes, regulations, and standards such as AISC, ASME, ASTM, ANSI, AWS, JIC, NEC, and OSHA, ensuring the highest levels of safety and compliance.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Troubleshoots electromechanical systems while conducting fault identification and failure analysis to facilitate downtime recovery during the day-to-day operations of Universal Orlando (UO) parks while being the main liaison between Engineering and partners in Ride and Show and Operations.
  • Provides design solutions for Ride & Show systems ranging from basic to moderate levels of complexity to improve safety, operational reliability, show quality, and serviceability of equipment. Places an emphasized focus on improving system diagnostics, technical training of Ride & Show and Engineering Team Members, and Preventive Maintenance improvement.
  • Generates engineering documentation to validate design solutions that have been implemented by the engineer including but not limited to control system hardware analysis, firmware analysis, code comparison documentation, change bulletins, CAD drawing changes, and training procedures. Generates Acceptance Test Procedures to validate all system design changes in accordance with Universal Destinations & Experiences (UDX) standards and procedures.
  • Utilizes project management skills to coordinate project efforts, assigned by Engineering management, with Operations and Ride & Show divisions to make effective use of the venue and Team Member resources to drive projects to completion.
  • Documents project status of assigned tasks to give regular and insightful updates to the appropriate attraction management, both operations and Ride & Show as well as Engineering Management. Maintains configuration management of controls hardware and software (drawings) documentation in accordance with Engineerings guidelines and procedures for proper archiving and security.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.

  • Sets the priorities and oversees any modifications and/or engineering modifications to ensure timely completion of tasks.  Analyzes operational performance of the attractions and manages priorities of maintenance activities.
  • Supervises and leads training and development of all direct reports in assigned area.  Administers development plans on a regular basis and as required.  Manages schedules and personnel records for direct reports.  Ensures compliance to all Universal Orlando policies and procedures.  Ensures safety is the top priority of assigned area for both guests and team members.

Job.JobDescription:
Description

Join a hands-on, milestone-driven Claims Apprenticeship designed to prepare you for a career in casualty claims. Over 612 months,youllcomplete a flexible, goal-based program combining classroom training, on-the-job assignments, one-on-one mentoring, and real claim work. Successful completion prepares you to move into a ClaimsResolutionSpecialist role or other claims opportunities.

Program highlights

  • Duration: 612 months (flexible, hybrid,based on milestone completion)
  • Schedule: Part-time or full-time options; progress is milestone-based so participants can advance as theydemonstratecompetency
  • Training: Comprehensive classroom and practical training,jobshadowingandone-on-one mentoring
  • Compensation:Competitive paid apprenticeship and eligibility forcompany benefits as applicable
  • Career path: Clear progression to Claims Specialist roles and support for licensing and development

Whatyoulldo (Key responsibilities)

  • Manage, investigate, and resolve assigned claims within established authority levels.Including but not limited to Auto Accidents
  • Gather information from policyholders, claimants, witnesses, and third parties (appraisers, medical providers, repair shops) to evaluate coverage, liability, and damages
  • Review medical records, police reports, and other documentation to assess claim severity and determineappropriate reserves
  • Negotiate settlements with claimants and attorneys; arrange expert inspections and coordinate ancillary resources as needed
  • Identifysuspicious claims and refer to Special Investigations Unit (SIU);identifythird partysubrogation opportunities
  • Maintainaccurateandtimelyclaim files, status reports, and documentation in claims systems
  • Sends and responds to various written, telephone and SMS text inquiries to pursue resolution of the claim.

Training & support

  • LicensingTraining(state adjuster licensing requirementassistancewhere applicable)
  • Structured curriculum combining technical skills (coverage analysis, state tort basics, reserving,evaluation,negotiation) and soft skills (communication, empathy, customer service)
  • One-on-onementoring from experienced claims professionals and regular milestone assessmentswith trainer and coach support
  • Hands-on scenario-based exercisesinand exposure to leadership and cross-functional teams
  • Continuous learning journeyprovidedfor enhancingCasualtyskills

What we offer

  • Paid apprenticeship with competitive compensation
  • Mentorship, career development, and individualized mobility plans
  • Support for licensing and tuition reimbursement for approved educational needs
  • Access to health and wellness benefits (as applicable),andpaid leave
  • Opportunity to convert to a full-time ClaimsResolutionSpecialist or other roles upon successful completion

How the milestone-based progression works

  • Youlladvance by completing a sequence of competency milestones (knowledge assessments,demonstratedtask performance, quality reviews) rather than strict calendar time
  • Typical milestones include coverage & liability evaluations, reserves setting, independent file management, negotiation simulations, and compliance/ethics checkpoints
  • The program is flexible: apprentices whodemonstratecompetency early can complete the program in ~6 months; others may take up to 12 months to meet all milestones

How to apply:Submityour resume and a brief cover letter describing your interest in claims and your availability. Candidates who meet the basic criteria will be invited to complete a virtual interview and skills assessment.

Equal opportunity statement:We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourage applicants of all backgrounds to apply. Reasonableaccommodations areavailable upon request during the selection process.

Pursue a meaningful career helping people recover after loss apply for the Claims Apprenticeship today.

Qualifications

Whatwerelooking for

  • High school diploma or GEDrequired(no bachelors degreerequired)
  • 02 years of professional experience; customer service, legal, medical, or investigative experience a plus
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills; ability to present information clearly, concisely, and professionally withappropriate empathy
  • Solid analytical, investigative, negotiation, and time-management skills
  • Detail-oriented and able to thrive in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment
  • Demonstrates change resiliency and a growth mindset by adapting quickly to shifting claim priorities, seeking feedback, and proactively pursuing learning opportunities to improve processes and outcomes.
  • Permanent authorization to work in the United States and ability to obtain required state licensing where applicable
  • Comfortableusing standard office software and learning claims management systems

JOB OVERVIEW:

The CRM Analyst is responsible for supporting and advising key business leaders across the organization on Email and SMS initiatives. This is a high visibility position requiring significant interaction with Senior Management and external vendor partners while working on daily campaign deployments as well as small projects. The ideal candidate will have a background with an emphasis in email campaign development (HTML), execution, post-campaign analysis, and independent decision making. This position requires a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset, and a person who is skilled and experienced in developing email campaigns, and can manage multiple projects at a time.

ROLES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:

- Work with ESP partners, creative agencies, Darden Brand teams and Darden Strategy team to create and execute email campaigns that drive business impact

- Execute a high volume of data-driven, dynamic email campaigns

- Execute SMS campaigns including broadcasts, mobile wallet offers, and automated messages

- Lead tactical development behind day-to-day campaigns as well as the overall trigger programs for both email and SMS

- Proofread and perform rendering checks on all campaigns prior to deployment, utilizing utmost attention to detail

- Troubleshoot rendering issues and provide end-to-end QA support

- Build and code emails using agency-provided creative assets

- Build and develop single-step email campaign journeys

- Manage campaign calendar and deployment schedule to ensure deadlines are consistently met

- Manage and track day-to-day activities across open projects, prioritizing work to be done each day, logging issues contributing to delays

- Partner across teams to ensure projects are on track for on-time deployment

- Become a super-user of email deployment platform

- Support process documentation and enforcement of SOPs

- Provide insightful recommendations to improve templates and approach to align to email best practices

- Assist in the development of year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter campaign analysis decks to Senior Management

- Ensure spam regulation compliance (CAN-SPAM)

- Deliverability monitoring, raising concerns to brand and leadership as needed

- Extract, analyze, and manipulate data from database

- Edit and troubleshoot HTML code to ensure proper structure, formatting, and functionality

- Ensure email and mobile marketing best practices are met

- Lead small scale projects as needed

- Develop and maintain project backlogs, regularly assessing priority to ensure business needs are met

- Create and manage a trigger and template maintenance process to ensure we are proactively addressing rendering issues and applying best practices

- Consistently enhance skills and job knowledge by participating in professional learning opportunities and personal networking

REQUIRED TECHNICAL SKILLS:

- Demonstrated experience working with an Email Service Provider to deploy email Campaigns

- Proficient in Excel: formulas, filters, and pivot tables

OTHER KEY QUALIFICATIONS:

- Organization, project management, and time management skills with the ability to organize, plan, and follow-up with tasks

- Ability to prioritize and re-prioritize various job activities/tasks, including the ability to multi-task when necessary

- HTML experience

- Basic knowledge and understanding of data, insight, and strategy

- Ability to adjust communication style such that it is effective with various audiences, including internal and external partners as well as peers or executive level employees

- Ability to clearly and confidently communicate/present (verbal and written) key learnings and metrics whether that be by phone, email, virtual presentation, or in-person

- Ability to exercise appropriate judgment with a sense of urgency by using information and knowledge to make timely, effective decisions

- Ability to work independently in a detail-oriented function and with minimal supervision

- Ability to build and maintain relationships, with a skill for conflict resolution

REQUIRED EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE:

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, Business, or a related field required

- 1-3 years' experience servicing high volume marketing initiatives (inclusive of internship experience working in marketing)

- Experience has led to strong understanding of email / SMS marketing best practices

  • Perform routine, pre-approved configuration and maintenance changes within client domains
  • Gather detailed information to support issue resolution and escalation efforts
  • Troubleshoot front-end application issues by:
    • Shadowing end users
    • Testing workflows
    • Validating functionality
    • Leveraging troubleshooting tools and knowledge articles
  • Support backend troubleshooting activities including:
    • Capturing log files
    • Querying tables
    • Updating database fields
    • Cycling or updating servers
  • Maintain accurate documentation throughout the support lifecycle
  • Collaborate with internal teams and customer stakeholders to support timely issue resolution
  • Prioritize and manage multiple issues independently while working within a collaborative, fast-paced support environment
  • Adhere to HIPAA, PECA, CHIA, Oracle Health policies, and customer security requirements

Training & Development

As part of the Client Services Academy (CSA), you will receive structured onboarding and support training designed to build foundational knowledge of Oracle Health technologies and support methodologies.

During training, you will:

  • Work alongside experienced support professionals
  • Gain hands-on exposure to real-world client support scenarios
  • Build technical troubleshooting and workflow analysis skills
  • Begin project work immediately while developing a foundation for long-term career growth within Oracle Health Support

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Associate degree, Bachelor degree, or Technical degree preferred
  • 2+ years of professional experience in customer service, technical support, healthcare, or related industries
  • At least 1 year of call center and/or phone-based technical support experience
  • Basic technical troubleshooting aptitude and willingness to learn healthcare technology systems
  • Strong communication and customer service skills

JOB SUMMARY

Manages and coordinates capital and operating projects assigned to the Engineering division. Oversees the bid process, city coordination, contractors and billing to ensure the successful execution of all assigned projects. Manages ongoing and daily performance of consultants, vendors, suppliers and contractors. Develops and manages project timelines to verify project execution goals are achieved and to minimize negative effects on guest experience.

CANDIDATE PROFILE

Education and Experience

• High school diploma or GED; 6 years experience in the project management, engineering and maintenance or related professional area.

OR

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university in Building and Construction, Engineering, Mechanics, or related major; 4 year experience in the engineering and maintenance, project management or related professional area.

CORE WORK ACTIVITIES

Managing Engineering Projects and Budgets

• Oversees the implementation and execution of approved capital and operating projects including the development of project specifications, part/product location, labor planning and the management of bidding services.

• Develops requisitions and presentations for capital projects.

• Assists in developing the annual capital/operating budget and in planning project requests.

• Identifies, qualifies and negotiates general contracts for capital, operating and special events projects.

• Manages ongoing and daily performance of consultants, vendors, suppliers and contractors.

• Develops and manages project timelines to verify project execution goals are achieved and to minimize negative effects on guest experience.

• Verifies that contractors and vendors adhere to appropriate local permitting procedures.

• Manages project related permits and inspection requests.

• Specifies or create a configuration management method for the projects.

• Performs routine project inspections to verify quality control, state/local building code compliance and adherence to plan specifications.

• Prepares project progress reports detailing timelines, delays and adherence to project cost.

• Verifies project compliance with Occupational Safety and Health Associaton (OSHA) regulations, Material Safety Data Sheets (MSDS) and safety precautions.

Maintaining Property Standards

• Verifies building and equipment licenses and certifications are current.

• Maintains property life safety systems (fire fighting equipment, sprinkler systems and alarm systems).

Promoting Exceptional Customer Service

• Displays leadership in guest hospitality, exemplifying excellent customer service and creating a positive atmosphere for guest relations.

• Reviews comment cards, guest satisfaction results and other data to identify areas of improvement.

• Shares plans with property leadership and ensuring corrective action is taken to continuously improve guest satisfaction.

• Strives to improve service performance.

Position Summary

As a Consultant in Deloitte's Digital Trust & Privacy practice, you will support the design and implementation of privacy technology solutions that help organizations address regulatory requirements, strengthen data governance, and enable trusted business outcomes. You will contribute across configuration, integration, testing, and deployment activities while working with client, vendor, and cross-functional teams. This role offers the opportunity to take on increased ownership in privacy-by-design initiatives, Consent & Preference Management, and AI governance efforts, and large-scale technology implementations.

Recruiting for this role ends on 12/31/2026.

Work you'll do

  • Strategize with clients to identify privacy technology gaps that can be addressed with technology to enable future state privacy goals and navigate complex IT architectures to incorporate privacy technology solutions.
  • Lead working sessions with client stakeholders to gather technical, functional, and business requirements and establish use cases to inform future state architecture.
  • General awareness of global and domestic privacy regulations and concepts, and how they relate to the deployment of technology in line with applicable laws and regulations, and general knowledge of integrating technologies with third-party tools and APIs.
  • Configure, integrate, test, and deploy privacy tools and technologies to help clients automate their privacy capabilities and enhance customer experiences.
  • Coordinate with client stakeholders and technology vendor representatives to clarify queries, troubleshoot implementation issues, and test end-to-end deployment and system integrations, and manage and execute project activities across the IT Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) including leading regular check-ins with team members and vendors
  • Develop and maintain technical configuration documentation, and manage and provide technical oversight to solution deployment and rollout.

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or similar Engineering disciplines
  • 2+ years of experience in software design, architecture development, and technology implementation
  • 1+ years of experience with OneTrust and other technologies
  • 1+ years of implementation experience with OneTrust, Ketch, Transcend, Cassie, or Securiti's Consent & Preference Management solution
  • Ability to travel 25-75%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

Preferred Qualifications:

Technical skills

  • Understand marketing technologies, including customer data platforms, consent, cookies, tag management solutions
  • Ability to understand, develop and enhance existing client architectures and solution designs to meet data privacy requirements
  • Prior experience in performing SaaS implementations for complex organizations and IT ecosystems.
  • Ability to comprehend and execute basic technology concepts such as Application Programming Interfaces (API's), system requests methods (GET/POST), etc.
  • Demonstrated experience in performing integrations with Marketing Platforms (e.g., Sales Force Marketing Cloud), Master Data Management (e.g., Informatica MDM) and middleware (MuleSoft, Kafka)
  • Familiarity with privacy tools such as OneTrust, BigID, Securiti.ai, etc.
  • Hands-on experience and knowledge of software engineering concepts/technologies, such as:
    • JavaScript, RESTful APIs, HTTP Requests, JDBC, HTML CSS
    • SQL, NoSQL, database management concepts
    • API management tools such as Apigee, Postman
    • Agile/Scrum methodology to build and rollout complex software solutions
  • Understanding of privacy program requirements and capabilities such as data inventory, data subject rights, consent and preference management, privacy by design, privacy impact assessments, incident response, third-party risk, etc.
  • Knowledge of Data Privacy Laws and Regulations: Familiarity with data privacy legislation such as GDPR, CCPA, LGPD, and other regional or industry-specific privacy regulations.
  • Communication Skills: Strong written and verbal communication skills to effectively articulate complex privacy concepts to business-facing audiences, such as clients and other team members.
  • Project Management Experience: Experience in managing projects, including planning, risk management, resource management, and meeting project timelines.
  • Teamwork and Collaboration: Proven experience in working effectively with diverse teams.
  • Change Management: Understanding of change management principles and approaches, to enable successful implementation and adoption of privacy solutions.
  • Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or similar Engineering disciplines
  • 2+ years of experience implementing privacy solutions such as OneTrust, BigID, Securiti.ai
  • Certifications in one or more of the following: CIPT, CIPM, CISSP, CPDSE, CIPT, Agile/Scrum Master
  • Experience with application development and testing using one or more programming or scripting languages (e.g., .Net, C#, Python)
  • Understanding of Ad-Tech / Mar-Tech ecosystem, frameworks, tools, and solutions
  • Limited sponsorship may be available

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. Job.CustomJobTypeName: Project Manager, IT / Technology, Sales / Business Development
Job.JobDescription:
Your opportunity


At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the wealth management industry together.

We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and expect the selected candidate to work on site four days per week in one of the specified locations.

The Digital Wealth Advisory organization helps shape the future of holistic wealth management for Schwab Wealth Advisory through innovative digital experiences, advisor productivity solutions, and emerging AI capabilities. We partner across a matrixed environment to identify unmet needs, reimagine how work gets done, and bring new capabilities from concept to reality. This team is ideal for people who thrive in ambiguity and enjoy solving complex problems.

You'll lead a digital offer management team that helps translate wealth management needs into AI and digital solutions. Our offer partners set the business strategy. Your team will make sure the digital tools, workflows, and platforms support the strategy in an evolving technical landscape.

You'll partner with teams across Schwab and lead the prioritization and trade-off decisions for advisor specific needs; weighing impact, business value, and delivery realities so the most important work moves forward.

As business priorities change, you'll move the team's capacity to the highest priority work, whether that's improving existing capabilities, supporting new offers, or adopting emerging technologies such as AI.

The role is fast paced. It's a great fit for a leader who understands both wealth management and digital delivery and can bring structure to ambiguity.

What you'll do:

  • Translate business strategy into digital strategy. Turn business strategy into prioritized digital capabilities and requirements that align with Schwab's broader advice and wealth strategies.
  • Simplify the advisor's day. Find friction, gaps, and manual work in advisor and client journeys. Turn what you find into clear, prioritized requirements that reduce effort and connect the experience.
  • Enable AI-powered efficiency.Identify where AI and automation can cut manual work, and define the requirements to bring those capabilities into workflows and dashboards.
  • Prioritize across partners. Work across a matrixed environment to prioritize Digital Wealth Advisory needs, balancing business value and advisor impact.
  • Show business value. Build business cases, define success metrics, and report outcomes that tie digital decisions to client, advisor, and business results.
  • Develop the team. Lead, coach, and grow a strong team of offer managers, building depth in wealth management, workflow design, and vendor evaluation.
  • Drive decisions with leaders. Work through ambiguity, competing priorities, and executive trade-offs to reach timely, well-reasoned decisions.

What you have


Required

  • 10+ years of experience in financial services, including wealth management, advisory offers, or advice-based platforms in large, complex organizations.
  • 5+ years of people leadership experience, including hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing teams.
  • Deep knowledge of how advisory offers work in practice, including client enrollment, servicing, and advisor workflows.
  • Proven offer management or product management experience, with the ability to turn offer strategy into digital capabilities and see them through to delivery.
  • Experience working with Risk, Compliance, and Legal partners in a regulated environment.
  • Executive presence, with the ability to influence, challenge, and partner with senior leaders.
  • Ability to turn complex inputs into clear recommendations and decisions.
  • High emotional intelligence, with a leadership style that balances urgency, accountability, and trusted partnership.

Preferred

  • Experience evaluating, contracting, or onboarding third-party wealth technology vendors, including demos and technology assessments.
  • Knowledge of the wealth tech landscape
  • Experience with process mapping or business transformation for advisor or client workflows.
  • Exposure to GenAI or advanced analytics in client- or advisor-facing products.
  • CFP designation and/or FINRA licenses (Series 7/24).
  • Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree a plus.

What's in it for you

At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

  • 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
  • Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
  • Paid parental leave and family building benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

Job.JobTitle: Sr Manager, Schwab Wealth Advisory Offer Management
Job.JobDescription:
Your opportunity


At Schwab, you're empowered to make an impact on your career. Here, innovative thought meets creative problem solving, helping us “challenge the status quo” and transform the wealth management industry together.

We believe in the importance of in-office collaboration and expect the selected candidate to work on site four days per week in one of the specified locations.

The SWA Client and Offer Experience team defines and evolves the end-to-end experiences that shape how Schwab Wealth Advisory (“SWA”) clients engage with the offer and how employees deliver it. Team members bring the SWA value proposition to life by translating strategic priorities into experiences, processes, and capabilities that drive meaningful outcomes for clients, advisors, and the business.

The team partners across Wealth and Advice Solutions, Investor Services, Operations, Marketing, Technology, Risk, Legal, Compliance, and other enterprise partners to translate client needs, field insights, business priorities, and data into strategic initiatives that improve offer delivery, strengthen the advisor and client experience, and drive measurable business outcomes.

We are seeking a Senior Manager to lead the offer strategy, design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of a more integrated SWA + Schwab Personal Trust Services (“PTS”) offer experience. This individual contributor role will lead through partnerships and influence, combining strong strategy and offer management skills with disciplined project execution to take an evolving concept from initial exploration to a functioning, scalable client offer.

As a Senior Manager, you will:

  • Own the SWA + PTS offer across its full lifecycle, from strategy, business case, and concept design through approvals, implementation, launch, and ongoing evolution.
  • Design a coordinated client and advisor experience with SWA as the relationship entry point and clear responsibilities across Wealth Advisors and PTS.
  • Translate strategic choices into a practical offer and operating model
  • Lead disciplined cross-enterprise execution, establishing workstreams, governance, milestones, decision points, resource needs, dependencies, risks, and accountability; securing alignment and approvals; and escalating issues with clear recommendations.
  • Build alignment and communicate a clear path forward, influencing senior leaders and cross-functional partners without direct authority by leveraging executive-ready narratives and navigating competing perspectives and trade-offs.
  • Own post-launch performance and continued improvement, defining measures of client and advisor experience, adoption, service quality, operational capacity, and business outcomes, and using results and feedback to prioritize enhancements.

You are likely a strong fit for this role if you:

  • Think like a strategist and operate like an owner
  • Bring strong consulting and structured problem-solving skills
  • Excel at program and project leadership
  • Influence across complex organizations
  • Communicate with clarity and take initiative – you must be a self-starter
  • Remain constructive and adaptable when plans change

What you have


This role has specific qualifications that successful candidates should have including:

  • Bachelor's degree.
  • 7+ years of professional experience in offer or product management, strategy consulting, internal strategy, business transformation, program leadership, or a related discipline.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from early strategy and design through approvals, implementation, launch, and ongoing improvement.
  • Strong strategic and offer management capabilities, including market and competitive research, client insights, business-case development, service and operating-model design, and creating executive-level recommendations.
  • Proven program and project management capabilities, including establishing governance, developing phased roadmaps, coordinating delivery teams, and managing resources, risks, dependencies, and trade-offs.
  • Proven ability to influence senior stakeholders and build alignment across organizational boundaries without direct authority, supported by exceptional written and verbal communication skills.
  • A high degree of comfort with ambiguity and a changing environment, demonstrated through adaptability, resilience, intellectual curiosity, sound judgment, and a positive, collaborative approach to resolving unknowns.
  • Strongly preferred: prior offer management and/or strategy experience in wealth management and/or personal trust services (including, for example, corporate trustee services, and/or tax, trust and estate wealth services).

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States now and in the future without employer sponsorship.


What's in it for you

At Schwab, you're empowered to shape your future. We champion your growth through meaningful work, continuous learning, and a culture of trust and collaboration—so you can build the skills to make a lasting impact. Our Hybrid Work and Flexibility approach balances our ongoing commitment to workplace flexibility, serving our clients, and our strong belief in the value of being together in person on a regular basis.

We offer a competitive benefits package that takes care of the whole you – both today and in the future:

  • 401(k) with company match and Employee stock purchase plan
  • Paid time for vacation, volunteering, and 28-day sabbatical after every 5 years of service for eligible positions
  • Paid parental leave and family building benefits
  • Tuition reimbursement
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance

Job.JobDescription:
Position Summary

Our Deloitte Customer team empowers organizations to build deeper relationships with customers through innovative strategies, advanced analytics, Generative AI, transformative technologies, and creative design. We can enhance customer experiences and drive sustained growth and customer value creation and capture, through customer and commercial strategies, digital products and innovation, marketing, commerce, sales, and service. We are a team of strategists, data scientists, operators, creatives, designers, engineers, and architects. Our team balances business strategy, technology, creativity, and ongoing managed services to solve the biggest problems that affect customers, partners, constituents, and the workforce.

Work you'll do

As a Delivery Consultant, Creative Content Solutions on the Customer Strategy & Design team, you will be responsible for…

  • Creating visual design deliverables, including mockups, wireframes, and prototypes, aligned to client brand standards, project goals, and user needs
  • Collaborating with design leads and cross-functional teams to develop, present, and refine design concepts across design, user experience, and development workflows
  • Supporting initiatives across the product lifecycle, including minimum viable product launches, feature releases, and maintenance updates for established digital products
  • Using artificial intelligence tools to accelerate research synthesis, ideation, content development, and design iteration
  • Working in a hybrid delivery model with up to 30% co-location at assigned locations and up to 10% overnight travel for client or project needs

A successful candidate would possess these skills:

  • Ability to work independently and collaborate as part of a team
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Meticulous attention to detail and quality of work product
  • Ability to build and sustain professional relationships
  • Ability to lead projects or workstreams
  • Ability to manage and prioritize multiple tasks in a fast-paced and dynamic environment
  • Strong interpersonal skills and professional demeanor
  • Ability to meet deadlines
  • Ability to provide clear guidance to others

The Team

Deloitte's Government & Public Services (GPS) practice – our people, ideas, technology and outcomes – is designed for impact. Serving federal, state, & local government clients as well as public higher education institutions, our team of professionals brings fresh perspective to help clients anticipate disruption, reimagine the possible, and fulfill their mission promise.

Our Customer Strategy & Design team discovers, designs, and prototypes customer growth strategies and innovation portfolios.

This opportunity sits within our Center talent model, which is dedicated to driving impactful business services. It leverages Deloitte's scale and talent, as well as a center delivery model to provide high-quality, cost-effective service with standardized processes and procedures to service businesses across Deloitte.

The Deloitte Center has a small-business feel with a big-business impact. With the resources of Deloitte and a community feel, the center model provides high-quality services to our clients. Center professionals work out of one of our specific delivery center locations, and each location presents dynamic career opportunities for professionals to focus on their work with nominal travel requirements.

Qualifications

Required:

  • Bachelor's degree
  • 1+ years of experience creating visual designs for web or mobile applications, including mockups, wireframes, or prototypes
  • 1+ years of experience using Figma and at least one digital design or prototyping tool such as Adobe XD, Sketch, or InVision
  • 1+ years of experience using design systems for enterprise digital experiences
  • 1+ years of experience applying user-centered design principles to web or mobile product design
  • Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future.
  • Delivery Center Location & Travel Requirements:
    • Hybrid Work Model: Operate under a hybrid system requiring residence within a commutable distance to one of the US Delivery Center locations (Gilbert, Lake Mary, or Mechanicsburg)
    • Co-location Expectation: Spend up to 30% of working time co-located at an assigned office for orchestrated opportunities, including projects, practice sessions, training, and Moments That Matter at a Deloitte Delivery Center location, Geo-Hub location, approved site, or project location
    • Travel Requirement: Maximum of 10% overnight travel for client or project purposes
    • Relocation Requirement: If relocation is necessary, complete the move within 12 weeks from the start date to reside within a commutable distance

Preferred:

  • Experience supporting federal, state, local government, or public higher education clients
  • Experience working on minimum viable products, feature releases, or maintenance releases
  • Experience collaborating with developers, business analysts, and project managers across the product lifecycle
  • Experience using artificial intelligence tools to accelerate design workflows
  • Experience with iOS and Android mobile application design, including Material Design and Human Interface Guidelines
  • Experience using motion design tools such as Adobe After Effects, Principle, or Framer

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $53,300 to $105,000.

National General is a part of The Allstate Corporation, which means we have the same innovative drive that keeps us a step ahead of our customers evolving needs. We offer home, auto and accident and health insurance, as well as other specialty niche insurance products, through a large network of independent insurance agents, as well as directly to consumers.

Job Description

The Direct Sales Agent Specialist is responsible for driving profitable growth by generating new business, cross-selling existing customers, and building lasting relationships. This role focuses on understanding customer needs, delivering tailored solutions, and maintaining a strong book of business.

This role sells to local customers both in person and over the phone, while driving growth through community involvement, relationship building, and outside marketing efforts.

If you are ready to start working in a fun & exciting environment while making adifference, then apply to join our team today!

  • Partner with leadership to support sales and local marketing initiatives
  • Stay informed on products, underwriting guidelines, and market competition
  • Deliver results aligned with performance standards, compliance requirements, and customer experience expectations

JOB SUMMARY:

Responsible for the safety and security of Universal Orlandos guests, employees, and company assets.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Ensures the safety and security of all guests and employees by performing a variety of roles including walking patrols, motorized patrols, and occupying various access control points. Utilizes radio telecommunication to report potentially unsafe, suspicious, or threatening conditions.
  • Identifies prohibited items through routine screening of bags, packages, and deliveries and prevents said items from entering property. Conducts routine visual inspections of structures, buildings, carts, and safes to protect company assets during and after business hours.
  • Responds to reported incidents, assesses the scene, and analyzes the situation using sound judgment all while collecting necessary information to construct a written witness statement.
  • Assists and directs guests and employees during safety & emergency situations.
  • Assists during daily operation, peak attendance periods and special events by consistently picking up shifts, overtime, and/or willingly moving to differ.
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

High school degree or GED is preferred.

CERTIFICATIONS, LICENSES, REGISTRATIONS:

  • Class D Security License must be obtained within first 90 days of employment (required) and must remain valid throughout employment.
  • Must have and maintain a valid Florida Drivers License.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 1+ years of previous security experience preferred; or equivalent combination of education and experience.
  • A background check is mandatory, and results must meet Universal Orlandos background check criteria.

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

Provide Security services by patrolling property, monitoring surveillance equipment, visually inspecting buildings, bags, packages, and deliveries, performing access control and other methods.

JOB SUMMARY:

The UDX Franchise Strategy team drives the global vision and strategic development and execution of franchise strategy and plans to cultivate Intellectual Property (IP) growth and drive revenue throughout the franchise ecosystem. We are a high-performing team of makers, thinkers, leaders and rebels whose passion is to ignite ideas every day, in a culture that celebrates creativity, fresh thinking, executional excellence and each other.

The Manager, Franchise Strategy is responsible for partnering with the Director and Vice President to lead the growth and development of UDX licensed properties (Western) into global franchises. Key functions include long term strategic planning for priority IP, ideation and execution of new business models, and creation of innovative marketing plans that maximize licensed IP cross-company, ensure long-term success, and ultimately drive revenue and brand value for NBCUniversal.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  •  Franchise Management
    • Partner with Director on the development of strategic global business plans for external franchises for Western IP and support in guiding implementation to drive UDX revenue and build brands.
    • Partner with Director and with the Destinations in annual business planning considering lifecycle, revenue potential, portfolio fit and long-term proposition.
    • First point of contact with Warner Bros. and Western IPs Franchise external partner teams to develop strategies that are mutually beneficial across the portfolio.
    • Provide input as a thought leader to drive innovation with new models, unique partnerships and first of its kind go to market strategies.
    • Support the analysis and tracking of relevant metrics to support business case modelling and scenarios.
  • Franchise Stewardship
    • Support Director and Vice President as the franchise champions and ambassadors for internal and external needs.
    • Partner with Director to connect key franchise stakeholders and oversee cross-company activations, including bridge year campaigns.
    • Support the creation of creative briefs to ideate authentic and merchandisable franchise extensions and refreshes.
  • Communication & Collaboration
    • Ensure presentations and other communications are best in class and shared among all relevant parties and support clarity of message and alignment.
    • Support the Director in franchise communication to and in support of all Destinations: UOR, USH, USJ, UBR, USS, UKR, and UHU on franchise vision, ideation and strategies.
    • Contribute to the advancement and actualization of UDXs inclusion commitments
  • Professional Leadership
    • Serve as a champion for best-in-class culture with an emphasis on collaboration, innovation and inclusion
    • Lead the professional development of direct reports through continuous training and coaching
    • Manage direct reports full-cycle including but not limited to managing team member performance, concerns, engagement, performance reviews and goals
  • Understand and actively participate in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities. 
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5 years general experience; or combination of education and experience.
  • 3+ years in Franchise Management or Brand Marketing preferred 

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION: 

  • Carries out supervisory responsibilities in accordance with the organizations policies and applicable laws.
  • Based in Orlando with periodic travel (up to 10%) to Los Angeles or other partner locations.
  • Hybrid: This position has been designated as hybrid, generally contributing from the office a minimum of four days per week.

DESIRED CHARACTERISTICS:

  • Bachelors Degree preferred in marketing or related field
  • Experience working with entertainment brands is a plus
  • Proven presentations skills with executive presence and leadership
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to think strategically and conceptually
  • Comfortable adapting to change in a continuously evolving environment

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Serve as a business partner to Universal Orlando leadership by supporting capacity management, admission access, and related planning across the destination. Develop analyses and recommendations that balance attendance demand, operating capacity, guest access, and business objectives while ensuring decisions adhere to applicable legal requirements and established program guidelines. Support capacity planning and access management across key products and programs, including Epic Universe, Annual Passes, Halloween Horror Nights, and complimentary admission programs. Partner with Finance, Revenue Management, Marketing, Operations, Legal, and other stakeholders to evaluate demand, establish and maintain capacity controls, and support collaborative decisions regarding block out dates and other admission restrictions. Use analytical tools and models to monitor utilization, forecast demand, identify capacity risks and opportunities, and translate complex data into clear recommendations for leadership.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage and support capacity planning across key admission products and programs, including Epic Universe, Annual Passes, Halloween Horror Nights, and complimentary admission programs. Monitor demand, utilization, and available capacity; develop forecasts and scenario analyses; and recommend capacity allocations and access controls that balance guest access, operational considerations, and business objectives.
  • Collaborate with key stakeholders on block out dates and other mechanisms used to manage demand during constrained periods.
  • Partner closely with Marketing to inform product and pricing decisions through financial and demand analysis, evaluating potential impacts to consumer behavior, revenue, profitability, and broader business objectives.
  • Provide insights that help balance commercial opportunities with financial considerations and assess the effectiveness of implemented strategies.
  • Monitor actual performance against capacity plans and expectations, identify emerging risks and opportunities, and recommend adjustments to capacity levels, allocations, or program parameters.
  • Evaluate the effectiveness and business impact of capacity-management decisions and communicate findings to leadership.
  • Develop and maintain analytical tools, reporting, forecasts, and scenario models supporting capacity-management decisions. Use Excel, Snowflake SQL, Power BI, and other analytical tools to evaluate alternatives, identify trends, and translate complex data into actionable recommendations.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Highly collaborative, with the ability to work across Finance, Revenue Management, Marketing, Operations, Legal, and other stakeholder groups
  • Ability to balance guest access, operating capacity, financial objectives, program requirements, and legal considerations when developing recommendations
  • Experience with capacity planning, demand forecasting, inventory or access controls, ticketing, admissions, or a comparable analytical business process
  • Able to translate financial and operational analysis into clear recommendations and decision materials that support business decisions
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and hands-on experience using Snowflake SQL or a comparable data platform to develop forecasts, scenario analyses, and data-quality checks
  • Experience developing and maintaining Power BI dashboards and reports, with the ability to reconcile results across source systems, models, and dashboards

EDUCATION:

  • High school degree or GED is required.
  • Bachelors degree is required. Bachelors degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Analytics, Economics, or equivalent is preferred.

EXPERIENCE:

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in finance, analytics, revenue management, capacity planning, forecasting, ticketing, admissions, or a related area. Demonstrated experience analyzing large datasets, developing forecasts and scenarios, partnering across functions, and communicating recommendations that support complex business decisions. Experience with Snowflake SQL, Power BI, and advanced Excel is preferred.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

The Director, Strategic Finance at UDX reports to the Sr. Director, Financial Strategy and is a highly visible individual contributor who serves as a strategic partner and primary point of contact for executive leadership and peers across the organization. The role combines financial analysis, executive storytelling, investor-relations insight, and business strategy to support critical decisions across Universal Destinations & Experiences.

The Director leads key elements of UDXs strategic finance and executive reporting agenda, developing executive presentations and decision-support materials that connect business performance, external insights, strategic priorities, and investment considerations. Success requires exceptional presentation development and strategic storytelling, strong financial judgment, and the ability to rapidly translate complex information into concise, executive-ready narratives.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

Executive Reporting & Strategic Communications

  • Lead key components of the UDX operational rhythm, including business reviews, annual planning, long-range planning, strategic check-ins, and other executive-level presentations.
  • Serve as a primary strategic partner and point of contact for executive leadership, helping frame key messages, identify decision points, and support informed decision-making.
  • Independently develop executive-ready presentations that translate complex financial, operational, and strategic information into clear, compelling narratives.
  • Own the quality and accuracy of executive materials, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy and leadership priorities.

Investor Relations & Leadership Insights

  • Partner with UDX Executive Leadership, FP&A and NBCUniversal to develop UDX perspectives and supporting analysis for earnings-related materials, investor discussions, and other external financial communications.
  • Synthesize investor, analyst, and external commentary about the business, key industry participants, and relevant sector themes into concise updates for UDX executive leadership.
  • Develop executive briefings that highlight recurring investor themes, external perceptions, emerging questions, and implications for

UDX messaging, strategy, and performance narratives

  • Maintain a clear, fact-based bridge between internal business performance and external financial narratives while protecting confidential information and ensuring alignment with approved disclosures.
    Investment Evaluation & Decision Support
  • Lead financial evaluation of strategic initiatives through robust financial models, scenario analyses, and decision frameworks.
  • Partner with cross-functional leaders to develop business cases, challenge assumptions, evaluate risks and opportunities, and present recommendations to senior leadership.
  • Oversee post-investment reviews to assess performance against original business cases and incorporate lessons learned into future decisions.

Process Improvement & Strategic Influence

  • Improve strategic finance processes, reporting tools, and governance to increase efficiency, consistency, and decision usefulness.
  • Establish best practices for executive reporting, analytical storytelling, presentation development, and data visualization.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships and influence outcomes through analytical rigor, executive communication, and strategic partnership rather than formal authority.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS:

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or abilities (KSAs) required.

  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to shape concise executive narratives from complex financial and operating information.
  • Expert PowerPoint and executive presentation-development skills, including persuasive visual storytelling for senior leadership audiences.
  • Experience supporting Investor Relations, earnings-related communications, external financial narratives, or comparable executive reporting processes.
  • Strong executive presence and the ability to build credibility with senior leaders and corporate stakeholders.
  • Ability to rapidly synthesize disparate information and deliver high-quality, executive-ready materials under compressed timelines.
  • Ability to influence decisions and build alignment across functions without direct authority.
  • Strong financial judgment, analytical capability, and attention to detail.
  • Sound judgment in interpreting external commentary and distinguishing investor perspectives from approved company positions.
  • Consistent attendance is a job requirement.

SPECIFIC QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS & ABILITIES:

  • Expert PowerPoint and executive presentation development
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling
  • Power BI and data visualization
  • Strong business judgment, intellectual curiosity, and agility
  • Knowledge of the tourism, leisure, media, or consumer experience industries
  • High emotional intelligence, executive presence, and interpersonal skills

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in finance, Economics, Business Administration, Engineering, Political Science, Data Science, or a related field required
  • MBA or Masters a plus

EXPERIENCE:

  • Minimum 8+ years of progressive experience in Strategic Finance, Corporate Strategy, Investor Relations, Management Consulting, or a related field, including experience leading complex cross-functional initiatives and presenting to senior executives. Experience in tourism, leisure, hospitality, media, or consumer experiences is preferred.

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

JOB SUMMARY:

Serves as the senior commercial strategy leader for the Universal Orlando hotel portfolio, setting the commercial agenda to drive demand, revenue optimization, profitability, and integrated go-to-market (GTM) planning in partnership with Loews Hotels & Co. and the broader Universal Destinations & Experiences (UDX) Brand & Commercial organization.

This role is accountable for connecting hotel strategy to portfolio-level brand, audience, commercial product, pricing, and destination GTM priorities so hotels are fully integrated into the end-to-end guest journey, from awareness and planning through booking, stay, and return.

The Head, Hotel Commercial Strategy acts as the primary UDX commercial executive partner to Loews, co-developing strategies, influencing investment priorities, and ensuring hotel commercial objectives are clearly represented, aligned, and delivered through centralized activation teams and JV operating structures.

MAJOR RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Commercial Strategy & GTM Leadership
    • Sets and leads the long-range commercial strategy for the on-site hotel portfolio, including transient, group, and emerging demand segments, to achieve annual and multi-year revenue and profitability targets.
    • Translates portfolio-level brand, audience, pricing, and commercial product strategies into hotel-specific GTM plans, demand strategies, and investment priorities.
    • Develops and presents the annual Hotel GTM Plan to Joint Venture partners, including demand forecasts, revenue projections, strategic choices, and recommended areas of commercial investment.
    • Partners with Destination GTM leadership to align hotel strategies with broader destination priorities, in-year performance goals, and growth opportunities.
  • Revenue Management & Commercial Performance
    • Owns hotel revenue management strategy, including pricing, inventory, channel mix, and yield strategies to maximize total revenue performance.
    • Partners with Pricing and Commercial Product teams to shape offer architecture, packaging, bundling, and hotel + ticket products that strengthen conversion and profitability.
    • Establishes performance targets and monitors KPIs across segments, channels, and properties, driving continuous optimization and clear accountability for results.
    • Brings an enterprise view of commercial performance, balancing hotel objectives with broader destination and portfolio priorities.
  • Integration Across the Guest Journey
    • Ensures each hotel brand maintains a distinct and compelling market position while contributing to the overall destination value proposition.
    • Integrates hotels into the end-to-end guest journey across awareness, planning, booking, pre-arrival, stay, and return/repeat engagement.
    • Partners with technology, commerce, marketing activation, and JV teams to enable seamless booking, merchandising, cross-sell, and upsell opportunities across direct and third-party channels.
    • Drives alignment between hotel communications and the broader omnichannel ecosystem to deliver a consistent and connected guest experience.
  • Joint Venture Partnership & Stakeholder Leadership
    • Serves as the senior UDX commercial liaison to Loews Hotels & Co., including executive-level engagement with Loews leadership and on-property operations teams.
    • Co-develops joint strategies to optimize performance across the hotel portfolio while respecting JV governance and operating structures.
    • Represents hotel commercial priorities in UDX senior leadership forums and ensures alignment across internal and external stakeholders.
    • Influences across a matrixed environment, bringing clarity to ownership, decision rights, trade-offs, and execution priorities.
  • Commercial Programs & Growth Initiatives
    • Identifies and leads growth initiatives that drive incremental demand, including packages, partnerships, market-specific strategies, and new commercial platforms.
    • Supports the integration of new experiences, events, and commercial products into hotel offerings to enhance value and drive conversion.
    • Collaborates with New Ventures and Product Strategy teams to ensure scalability, repeatability, and readiness for future destination growth.
    • Anticipates white-space opportunities and builds business cases that connect guest value, operational feasibility, and commercial return.
  • Data, Insights & Continuous Improvement
    • Leverages data, analytics, guest insights, competitive intelligence, and market signals to inform strategy, optimize performance, and anticipate shifts in demand.
    • Establishes a disciplined test-and-learn agenda to continuously improve pricing, offers, channel mix, merchandising, and guest engagement strategies.
    • Monitors macroeconomic, competitive, and travel industry trends to proactively adjust strategies and inform executive decision-making.
  • Team Leadership & Culture
    • Leads and develops a high-performing commercial team across marketing, sales, and revenue management disciplines.
    • Builds senior-level capability, accountability, and collaboration across direct reports and cross-functional partners.
    • Fosters a culture of strategic rigor, commercial ownership, continuous improvement, and strong team engagement.
  • Understands and actively participates in Environmental, Health & Safety responsibilities by following established UO policy, procedures, training, and team member involvement activities.
  • Performs other duties as assigned.

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelors degree in Marketing, Business, Communications, or related field required
  • MBA or equivalent advanced degree preferred; equivalent senior leadership experience will be considered

EXPERIENCE:

  • 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in hotel commercial strategy, sales, marketing, revenue management, and/or enterprise hospitality growth strategy
  • Significant experience managing multi-property or enterprise-scale hotel portfolios and leading senior cross-functional teams
  • Demonstrated success driving material revenue growth through integrated commercial strategies, executive-level alignment, and disciplined performance management
  • Experience building commercial strategies that integrate hotels with theme parks, experiences, packages, loyalty, and direct-to-consumer channels preferred
  • Experience working within or alongside joint venture, ownership, or strategic partnership structures required; hospitality ownership or operator partnership experience strongly preferred

ADDITIONAL INFORMATION:

  • Deep commercial acumen across pricing, distribution, revenue management, marketing, sales, and guest engagement
  • Deep understanding of hospitality, travel demand drivers, hotel brand positioning, and destination-based commercial models
  • Ability to influence at the executive level across a complex, matrixed organization and external partner ecosystem
  • Strategic enterprise thinking with the ability to translate ambiguity into clear choices, aligned plans, and measurable execution
  • Strong analytical judgment, financial orientation, and data-driven decision-making skills
  • High executive presence with exceptional communication, storytelling, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills

Your talent, skills and experience will be rewarded with a competitive compensation package.

If you hold aP&C license, this is your opportunity to join Liberty Mutuals Inside Sales team and take the next step in a rewarding, growth-focused career. We are also welcoming unlicensed candidates who are ready to begin their insurance journey with free P&C license training and paid training time.

Key Dates:

  • Licensed Class: January 11, 2027
  • Unlicensed Class: January 25, 2027

Start your journey with us and build a career where your talent and passion for helping others truly make an impact.

As an Inside Sales Representative at Liberty Mutual, youll have the tools, training and support you need to succeed from day one.

Plus, youll enjoy:

  • Generous earning potential
  • Paid licensing and training opportunities
  • Comprehensive benefits
  • Flexible work arrangements
  • Strong work-life balance
  • And more!

Why Liberty Mutual?

Pay Details:

  • Starting base salary is $45K with opportunity for growth.
  • Average earnings range from $55K-$75K through a combination of base salary and generouscommission.
  • Top Performing Agents in their second year and onward, can earn up to $85k+.

We are currently hiring quality Inbound sales professionals in the following states:AR, AZ, FL, GA, IA, ID, IN, KS, LA, MA, MD, ME, MI, MN, MO, NC, NE, NH, NJ, NM, NV, NY, OH, OR, PA, SC, TX, UT, VA, WA, WI, andWV

Licensed only candidates based in ID, MT, WY, GA, TN, AL, OK, KS and KY Applicants must reside within these specified locations to be considered for this role.

Positivity. Flexibility. Determination and a persuasive personality. Qualities like these cannot be taught. But they can be sharpened, strengthened, and appropriately compensated when you join Liberty Mutual Insurance as a part of our Contact Center Sales Organization. Bring your unique sales talent to our Fortune 100 company and receive paid-training, licensing in all 50 states, and a dynamic role that directs only warm leads your way (no cold calls) because we believe in supporting your success, not holding it back. Join our sales team and realize the rewards of a career with unlimited earning potential, generous commissions, and a portfolio of benefits that start on day one.

Job Details

As an Inside Sales Agent you will be handling inbound calls and warm leads, consulting with customers on their insurance needs and match the correct coverages, products, and benefits to convert sales leads into policyholders.

Due to state licensing restrictions, employees must remain in their resident state for at least one year before relocating.

Youd be a great fit if you are:

A Passionate Seller:When a lead comes in, you skillfully pick up the phone and use your sales expertise to turn prospects into happy, confident Liberty Mutualpolicyholders.

A Front Lines Liaison:You rise to the role of representing the Liberty brand, you believe in what youre selling, and you enjoy connecting customers to the right products for their individual needs.

A Reliable Teammate:Whether you work at the office or from home, you adapt well to different environments, schedules, and the varying needs of ourpolicyholders.

A Customer-Centric Closer:While sales is in your title, integrity is in your nature. That means you sincerely care that our customers get exactly the quality products and services they need to embrace today and confidently pursue tomorrow.

Position Details:

From day one you will begin paid training in a remote work environment. All insurance representatives need to hold a Property & Casualty Insurance license. If you do not have one, no worries, paid training also includes licensing!

  • Training extends over a period of 16 weeks for licensed hires and 18 weeks for unlicensed hires.
  • Comprehensive medical benefits from Day 1.
  • No cold calls, all incoming warm leads.
  • Opportunities for rewards and recognition.

  • Must be available to work a schedule of 4 weekdays and 1 weekend day. Standard shift is 11:30-8 EST, 12:30-9 CST, or 8:30-5 PST.

  • All computer equipment is provided. Youmust be able to maintain department.Work at home (W@H) requirements whichinclude a professional workspace/room with adedicated desk and wired (cable, fiber of DSLservice) high-speed internet connection with aminimum 100 MBps download speed and 20MBps upload speed. Liberty Mutual does notsupport satellite and mobile internet services.
Qualifications
  • 2-3 years sales experience preferred. 2 yearsof sales/service-related work experiencerequired.
  • Strong, engaging interpersonal and persuasion skills needed to close sales
  • Ability to communicate well to both prospects and customers
  • Excellent analytical, decision-making and organizational skills
  • Strong typing capabilities and PC proficiency
  • Property and Casualty License required afterhire.
About Us

Pay Philosophy: The typical starting salary range for this role isdeterminedbya number offactors including skills, experience, education,certificationsand location. The full salary range for this role reflects the competitive labor market value for all employees in these positions across the national market andprovidesan opportunity to progress as employees grow and develop within the role. Some roles at Liberty Mutual have a corresponding compensation plan which may include commission and/or bonus earnings at rates that vary based on multiple factorsset forth inthe compensation plan for the role.

This comes to life through comprehensive benefits, workplace flexibility, professional development opportunities, and a host of opportunities provided through our Employee Resource Groups. Each employee plays a role in creating our inclusive culture, which supports every individual to do their best work. Together, we cultivate a community where everyone can make a meaningful impact for our business, our customers, and the communities we serve.

We value your hard work, integrity and commitment to make things better, and we put people first by offering you benefits that support your life and well-being. To learn more about our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.libertymutualgroup.com/about-lm/careers/benefits

What Is the Opportunity?

As an Associate Claim Rep, Auto Express, you will receive comprehensive training in claim handling, customer service, and policy interpretation while working alongside experienced claim professionals. This position focuses on developing your skills and knowledge to successfully manage personal insurance claims involving various types of automobiles and property damage. This role involves frequent customer interactions through telephone and written communications. This program is typically 8-12 months and upon successful completion of this program, you will have the skills needed to handle claims independently and progress toward full claims handling responsibility.

What Will You Do?

  • Actively participate in structured training classes covering insurance policies, specific claim processes, systems, and procedures, including virtual, classroom, and on-the-job training.
  • Assess coverage to determine compensability.
  • Investigate by gathering information from policyholders and claimants to verify the facts of loss.
  • Assess coverage and bring claim to resolution with accurate payment in a timely manner.
  • Communicate and apprise all parties regarding claim status.
  • Maintain accurate records of claim activity in claim management systems.
  • Adapt to new technology implementations, system upgrades, and digital tool rollouts, particularly in the areas of AI while maintaining productivity and service quality.
  • Acquire and maintain relevant Insurance License(s) to comply with state and Travelers' requirements within three months of starting the job.
  • Perform other duties as assigned.

  • Bachelor's Degree.
  • Previous internship or work experience in customer service or insurance.
  • Willingness to obtain an active adjuster license where required by state law.

  • Exceptional customer service skills and commitment to providing a positive experience for insureds and claimants.
  • Attention to detail and organizational skills; ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize effectively.
  • Basic conflict resolution skills; willingness to learn techniques for facilitating productive discussions and negotiations.
  • Demonstrate openness to continuous learning.

  • High School Diploma or GED and one year of customer service experience.

  • Health Insurance: Employees and their eligible family members - including spouses, domestic partners, and children - are eligible for coverage from the first day of employment.
